tei:div.tei:p: /ra gangs grong gi jiXkha /da/nga po)'ju skal bzang /cho1 zu mi cal gyi gtam bad/ gangs zhun/—7331 — —— — rte tho—— rabs gsum gyi ji lam/ stag 'bum rgyal/tsā / khyi tsho nga sa yong cha nen/ snyeratshubar kheng rkyang bkuchuno ༷༷ci/ ci ci 1 du ba zid/ pad ma tshe brtan/ yu ༷ /cho ci bkra bhas brtsams/0 — — — 6 ji 4lta ci nga —— 45ci mi ga zi rna snyi 'ici — — ——6 ci zhung ༄du byung ro
ri — — ci rdo— — —— sna — rwa rim rnya kyi sgyu — — — —

dpe skrun gsal bshad/dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs80pa'i rjes su/ bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig gsar rtsom ni dbyar gyi mtsho mo rgyas pa bzhin gong du 'phel ba'i rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dus skabs shig la bslebs/ phyogs yongs dang 'bus sgo tshang ba'i ngang skabs de'i bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom gyi rnam pa dang chu tshad mngon par mtshon slad/ nged dpe skrun khang gis1991lo dang2001lor snga gzhug byas nas bod kyi deng rabs rtsom rig dpe tshogs〉(pod bcu)dang 〈snang char lo 'khor20dpe tshogs〉(pod brgyad)zhes pa gnyis par sgrun byas pas spyi tshogs su gdeng 'jog cung legs po thob/ dus rabs21par bslebs pa na/ bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom la sngar byung ma myong ba'i 'phel rgyas kyi gnas tshul legs po byung ste/ dus rabs gong ma'i lo rabs80pa'i smad tsam la rtsom stegs su bud pa'i rtsom pa po skor zhig la mtshon na/ dus rabs gsar ba'i nang du'ang sngar bzhin dungs pa'i tshor rlabs mkha' la 1

'phyo zhing rtsom pa'i rgyun la nyams pa med par/ 'bras bu'i khur gyis dud pa'i gsar rtsom dang shugs rkyen gyi nus pa srung 'dzin byas thog su mthud du rang nyid la yar skyed chen po 'byung du bcug ste brtsams chos gsar ba mang bo 'don spel gnang 'dug khong tsho ni bsam gzhig gtong la mkhas shing 'tshol rtog byed la rings pas/ brtsams chos kyi bsam blo'i snying bo sngar las phun sum tshogs pa dang / spyi tshogs kyi don snying mngon pa sngar las gting zab pa/ sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos sngar las gsal zhing gsar bas/ klog pa po'i khrod shugs rkyen cher 'phel ba dang bstun nas/ bod kyi rtsom rig gsar rtsom dpung khag gi lam sna 'khrid mkhan du gyur 'dug de las kyang dga' 'os pa zhig la/ dus rabs gsar ba'i gom 'gros dang bstun nas bsam blo'i 'khyug shed che zhing gsar gtod kyi blo spobs ldan la/ lta rgya dang thos rgya che ba'i rtsom pa po gsar ba skor zhig char rjes kyi sha mo brdol ba bzhin rtsom stegs kyi gru ga so sor mngon te/ bod kyi rtsom rig dpung sde'i rgyun 'dzin mkhan du grub pas/ bod kyi rtsom rig gom gang mdun spos kyis 'phel rgyas 'gro bar nus stobs gsar ba bsnan par gyur/dus rabs gsar ba'i bod kyi rtsom pa po'i gsar rtsom gyi grub 'bras phyogs yongs nas mngon par mtshon ched/ nga tshos dus rabs21pa'i bod kyi rtsom pa po'i deb phreng〉zhes pa 'di rtsom sgrig par skrun bya rgyu thag gis bcad/deb phreng de'i nang du dus rabs gsar ba'i tshun la grub 'bras mngon gsal thod cing / khyad chos 'bur du thon pa/ klog pa po'i khrod shugs rkyen cung che 2

ba'i rtsom pa po dag dmigs su bzung ste/ khong tsho'i brtsams chos la sgo kun nas gsod shad dang phyogs bsdus byas thog legs pa'i legs pa bdams nas par skrun bya rgyu yin/ de ni rnam pa cung rgya che ba'i par skrun 'char gzhi zhig yin nges na/ nga tshos2009lo nas mgo brtsams te lo rer rtsom pa po gsum nas lnga'i bar gyi brtsams chos bdams te/ lo lnga yas mas kyi dus yun nang deb phreng de rtsom sgrig par skrun byed pa'i 'char gzhi mjug 'gril bar bya rgyu bcas so// zhes sprang char〉rtsom sgrig khang gis/2009lo'i zla6par/
dkar chagasrin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/ (1)ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha/ (88)'tshub ma kher rkyang / (195)lam (245)mjug byang / (274)

srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/srin po g.yu sngag dang nyi ma lha sa/6 a ye/ gnam na lha dang lha mo yod na/ ngas gcig kyang mi rig pa ci yin/‘ mi 6 a ye/ shod ya/ ngas lha mi rig pa ci yin/ gcod log gis rtse ra nas nor lug rnams par 'ded tshur 'ded byed bzhin yun ring la bsam gzhig byas pa'i don de a ye la dris pa na/a ye sgrol mas dmigs pa rtse gcig la bsdus nas kha ton 'don pa las tshig gcig kyang ma bshad pas/ kho la 'dzem bag ci yang med par yar langs nas a ye sgrol ma'i phu thung la 'jus te/ stobs shugs chen pos g.yas 'ben g.yon 'ben byas/6 nga'i gces phrug pra tshag byed mi nyan/mi 6 min/ mi bshad na pra tshag byed rgyu yin/mi gcod log gis /ra

'tshub ma kher rkyang /bzhin stobs shugs chen pos phu thung nas g.yas 'ben g.yon 'then byas/6 ya ya/ ci zhig bshad dgos/mi smyo gnam na lha dang lha mo yod na/ ngas gcig kyang mi rig pa ci yin/mi zu 'u gnyis kur lha dang lha mo rig pa'i bsod nams med/ 6 bsod nams zer ba a pa'i rgyang mthong 'dra ba zhig yin nam/mi tsa bsod nams a ye sgrol mas bsod nams kyi go don gsal bor shes rung / bshad bsam na ji ltar bshad dgos pa mi shes pas/ glo bur du khros te/ gcod log gi sog rgyab nas bzung ste pang la bsnyel rjes/ rkub ngos la thal lcag tsha thag chod pa gnyis gzhus te tshubasod nams zer ba 'di red mices bshad/gcod log 'phag ra 'ga' byas te myur mor yar langs nas a ye sgrol ma'i gdong la bltas pa na/ mo khros te ngo mdangs kyang 'gyur 'dug par ma zad/ da dung mchu sgros kyang lhab lhab 'dar bzhin yod pas/ thog mar had nas cung tsam bsdad/ de nas ngu 'bod byed bzhin de'u 'bur las mar babs/ par bltas na a mar gtug bsher la 'gro rtsis yod pa 'dra/kho lo bdun la son kyang ha cang rgod po yin pas ma rabs ji ltar byas kyang /a ye dang pha mas tshig gcig kyang mi bshad pas/ gcar rdung gi bro ba zer ba de ji lta bu zhig yin pa gtan nas mi shes/tsha bo'i ngu skad kyis a ye sgrol ma gnyid las dkrogs pa ltar yid 2

zin po ga rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/sems skad cig nyid la gsal lhang nger song zhing sngar byas la 'gyod pa skyes/lhag par gcod log ri ngos las mar 'bab skabs kyi rgyab gzugs mthong ma thag tshe las 'das pa'i khyo ga'i snang brnyan yid la shar bas/ sems la zug gzer 'ga' langs shing / mig chu rdog po 'ga' mkhur ngos las gril/mo'i khyo ga'i ming la 'jam dbyangs tshe brtan zer/ tshe gcig lus gcig la skyid til 'bru tsam yang rig ma myong rung / nam yang sdug snang med par 'dzum dmul dmul gyis 'tsho ba rol pa zhig yin/ gal srid kho med na/ a ye sgrol ma'i pha ma gnyis na'i bem po pha yul la 'dren thabs med la/ a lags mkha' lding tshang gi gdung mchod la gra sgrig byas pa'i gser dngul rnams kyang dbus lam nas bor brlag 'byung nges/ a ye sgrol mas drin chen la drin lan gzo ched/ rang gi snying grogs bskyur te kho'i chung ma byas pa yin/nyi ma sprin 'og nas thar te gdug rtsub che ba'i 'od zer de slar yang sa gzhi la gtor bas/ bar med du grag pa'i cha ga ba rnams kyang dal cag ger gyur/ nyi 'od thog tu a ye sgrol ma'i skra tho re ba las med pa'i spyi gtsug la thog mar tsha lam lam byas shing cung tsam 'gor rjes zug gzer zhig langs/par lang bzhin dbugs ring zhig 'then rjes/ gcod log gis rtse ra nang na spra nag byas yod pa'i mgo dkri kham nag de blangs nas sprug tsam byas te mgo la bkab pa dang / de nas slar yang nub phyogs kyi ri rtse la cer /sa

'tshub ma kher rkyang / —yud tsam bsdad/ ri bo'i 'dabs na lam phran kya ma kyog cig 'dug pa de ni mdo smad kyi mi rnams nyi ma lha sar 'gro na nges par du brgyud dgos pa'i dbus lam g.yung drung rang 'khyil zhes pa de yin la/ mi dad pa can dang bsod nams can ci 'dra mang po zhig lam phran der zhugs nas dbus la song yod pa sus kyang bshad mi thub/ 'on kyang / sde ba 'di'i mi rnam sa a myes g.yu rngog gi phrag dog la 'jigs nas/ lam phran de la zhugs nas dbus gtsang dag pa'i zhing la 'gro phod mkhan gcig kyang med/ glo bur du/mo'i yid la rang gi pha ma 'khor dang bcas pa dbus lam nas 'das pa'i don ngan de shar bas/ am gcigs bsdams shing mgo bo 'phred du g.yug bzhin sar bsdad/a ye sgrol ma yod sa'i de'u 'bur chung chung de kho tshang gi lug lhas dang thag mi ring mod/ lo bcu lhag gi ring la mo thengs gcig la'ang 'gos ma myong / mdang dgong bu dang mna' ma gnyis nas gcig rgyab gcig gis mnan nas mo la khong khro de 'dra bslangs pas/ da nangs zhogs ja 'thungs rjes/ rngam ston byed ched tsha bo gcod log rjes la khrid de de'u 'bur klad la 'gos pa yin/ mo rang lo na tshod kyis thub ste 'gro 'dug stabs bde min pa'i dus nas bzung / mi tshe la sdom tshig gsar ba zhig rnyed pa ni/ da ni rang don dngos la 'bad pa'i dus la bab byung snyam ste/ nam rgyun snga mo dus ltar mal las langs nas kha lag bkrus rjes/ ya phugs kyi mchod khri'i steng 4

wa wa srin po g.yu rdzog dang nyi ma lha sa/la mchod pa bshams shing / rang gis shes pa'i bla ma rnams la snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba 'debs bzhin phyag brgya dang brgyad 'tshal nges yin/ nyin zas thun gsum gyi rjes su/ spra nag gi sgo phyar 'og tu bsdad nas kha ton bton pa na/ mgron po gal chen gnam 'dra phebs rung yar mi lang ba dang / bya ba gal chen thog 'dra byung rung nyams snang sru tsam yang med/da lo dbyar kha sde ba'i rgan pa 'ga' mnyam du lha sar 'gro rtsis byas pas/ gsar 'gyur dang 'khrug rtsod ci yang med par dal cag ger gnas pa'i 'brog sde de zang zing lang long du bsgyur/ kho tsho las mang che ba bcings 'grol byas rjes gung khran tang la zhugs pa'i tang yon rgan pa sha stag yin la/rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su/ la las mang tshogs sngon thon pa rnams kyi sne drangs nas mkha' lding dgon pa rmang nas bshig pa dang gtsug lag thams cad chu la bskyur/ chos lugs srid jus slar gso byas rjes/ sngar byas la 'gyod pa skyes nas dgon pa bskyar bzhengs dang sprul sku 'tshol ba sogs la 'bad pa lhod med byas / da skabs tshe phyi ma'i don la a myes g.yu rngog gi phrag dog la'ang tshod blta byed phod/ mi sems kyi 'gyur ldog nam mkha'i glog dang mtshungs zhes pa 'di lta bu zhig ma yin nam/a ye sgrol mas chung dus ma gtogs go ma myong ba'i 'phrin bzang de go rjes/ sems la 'tshub cha langs te nyin mo'i zas dang mtshan mo'i gasdud

'tshub ma kher rkyang /brjed/ mos sgo phyar 'og tu kha ton 'don dus/ mig zung sngar bzhin btsums yod rung / dmigs pa gzhi gcig la gtad nas gnas mi thub/mig lam du 'bag sku ha cang mang ba'i dgon pa mang po gcig 'phror gcig shar yong / de dag las gang zhig jo khang dang gang zhig bsam yas/ gang zhig se 'bras dge gsum yin pa dbye mi thub mod/ mig lam la yang yang shar ba'i brnyan ris sna tshogs kyis mo'i sems pa dbang med du phrogs nas dbus la 'gro 'dod kyi bsam pas kun nas bslangs shing / blo stobs kyang nyin re bzhin je che nas je cher gyur/nyin de'i nyin gung / a ye sgrol mas tsha bo'i kha nas a khu klu skyabs kyis rdo dkar gtsang 'gram na lug 'tshos yod pa go ba na/ blo sgo skad cig la phye ste dga' spro chen po byung / rang gi mig snga'i bsam tshul de bde blag ngang nas mngon 'gyur byed ched gsang stabs kyis phyi la song /zu khyod gang la 'gro rtsis yin/mi a khu klu skyabs kyis a ye sgrol ma mthong ma thag myur mor yar langs te ngo mtshar ba'i ngang nas de ltar dris/smyo khyod btsal nas yong ba yin/ 6 'o de red/mi a khu klu skyabs deng thog grog shur chung chung zhig tu bsdad yod mod/a ye sgrol ma dang mnyam du sngar bzhin grog shur de la 'dzul na/ sde mi rnams kyis mi bshad dgu bshad byed srid snyam ste/ dal ba dal bur kun 6

srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/gyis rig sa'i ri ngos la 'gos pa dang / a ye sgrol mas kho'i bsam tshul rtogs te ci yang mi bshad par kho'i rjes su 'brangs nas ri ngos la 'gos/zu khyod lha sar 'gro rgyu yin nam/mi a khu klu skyabs kyis a ye sgrol ma'i yong don shes pas sems la 'tshub cha chen po langs/ gal srid mo 'gog thabs ma byas na/ a ye dkar skyid kyis dbus lam nas kho la bya ba yag po zhig las mi srid/ a ye sgrol ma'i blo kha bsgyur ched/ a khu klu skyabs kyis gdong la 'jigs snang dang sdug bsngal 'dres pa'i nyams 'gyur bcos ma zhig bsdus te ci yang mi bshad par kha rog ger bsdad/smyo khyod lha sar 'gro rgyu yin nam/mi 6 min/ nga lha sar 'gro mi thub/ gcig na a skyes g.yu rngog la phrag dog che bas dbus lam nas thar ba'i re ba med/ gnyis na da lo phyugs kyi 'phel kha dang tshong gi yong 'bab mi bzang bas/ sgor mo de tsam 'khyer rgyu med/mi khos a ye sgrol ma'i gdong la lta tsam byas rjes sems khur gyi nyams shig bstan te rab yin na khyod kyang ma 'gro/ nyi ma lha sa na'ang mkha' lding dgon pa las lhag pa'i dgon sde zhig med ces bshad/a ye sgrol ma ngo mtshar ba'i ngang nas a khu klu skyabs kyi gdong la cer/chung dus su khyim tshang gnyis ka nam rgyun khyim mtshes yin pas/ kho gnyis la gcig ngor gcig gis bltas nas nar son pa dang / gcig sems gcig 7

'tshub ma kher rkyang /la 'dris nas khyim gcig la smon lam 'debs pa'i skal ba byung / gsar bu yin pa'i skabs su/ a khu klu skyabs kyi dpral ngos na nag thig cig yod pa ma gtogs/ yag pho sgo 'dzoms shing gtam kha lce yod pa'i gzhon nu yid du 'ong ba zhig yin/ lo na tshod nas pa dang bstun nas gdong yongs gnyer mas khebs shing sha mdangs kyang nag por gyur te dpral ngos kyi nag thig de'ang mi gsal bar gyur/ a ye sgrol mas yud tsam la cer ba na/ kho'i ngo gdong rim bzhin skya bor gyur cing / thod pa'i nag thig de rim bzhin je gsal nas je ba/sal la song / khos dogs mi bde ba'i ngang nas rum gyi tha mag bag cha phyed ka de blangs shing / lag pa 'dar bzhin du rkang gcig la me bsgron rjes / shed kyis brngubs te shugs ring zhig dang mnyam du kha nas du ba sngo lhos/ lhog 'phyur/ 6klu skyabs/ khyod ngo ma lha sar mi 'gro'am/mi rgyu nga ngo ma 'gro mi thub/ nga'i tshig brtsi na khyod kyang ma 'gro/mi smyo rdzun ma bshad/ nyi ma lha sar 'gro ba'i jus gzhi 'don mkhan khyod ma yin nam/mi zir nga'i kha nas mi bshad pa ci/ ngo ma a myes g.yu rngog la skrag nas 'gro dka/6rdo sngon khyod pha bu gnyis po'i sems kyi 'char sgo ma shes pas/ khyod kyi ḍi ma lta bu'i tshig la yid ches te chung dus pha ma dang mnyam du lha sar 'gro

wa srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/ma thub/ 〉 mo shugs kyis yar langs te gom pa 'ga' spos rjes/ glo bur du kha phyir 'khor te klu skyabs thod nag sa skyes g.yu dzog la rtsam khug cig gis ci byed/ khyod lha sar ma song na khyi lha sar ma song ba red/ nga mi 'gro na dkon mchog gsum zhes bshad de phyir bltas med par bud song /gyis pa ni ngo ma byi pa red/ gcod log la a ye sgrol mas thal lcag gis de tsam gzhus rjes/ ngu 'bod byed bzhin a mar gtug bsher byed du song mod/ a ma a ye sgrol ma'i phyogs nas langs te/ zhi drag zung 'brel gyi thabs la brten nas kho la slob gso legs po btang ba na/ rkub kyi na zug dang sems kyi sdug bsngal gar song cha med du gyur/ khos bag leb phyed ka zhig la so 'debs bzhin de'u 'bur ngos la dal ba dal bur 'go dus/a khu ban de skyabs tshang gi rin chen don grub kyang der slebs pas/ gnyis gas gcig gis gcig la ma rabs bca' bzhin a ye sgrol ma'i gam la song /4 a ye/ khong khro zhi yod dam/ nga khyod kyi 'dug rogs la yong ba yin/mi gcod log gis a ye la ngo dga' byed ched 'dzum dmul dmul gyis de ltar bshad pa na/ mo'i sems kyi sdug bsngal de cung tsam zhi bar gyur/ gal srid a myes g.yu rngog dang bu mna' ma rnams min na/ rang nyid da lo'i ston kha lha sar sleb thub la/ de ring 'dir yong nas 'u thug pa'i mchi ma khog la mid dgos don med/ sems gzhan la g.yeng ched mos tsha bo'i lag ma/ra

'tshub ma kher rtsang /'jus te rtse ra'i 'gram la song nas bsdad/ca 'di/ 'u cag gi mgo spra/ mos mgo dkri blangs te byis pa gnyis ga'i lag la bzhag/ a ye/ khyod kyi mgo bo na na ci bya/mi 6 skyon med/ skyon med/ khyod kyi rkub na'am/ a ye hon log gis rjes su mi gcar kho thag yin/mi byis pa gnyis nas skud sne 'ga' chon thag byas shing / spen mas ka ba dang phur ba las te spra nag chung chung de legs par phub pa dang / myur mor nye 'gram nas ril ma dang de'u dkar 'ga' btus te rtse mgo brtsams/ a ye sgrol mas bltas kyin bltas kyin byis pa'i dus kyi 'tsho ba de dran pas/lag pas ril ma 'ga' btus te 4'di nged tshang gi nor khyu yin zer bzhin nor rdzir 'gro khul byas/6 a ye sgrol ma/ khyod tshang nyi ma lha sar 'gro rtsis yod dam/’ rin chen don grub kyis dgos med kyi dri ba de 'dra bton pas/ a ye sgrol ma'i spro snang skad cig la yal cing / sems la 'dug mi bzod pa'i 'tshub cha zhig langs/6 lha sa na ci yod/mi gcod log gis de ltar dris/6 lha sa na lha dang lha mo yod/mi 6 lha dang lha mo gnam na yod pa min nam/mi 10

srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/tsa nga tsho'i lha dang lha mo gnam na yod/ lha sa'i lha dang lha mo sa na yod/nyi ma lha sa'i byis pa rnams thog rdzir 'gro dus/ lha la gshog pa g.yar nas gnam la 'phur chog zer/mi 6 a ye/ rin chen don grub kyi skad cha de bden nam/mi a ye sgrol mas ci ying mi bshad par yar langs te gom pa 'ga' spos rjes/ krong nger langs nas srin po g.yu rngog gi ri rtse la bltas/ da skabs pha ma gnyis ka a myes g.yu rngog gi 'khor na skyes yod pas/ nyi ma lha sar 'gro ba'i skal ba nam yang yod mi srid la/ gal srid rang nyid dbus la 'gro ma thub na/ pha ma'i re ba de jo bo yid bzhin nor bu la zhu mkhan med pa kho thag yin/ da lta'i phyi rabs pa 'di tshos chos la mi gces srog la gces/srog la mi gces rgyu la gces/ rang don rang gis ma bsgrubs tshe kho tshor re ba ni 'ja' tshon gos su 'dod pa dang gnyis su ma mchis/ 'on kyang /las rgyu 'bras dang mthun pa'i skad cha zhig bshad na/ rang gi bu dang mna' ma gnyis ka ya rabs gshis bzang gnyis yin/ mos bsams shing bsams shing a myes g.yu rngog la sdang sems skyes pa dang / o rgyan rin po che la'ang 'khang ra byas/ yud tsam gyi rjes su rang gis gzhi bdag dang sangs rgyas la dad log byed bzhin yod pa rtogs te/ slob dpon la gsol ba 'debs bzhin gnas ri'i phyogs la phyag gsum btsal/a ye sgrol ma yod sa'i de'u 'bur chung chung de la jag pa lam nyal zer 11

'tshub ma kher rkyang /zhing / brag dmar khyung mgon gyi nang 'khor zhig gnyan chen thang lhar jag la 'gro skabs/ lam nas gnyid de nam langs pas/ gnas 'di nas gtan du lus par bshad/ jag pa lam nyal nas lho phyogs su spyi le gsum tsam la song na yongs su grags pa'i rdo dkar gtsang po yod pa dang / gtsang po'i pha rol gyi rtsa ba nags dang rtse mo brag las grub pa'i ri rab 'jigs yer ba de la srin po g.yu rngog zer/ ri sked na me tog dkar lam mer 'dug pas thag ring nas bltas na gos dar dkar po zhig 'then pa dang kun nas mtshungs/ sngon slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas bod la phebs nas bdud rigs dang 'dre srin ma lus dam la 'dogs dus/ ri de'i gnas bdag srin po g.yu rngog bar skabs su 'dul ba'i dus la ma slebs pas de ltar bskur ba red/ de nas lo brgya phrag 'ga' 'gor ba'i rjes su/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen mo mkha' sding o rgyan 'phrin las 'jigs med chos kyi rdo rje tshang rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar gnas skor la phebs skabs/ srin po g.yu rngog gis yul 'di mya ngam thang du bsgyur yod pa mthong bas spyan chab dbang med du shor/ khong gis 'gro ba kun gyi bde sdug la dmigs nas/ ri rtse nas phyi bltas dmag gi btsan rdzong / nang bltas rgyal po'i pho brang dang 'dra ba'i lab rtse chen po zhig bstan nas gnas bdag a myes g.yu rngog zhi ba'i thabs kyis chos 'og tu btsud/ yin na yang gnas bdag de phrag dog shin tu che ste kho rang gcig pu bkur ba las yul lha gzhi bdag gzhan la mchod pa dang 12

srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/gnas gzhan la mjal bar song na gnod pa skyel nges/ lhag par du rjes su lha sar mjal skor la 'gro ba'i mi rnams lam nas bgegs bar chad gang mang byung bas/ ri de'i nye 'khor gyi mang tshogs tshang mas a myes g.yu rngog gi //sa ma dgyes pa red snyam nas lha sar mjal skor la 'gro mkhan shin tu mkha' mo mtsho skya rengs dang po dang mnyam du mal las langs rjes/thog mar 'dur ma rgyug gis bzhon ma rnams bzhos/ de nas 'dur ma rgyug gis 'o ja mngar mo zhig bskol cing / rta mgrin tshe ring dang mgon po rgyal gnyis gar nangs ja blud de zog rdzir mngags pa na/ nyi ma ri rtse nas dal gyis mkha' la 'phags pas/ ston gyi mkha' dbugs 'khyag pa de la drod thig tsam bsnan byung / sngar yin na/ a ye sgrol ma mal las langs te mchod pa gshom bzhin pa'i skabs yin mod/ de ring mgo rum la bcug ste 'gul rgyu dang 'phag rgyu ci yang med par nyal 'dug de ni nyin 'di dag la de'u 'bur steng la 'gos te nyin gang bor rang gis rang la zhe sdang bslangs pas/ lus zungs zad cing a thang chad pa'i rkyen yin shas che/ mo rang lo na chung dus/ hab cha dang ku res nyi ma re re bsu zhing / dka' sdug ci 'dra byung rung gdong la sdug nyams shig gtan nas 'char mi srid/ thog mar a myes 'jam dbyangs tshe brtam/ mtho ris po de'i chung ma byed dus/ sde ba'i mi 13

'tshub ma kher rkyang /rnams kyis pha phyug po'i bu mo g.yog po'i chung ma byas na/ rtags dang ltad mo gzhug na yodami ces rang rlom dang bcas te bshad mod/ mos nam rgyun che ba la ya ya dang chung ba la yo yo zer bzhin ya rabs gshis bzang gi brtul zhugs la rol pas/ sde mi rnams kyis pho ya rabs rgyud la ma rabs med/ 'brong bre sar rgyud la mgo rdo med ces pa ci ma bden zhes mi bshad ka med byung / 'on kyang khyo ga tshe las 'das shing lo na tshod kyis thub pa dang bstun nas/ bshad rgyu dgod rgyu nyung bar ma zad/ don dag cig sgrub 'dod yod tshe mo'i bsam tshul dang ma bstun na/ srog dmar po 'ben la 'jog dgos rung u tshugs byed nges yin/ nyin 'ga'i sngon la rang nyid lha sar 'gro rtsis yod pa'i 'char gzhi de bshad pa na/ bu dang mna' ma gnyis la 'jigs snang chen po byung ste song na mi bzang ba'i skor gyi gnas lugs brgya phrag khri 'bum bshad rung / rdo thog la chu blugs pa ltar blo kha gtan nas sgyur ma thub/ mdang dgong / a khu klu skyabs tshang gi mna' ma gsar brje skyid kyi lus tril bor gzer zug langs pas/ gam gung gzur skabs dge go bos te sman bcos byed par song ste da rung phyir ma slebs/ mkha' mo mtsho gcig pus khong khro langs yod pa'i a ye sgrol ma mal las slong dka'/mo 'u thug ste 'dur ma rgyug gis mchod khri'i steng la mchod pa bshams rjes/slar yang 'dur ma rgyug gis sgo phyar 'og la song nas a ma'i tshab tu phyag btsal/ phyag dgu bcu lhag btsal ba'i skabs su/ thab kyi ong ba 'bar 14

srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/tshar te thab gnya'i ril ma mar nyil pas/ khyim hril bor du bas bkang ste dbugs kyang grub dka' bar gyur/ mkha' mo mtshos phyag 'tshal mtshams bzhag nas a mar lta tsam byas rjes/ mo khyim gyi yar snyed nas pus tsog byas te/ go khung las me cung tsam brus rjes mar bsgur te me la phu 'debs mgo brtsams/ skabs shig la lan bu 'ga' phrag kha nas thal nang la lhung ste gzhob dri chil ler song ba na/ mos rtseb thag 'di zhes sdigs bzhin g.yas lag gis lan bu phrag la g.yugs nas mu mthud du me la phu btab/rgyang ring nas sbag sbag 'khor lo'i sgra zhig je gsal nas je gsal la song ste/ rim gyis spra sgor slebs pa na grag mtshams bzhag4 phe/ du ba 'di ci red/mi dge go khyim la 'dzul yong ste lag pa g.yug bzhin a ma gang la bud thal ces dris/6 da rung langs med/ gsar bho ci 'dra red/mi dge go pho khyim gyi yar snyed nas bsdad de skyon mi 'dug dros 'khyag la song nas tsha brgyab pa red ces bshad/gcod log gis a pha yul la slebs pa shes te/ a ye sgrol ma'i rum nas yar tsog pur bsdad nas dal bur glal ging zhig byas te lag pas mig zung 'phur 'phur byed bzhin a pha/ ka ra e nyos zhes dris/6 ma nyos/ ’smyo ma nyos/ des na ngas bshad rgyu yin/mi 15

'tshub ma kher rkyang /6 ci bshad 'dod yod na shod/mi smyo khyod kyis dgong mo der a mar 6 skyag phrug 'di/mi dge gos 'tshab 'tshub kyis stod gos kyi khug ma las ka ra gnyis blangs te myur mor gcod log gi bang la g.yugs/me 'bar ba dang bstun nas khyim gyi du ba rim gyis yal/ dge gos ta len gam la drud de nang gi ja dang tshwa khu/ bro sman sogs blangs nas mkha' mo mtsho la byin rjes/ spra'i ngo thig la btags yod pa'i nyi glog gi glog sgron 'tshig ro de blangs nas bang kha'i nang la g.yugs shing / tshab la am phrag nang gi glog sgron so ma de sprad/6 a khu klu skyabs tshang na glog sgron yang yod dam/mi mkha' mo mtshos de ltar dris/6 tshe brtan 'bum gyis tshong blangs te kha sang yul la slebs pa red/tshong sna mang po 'dug dge gos ta len gyi zhabs nas ma ṇi 'khor lo zhig blangs te a ye sgrol ma'i sngas mgor song nas a ma lags/ khyod thugs rgyal ma bzhengs/thugs zhi ba'i ngang nas yar longs dang / ngas a ma drin mo che la 'tshams rtags rin thang bral ba zhig nyos yod ces bshad/a ye sgrol ma 'gul tsam byas rjes/ sngar bzhin nyal te ci yang mi ba/spya/

srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/zu a ma/ khyod la ma ṇi 'khor lo zhig dgos zhes nam rgyun bshad pas/de ring gser srang stong dang dngul srang brgya byin nas blus pa yin/mi ra khyi phrug khyod kyi sems na a ma yod dam/ ’a ye sgrol ma dal bur yar dgye ba na/ dge gos phyi thum zangs las grub pa'i ma ṇi 'khor lo chung chung zhig skor bzhin 'dzum dmul dmul gyis mor bltas 'dug pa mthong bas dga' spro tshad med skyes te ma ṇi 'khor lo phar sdiXsdu ya/ ga gi 6yag gi nga la 'dug rogs shig yod song ba red/ ’6 thar mdo'i ma ṇi red/ khyod kyi blor bab na nga'i sems bde song ba red/mi a ye sgrol ma rtsed chas legs po zhig lag la son pa'i byis pa zhig dang 'dra bar skabs rer ma ṇi skor ba dang / mtshams rer skor mtshams bzhag nas ma ṇi 'khor lo'i mgo mjug bar gsum la zhib lta byas/ dge gos tshul de mthong bas a ma/ ma ṇi 'khor lo de 'dra blus tshe lha sar ma song na e chog ces 'dri bsams mod/ a mar khong khro langs te de'u 'bur klad la 'go bar dogs nas ci yang bshad ma phod/gsar brje skyid a khu klu skyabs tshang la yong ba nas bzung / khyim1 rdong

'tshub ma kher rkyang /la bde 'jags kyi nyi ma zhig yod ma myong / mo dga' dus bza' mi rnams dang mnyam du rang gi 'dod pa ltar khyim las yang mo re las te 'gro thabs 'dug thabs tsam byed mod/ ma dga' na lus khams mi bde bar kha g.yar nas nyin gang bor lang mi srid/ a ye dkar skyid kyi zhe snang sde ba yongs la grags yod rung / phar la tshig gcig bshad na tshur la tshig gnyis bshad pa'i mna' ma la bkod pa ci yang med/ da nangs tshe brtan 'bum gyis mkha' lding dgon par tshong 'drud rtsis byed skabs/ mos kha lag gtsang mar bkrus shing shom lwa thams cad gyon te bag gsar 'dra ba zhig byas rjes 'dzum dmul dmul gyis rlangs 'khor la bud/ca khyod gang la 'gro grabs yod/mi zu mkha' lding dgon par gnas skor la 'gro dgos/mi mdang dgong / tshe brtan 'bum gyis pha ma gnyis la gces dgos pa dang khyim gyi las ka yang lci tshang ma las dgos pa'i thad kyi gnas lugs ri rab 'dra zhig brtsigs te/ mor sems zhib mos slob gso btang ba na/mos kyang sngon chad kyi 'tsho ba rol stangs dang bsam blo'i 'khyer so thams cad 'chugs 'dug pas/ rjes su mkha' mo mtsho mig dper byas te ya rabs gshis bzang gi mna' ma zhig byed par 'bad pa byed rgyu yin ces khas len dam bca' byas/ mig sngon gyi snang tshul de mthong bas/ tshe brtan 'bum gyis rang nyid g.yo 'og la tshud pa gsal ler rtogs te khong khro chen 18

srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/pos mar song / khyi rgan ma khyodami zer nas sdigs mo byed bzhin mo sar g.yugs rjes/ rlangs 'khor gyi bang sgo shugs kyis mnan te bya 'phur ba ltar kha lo bsgyur nas song / skabs der/ gsar brje skyid kyis khyo ga'i gzhug la mdzub mo btsugs te skad gsang mthon pos klu skyabs thod nag tshang gi shi shi yal yal bo zhes ki rgyangs byas pa na/ a ye dkar skyid la zhe sdang langs nas 'dug mi bzod par gyur na'ang / a khu klu skyabs kyis ci mi snyam pa'i ngang nas du ba 'then bzhin 'dug pa mthong bas/ bya thabs zad de snye mo mchan la bcir nas lci ba btu bar mi 'gro ka med byung /a khu klu skyabs kyi blo rig dang g.yo sgyu ni snga mo nas kun la grags yod rung / gsar brje skyid kyi gshis ka de la thabs bkod ci yang med/ khos yid sems gzhan la g.yeng ched/ spra'i hrag bar nas tsha ru 'ga' blangs te nor lhas 'gram nas mnyed mgo brtsams/ skabs shig la a ye dkar skyid kyis lci ba btus tshar rjes thang chad nas khyo ga'i gam la yong nas ljid tig ger bsdad/ mo'i lus ha cang rgyags pa dang glo ba'ang nad pa yin pas/dbugs 'tshangs te gdong hril bo dmar nag tu gyur par ma zad/ dpral ngos dang sog rgyab thams cad rngul chus brlan/ 6mna' ma 'di'i gam nas 'u gnyis ka 'chi mi thub kho thag red/ a shu/mi a ye dkar skyid kyis yid skyo ba'i ngang nas de skad bshad/zu bkod pa ci yod/ las dbang red/mi 19

'tshub ma kher rkyang /6 gzhan gyi mi 'grig bza' tshang thor srol yod na/ 'u tshang gi bu mna' ma gnyis ka thor na mi chog pa ci yod/me zu 'jig rten na thor mi chog pa'i bza' tshang zhig med mod/ mna' ma gsar brje skyid ni dmigs bsal can gyi bud med cig red/ mo khyim tshang 'di nas 'gro 'dod med la 'dug 'dod kyang med/ btsan dang thabs kyis sgor phud na/ mos nged pha bu gnyis gas me mda'i tshong brgyab pa de gong rim la gtug nges yin/ tshe brtan 'bum da skabs chung mar skrag pa'ang rgyu mtshan de la thug pa red/ da thengs e go thal/ gnas lugs 'di khyod la thengs brgya dang brgyad la bshad yod pa kho thag yin/mi 6 'o na ci bya/ 'di ltar 'tsho ba rol na btson khang la bcug pa dang khyad par ci yod/mi a ye dkar skyid kyis bsam blo btang gin btang gin zhe snang je che nas je cher song bas/ a khu klu skyabs myur mor yar langs nas 'gro grabs byas/ mo khong khro langs yod dus/ kha 'gul te bshad ya ma yong na lag 'gul nas 'thab ya e yong lta ba'i goms srol snga mo nas chags yod la/bza' zla gnyis gas a khu klu skyabs dang a ye sgrol ma gnyis ga'i chung dus kyi don dag de rtsod gleng byed thengs rer/ mos tshig rtsod byas te do ya ma yong na/ rtsal rgu bton te khyo ga la gcar rdung yid tshim pa zhig byed nges yin/gsar brje skyid kyis kyang lus rtsal 'gran na sgyug mo'i do ya mi yong ba shes te/20

zin po ga rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/nam rgyun khyod kyis nga'i ba spu gcig sgul phod na/ ngas tshe brtan 'bum btson khang la rdzong phod ces mor 'jigs bslangs pa dang / a ye dkar skyid kyis bu'i bde sdug bsams te mna' ma'i lus ngag yid gsum rgya yan la gtong dgos byung /a ye dkar skyid rang gi rjes la ma 'brangs pas/ a khu klu skyabs dal lhod lhod kyis pha gi'i ri ngos la 'gos/ sa cha mtho sa zhig la bud de sde ba'i mi phyugs gnyis ka gar 'gro gang 'dug la lta ba ni kho'i goms srol zhig yin la/ khos de bde skyid gcig dang sems khams gso ba'i thabs lam nyag gcig tu rtsi bzhin yod/ kho sde ba'i khyim tshang phal che ba rig sa'i pha bong chen po zhig yod pa de'i steng du skyil krung du bsdud rjes/ sde ba'i nor lugasde ba'i zog rdzi/ sde ba'i rtswa sa bcas la gcig gcig gnyis gnyis byas nas zhib lta byed mgo brtsams/ nyin bzhin de ltar bltas pas/ mig lam la don dag gsar ba zhig gtan nas 'char mi srid/ skabs shig la/ a mchod gsang sngags tshang gi mna' ma'i gam la gsar bu chung chung zhig song nas bsdad pas/ kho 'tshig pa thos te rang gi brla thog la khu tshur gyis lan 'ga' gzhus rjes/ sde ba'i mgo sbra dang zog lhas re re la bltas nas/ khyim tshang so so'i dbul phyug la tshod dpog byed bzhin stobs 'byor che chung la go rim bsgrigs pa na/ sems la dga' spro dpag med skyes byung / mug sde 'di la khyim tshang bdun cu lhag yod rung / stobs 'byor can mang po med/ a 21

'tshub ma kher rkyang /mchod gsang sngags tshang dang sde dpon 'bum lo tshang gnyis skar nor lug mang rung / thabs dang bkod pa rang nyid la gtan nas mi do/ ltos dang /'gan gtsang len gyi lam lugs lag bstar byas rjes/ klu skyabs zer ba'i rgad po rig rgod des/ zog gi phyed ka btsongs te pha bu gnyis gas tshong las gnyer/ tshong la khe bzang byung rjes nor lug mang po nyos pa dang / stong skor mkhar nas zog rdzi zhig khrid yong bas/ da skabs khyim mi gcig kyang zog rdzi byed mi dgos/ kho tshang zhing chen rlung 'phrin khang brgyud nas bod khams la dril bsgrags byas/ ltos dang / nad po klu skyabs phyug po min nam/kho tshang gis spra che chung bzhi phub yod/ dang po ni khyim tshang gi mgo spra/ gnyis pa ni bu dang mna' ma nyal sa/ gsum pa ni tshong khang / bzhi pa ni gong rim gyi las byed pa dang mgron po gal chen yong na 'dug sa/ de'i 'gram na yod pa'i rlangs 'khor de ni tshong dang khyim tshang gi skyel 'dren yo byad la nyos pa yin/ a gi nangs 'khor gang na yod/ de ring tshong drud nas dgon par bud song / ci 'dra red/ sde ba 'dir rlangs 'khor de gcig pu las med/ a khu klu skyabs kyis rang sems rang gis gsos nas bzi 'dug pa'i skabs der/ a ye dkar skyid dred mong tshang nas bud pa ltar spra sgor thon pas/ kho'i sems skad cig nyid la 'khyags song / mo la rtsal dang zhe snang gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa zhig yod pa ma gtogs/ chung dus nas khyim phyi nang gi las ka gang yang mi nus pa'i rul ma skad grags can zhig yin/ na 22

zin po g.yu rdzog dang nyi ma lha sa/tshod smin pa dang bsnun nas rim gyis sha rgyas te da skabs mi tshugs kyang shor 'dug mos nam rgyun slog par ska rags lhod por bcings shing / phu thung gnyis ka phud de tshi len gyis khebs dka' ba'i pho ba phyir 'jur nas 'gro skabs nor rkyal zhig 'gul bzhin pa dang gnyis su mi 'dug thengs shig la mos mgron por ja 'dren skabs/ thab kyi 'o ma gdus te glo bur du 'phyur bas/ brel 'tshub chen pos gom pa 'ga' spos pa na/ ska rags lhod por bcings pa'i slog pa dpyi mgo nas skyid khug la lhung song / mgron po rnams song rjes/ a khu klu skyabs kyis ngo tshas bslangs pa'i khong khro de ma bzod par mo'i lan bu nas bzung ste sa la bsnyel rjes/ sog rgyab la bzhon nas gcar rdung byed rtsis byas pa na/ mos shugs kyis 'phag ra 'ga' byas te khyo ga 'og la mnan nas skya rtsal de 'dra med na/ mtshan mo lto bar bzhon pa las nyin mo rgyab la ma zhon zer bzhin hab cha 'ga' byas te ci mi snyam pa'i ngang nas yar langs/ shu/ rgad po klu skyabs kyi las dbang 'di/ mo lta bu zhig khrid nas nyi ma lha sar ji ltar 'gro/ dbus pa rnams la ji ltar bshad/ a khu klu skyabs 'dra ba'i skyes pa rig rgod cig gis chung ma de 'dra ci la blangs zhes 'phya dmod byas na ci bya/ rtsa ba'i rtsa ba ded na stong dpon nyi ma lan pa yin/gal te kho dbus lam nas shi med na/ dpon tshang gi bu mo sgrol ma chung mar len thabs byas yod/ 'owa wade ring sgrol ma jag pa lam nyal steng la bud mi 'dug lha sar 'gro bar gra sgrig byed bzhin yod pa min nam/ gal srid 23

'tshub ma kher rkyang /mo dbus la song na/ dkar skyid kyis ci bshad mi shes pas/ rang nyid gtan nas 'gro mi rung / nyi ma lha sa zer bar re ltos che rung rang gi ngo ko bsregs na phan pa ci yang med/6 a rog mi cha med dang skad rgyus med cig gis bos byung /a khu klu skyabs kyis myur du mar bltas pa na/ kho dang thag mi ring ba'i ri ngos na skya mi rta khrid cig langs 'dug rjes la khrid pa'i khal rta'i rgyab la snye mo kha bsdams 'ga' bkal 'dug6 ci red/ a rog zer nas 'bod srol la gzhigs na/ nga rgad po klu skyabs la ming med pa 'dra/mi smyo a khu/ ngas khyod kyi ming la klu skyabs zer ba mi shes/mi 6 rdzun ma bshad/ rta la bkal 'dug pa de ci yin/mi 6 tshong yin ya/mi tsa sde ba 'di na nged tshang gi tshong khang 'dra zhig yod pas/ khyod kyis ci zhig btsong rtsis yod/mi 6 a khu/ sman pa dge go tshang gang na yod/mi rjo pha gi'i de'u 'bur 'gram gyi spra nag gan red/mi a khu klu skyabs kyis skya mi'i rjes la yun ring zhig bltas nas 'dug bzod med pa'i tshor snang byung / 6 dge go la ngas mi shes pa dang nga'ang mi shes pa'i ngo shes shig 'dug ngo ma ya mtshan red/ shuwa wanyi ma mgo spang 24

zin dzo g.yu rdzog dang nyi ma lha sa/gi rgyud pa la bu sdug cig med pa 'dra/mi nyin gung yol rjes/ nyi ma'i tsha gdug de sngar las je cher song bas/yul gru thams cad tsha lam lam byed/ a khu klu skyabs la pho ba ltogs pa dang kha skom pa'i snang ba zhig skyes pas/ da gzod rang gis nangs ja 'thungs med pa yid la shar/ kho yar langs nas slar yang phyogs bzhi la zhib lta thengs shig byas te ri ngos nas dal bur mar babs/ pho 'phyi zhig gis mo 'phyi gcig phar 'ded tshur 'ded byed bzhin chags pa slong bzhin 'dug pa mthong bas/ sems la ci zhig bor ba lta bu'i snang ba zhis skyes te mi rgas nas ci yang mi nus skabs/ dud 'gro 'di tshos kyang brnyas bcos byed zer bzhin sa nas rdo log cig blangs te shugs kyis g.yugs pa na/ 'phyi ba la ma phog mod/ rang nyid kyi nub nas dri chen skad sgra can zhig shor song /smyo skyag khug 'di/ nam yin rung lhod 'dug pa ci yin/mi a khu klu skyabs kyis sdug smre 'don bzhin mu mthud du ri ngos nas mar babs/ skabs shig la kho'i sems la mkha' lding dgon pa'i grwa pa dge legs rgya mtshos dpyid ka sbag sbag 'khor lo nyo dus/ kho la sgor mo stong tsho gnyis bskyis te da rung skyin pa ma byin pa shar pas/ slar yang deng sang gi grwa pa 'di tsho tshig thog nas mi 'dug sdom khrims mi brtsi/ 'don pa mi shes zhes chig lab brgyab/mkha' lding o rgyan 'phrin las 'jigs med chos kyi rdo rje tshang gi huXng

'tshub ma kher rkyang /srid/ mkha' lding kun bzang rang grol thub bstan chos dbyings rdo rje tshang dgung lo nyer lnga la son skabs/ rang gi dgon pa sras kyi thu bo 'jam dpal ral gri tshang la sprad rjes/ dus yun ring por yon bdag byas pa'i khyim tshang 'ga' zhabs phyir khrid de yul 'di la yong nas gnas bcas/ dus de nas bzung / bla mas chos lung bkra shis sum mdo nas spyil bu chung chung zhig brtsigs te sgrub pa lhur len byas/ yon bdag rnams kyis nor lug bskyangs te bde skyid kyi 'tsho bar rol pa na/ stod kyi 'khyam po/ smad kyi sdom po/dpon po'i khrims la 'gal ba'i nyes can/ tsho ba nang 'khrug byung ba'i gyod pa sogs snga gzhug tu sa 'dir yong nas bsdad pas/ rim gyis sde ba chung chung zhig chags/ da skabs mi rnams kyis rang snang gang shar sgos stong lab rgyag dus/ rang gi mes po sa 'dzin gyi snga ba dang bla ma dbus nas gdan 'dren mkhan yin zer mod/ su la'ang yid ches byas chog pa'i dpang rtags shig ston rgyu med/sde ba chags rjes/ dus yun ring por gtan 'khel gyi sde dpon zhig med cing / dpa' rtsal dang stobs 'byor su che na/ de sde ba'i khrims srid gnyis ku'i bdag po yin/ a ye sgrol ma'i pha gon mtho ris po de lo bco brgyad la son skabs/ khro rgyal gla kha zer ba'i rgad po gtum zhing btsan po zhig yod pa de tshe las 'das pa na/ gnas skabs su sde mgo skyong mkhan med paX/6 gsar bu rang rlom che ba rnams kyi khrod du go sa rtsod pa'i 'thab rtsod

srin po g.yu rdzog dang nyi ma lha sa/cig rang shugs kyis langs pa dang / dus tshod nges can zhig 'gor pa na/'thab rtsod de rim bzhin dza drag che ba dang rnyog dra can du gyur/ a ye sgrol ma'i pha rgan mtho ris po der mtshon na/ sgo na rgyu med pa dang lus na rtsal med pa'i khar/ da rung rgyab na pha med pa'i bu chung kher skyes shig yin pas/sde ba'i gsar bu rnams kyis nyi ma mgo spang mizar nas 'phya dmod dang brnyas bcos byed pa las mi gras la gtan nas 'jog mi srid na'ang / sde spyapon gyi go sa de la khos kyang snying khong rus pa'i gting nas re ba byed bzhin da/ nyin der nyi ma mgo spang lug rdzi yin/ khos rang tshang la ra lug lnga bcu lhag yod pa de sman lung gi ri ngos la bgos rjes/ slog pa gdan la bting zhing ska rags sngas mgo byas te gan rkyal du nyal/ skabs 'dir khos bsam gzhig byed sa ni sde dpon gyi go sa rang lag la tshud thabs byed rgyu de yin la/ rjes phyogs kyi 'tsho gnas cha rkyen je legs su gtong na/ sde dpon la ma bsdad na thabs gzhan med snyam bzhin 'dug skabs rer kho la sde dpon byas pa'i 'phrul snang byung ste/ sems la sprang rtsi myangs pa lta bu'i spro snang byung /zu a rog nyi ma mgo skrang / yang 'phrul snang la brten nas sde dpon byed bzhin 'dug gam/mi nyi mas pho skad rgyus yod de go ma thag 'tshub cha dang bcas yar ༷/sa

'tshub ma kher rkyang /pa na/ kho ya mtshan skyes te re zhig had nas 'dug dgos byung / ma gzhi bla ma mkha' lding dge legs rnam rgyal dpal ldan rang byung rdo rje tshang gam la phebs te/ zhal la brtse ba'i 'dzum mdangs grol nas rang nyid la gzigs 'dug pa mthong bas/ ci byed 'di byed med par phyag gsum btsal rjes lha nga sar btsugs nas bsdad/tsa sde dpon byed 'dod na jag la 'gro dgos/ khyod kyis phod dam/’ nyi mas bla ma thugs rje can 'di mngon mkhyen dang rdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med/ khong gis rang nyid sde dpon byed 'dod yod pa mkhyen na/ rang gis da lta'i bar du ra ma gcig kyang brkus ma myong bas/ jag la gtan nas 'gro mi phod pa mkhyen pa kho thag yin snyam mod/ bka' bkyon gnang bar 'jigs nas lags/ ngas mi phod lags zhes mi zhu ka med byung /smyo longs longs/ khyod kyi skye ba kun la snying stobs ra ma'i ril ma tsam yang med/ ’mkha' lding tshang spang thog gi slog pa'i steng nas bzhugs rjes/ nyi ma sku mdun la bos te sus kyang go ma myong ba'i gtam rgyud cig gsungs byung /de yang mkha' lding dge legs rnam rgyal dpal ldan rang byung rdo rje'i sku gong ma la gsol thab pa zhig yod pa de'i ming la bde mchog zer/ kho zas kyi g.yos sbyor la ha cang mkhas rung / snying stobs ci yang med pas mtshan mo gaX/ thog la 'gro na'ang bla mas skyel ma byed dgos/ lo zhig la/ li yul

srin po g.yu rdzog dang nyi ma lha sa/lcang ra smug po'i sog po wang tshang gis gser gyi thugs rje chen po dang dung gi sgrol ma dkar mo zhu rten du phul te/ bla ma mkha' lding tshang sog yul la phebs nas dad ldan pho mo kun la dus 'khor dbang chen gsung ba'i re ba zhus/ skabs der gsol thab pa bde mchog lo lnga bcu lhag la son te rkang lag ha cang mi bde mod/ bla mas sdar ma wa mo 'dis tshe gcig la thab ka ma gtogs ci yang rig myong medami gsungs te kho zhabs phyir khrid/sog po wang tshang gis bla ma'i dbang yon la rta lnga brgya dang bcu gsum phul rjes/ skya dmag phog bsdus lnga bcu mngags te/ khong gnyis rang yul la son pa'i bar du zhabs g.yog bzang bo bsgrub dgos zhes bka' bstsal/khong rnams tsha 'dam gzhung gi thol wo sog po wang tshang gi sa khongs la slebs skabs/ sog dmag sum brgya lhag gis phyogs bzhi nas a long bzhin bskor te/ bya rgod po yin rung 'phur mi thub pa/ stag dmar yag yin rung mchong mi thub pa zhig byas pa na/ gsol thab pa bde mchog gis ag rgyangs shig byas rjes rta thog nas lhung ba dang / skyes ma byed mkhan rnams kyis phrag nas mtshon cha blangs te 'thab grabs byas/ mkha' lding tshang gis nam mkha' la yud tsam gzigs rjes 'dzum dmul dmul gyis ya ngo ma 'grig thal/ ngas bde mchog gis rta mang 'di la bdag dam byed thub bam snyam nas sems khur byed bzhin yod mod/ da ni rta rdzi bzang bo zhig la lam nas thug song /khos 'tsho thub na ngas mkho gal che dus 'ded thub pa yin ces gsungs rjes/29

'tshub ma kher rkyang /rta rnams sog dmag la sprad pa dang / skyes ma byed mkhan rnams la jag lan sprod mi chog pa'i bka' bstsal te rang yul la mngags/ca lags/ rta de dag da rung yod dam/’ nyi mas ngo mtshar ba'i ngang nas de skad dris/6 glen pa klad med/ ngas kyang lus rten brjes pas rta de tsho gang na yod/ ya/ nyi ma/ khyod kyis rang nyid kyi skye ba sngon ma su yin pa e shes mizhes mkha' lding tshang gis glo bur du dris/lha lags/ mi mi shes lags/mi nyi ma ci yin cha ma 'tshal bar gyur nas re zhig ci zhig bshad dgos pa'ang ma shes/6 snying re rje/ khyod kyis ga la shes/ nga'i sku phreng gong ma'i gsol thab pa bde mchog gi rnam shes khyod rang red/mi 6 a gi lags so/ thugs rje che/ thugs rje che/mi nyi mas skad cha de thos rjes dga' ba'am skyo ba gang yin mi shes mod/ kha nas mtshams med du de ltar zer/mkha' lding tshang gis mu mthud du bshad rgyur spyod ni wang tshang gis 'u gnyis la rta skyin ster ba'i dus la bab/ de e red/ khyod jag la song dang /chos skyong srung ma dang yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyis khyod kyi sdongs grogs mdzad nges/ skrag don ci yang med/ 30 lags/ nga jag la 'gro dgos na srung ba rdo rje go khrab cig cis kyang

zin po gas rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/gnang rogs/mi zu dmar 'dzing byed mi dgos pas/ mtshon cha dang mtshon srung gis ci bya/ 'u gnyis la rta lnga brgya dang bcu gsum las med/ de las brgal na skyin pa ster dgos/mi 6 lags so/ lags/ ngas rta 'ded thub pa byung tshe gcig kyang ma lus par khyed la 'bul lags/ ’zu mi dgos/ mi dgos/ nga ri khrod pa zhig la rta yis ci byed/ bde mchog gis mi tshe gang bor nga'i sku gong mar za ma g.yos sbyor byas te skyid sro mang tsam yang rig ma myong / rta de rnams kho'i drin lan gzo byed tsam yin/rjes su sde dpon byed dus dmangs la byams dgos/ grogs la mthun dgos/e go thal/’ 6 shā5ba/sa 1pu/mi 6 a rog jag la 'gro dus gzhan la gsang ste rang gcig pu song / da dung shes dgos pa ni 'u gnyis na'i kha brda 'di gzhan su la'ang bshad mi rung /mi/ lags so/’ pho gsar jag la 'gro ba dang mo gsar gnas la 'gro dus/ sde mi che chung thams cad khyim gcig la 'dzoms te gsol ston rgya chen po bshams pa ni yul 'di la snga mo nas goms pa'i srol zhig yin mod/ nyi mas rang 3rdod

'tshub ma kher rkyang /jag la 'gro ba'i gtam de mi gcig la'ang bshad ma phod/ gcig na bla ma'i lung bstan yod/ gnyis na sog rta nom la len ma thub na ngo tsha de gang la 'jogazla 'od med pa'i mtshan mo zhig la/ nyi mas rkang 'jab lag 'jab kyis rta la sga chas sprad cing / lam bro bcug yod pa'i ta len de sga'i phyi ru'i steng la 'phangs te sha thag mdud pa na/ mtshon cha zhig cis kyang 'khyer dgos snyam pas/ rkang 'jab lag 'jab kyis khyim la 'dzul pa na/ a ma gnyid stug por yur 'dug khos me mda' phrag la khur cing / sman nag dang rdo'u rum la bcug te spra sgor bud/ khos a myes g.yu rngog la gsol ba 'debs bzhin rta thog la bud pa na/ rta rgan su zhig gis khrid pa ltar bla ma mkha' lding tshang gis gsungs pa'i lam phyogs te nub byang gnyis ga'i mtshams su mda' 'phangs pa ltar chas song /nyin mtshan bdun la song rjes/ rta phos rkang lam phra mo zhig ded nas nyag ga zhig la slebs/ nyag ga'i pha rol ni spang ljongs mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba zhig yin la/ sog gur ni me tog bzhad pa dang mtshungs/ dkyil gyi gur chen po de'i g.yas g.yon la stong rta 'ga' bsdus 'dug cing / phar bltas na wang tshang gis ru spor rtsis yod pa 'dra/ kho'i sems la tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khras hor gyi la lo 'ded dus/ mi gyol rta gyol zhig sprul nas so/ 2/ rang mi rta gnyis la rdzu 'phrul med rung thabs bkod yod dgos snyam

grin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/ste/ rta 'tshol zhig yin khul byas te sog gur mang po'i sgo 'gram brgyud nas song rung / mi khyi gcig gis kyang ma rig pa ltar kha ya mi byed pas kho'i spobs pa sngar las je cher song / kho sog gur chen po de'i rta lhas la slebs dus/ sog mo chung chung zhig gis rgod ma 'ga' btags te 'jo bzhin yod pa ma gtogs gur gyi phyi na mi gcig kyang mthong rgyu mi 'dug kho sog mo'i 'gram du song rung mos ma rig pa ltar mgo bskur nas 'dug pas/ nyi ma'i sems la da ni rta 'ded pa'i dus la slebs 'dug snyam nas sngar med pa'i spobs pa zhig skyes te sog rta'i khyu sne bcad nas glog 'khyug pa ltar ded song /nyag ga'i tshu rol la slebs rjes/ nyi ma la brel 'tshub dang 'dzem bag ci yang med par rta rnams tshang rtsis byas/ khos thengs gsum la brtsis rung rta lnga brgya dang bcu bzhi yod pas rta gcig lhag 'dug tag tag skabs der/ rta khyu'i gras kyi rta nag srung gor can zhig yod pa de mi zhig gis gzas nas bkar pa dang 'dra bar rta khyu'i khrod nas gcig pur phyir bud de mgo gnam la btegs te lan 'ga' 'tsher bzhin phyir nyag ga'i pha rol tu shor song / nyi mas a myes g.yu rngog ngo ma rang gi dpung rogs la phebs 'dug snyam nas/ rta las babs te gcin pa shag ser gtong 'dod kyang sa la chu thigs tsam yang babs ma byung /nyi mas sog rta lnga brgya rang zog lhas la 'ded pa ltar ded yong bas/dpa' rtsal kun la grags song / mi su zhig gis thog mar bshad pa mi shes 33

'tshub ma kher rkyang /mod/ skabs shig la kho tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra'i sprul pa yin ces sde ba yongs la khyab/ khos sems gting nas bshad tshul der khas mi len na'ang kha nas yin min gyi gtam ci yang ma bshad/ rta nyis brgya lhag gser dngul la brjes pa dang sde ba'i dpa' dar la phul pa'i nor lug thams cad blangs te/ chung ma dang g.yog po yod pa'i khyim gzhi gsar ba zhig bsgrigs shing /dus ring po ma 'gor bar kho sde dpon du gyur/sde dpon nyi ma la dpa' rtsal med rung thabs bkod ha cang mang bas/dpon po sngon ma rnams kyi rjes su 'brangs te stobs 'byor ldan dus dpon po dang 'byor ba rgyad dus g.yog po byed mi srid/ khos go sa brtan po yong ched/ rang gi mnga' 'og na khyim tshang sum cu lhag las med rung / gser dngul gyi 'gro gron btang ste zi ling an pan gyi lag nas stong dpon gyi thob dang tham ga cha tshang nyos/khyim tshang sum cu lhag la srid don gyi bya ba mang po med/ kho stong dpon la bsdad nas lo 'ga' 'gor ba na/ sun snang skyes nas 'dug mi bzod pas/ bla ma mkha' lding tshang gi phyag nas gsang sngags rnying ma'i dpe cha 'ga' g.yar te yang nas yang du bltas/ skabs rer mgron po phebs tshe dpe cha myur du sbas te rang gis chos gzhung nas go ba rnams drang mor bshad pa dang / ma go ba rnams blo bcos byas te kha brda byas pas mgron po ngo mtshar te rang gi yong don yang brjed 'dug de ltar dus tshod nges can 34

srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/zhig 'gor ba na/ sde mi rnams kyis stong dpon nyi ma tshang ni tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra'i sprul pa yin zer ba ci la mi bden/ chos gzhung thams cad kha thog lce thog la blangs nas bshad thub/ dbus kyi dge bshes chos kyang de 'dra mi nus zhes bstod bsngags byas pas/ kho'i dpe char lta ba'i 'dun ma sngar las je cher song ste/ mkha' lding tshang gi phyag nas dpe cha gang mang g.yor mgo brtsams/ 'on kyang / gcig na bla ma tshang la dpe cha mang po med pa dang / gnyis na chos gzhung 'ga' la go ba ci yang mi lon pas/mgron po rnams la kha brda gsar ba zhig ma rnyed/ de nas bzung / kho la sngar bzhin sun snang skyes te 'dug mi bzod par gyur/ bla ma'i bka' drin gzo ba dang rang gi mtshan snyan je mthor gtong ched/ gcig bus 'gro gron btang ste mkha' lding gsang sngags dar rgyas gling gi tshogs chen 'du khang bzhengs pa dang / bla ma mkha' lding tshang la tsan dan dkar po'i khri brgyab/'du khang bzhengs skabs kyi las dpon ni a khu klu skyabs kyi pha rgan yin la/bshad sa tshogs sa dang las sa rgyug sa zhig la kho slebs yod pas/ sde mi rnams kyi kho la rgya bho tshwa khu zer/ kho rang nyid kyi bshad tshul yin na/ gnam 'og 'di na kho la mi cha med dang sa rgyus med cig gtan nas med/ sde bar mgron po cha med cig slebs na/ kho sngon la brgyugs te ngo 'dzum 'dzum dang lus sgur sgur byas te sa cha gang gi yin ces 'dri srid la/ mgron pos rang yul bshad na a khu ga ge mo dang a ne ga ge mo bde 'tshams yin nam zhes 35

'tshub ma kher rkyang /'dri ba dang / de nas mgron po'i rus ming / khyim tshang gi gnas tshul sogs kha 'dri gting 'dri byas te/ rjes su yul de'i mgron po yong na bshad par gra sgrig byed/ 'du khang bzhengs pa'i go rim khrod du/ khos gser dngul mang po lkog za byed thub song mod/ stong dpon nyi ma'i dogs pa bslangs na mjug 'bras legs po zhig 'byung dka' bsams te/ sngar bzhin dbul bo'i 'tsho ba de mi rol ka med byung / 'on kyang / yid spro ba zhig ni/ bu chung klu skyabs kyis dpon tshang sgrol ma'i sems pa bkug yod la/gal srid kho gnyis ku'i gnyen don la bar chad ma byung na/ stong dpon la bu mo gcig pu las med pas/ rjes su thob dang tham ga'i bdag po rang gi mi rabs gzhug ma yin/ khos nam rgyun klu skyabs la 6gces log dpon po'i mag pa byed thub na/ a pa'i srog 'chor dgos rung phangs sems mi skye mizhes bshad pa dang / bus kyang a pa'i gtam de legs bshad cig la brtsis te lag len la 'bad pa lhod med byas/nam mkha' na sprin bye'u mgo tsam yang med la/ ston gyi gnam gshis bzang po'i tsha grang ran pas/ mi rnams la sems khams dwangs shing lus khams bde ba'i tshor snang ster/ nam rgyun yin na/ ston gyi dus ni rtswa thang gi sdug bsngal dang skyo gdung med pa'i bskal bzang gi dus yin mod/ 'on kyang / da lo char chu dus ltar ma babs pas than mug ha cang che ba dang /36

srin po gas rdzog dang nyi ma lha sa/rgan po spobs pa can la las a cas g.yu rngog gi phrag dog la 'dzem bag ci yang med par nyi ma lha sar 'gro grabs byas pas/ yul mi rnams kyi sems khams ha cang mi bde/ lhag par du a ye sgrol mas pha rgan dbus lam nas 'das pa'i chag sgo de la 'jigs pa ci yang med par nyi ma lha sar 'gro rtsis byas pa na/ dge go khyim tshang gang bo zang zing lang long du gyur te re zhig bde la 'bab ma thub/de ring mgon po rgyal gyis pho ba na zer nas thog rdzir ma song / kho pho khyim gyi mar skyed nas skyil krung bcos shing lag pa gnyis ka pus mo'i steng la bzhag ste ci yang mi bshad par 'dug a ye sgrol mas mal du dbo lug la ma ṇi skor bzhin 'dug na'ang mig lam du se 'bras dge gsum dang jo khang sogs glog gi brnyan ris bzhin shar bas sems rnal la phab nas kha ton zhiX 'don ma thub/ mos da nangs mchod pa ma bshams la phyag kyang ma ba la/6 ya nga'i zhi li 'dir shog dang / a phas lag rtsar brtag dge gos sman gzhung zhig la bltas nas 'dug skabs/ mgon po rgyal gyi lus khams mi bde ba dran pas/ myur mor dpe cha brla thog la bzhag ste de ltar bshad/zu nga'i de ring gi nad de khyod kyis ngos mi zin/mi 6 a ma'i gces phrug sa longs/ a pha sman pa red/ gzhan gyi /da

'tshub ma kher rkyang /ngos zin na/ khyod kyi nad ngos los zin/ mi mkha' mo mtshos 'o ma srub mtshams bzhag nas de skad bshad/6 min/ de ring gi nad de khos ngos mi rin/mi 6 'o de red/mi dge gos mu mthud du dpe char bltas/skabs shig la/ gcod log gis lug lhas 'gram nas a bra zhig bzung ste/ lcags skud kyi sna gcu sprad cing ras skud thung thung zhig sna thig byas rjes/ dga' spro chen pos a bra phu bo'i gam la drud yong ste a rog phu bo/ khyod kyis 'brong nyo'am zhes dris/mgon po rgyal gyis skrag nas lhab lhab 'dar bzhin yod pa'i a bra de mthong rjes srog chags nyam chung 'di rigs la snying re rje snyam/ cang ma 'gror bar a bra'i lcags skud kyi sna gcu de chad de a bra sgo 'gram gyi ab khung du 'dzul/ khung bu chung chung de phal cher a bra btsan po zhig gi tshang yin pa 'dra/ yud tsam 'gor rjes/ gcod log gi lag nas thar ba'i a bra de khung sgor bud de/ khung bu gzhan pa zhig gi nang la 'dzul dgos byung /gcod log gis ci mi snyam pa'i ngang nas 'brong rgan de tshong pa'i gam la slebs ma thag shor song / yang cig mi 'dzin thabs med redami zer bzhin slar yang lhas 'dabs la song / thang dkar rgod po zhig skabs der kho tshang gi sbra mgo'i mkha' lam du 'khor bzhin 'duganyin gung gi rig rtsal le tshan gtong ba'i dus tshod la slebs pas/ dge 38

srin po g.yu rdzog dang nyi ma lha sa/go yar langs te sgra sdud 'khor lo'i skud sne nyi glog gi glog khung la btsugs te glog sgo phye ba na/ lo du ma 'gor ba'i sgra snyan rdung len de grags byung / mgon po rgyal gyis ngu nas rang nas zhing dgung la 'jur minas pa'i glu tshig de go ma thag bya nas shing nas shing thang la lhung na ci 'dra yin nam snyam pa na/tag tag skabs der da ci gnam 'phang stod bzhin pa'i thang dkar de nam mkha' nas gshog 'gyur 'ga' byas rjes glo bur du lug lhas la lhung / dge go dang mkha' mo mtsho gnyis pos snang tshul ngo mtshar can de mthong bas spag nas had song / a ye sgrol mas tshul de mthong rjes rnam rtog skyes te 'dug mi bzod mod/ gdong la ci mi snyam pa'i nyams bcos ma zhig bsdus te/ mig zung btsums nas sngar ltar ma ṇi 'khor lo bskor/ mgon po rgyal yang blong blong por gyur nas re zhig had 'dug skabs der bya rgod de'i gshog pa chen po lan 'ga' g.yabs rjes slar yang dgung la 'phur/smyo 'di 'dra'i than ltas shig gang na yod/ bya rgyal rgod po lhas rar lhung ba 'di gzhan la bshad na rnar mi 'gro’ dge gos de ltar zer bzhin yar langs nas sgra sdud 'khor lo'i glog sgo brgyab/ mkha' mo mtshos glo bur du ci zhig dran pa ltar a ma'i lag 'gor 'jus nas a ma khyod lha sar ma 'gro zhes zhu ba byas/a ye sgrol ma'i sems smreng ste mig mchi ma nyil ler ci yang mi bshad par kha rog la bsdad/ 39

'tshub ma kher rkyang /zu a pha/ a ye lha sar 'gro 'dod yod na mo'i bsam tshul dang bstun ya/ chos la bar chad byas na nyes pa che/mi mgon po rgyal gyis de ltar bshad/6 byis pa gcin skyag gar gtong mi shes pa zhig gis ci shes/ a myes g.yu rngog la phrag dog che bas/ khyod kyi lo lon drin chen de'ang dbus lam nas ma thar ba red/ da so ma'i bya rgod de e rig gzhi bdag ma dga' na de 'dra red/’ 6 a pha/ a myes g.yu rngog la de 'dra skrag dgos don ci yod/ nga gtan nas mi skrag ’ra skyag phrug kha pho de 'dra ma che/ khyod su yin pa e shes/ khyod skyag phrug mgon po rgyal red/ dge go khong khro langs/6 nga nga / nga bla ma mkha' lding tshang yin/mi 6'di smyos 'dug dge go yar langs te mgon po rgyal la 'gram lcag tsha thag chod pa zhig gzhus pa na/ mgon po rgyal gyis 'gram pa 'phur 'phur byed bzhin a pa'i gdong la yud tsam bltas rjes dbugs ring zhig 'ben pa dang / de nas 'ur cha bzung ste zog sdun la song /dge go ni spun gsum nang gi tha chung yin la/ phu bo gcig dang a ce gcig yod pa chung dus nas tshe las 'das/ kho pho lo nyer gcig la son skabs gnyen sgrig byas te/ da skabs byis pa gsum gyi a par gyur 'dug40

zin po g.yu tshog dang nyi ma lha sa/bsam shes pa nas bzung / mi la lag rtsal zhig med na rjes kyi spyi tshogs su 'tsho ba rol dka' bsams te/ bod kyi gso ba rig par rang sbyong byas/ da skabs sman la mkhas rgyu med rung / sde ba'i mi rnams la cham pa dros 'khyag re byung na kho las re sa med pas/ pho mo rgan gzhon tshang mas a khu sman pa zhes 'bod pa dang / sde bar don dag gal chen re yod na kho'ang 'du tshogs la 'bod nges yin/ gsar bu lo mnyam rnams kyis de bde skyid cig red bsams te kho la yid smon byed mod/ khos de na bde ba dang skyid cig yod pa gtan nas mi shes/ lo sum cu lhag gi mi tshe'i bgrod lam ring mor rang nyid bla ma zhig gi yab tu 'gyur pa'i smon lam med la/ stong sems kyang bcangs ma myong / de ring mgon po rgyal gyis rang nyid mkha' lding tshang gi yang sprul yin ces bshad pa na/ thog mar ha las nas hon 'thor ba dang /zhib tu bsam blo re btang na de yang khrigs khrigs med snyam pas/ bu chung la dmigs bsal gyis gces skyong ma byas pa dang / de ring 'gram lcag de tsam gzhus par sems gting nas 'gyod bshags byed dgos byung / dge go bza' zla gnyis ma'i bu che ba la rta mgrin tshe ring zer zhing da skabs lo bcu gsum yin/ kho lus rid cing gzugs zung rung byis pa rig rgod cig yin/khos rang khyim gyi lug gcig bor na de ma thag shes par ma zad/ khyim mtshes tshang gis lug gcig bshas na/ nyin 'ga' 'gor rjes de tshang la lug gang 'dra 'di 'dra zhig yod pa de lug khyu nas mi rig zer nges yin/ dge gos 41

'tshub ma kher rkyang /kho slob grwar song na bzang snyam mod/ zog rdzi zhig cis kyang dgos pas bsam tshul de mngon 'gyur byed ma thub/ 'bring ba mgon po rgyal nam yang ma rabs dang pra tshag med par kha rog la 'dug pa las bshad rgyu dgod rgyu ci yang med pas/ kho la rig pa yod med mi shes la ci zhig sems bzhin yod pa'ang mi shes/ de rang bla ma'i yang sprul yin ces bshad na/ bden pa red 'dod pa'i khyad chos re yang yod de/ kho'i gshis ka dang 'gro stangs 'dug stangs thams cad pha ma gcen gcung su la'ang mi 'dra zhing / bsam cung tsam shes pa nas bzung / nam rgyun mkha' lding dgon pa'i phyogs la bltas nas shugs ring re 'ben/ kho da lta lo dgu yin pas sdug bsngal de 'dra yod mi srid la skad cha de 'dra bshad ga la shes/ ngo ma blo ngor shong dka' ba zhig red/ gcod log ni dge go'i pha gon drin chen de'i rnam shes yin pas/khyim mi che chung kun gyis gces lang la btang ste/ bshad mi phod pa dang las mi phod pa zhig med/ sde ba'i byis pa gang gis ma rabs kyi bya ba zhig bsgrubs tshe khyim mi tshos 'dir gcod log gi 'dre des bzung 'dug /ces 'chad bzhin yod/ dge gos bsam bzhin bsam bzhin sems pa mag mog tu gyur pas dal ba dal bur khyim la 'dzul dgos byung /6 a ma/ a lags mkha' lding tshang gshegs khar lung bstan 'dra yod dam/mi dge go yar snyed nas yun ring la bsdad rjes mar snyed kyi a ye sgrol mar de ltar dris/42

srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/6 mi shes/ nga'i pha drin chen gyis kho la bla ma'i lung bstan gal chen zhig gnang yod zer nas/ a myes g.yu dzog gi phrag dog la ma 'dzems par dbus la song ba yin/ 'on kyang / lung bstan ga 'dra bstan yod pa su la'ang ma bshad/mi 64khong gi sprul sku da lta gang na 'khrungs yod dam/mi mkha' mo mtshos thab rtsa nas de ltar zer/6 khong rin po che 'khrungs yod na/ dgung lo bzhi bcu lhag bzhes na 'grig mod/ bla ma'i mdzad pa ni 'u cag lta bus ga la shes/mi nor lug rnams 'dabs la bskor rjes/ rta mgrin tshe ring dang mgon po rgyal gnyis ka bshad zhor dgod zhor du yul la yong bzhin 'dug skabs der/ dge go bza' zla gnyis ma'i sems la dga' skyo 'dres ma'i snang ba zhig shar/nub ja 'thungs rjes/ a khu klu skyabs kyis khyim mi lhan 'dzoms kyi tshogs 'du zhig cis kyang bsdu dgos snyam/ kho gtam bshad dang cod gleng la ha cang dga' la/ mi ji ltar mang na kha rtse de ltar bde ba dang spro snang de ltar che/ 'on kyang / nor lug sger la bgos rjes sde bar tshogs 'du ha cang nyung bas/ kho la gtam bshad pa'i go skabs je nyung du song / lhag par du rtswa ra bgo skabs/ rim pa gong mas sde ba so so'i sa mtshams chu mtshams gtan khel nan mo byas rjes/ mi phyugs kyi grangs ka ltar khyim tshang 43

'tshub ma kher rkyang /so sor bgos nas rtswa ra bskor pa na/ sde ba'i bar la sa rtsod chu rtsod kyi gyod gzhi ma byung bas/ kho la rtsod gleng byed pa'i go skabs gtan nas med par gyur/ rang sems kyi stong cha de skong ched/ nyin 'ga'i sngon la khos sde ba'i rgad po bsam shes rnams rang tshang la 'dzoms te/ nyi ma lha sar ji ltar 'gro ba dang / gnas skor ji ltar byed pa sogs la gros sdur zhib mo byed ces brda btang ba na/ rgad po tshos nyi ma skar ma gtan khel byas te lam la chas na de red/ gros mol yang yang byed don ci yod/ klu skyabs thod nag gi kha la za 'phrug langs nas ma bzod pa red/mi ces bshad de mi gcig kyang ma yong / sde gras nas gtam bshad pa'i go skabs med na/ khyim mi'i gras nas kha bde lce bde bcos chog chog yin/ a khu klu skyabs kyis do dgong gi gros gzhi gtso bo nyi ma lha sar 'gro min de yin/6 tshe bho/ a ma nged gnyis ka nyi ma lha sar song na bzang ngam mi.a khu klu skyabs kyis yun ring la bsam blo btang rung tshig mgo ji ltar 'dzin dgos pa ma shes pas/ mar snyed na tha mag 'ben bzhin kha rog la 'dug pa'i tshe brtan 'bum la de ltar bshad/6 a myes g.yu rngog la skrag na sdod/ mi skrag na song /mi tshe brtan rgyal gyis ci mi snyam pa'i ngang nas de skad bshad/da skabs a ye dkar skyid la mtshon na/ nyi ma lha sar 'gro 'dod med la/ a myes g.yu rngog gi phrag dog la'ang 'jigs dgos don med/ mna' 44

srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/ma gsar brje skyid yong nas khyim tshang la 'gal ba bslangs te bde 'jags med par bsgyur pa nas bzung / rang nyid shi song na bzang snyam pa'i bsam tshul byung ste/ 'jig rten mi yul la dga' spro dang chags zhen de 'dra med par gyur/ mun rub pa nas bzung / mo khyim nas yar 'dur mar 'dur byas te khrim las la 'bad pas/ 'phongs tshos sar 'phen pa'i go skabs ma byung mod/ mna' ma mar snyed nas bsdad de mdun shog na bud med gcer bu gnyis yod pa'i dpe cha de la zhib mor lta ba las 'gul tsam yang mi byed/'di ni mna' ma a ma dang a ma mna' mar gyur pa ma yin nam/ a ye dkar skyid slar yang khong khro chen po langs na'ang thabs bkod ci yang ma byung /6 nyi ma lha sar 'gro min de 'u tshang la mtshon na don dag gal chen zhig red/ der brten/ 'gro na ji ltar 'gro ba dang 'dug na ji ltar 'dug par gros sdur zhib mo byas na 'grig pa yin/ shod ya/ tshang ma kha rog la bsdad nas ci bya/mi khrim bdag ma gnyis gas ci yang mi bshad pas a khu klu skyabs la 'tshub cha langs/zu a pha/ ngas bltas na song na 'grig bod kha ba can dang phreng ba can la mtshon na/ dbus kyi jo bo yid bzhin nor bur mjal ba las don chen zhig gang na yod/ a skyes g.yu rngog la skrag dgos don med/ rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su lab tse rmang nas bshig rung than rtags ci yang 45

'tshub ma kher rkyang /ma byung / der bltas na a skyes g.yu rngog la phrag dog che zer ba ngag rgyun tsam yin pa 'dra/ gsar brje skyid kyis pha ma gnyis ka dbus la rdzong thabs byed ched de ltar bshad/zu nyi ma lha sar ngo ma 'gro rtsis yod na/ bu mo dang mag pa rnams la gsang dgos/ kho tsho ni byams snying rje can tag tag yin pas/ pha ma gnyis ka dbus la 'gro rtsis yod pa go na sngon 'gog byed thag chod yin/ ’a ye dkar skyid kyis gsar brje skyid kyis a myes g.yu rngog la phrag dog che ba shes bzhin du kho gnyis ka nyi ma lha sar rdzong thabs byed bzhin pa shes te zur za'i tshul du de ltar bshad/ mna' mas kyang tshig gi rtsa ba skad cig nyid la rtogs song mod/ rang gi bsam don de mngon 'gyur byed ched ma shes khul byas te gdong la 'dzum mdangs bcos ma zhig langs/ /a ma/ ngal gsos ya/ lug rdzi gla pa gang la bud thal/ khyim las khos las na los chog zu lug rdzi gla pas tshong khang bsrungs 'dug mi6 a ma/ a pha khyod gnyis gas khyim tshang 'di'i don la dngos gnas sdug mang po myangs/ de bu bu mo dang mag pa mna' ma rnams kyi sems su khrigs khrigs yin/ lo na tshod kyis ded de nas gnyer thod la shar ba'i skabs 'dir dam pa'i lha chos sgrub par nga tshos bar chad byed ga la rung /da reb song dang go skabs ha cang bzang / gcig na 'gro rogs mang /46

srin po g.yu rngog dang gyi ma lha sa/gnyis na 'gro rogs tshang ma mi bkan mo tag tag red/mi a khu klu skyabs ya mtshan skyes/ nam rgyun yin na mna' ma 'dis khyim tshang gis don dag gang zhig bsgrub grabs byed dus/ thabs brgya jus stong gis bar chad byed nges yin/ 'on kyang / do dgong ci byung / kho pho lo bdun cur son rung 'di 'dra'i bu mo rig rgod cig rig ma myong / ngo ma bsam yul las 'das pa zhig red snyam byung /a ye dkar skyid la bu mo lnga yod rjes da gzod tshe brtan 'bum btsas pa yin/ bu mo che ba dang 'bring ba gnyis ka btsa' skabs/ a khu klu skyabs la bu zhig yod na ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam tshul ma byung / 'on kyang bu mo gsum pa tshe mo yag btsas dus sems glo bur du 'khyags te snying khong rus pa'i gting nas bu yod pa'i khyim tshang rnams la yid smon byas/ 'jig rten rgad po zhig gi gzhug na bu zhig med na pho lus blangs pa don med red bsams/ rjes su bstud mar bu mo gnyis btsas pa na/ a khu klu skyabs kyi sems sdug ste rdog lam yang mi mthong bar gyur pa dang / lo gcig gnyis tsam gyi ring la dpral ngos su gnyer ma je mang du gyur/ 'on kyang / pho lo zhe brgyad kyi skabs su tshe brtan 'bum yod pa nas bzung kho la slar yang nyin re bzhin je chung nas je chung yin pa'i snang ba skyes te/ sdug bsngal zer ba ci yin mi shes par gyur/ khos bu mo rnams nar son pa dang bstun nas snga phyir 47

'tshub ma kher rkyang /gnas la bskyal rjes/ bu la 'jig rten bu mo'i dwangs rtser rtsi chog pa'i chung ma zhig len bsams pa na/ dmigs tshad ha cang mtho ba'i dbang gis sde ba g.yas g.yon nas rang tshang gi mna' ma byas chog pa zhig ma rnyed/ nyin zhig mgon yul sde ba'i thar lo tshang gi bu mos slob chen la rgyugs ma 'phrod par yul na bsdad yod pa go rjes/ yid la 'char sgo gsar ba zhig byung / khos deng skabs kyi spyi tshogs la mkho ba rig gnas red/ 'on kyang tshe brtan 'bum chung dus rang gis rig gnas kyi rin thang la ngos zin chen po med pas slob grwar ma mngags/ da skabs 'gyod kyang tshar song ba red/ gal srid chung ma rig gnas can zhig yod na rjes phyogs su gzhan las lhag pa'i 'tsho ba rol thub nges snyam ste gsar brje skyid mna' mar bslangs pa yin/gsar brje skyid mtho 'bring nas mthar phyin rjes/ bstud mar lo gnyis la rgyugs sprad kyang ma 'phrod pas gnas skabs su yul nas mi 'dug thabs med byung / mos rang nyid rab yin na bzo grwa zhig la song nas bzo pa byed pa dang / bsam don de ma grub na dge rgan 'jon thang can zhig gi chung ma byas te dmangs sgrub dge rgan gyi bya ba zhig btsal ba dang / rim gyis gzhung sgrub dge rgan la bsgyur thabs byed bsams nas bsdad yod/ a khu klu skyabs gnyen slong bar yong dus mo mtshar song / sde ba 'di'i gsar bu rnams kyis rang nyid yon tan pa zhig la rtsis nas tshig gcig kyang bshad mi phod mod/ kho tshang la mna' ma slong ba'i spobs pa 'dug rang ngo rang gis 48

srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/ma zin pa min nam/ bsam bzhin bsam bzhin khyim tshang des rang nyid la brnyas bcos byas song bsams nas khong khro chen po langs/ 'on kyang /khong khro ci 'dra langs rung pha ma gnyis ga'i tshig la mi nyan thabs med yin/lo bcu lhag la slob grwar mngags rung tha mar rgyugs ma 'phrog da 3 5 ma gnyis gas dbang thag bcad de gnas la ster dus nga mi 'gro/ de mi chog ces bshad na drin chen pha ma'i sems pa 'khyag 'gro bsams nas tshig gcig kyang bshad ma phod/ a khu klu skyabs tshang ni gsar brje skyid bzo grwa'i bzo ba dang yang na slob grwa'i dge rgan zhig nas 'brog mo dkyus ma zhig la sgyur mkhan yin pas/ mos pha ma gnyis ka ltar gu yangs gtang rtsis gtan nas med/ mos gnyen sgrig byas pa nas bzung thabs sna tshogs la brten nas sbrum 'gog byas pas da lta'i bar byis pa zhig ma skyes/ cung ma 'gor par khyo ga pha bu gnyis gas me mda'i lkog tshong rgyag bzhin yod pa shes rjes/ spobs pa sngar las je cher song ste rang gis ci 'dod byas nas khyim mi rnams la brnyas bcos byed mgo brtsams/ mos tshe brtan 'bum la rgyun par nga'o dang bcas zung la mi dga' ba'i tshig gcig shod dang / khyod tshang gis me mda'i lkog tshong brgyab pa de gtug rgyu yin ces 'jigs snang bskul pas khyim tshang gang bos mo la ngo ya byed mi phod/ don dngos su mos 'jigs snang bskul ba ma gtogs gtug mi srid la/ khyo ga dang sgyug po gnyis ka btson la bcug na/rang nyid la mtha' 'bras yag po zhig med pa sems na khrigs khrigs yin/49

'tshub ma kher rkyang /da lo khyo ga'i pha ma gnyis ka lha sar 'gro rtsis yod pa go rjes dga' spro tshad med skyes/ gal srid spyi tshogs rnying ba'i nang ltar dbus lam nas bar chad 'dra byung na mi kha ngan pa rang gis 'khur mi dgos snyam ste/ kho tsho lha sar 'gro bar spro ba chen pos rgyab skyor byas/bza' mi lhan 'dzoms kyi 'du tshogs de chu tshod gsum tsam la bsdus rung / a khu klu skyabs kyi bsam don ma grub pas ngal gso mi byed thabs med byung /66khyod sems bsam pa'i gting nas nyi ma lha sar 'gro 'dod yod dam med/mi a khu klu skyabs kyis mal sa'i nang nas mgo bkyags te gam na nyal 'dug pa'i a ye dkar skyid la de ltar dris/zu khyim tshang gi don la 'bad de mna' ma'i lag nas 'chi ba las dam pa'i lha chos kyi don la a myes g.yu rngog gi lag nas shi na bzang / 'gro ya/bsdad nas ci byed/mi smyo de red/mi tsa 'o na khyod 'gro 'dod yin nam 'dug 'dod yin/’ 6 rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs su/ mang tshogs kyi sne drangs te mkha' ring dgon pa rmang nas bshig lha rten chos gsum chu la bskyur te nyes pa tshad med bsags pas/ tshe phyi mar 'gro sa med pa kho thag yin/ rab yi/ / da thengs lam la chas te dbus kyi jo bo yid bzhin nor bur thod pa

srin po g.yu rdzog dang nyi ma lha sa/gtugs na rang lus kyi nyes pa cung tsam 'dag nges yin/ 'on kyang mi khyim mi'i 'du ra bsdus kyang don ma grub pas/ a khu klu skyabs kyis rang gi sems gtam mi bshad ka med byung mod/ gnad 'gag gi skad cha de ji ltar ba'i rung ngag sgor ma bud/6 ci red/ shod ya/mi 66'di 'di dge go'i a ma'ang 'gro rtsis yod zer bas 'u cag mnyam du song na khos a ye dkar skyid kyi 'gram lcag tsha thag chod pa zhig la bsgugs nas bsdad/6 mo song na song / nga skrag dgos don ci yod/ chung dus 'jig rten snang ba rin po che zhig la brtsis te dgod bro ba'i don dag de tsam byas rung /da skabs nas nas lus kyis mi lcogs pa'i skabs 'dir/ snying bo med pa'i gna' dus kyi don dag rul ba zhig gleng ba'i sems ga la yod/mi 6 bden pa yin nam/ mikho ha las song /6 bden pa yin/ min na mkha' lding dgon/’ a khu klu skyabs dga' spro'i ngang nas yar dgye ste/ a ye dkar skyid la 'o zhig byed rtsis byas mod/ dus yun ring bor de 'dra byas ma myong bas/lus kun sbrid de spobs pa med par gyur/rgod po khrid na mthur mda' ring dgos/ sde mgo skyong na khog rgya 51

'tshub ma khor rkyang /yangs dgos zer mod/ stong dpon nyi ma la mtshon na khog rgya yangs dgos don med/ kho dpa' bo kher rgyug byas te sog rta rnam la blangs pa nas bzung /sde mi rnams kyis thog mar kho tsha zhang 'dan ma byang khra'i sprul pa yin snyam nas dad pa byas/ rim bzhin khong 'dra ba'i skyes chen dam pa la mthu dang mkhyen pa'ang yod nges snyam ste/ kho'i khrims mi 'khur ba dang tshig mi brtsi ba gcig kyang med/ de bas mkha' lding tshang gis re zhig gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su 'thim pa'i tshul ston pa'i bar du'ang / khos sdug bsngal dang pham kha sogs kyi bro ba de gtan nas myong ma dgos/ 'on kyang / bla ma rin po che gshegs rjes/ khos cha rkyen ldan tshul dang nus pas lcogs tshul gyis 'das mchod rgya chen po byas/ sku 'bum byams pa gling nas gser mgar dang dngul mgar gdan drangs te gser dngul zangs gsum gyis grub pa'i sku gdung mchod rten yid du 'ong ba zhig bzhengs rung / bla ma bka' drin can gyi sku drin dran na/ sems pa sngar bzhin sdug bsngal gyis khengs te/ go sa dang bde skyid/ tshe srog dang nye du bcas la brtse mdangs ci yang med par gyur pas/ a myes g.yu rngog gi phrag dog la mi 'tshem par nyi ma lha sar 'gro 'dod skyes/ lhag par du u ru su'i gnas skor pa sdom po de yong nas dbus gtsang skor bya kha brga rnab rdzo byas pa na/ kho dbus la 'artso 'dod sh+lau 'dun pa sngar las je drag la song ste/ lkog tu rta nor gyi phyed ka gser dngul dang ma// cha la brjes nas lam la chas grabs byas/ (u ru su'i gnas skor pa

srin po g.yu chog dang nyi ma lha sa/de don dngos su sog po zhig yin la/ khos bod yig dang bod skad cung tsam shes pas/ u ru su sa gshes zhib 'jug khang gis gron dngul 'bor chen btang nas bod yul la nyul mar btang ba yin/ kho rang rgyal du log rjes/srid gzhung gi bka' bsgos ltar bod khul 'grims pa'i lam yig〉ces pa zhig bris pa dang / dpe deb nang du bod kyi deng rabs pa rnams la mkho gal che ba'i yul srol goms 'dris gang mang gsal bor bkod yod par ma zad/ stong dpon nyi ma tshang gi gnas tshul yang bris 'dug la/ zhib 'jug khang zhig gis mkhas pa rnams la dmangs srol zhib 'jug la mkho ba'i zhib 'jug rgyu cha 'don sprod byed ched/ nye lam dpe deb de rgya yig la bsgyur nas par skrun byas 'dug)stong dpon nyi mar stong dpon gyi go sa thob pa nas bzung / lus sems bde la babs te don dag gal chen med na nyin gung bar du mal las lang mi srid/ dpon mo bde chen mtsho mo dpon tshang gi bdag mor gyur rjes/gnas lugs brgya stong bshad de khyo ga'i goms srol de bsgyur bar 'dod mod/khos rang gi spyod stangs de dpon chen gyi dpon tshugs dang mi chen gyi che tshugs ston thabs shig la rtsis te rgyun 'khyodas byas pa na/ lo gnyis gsum gyi rjes su don dag gal chen yod rung nyin gung bar du gnyid las mi sad pa dang sad rung lang 'dod med par gyur/ 'on kyang / da nangs nyi ma ri rtse nas thag tshad gcig tsam la 'phags ma thag stong dpon nyi ma rang 'gul 53

'tshub ma kher rkyang /gyis mal las langs pas/ thab las byed pa'i g.yog mos dpon por don dag gal chen zhig yod pa myur mor rtogs te/ brel 'tshub chen pos nangs ja skol mgo brtsams/ sgrol mas zangs kyi thom bu bzung nas a pa'i lag mgor chu blugs/ kha lag bkrus tshar rjes dpon pos mtshon sgam las nye sngon nyos pa'i me mda' rnams blangs te phyis/bla ma gshegs rjes/ stong dpon nyi mas mi chen gyi cha lugs thams cad dor te/ gong ba med pa'i slog chad cig gyon nas khong rin po che la mya ngan zhus/ slog pa de g.yog po mkhar tho tshang gi yin la/ bzos nas yun ring 'gor pa dang dbyar dus char chu'i nang la gyon myong bas/ thu ba dang phu thung tshang ma gyong nas rengs por gyur 'duganangs ja 'thungs rjes/ stong dpon nyi mas slog chad la ska rags bcings pa dang / rang gis me mda' gcig khur pa dang mda' ra gcig sked la bcings rjes/ me mda' 'phro ma rnams g.yog po 'ga'i lag la bzhag nas spra sgor bud/ khos lhas 'dabs na khyi 'ga' nyal 'dug pa mthong bas mtsho bha/ khyi khogs zer bzhin ci mi snyam par langs nas bsdad/ skabs der/g.yog mo mtsho bhas bu chung la nu ma snun bzhin yod mod/ dpon pos bos pa go ma thag myur ba myur bar bu chung rgyab la khur te/ sgo chon sne na yod pa'i shing gzhong de dag dkyil chon sne la bzhag pa dang / slar yang rkang 'jab lag 'jab kyis khyim la brgyugs yong nas dar ba bzho ze'u gang khyer nas 54

srin po ga rdzog dang nyi ma lha sa/shing gzhong du blugs te/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad na nyal 'dug pa'i khyi rnams bos/ stong dpon nyi mas mi chen gyi cha lugs dor te slog chad de gyon pa nas bzung / khyi rnams kyis bdag po mi cha med cig la brtsis te/ kho sgo chon sne la slebs ma thag phyogs so so nas rub yong bas/ mtsho bha med na chab gsang la'ang 'gro mi thub/stong dpon nyi ma 'khor dang bcas pa dal bur lhas 'dabs la slebs pa na/ rgya sgo tshwa khu'i sems la dga' snang dang 'tshub cha 'dres ma'i za 'phrug cig langs te/ myur mor lham dang lu ba gyon nas kho tsho'i gras la zhugs rtsis byas/ nam rgyun sde bar mgron po gal chen re med na/ pa'i sgo phyar 'og tu bsdad nas 'o ja 'thung bzhin dpon tshang gis ci byed lta ba ni kho'i dga' phyogs dang goms srol zhig tu gyur yod/ gal srid stong dpon phyi la 'gro rtsis byas pa na/ rjes su 'brangs thabs byas te dpon pos ci zhig las pa dang ci zhig bshad par mnyam 'jog byed bzhin dpon po'i dmigs bya gang dang 'char gzhi ci yin par bsam gzhig byed pa yin/ skabs rer stong dpon nyi ma'i 'char bkod rang nyid kyis rjes dpog byas pa dang yongs su mthun tshe dga' spro tshad med skyes te mtshan mo gnyid kyang mi khugs par 'gyur/ mkha' lding rin po che tshang sku bzhugs dus/ stong dpon nyi mas rang gi mgo spra ge sar rgyal po'i las gur g.yu spra thang shog gung dgu la brtsis te/ dbyar sa ston sa gang yin rung mgo spra'i phyogs bzhi la khyim tshang bzhi 55

'tshub ma khyer rkyang /bkod sgrig byas te/ rang gi sems su de la g.yas ru dang g.yon ru/ rgyab ru dang mdun ru zhes 'bod bzhin yod/ 'on kyang / mkha' lding rin po che tshang gshegs rjes/ sngon chad rjes su 'khrid bzhin yod pa'i khyim tshang rnams rang rang gi 'dod pa ltar ru spar du bcug mod/ rgya sgo tshwa khus rang gi goms srol de rgyun 'khyodas byed pa dang / sgrol ma dang klu skyabs gnyis la lhan 'dzom gyi go skabs yod par byed ched/ mgo sbra sngar srol ltar dpon tshang gi g.yas phyogs nas phub/ stong dpon nyi ma la bu mo sgrol ma gcig pu las med pas/ thob dang tham ga bsams nas mag pa byed 'dod mkhan ha cang mang / gal srid sgrol ma dang klu skyabs gnyis ka sha mthun rus mthun byung na/ rjes su stong dpon gyi tham ga klu skyabs la dbang nges yin/ de dag bsams tshe rgya sgo tshwa khu'i sems la za 'phrug langs te 'dug mi bzod/tsa a khu dpon po tshang gang la phebs rtsis yin/mi rgya bho tshwa khu stong dpon nyi ma las lo gsum che na'ang khos a khu zhes 'bod bzhin yod/6 me mda' 'di dag gi bzang ngan la lta bar 'gro rtsis yin/mi zu 'o na khyod tsho khos dpon por ngo bstod kyi gtam 'ga' bshad rtsis byas mod/ g.yog po kha bde 'ga' yod pas stabs mi 'grig pa shes te kho tshor dma' 'bebs byed ched ltar dris/6 nged cag tshwa la 'gro ba yin/’ g.yog po'i gras na tshe ring snabs lug zer ba zhig yod pa des ma dga' ba'i tshig lan mtshang la phog pa de byin/56

srin po ga rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/zu khyi dang khyi mo rnams la tshwa mkho na/ tshe ring tshang gi tshwa gter de blangs chog rgya sgos de ltar bshad pa na/ stong dpon 'khor dang bcas pa 'ur chil ler bgad/ tshe ring gis rang nyid kyi snabs lugs song snyam nas sna mdo lag pas bkab pa na/ g.yog po la la sar bsdad nas dgod dgos byung /kho tsho gdong ga chung chung zhig brgyud nas mi zog gcig kyang med pa'i gram chen der slebs pa na/ stong dpon nyi mas 'gro mtshams bzhag ste ya/sdod sdod/ de ring 'di nas 'u cag gis bo'u gang bzang dang bu gang ngar la lta ya zer bzhin g.yas g.yon gyi ong ba bstan te stobs lo/ khyod kyis gom pa lnga brgya'i mtshams nas mi re la 'ben che chung med pa re zhog dang zhes bshad pa na/ stobs los ya ya zer nas myur mor thu khud la yong ba btus te gom pa rtsi bzhin pha bong zhig gzas nas bud song /lha sar 'gro ba'i nyi ma sleb la nye bas/ stong dpon nyi ma'i sems la 'tshub cha langs nas 'dug ma bzod/ de ring khos nye sngon nyos pa'i pu ra de dag gzu min la lta rtsis yin la/ dbus la 'gro dus mtshon cha bzang bo skor zhig ma bzung na/ jag pa dang rkun ma'i lag 'og nas thar mi thub/ kho me mda' la dga' ba ma gtogs don med la me mda' mi 'phen pas/ 'khor g.yog re la mda' bcu re byin rjes/ rgyang mthong bzung ste mtha' nas ltad mor bltas/ 'khor g.yog gzhan rnams kyis mda' bcu bo 'phangs te rang 57

'tshub ma kher rkyang /gi 'ben rtsa med du btang mod/ tshe ring gis bo'u mig la len ma shes pas mda' gcig kyang 'ben la ma phog rgya bho tshwa khus stong dpon nyi mas glo bur du mtshon cha 'di 'dra mang po nyo don ci yin nam snyam nas de kho nar bsam blo gtong bzhin me mda' 'phangs pas khos kyang 'ben la ma phog stong dpon nyi mas tshul te mthong bas ci 'dra'i bu sdug gnyis/ kha gson po dang lag shi bo zhes sdigs mo byed bzhin 'jam dbyangs tshe brtan dang stobs lo gnyis ma'i lag la mda' lnga re bzhag ste me mda' 'di gnyis ku'i lag la zhog zer/'jam dbyangs tshe brtan dang stobs lo gnyis gas mda' lnga la brten nas rang gi 'ben rtsa med du btang ba na/ stong dpon nyi mar bsam don 'grub pa'i dga' spro zhig skyes nas slar yang mi re'i lag la mda' lnga re bzhag ste ca'adi rnams gang 'dod du phongs zer bas/ 'khor g.yog gzhan rnams dga' ste 'ben 'os 'tsham zhig btsal ched ri ngos la 'gos/ rgya bho tshwa khu gcig pu stong dpon gyi gam nas bsdad/zu rgya bho/ song ya/mi 4 min/ nga la me mda' 'phen 'dod med/ ru ci red/ don dag 'dra yod dam/mi zu med yin khyed sa cha zhig la phebs rtsis yod zer ba bden nam/mi rgya bho tshwa khus dpon tshang gi 'char gzhi rtogs par byed ched g.yo 58

srin po g.yu rdzog dang nyi ma lha sa/thabs kyis de ltar dris/smyo nged tshang lha sar 'gro rtsis yod ces sus bshad pa yin/mi stong dpon nyi ma ha las song / kho tshang lha sar 'gro rtsis yod pa de dpon mo dang bu mo gnyis gas kyang mi shes mod/ rgya bho tshwa khus ji ltar shes pa yin nam snyam/khyim mi rnams snga gzhug tu nyal rjes/ rgya bho tshwa khus rang gi bu klu skyabs khrid de lhas 'dabs la song / smag rum khrod du rdog sne'ang gsal bor mi mthong rung / khos thog mar dogs zon chen pos phyogs bzhi la zhib lta yud tsam byas rjes/ klu skyabs sar tsog tu bcug ste rang nyid gam nas bsdad/4 dpon po nyi ma tshang lha sar 'gro nges red/’ 66khyod kyis ji ltar shes/mi rgya bho tshwa khus nyin mo byung ba'i don dag de zhib bshad thengs shig byas/zu 'o na/ a khu nyi mas gsang don ci yin/mi 6 glen pa klad med 'di/ dpon po dbus la 'gro rtsis yod pa go na/sde ba tsho ba a myes g.yu rngog gi phrag dog la skrag ste bshol na 'gro thabs med la/ 'u tshugs kyis 'gro thabs byas rung / rkun ma jag pas thos na lam sgug byas te 'phrog bcom byed nges yin/ 'di tsam yang mi shes sam/’ 6 'o na 'u cag 'gro rgyu yin nam/’ 6 'thob bya ci yang med par 'chi bdag gi kha nang la sding don med/59
