'tshub ma kher rtsang /khyod kyis myur ba myur bar sgrol ma sa cha gzhan zhig la khrid/ nyi ma bza' zla gnyis ka dbus lam nas ma thar rung / sgrol ma bde mo 'tshams po yin na stong dpon gyi tham ga 'u tshang la dbang song ba red/mi 6 ngas sgrol ma gang la 'khrid thabs byed/mi 6 mor paṇa chen rin po che sku 'bum la phebs 'dug 'u gnyis ka mjal bar 'gro zhes shod dang / mo 'gro ba thag chod yin/’ 6 paṇa chen tshang sku 'bum la phebs 'dug gam/ ’64de sus shes/ ngas ma shes na sde ba 'di'i nang mi gcig gis kyang shes mi srid/ gang ltar khyod gnyis zla ba 'ga' la phyir rang yul du ma yong /mi 6 'o na sgrol mas rjes su 'u gnyis ma'i g.yo sgyu bkod pa shes na ci bya/ ’6 'o na 'o na ma zer/ nga rgya bho bla ma min rung ma 'ongs lung bstan la mkhas/ skye dman bu mo zhig la de lta bu'i blo rgya yod mi srid/ rang kha gser gyi sgo mor bdag dam byed thub na/ mos mi shes kho thag yin/mi 6 'o na mi //'o na sdod kyi a pa'i ro/ 'gro/ gzhan gyis go na ci bya/’ a rog sgrol ma la pha ma gnyis gar nges par du gsang dgos pa'i rgyu marten ri rab 'dra zhig shod/ dpon po bza' zla gnyis nas shes na ma 'grig pa 6)/6ya ya/mi

srin po g.yu rdzog dang nyi ma lha sa/khyi rgan rgya stag glo bur du zug pas a ye dkar skyid dang gsar brje skyid gnyis ka gcig 'phror gcig gis ded nas spra sgor bud pa na/ mkha' mo mtsho lhas 'dabs la slebs nas langs 'dug gsar brje skyid kyis khyi rgan bkag nas 'dzum dmul dmul gyis mo bsus/ da lta gsar brje skyid kyis pha ma gnyis ka dbus la rdzong thabs byed ched/ 'brog mo dkyus ma zhig gi 'du shes bzung ste khyim las sogs la 'bad pa lhod med byas pas/ sde mi rnams ha las par gyur 'dugatsa mkha' mo mtsho/ de ring khom 'dug gam/ shog shog 6 min/ khyim la 'gro khom med/ nga la tshong tsag cig re dgos pa yin/mi mkha' mo mtshos gsar brje skyid kyi gshis spyod skyug bro ba de dran pas/tshig gcig kyang bshad ma 'dod par gzas nas tshong rdzas shom sa'i spra gur )migs nas song ba na/ gsar brje skyid kyang mo'i rjes su 'brangs nas teng /sbra nag tshong khang nang gi tshong rdzas mang che ba lha chang yin la/ gyon gos dang du ba'ang sna tshogs bshams 'dug mkha' mo mtshos tshong rdzas rnams la zhib lta byed bzhin rang gi mkho dngos btsal/lha khyod tshang gi a ma lha sar 'gro grabs yod dam/mi 61

'tshub ma kher rkyang / cad rung mi shes/’ mgon po rgyal gyis rang nyid a lags mkha' lding tshang gi yang srid yin par bshad rjes a ye sgrol ma dbus la 'gro ba'i bsam pa de bas kyang je brtan du gyur pas/ dge go bza' zla gnyis ka yid 'thad mi 'byung ka med yin/ 'on kyang / mos gsar brje skyid la drang gtam bshad 'dod med pas/ ci mi snyam pa'i ngang nas de ltar bshad/gsar brje skyid kyis mkha' mo mtsho'i khengs nyams de mthong ma thag zhe sdang zhig ngang gis langs mod/ mo'i gzi 'od bral ba'i mig zung dang bab chags ldan pa'i gyon gos/ ci zhig mthong rung ngo mtshar pa'i ngang nas yun ring la lta ba'i gshes spyod rnams mthong rjes/ rang gi sems la rig gnas med pa dang mthong rgya chung ba'i dbang gis bod rigs bud med skor dang rim pa zhig la/ skyes pas dbang sgyur ba'i spyi tshogs 'dis mnar gcod byas te tshe srog gi rin thang mngon 'gyur byed thub kyin med par ma zad/phyogs nges can zhig nas bshad na/ kho tsho ni ming gi chung ma dang don gyi g.yog mor gyur 'dug snang tshul de rtogs pa'i bud med re gnyis las med pa dran pas/ mkha' mo mtsho la sems khong rus pa'i gting nas snying rje zhig skyes nas/ mos tshong rdzas gang dgos zer kyang 'dzum dmul dmul gyis blangs nas lag la bzhag pa yin/mkha' mo mtshos a ye sgrol ma la tshi len gcig dang stod gos gcigabyis pa gsum por rgya lu cha tshang re/ dge go la tshi len gcig bcas nyos pa na/62

srin po ga rdzog dang nyi ma lha sa/gsar brje skyid kyis glog rtsis ngos nas myur mor rtsis brgyab ste bsdoms sdus sgor mo sum brgya dang bcu bdun yin mod/ sum brgya byin na chog rjos ba//'a/ mo mtshos tshong rin byin pa na/ da rung sgor mo nyung tsam lhag 'dug pas/ rang nyid la ras lham gcig dang mgo dkri gcig bcas nyos te 'gro rtsiX byed skabs/ a khu klu skyabs kyis kha ton 'don bzhin sbra nang la 'dzul rdor+sha / lu mang po nyos 'dug sna a khu/ mang po ma nyos/ ngas sgor mo de tsam bzung med/ ’66mang gi mang gi 'o de red/ a ma lha sar 'gro rgyu e red/mi ‘ da rung mi shes/’ mos gsar brje skyid la de ltar bshad pas a khu klu skyabs la'ang de ltar mi bshad ka med byung /‘ 'o de red/ a khu klu skyabs kyis mkha' mo mtsho'i kha nas skad cha gsar ba zhig ma lon pas ma ṇi 'don bzhin spra sgor bud/ kho phar la gom pa 'ga' phyin rjes ci zhig dran pa ltar phyir 'khor te mna' ma mkha' mo/khyod tshang gi zog rdzi su yin mi ces dris/6 a khu/ zhi li gnyis ka yin ya zhes mkha' mo mtshos tshong khang las lan btab/63

'tshub ma kher rkyang /sman lung ni lung ba ya mtshan can zhig yin te/ than pa ci 'dra che rung rtswa dang rtsi tog gi skye tshul sngar ltar bzang / yin na'ang lo du ma'i sngon nas bzung sa de spyang gis khengs te nor lug ci tsam song na de tsam gsod pa yin/ yul tsho srid gzhung gis gnas tshul de shes rjes/ myur ba myur bar spyang gsod ru khag rtsa 'dzugs byas te mtsha/ lung la mngags mod/ zla phyed tsam gyi ring la spyang ki phar zhog tha na rgyang ki'i rjes tsam yang ris ma thub pas/ mgo khrid 'u thug ste lan chags red/ deng skabs kyi spyang ki la'ang rdzu 'phrul yod pa 'dra zhes bshad bzhin mi rnams rang rang gi yul la mi mngag ka med byung / ngo mtshar pa zhig ni/ dge go tshang gi nor lug lung ba de la ci tsam song rung spu nyag gcig kyang yal ma myong / de ring rta mgrin tshe ring dang mgon po rgyal gnyis nas phyugs khyu sman lung gi ri ngos la bsgos rjes/ skabs rer mchong lding byed pa dang mtshams rer gcig gis gcig la mtshar gtam re bshad bzhin nor lug gar song rig sa'i de'u 'bur kher skyes de'i ngos la dal gyis 'gos/ kho gnyis la cha mtshon na/ nor lug sman lung la 'ded pa'i spro snang ha cang che/ gcig na khyim tshang gzhan pa'i lug khyu de na med pa dang / gnyis na lug gi sngon ma ri bo'i pha rol tu 'gro grabs byed skabs/ mgon po rgyal gyis 'phyi khung las dung dkar de blangs nas lan gsum bus pa na/ khyi mo thar zer ba'i bu mo lkugs pa de brgyugs yong ste lug rnams ri ngos la phab nges yin/ rta mgrin tshe ring pha gi'i ri rtse la 64

srin po g.yu rdzog dang nyi ma lha sa/'gos ma myong mod/ mgon po rgyal gyis bshad pa ltar na/ ri bo'i pha rol ni mu mtha' med pa'i sa cha g.yer mo zhig yin la/ 'di phyogs nas bltas na sprin dkar gyi klad la shor 'dug nga 'i ri bo de/ par phyogs nas bltas na jag pa lam nyal dang 'dra ba'i de'u 'bur chung chung zhig yin/ de dang thag mi ring ba'i sa na khyi mo thar tshang gi ston mtsher yod pa dang / mo yul mi rnams kyis nad par brtsis te khyim las gcig kyang las mi dgos pas/nam rgyun de'u 'bur klad la bud de dge go tshang gis ci byed la lta bzhin yod/mo la ngag gi nus pa med rung mig ni ha cang gsal bas/ nyin mtshan gang yin rung mi phal bas mi rig sa na ci yod pa mos gsal ler mthong thub/mgon po rgyal gyis dus rgyun dang 'dra bar g.ya' leb 'ga'i steng la sa dang rdo yi mchod pa bshams rjes/ sngar gyi 'dug sa de nas skyil krung du bsdad de dbyangs tsam las ci yang mi go ba'i ngang nas ci zhig 'don bzhin 'dug rta mgrin tshe ring gis tshul de mthong ma thag de ring yang sngar bzhin rang gcig pus nyi ma 'khyol thabs byed dgos snyam nas/ 'u thug pa'i shugs ring zhig 'then bzhin lug khyu gar 'gro la zhib lta thengs shig byas rjes/ rum nas hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉kyi stod cha blangs te bltas/ kho slob grwar zhugs ma myong rung / a pha dge rgan la bsten nas bod yig sbyangs pas lo gcig gi rjes su klog 'don la byang bar gyur/ lhag par a pas rta rgyugs dpyid kyi nyi ma〉deb gcig nyos yong ba nas bzung / sgrung dpe de la 65

'tshub ma kher rkyang /thengs bcu lhag la bltas pas bod yig gi yon tshad ldab 'gyur gyis je bzang la song bar ma zad/ sgrung de blo nas kyang bshad thub par gyur/ kho'i yid 'dzin dang rig pa rim bzhin kun la grags pa dang / ge sar sgrung la lta 'dod kyi kun slong de nyin bzhin je drag nas je drag tu gyur/ 'on kyang /nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la sa gnas so so'i dpe skrun khang gis sgrung dpe mang po par skrun byas rung / sa cha 'di na dpe khang gcig kyang med pas shin tu nyo dka'/ mtsho sngon rlung 'phrin khang gis sgrung dpe sna tshogs la sgra blangs te gtong bzhin 'dug rung / mtshan mo sgra sdud 'khor lo las grags pa'i tsag sgra mi skad las mtho bas/ sems rnal la phab nas zhib mor nyan rung ci yang mi go bas/ sde mi rnams kyis bar snang 'phrin gyi pho nya〉la nyan thabs mi 'dug zer nas sdug smre 'don bzhin yod/ rta mgrin tshe ring gis rtsom rig le tshan gtong ba'i dus tshod la slebs thengs rer/ nam rgyun sgra sdud 'khor lo'i glog sgo yar skor mar skor byas nas tsag sgra de med thabs byed par 'bad mod grub 'bras ci yang ma byung / nyin 'ga'i sngon la/ a khu klu skyabs tshang gi tshong khang la sgrung dpe skor zhig blangs yod pa go rjes/ a pha la zhu ba byas nas sgor mo nyi shu lhag len thabs byas te sgrung dpe sna drug tsam nyos/ khos dpa' rgod snang ngu g.yu stag hor gyi a lnga mtheb drug gis bkrongs pa'i le'u der bltas tshar ba na/ sems gting nas sdug bsngal gyi zug gzer chen po zhig dal gyis langs pa dang mchi ma rdog po 'ga' mig 66

srin po g.yu rdzog dang nyi ma lha sa/zung brgyud nas mkhur ngos la babs/ ma bzhi dpon po khro thung gis phu nu dgra lag la 'jog pa'i spyod stangs tha shal ba de dran ma thag khong khro bzod glags med pa zhig skyes byung /mgon po rgyal gyis rang nyid a lags mkha' sding tshang gi yang srid yin pa bshad bshad rjes/ a ye sgrol ma dang dge go bza' zla gnyis gas kha nas kho la ci yang mi bshad rung / sems gting nas khas len dang yid ches byed bzhin yod pa 'dra/ sngon chad gos ser po rnams bla ma'i sku chas yin zer nas bza' mi zhig la mi nyo mod/ kha nyin khrim mi rnams kyis gros byas rjes mkha' mo mtshos a khu klu skyabs tshang nas tshi len ser po zhig nyos nas mgon po rgyal la bskon 'dugasngon dus yin na/ mgon po rgyal gyis bos na a dang bshad na ya zhes gus gus zhum zhum gyis kha len tshig brtsi ma byas na/ rta mgrin tshe ring gis phu bo'i khe dbang ltar kho la gcar rdung dang sdigs mo 'os shing 'tsham pa zhig byed nges yin mod/ 'on kyang / mgon po rgyal gyis rang nyid a lags mkha' lding tshang gi sprul sku yin par bshad pa dang / mi gcig kyang 'gro mi phod pa'i mkha' lding mtshams khang nas dung dkar dngul shan ma zhig rnyed de/ngo mtshar pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs ston bzhin nga'i spyod pa 'di dag mi gcig la'ang bshad mi rung zhes yang yang gdams pa na/ rta mgrin tshe ring thog mar ha las shing rjes su sems rnal la phab nas bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu 67

'tshub ma kher rkyang /gnyis btang rjes/ don zhig gi mthil rtogs pa ltar yid la nongs 'gyod dang 'jigs snang gis khengs te lags so/ ngas bshad na dkon mchog gsum zhes dam bca' byas/ dus de nas bzung / nu bos kha len tshig brtsi mi byed dus gcar rdung byed pa par zhog tha na tshig btsan po zhig kyang bshad mi phod par gyur/‘ rem rem/ dung bus/mi rta mgrin tshe ring gis lug khyu ri rtse la slebs pa mthong bas 'tshab 'tshub kyi ngang nas de ltar bshad/mgon po rgyal gyis ri rtse la lta tsam byas rjes shugs ring zhig 'then cing / 'phyi khung las dung dkar de blangs nas shugs kyis lan gsum bus pa dang / de nas dung dkar steng gi sa rdul gtsang mar phyis te shubs su bcug rjes sngar gyi 'phyi khung nang la bzhag nas ci yang mi bshad par sa la bsdad/ yud tsam 'gor rjes/ khyi mo thar gyis ri rtse nas skya yor rer lug khyu'i kha phyir bskor/ 6khyi mo thar 'on pa zhis yin pas dung sgra ji ltar go ba yin/mi rta mgrin tshe ring gis rang sems kyi dogs gzhi de sel ched de ltar dris/ 6khyi mo thar gyi skye ba sngon ma ni nam rgyun mkha' lding mtshams khang gi sgo 'gram na nyal 'dug pa'i khyi mo sdom po zhig ste/ dus yun ring bor chos skad go ba'i drin gyis skye ba phyi mar mi lus thob pa dang / skabs rer a lags tshang gi bzhes pa brkus nas zos pa'i rnam smin gyis tshe 'dir rnas mi go zhing 68

zin bo g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/ngag brda ma 'phrod pa red/mi 4 'o na 'u tshang gi phyugs khyu sman lung la song rung spyang gis mi gsod pa ci yin/’ 46de ni bla ma mkha' lding tshang sku gong ma'i sku drin los yin// 6'o de red/mi rta mgrin tshe ring gis yid tshims nas de skad bshad/nyin gung yol pa dang bstun nas nyi ma'i tsha gdug rim gyis je chung la song bas/ lug khyu lob phyogs kyis ri ngos nas dal bur mar babs byung /rta mgrin tshe ring dang mgon po rgyal gnyis skar las ka ci yang med pas/de'u 'bur klad nas mig mangs rtse mgo brtsams/kho gnyis yod sa'i de'u 'bur de mtho rgyu med mod/ mdun phyogs nas bltas na ri'i chags dbyibs rtswa chus 'grangs pa'i glang chen zhig sos dal bag phebs kyis nyal 'dug pa dang mtshungs pas/ yul mi rnams kyis glang chen phyug ri zhes 'bod bzhin yod/ mkha' ring kun bzang rang grol thub bstan chos dbyings rdo rje tshang gnas 'dir phebs ma thag sa la bcud dang mi la g.yang 'khor ched/ glang chen gyi rgyab la rin po che sna tshogs kyi gter brgyab/ 'on kyang / na ning dbyar khar/ ri 'dabs su dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu rko mkhan mi nyung ba zhig slebs nas ras gur phub ste dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu brkos pa red/ rjes su sde ba'i mgo khrid kyis dmangs dmag rtsa 'dzugs byas te/ zhor las pa de tsho phar bskrad par chas tshe kho tshos6 /bu

'tshub ma kher rkyang /bskos tshar nas gar song cha med du gyur/ de bas rgan pa rnams kyis da lo char chu dkon pa'ang ri gter bslogs pa des lan pa yin zer/skya rengs gnyis pas shar phyogs kyi mkha' mtha' skya gsal ler btang ba dang mnyam du/ stong dpon nyi mas rta nor lug gsum lhas las phud de/mdang dgong gi bkod sgrig ltar rta khyu'i rjes la g.yog po gnyis/ nor khyu'i rjes la g.yog po gnyis/ lug khyu'i rjes la g.yog po gnyis bcas mngags/g.yog po rnams dga' dga' spro spro'i ngang nas rang rang gi rta thog la bud de ki rgyangs byed bzhin lug khyu sprin dkar 'phyur 'dra/ rta khyu mtshams sprin brdol 'dra/ nor khyu rdza ri nyil 'dra byas te byang phyogs kyi rtswa ra pad+ma stong ldan dmigs nas ded song / de nas stong dpon nyi ma khyim la 'dzul te/g.yog po 'phro lus rnams la bkod 'doms byas te/ snga mo nas gra sgrig byas yod pa'i ca lag rnams mdzo g.yag la bkal rjes/ 'jam dbyangs tshe brtan gtsos pho gsar bcu gcig mngags te khal ma ded pa dang / de nas dpon mo bde chen mtsho mo dang ja ma g.yog mo gnyis sogs rta thog la bud pa na/phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad na nyal 'dug pa'i khyi rnams kyang myur mor bdag po'i rjes su bsnyegs byung /skabs der/ 'phro lus kyi g.yog po g.yog mo yod tshad dpon tshang gi lhas 'dabs su dpon mo 'khor dang bcas par mig gis skyel ma byed bzhin 70

srin po gas rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/dpon po'i bka' gsung la bsgugs nas bsdad/ tshul de mthong bas stong dpon nyi ma'i sems la zug gzer bzod glags bral ba zhig langs te/ kha lce srid nas skad cha'ang bshad mi thub par gyur/ khos g.yog po g.yog mo rnams kyi gdong la cer nas yun ring bsdad pa na/ g.yog mo la la dogs ma bde bar mgo bo sgur te lag pa 'phur 'phur byas/66'gro 'gro/ khyim la 'gro/mi stong dpon nyi mas de ltar bshad de/khyim la yong nas pho khyim gyi yar snyed nas bsdad/ g.yog po rnams dal bur yong nas snga rjes su dpon po'i zhol du bsdad/ g.yog mo rnams mo khyim du langs nas dpon pos ci gsung la bsgugs/46khyod tsho'i ngo mdangs 'gyur 'dug pa ci yin/mi 6 lags/ nged cag gis khyed gang la phebs rtsis yod pa mi shes pas sems ha cang mi bde/mi g.yog po bsam shes shig gis de ltar zhus/smyo nga thag ring zhig la 'gro rtsis med/ khyod tsho'i sems bde mo gyis/spyir yin na da thengs 'u cag tshang ma mnyam du 'gro dgos mod/ gcig na 'u tshang gi mgo spra la lta mkhan med pa dang / gnyis na sgrol ma gar song mi shes pas/ myur mor rang yul la slebs na/ 'dug sa dang 'dug rogs 'ga' med na mi 'grig rgyu mtshan 'di dang 'di 'dra zhig gi rkyen gyis khyod tsho ma khrid pa yin/mi 6 lags so/mi g.yog po g.yog mo rnams kyis snga rjes su de ltar ba///

'tshub ma khyer byung /snyo de na ha cang bzang / ya/ mtsho bha/ khyod 'dir shog dang /mi zu ya lags/mi mtsho bha gam la slebs rjes/ stong dpon nyi mas mdzod sgam gyi lde mig thams cad mo'i lag la bzhag ste/ sgrol ma yul la myur mor slebs na/ lde mig rnams mor byin te dpon khyim la bdag dam bzang bo byed dgos pa dang / gal srid myur bar ma yong na/ khyim 'di'i dbang can mtsho bha yin zhing / mdzod kyi rnam rdzas rnams la ser sna mi byed par g.yog po g.yog mo rnams kyi 'tsho ba bkod sgrig legs po byed dgos tshul sogs yang bshad bskyar bshad byas/ mtsho bhas ya ya/ lags so sogs kyang yid la ma dran par had nas langs bsdad/ mo chung dus su dwa phug tu gyur pas dpon tshang gis gnyor skyong byas nas nar son pa yin/ mo lo sum cu lhag la son rung de ring bar du lde mig cig la reg ma myong ba dang / las 'gan 'di 'dra lci mo zhig phrag la blangs ma myong bas/ dran pa shor te lus po bar snang rgyus med cig na rang dbang med par dal gyis g.yo ba dang mtshungs/smyo lags/ sgrol ma sa cha gang la song ba yin/mi g.yog po bsam shes des de ltar dris/tsa sus shes/ ngas kyang mi shes/ ngo ma/ sgrol ma sa cha gang la song ba dang nam zhig rang yul du log rgyu yin pa stong dpon nyi mas kyang mi shes/ dang thog mo gar song cha med du 72

srin po g.yu rdzog dang nyi ma lha sa/gyur pa na/ dpon po yab yum gnyis gas sems pa skyo gdung dang 'tshub chas mnar te/ g.yog po g.yog mo thams cad mngags nas nye 'gram gyi ri lung kun la zhib btsal byas rung ma rnyed/ de'i rjes su rgya bho tshwa khu tshang gi klu skyabs kyang sgrol ma bor pa'i mtshan mo der gar song mi shes pa go bas/ khong khro ri rab yom yom sgul ba zhig langs te/ myur mor rgya bho btson la bkag ste 'dri gcod byed rtsis byas mod/ slar yang bsam blo re btang na gal srid rang nyid dbus lam nas thar ma thub na/ bu mo phyi la bros pa de rkyen ngan grogs su gyur pa ma yin nam snyam nas/ rgya sgo'i g.yo jus la sems gting nas bka' drin zhu bzhin bya ba de snang med du bzhag ste/ myur mor dbus la chas par gra sgrig byas/bu mo dang khyim tshang bcol dam byas tshar rjes/ stong dpon nyi mas rang nyid kyang 'gro ran 'dug snyam ste yar langs nas sbra sgor slebs pa na/rang gis dngos po gal chen zhig brjed 'dug pa dran/ gal srid de rgya bho tshwa khu'i lag la shor na tsho ba'i mgo la skyid til 'bru tsam yang mi yong snyam ste/mtsho bha'i lag nas lde mig blangs nas ya phugs kyi mdzod sgam las tham ga blangs te rum la bcug rjes lde mig slar yang mtsho bha'i lag la bzhag ste spra sgor bud/ kho myur mor rta thog la bud de yob deb cig byas pa na/ rta phos byang phyogs dmigs nas gom 'gros byed mgo brtsams/ stong dpon nyi mas ru skor khyim mtshes rnams kyis ci byed la lta bzhin rta kha bsgags nas sngon la 73

'tshub ma kher rkyang /song / skabs der/ nye 'gram gyi khyim tshang so so'i sbra sgo la mi 'ga' re bud yod na'ang / mi gcig kyang dpon po'i gam la song nas gar 'gro zhib 'dri byed ma phod/ rgya bho tshwa khu tshang gi sbra sgo na mi gcig kyang mi mthong la sal cher stong dpon gyi khong khro'i me lce de slar yang 'bar byung na ci bya snyam nas khyim la yibs nas bsdad pa yin las che/stong dpon nyi mas rang gis mi lo bzhi bcu lhag la 'tsho rten byas pa'i ri lung rgyus yod rnams la zhib lta byed bzhin dal brel med par sngon la phyin/sman lung du slebs dus nyin gung phal cher yol 'dug la/ rta nor lug gsum dang dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa snga mo nas sa der slebs nas phyugs khyu ri ngos la bsgos shing spra nag rnams legs par phub 'dug za nag re re'i kha tshub tu du ba sngo lhog lhog gyen la 'phyur bzhin gda'/ khos dpon po'i gyon gos cha tshang de gyon yod pas/ sbra nag gi nye 'gram la slebs tshe khyi mang gis bdag po ngos zin te rnga ma g.yug bzhin mdun la brgyugs yong / g.yog po 'gas kyang stong dpon rig ste lag zung sngon la bsrings nas bsu ba byed par song ba dang / kho rta thog nas babs ma thag chibs rta'i srab mda' 'phrog res byed bzhin so ma brdabs pa'i rta phur la btags/6 nyi ma/ 'u cag gang la 'gro rtsis yin/ stong dpon nyi ma bza' btung gis 'grangs rjes g.yog mo gnyis kur laX ka ci yang med pas phyi la bud song / skabs de dang bstun nas dpon

srin po ga rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/mo bde chen mtsho mos de ltar dris/tsa gang la'ang mi 'gro/mi smyo 'o na sman lung nas gtan 'dug byed rgyu yin nam/mi 6 min/ sang nyin mu mthud du 'gro dgos/mi 6 gang la 'gro dgos/ ’stong dpon nyi mas ci yang mi bshad par dpon mo bde chen mtsho mo'i gdong la cer nas bsdad/ mo bud med gshis bzang zhig yin par ma zad/chung dus mo sgo kun la grags te stong dpon gyi go sa dang 'dra bar gsar bu rnams kyi rtsod gzhir gyur/ dpon tshang gi bdag mo byas pa nas bzung /khyim las gcig kyang las mi dgos pa dang zas gos la 'dang rgyag med pas/lo bzhi bcu lhag la son rung nas nyams chen po med mod/ sgrol ma phyi la bros rjes mos nyin mtshan dus drug la bu mor sems khur byas pas/ dus yun thung ngu'i nang dpral ngos la'ang gnyer phreng 'ga' babs byung / stong dpon gyis chung ma'i gdong la bltas kyin bltas kyin snying rje zhig skyes byung /'on kyang / gang la 'gro rtsis yod pa drang bshad byas na/ mos g.yog po g.yog mo thams cad grogs su bkugs na dbus la 'gro thabs mi 'dug bsams te ci yang mi bshad par spra sgor bud/ nyi 'od drag po'i 'og tu/mig lam la kha dog sna lnga ldan pa'i 'od kor che chung mang po rub yong / khos lag pa mig klad la bkab nas phyogs yar mar la bltas pa na/ bla ma mkha' 75

'tshub ma kher rkyang /lding rin po che tshang gis kho jag la 'gro bar skul sa'i de'u 'bur de mig lam la mngon pas/ myur mor rta thog la bud de de'u 'bur de'i phyogs su song /de'u 'bur de mtho rgyu med rung / rtse la 'gos te rgyang lta byas na sman lung gi ri sul thams cad lag mthil la blangs pa dang mtshungs/ gang sa gang du dkar chil ler/ khra ldem mer bzhad 'dug pa'i me tog mthong na/mi sems kyi sdug bsngal dang skyo gdung skad cig nyid la yal 'gro/ lhag par lung ba'i g.yas ngos g.yon ngos la rta nor lug gsum gyis khengs pa de gos chen ngos la mu tig gtor ba dang 'dra bar lta ba mig gi dpyid du smin yong /stong dpon nyi mas sman lung la rtswa ra pad+ma stong ldan zhes btags yod na'ang nyi ma de ring gi yar sngon la/ yul 'di'i mdzes ljongs 'di 'dra yag pa gtan nas ma rtogs/ skabs shig la kho'i mig lam du glang chen phyug ri shar byung ba na/ glang chen gyi rgyab la sa bcud mi g.yang mi 'chor ba'i gter zhig brgyag dgos bsams med/ bla ma bka' drin can mi bzhugs pas/ rang nyid la nus pa dang yon tan de tsam med pa dran te/ 'u thug pa'i shugs ring zhig 'ben rjes ri ngos las mar babs/phyi nyin nangs ja 'thungs rjes/ stong dpon nyi mas g.yog po g.yog mo rnams rang gi sbra nang la bsdus te/ mi re la 'phyor gos gsar ba cha tshang re byin nas gyon du bcug pa dang / de nas me mda' rnams sgam las blangs te g.yog po re la me mda' re dang mda' ra mda' yis gang ba re byin pa na/76

srin po ga rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/g.yog po g.yog mo rnams dga' ste kha zum mi thub par gyur/ dpon mo'i yid sems sngar las mi bde bar gyur rung / skyas kyi rjes su ded nas byang phyogs su mi 'gro ka med byung / kho tsho sbrul lung nyag chen gyi pha rol tu slebs pa na/ stong dpon gyis da ni dbus kyi lam sde 'dzin ran song snyam nas/g.yog po rnams la bka' phab ste rta nor lug gsum gyi khyu sne lho nub phyogs su bskor nas 'ded du bcug stong dpon nyi ma thog mar lam la chas dus skyas kha byang phyogs su gtad nas 'gro bar dmigs yul gnyis yod de/ gcig na kho thog mar jag la 'gro skabs byang phyogs su song bas bsam don yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang / byang phyogs ni kho la mtshon na bkra shis pa'i kha phyogs shig yin/ gnyis ni thog mar byang phyogs la song ba dang / de nas skyadi kha lho nub phyogs su bsgyur na tsho ba dang jag rkun la mgo skor thebs 'gro banganakho/ tsho de ltar nyin lnga tsam la song ba na/ grang ngar che zhing sa gshis mi legs pa'i sa cha med dang yul rgyus med cig la slebs byung / mtshan mo gnas der zhag 'dug byas pa dang phyi nyin zhogs par lam la chas te 'gro rtsis byas tshe/ pho rog bdun 'phur yong ste rta nor lug gsum la gshog lcag gis brgyab nas yul phyogs su bskor pas/ stong dpon nyi mas a ces g.yu rngog gi ra mda' slebs byung snyam nas/ myur mor rum gyi chang rdza blangs te lha 'bod klu 'bod byed bzhin mchod pa na/ pho rog rnams shar phyogs su 77

'tshub ma kher rkyang /'phur song mod/ kho rang gi sems khams sngar las mi bde bar gyur/6 lags/ 'u cag lha sar 'gro ba yin nam/mi 'jam dbyangs tshe brtan stong dpon gyi gam la yong nas gsang stabs kyis de ltar dris/6 yin/mi skad cha de go rjes/ 'jam dbyangs che brtan la mtshar snang ci yang med par ma zad gdong nas 'jigs snang tsam yang mi mthong / stong dpon nyi mas tshul de mthong bas glo bur yid la ci zhig dran pa ltar rum nas tham ga dang tsan dan dkar po'i phreng ba zhig blangs te kho'i lag la bzhagazu 'di mi 6 tham ga red/ phreng ba ni a lags mkha' lding tshang gi phyag phreng yin/nga'i lo na tshod mtho ba dang skya rtsal zhan pas/ rjes su yul lha gzhi bdag gis cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan na bdag dam bzang bo byed mi thub/ khyod kyis do dam bzang bo gyis/mi legs /ya sdu /gas/ tham ga ngas 'dzin/ phyag phreng khyed kyis zungs dang 6 phyag phreng khyod kyi srung ba byos/ ngas grib srung khams gsum zil gnon btags yod pas skyon med/mi stong dpon 'khor dang bcas pa dang rta nor lug gsum brag ri ral gri/ 8gtub 'dra gnyis kyis bcir ba'i 'gag 'phrang dog mo zhig las brgal

zin po ga rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/pa na/ rtswa chu 'dzoms pa'i lung ba g.yer mo zhig la slebs byung bas/ mi sems rim gyis bde la babs pa dang snang ba'ang sngar las je skyid la song /kho tshos rta nor lug gsum lung mthil la bkram ste dal ba dal bur sngon la 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs su/ mdun phyogs su glo bur du spyang tshogs shig 'dus te lhan du ngu zug byas/ nor lug rnams kyis tshul de mthong bas 'jigs zhed kyi 'ba' sgra ldir rer khal ma'i nye 'gram la zhogs yong ste skor rgyug byas/ skyas rjes na yod pa'i khyi mang gis tshul de mthong bas khyi rgan rgya stag gis sne 'dren byas 'og spyang tshogs dmigs nas phar rgol byas/ khyi spyang gnyis ka yid du 'ong ba'i spang ngos nas 'khrug pa na/ dang thog khyi rnams la ngar che ba dang / 'khrug bzhin 'khrug bzhin khyi gcig gi steng la spyang ki gnyis gsum re rub byung bas/ mang kha nyung ngus ma lon par khyi mang po zhig gi srog shor ba dang / la lar rmas skyon tshabs chen byung ste par rgol gyi nus pa med par gyur/ la la dmar 'dzing la mi zhugs par rnga ma shal ler bdag po'i phyogs su bros yong / 'jam dbyangs tshe brtan gyis tshul de mthong bas/ kha spo kha nas langs shing zhe spo gting nas langs te/ me mda' phrag nas len bzhin rta la yob deb 'ga' byas te glog 'od 'khyug pa ltar brgyugs pa na/ g.yog po zhed po 'ga' yang kho'i rjes su mchongs/ kho tsho spyang tshogs dang thag mi ring ba'i thod ngos de la slebs dus/ spyang mang gis ngu zug byed bzhin khyi ro rnams g.yas 'drud g.yon 'drud byed bzhin 'dug79

'tshub ma kher rkyang /tshul de mthong bas kho tsho'i zhe snang sngar las je cher song / kho tshos rta kha bsgags te spyang tshogs par skyod byed thabs la gros mol byed skabs/ spyang rgan rgya stag 'dra ba zhig spyang tshogs kyi sdun la bud de/ mchu to klad la bskor nas zug rgyangs lan gsum byas rjes mda' 'phangs pa ltar tshur kho tsho'i phyogs su mchongs pa na/ spyang mang la'ang stong 'jigs med par brgyugs byung / g.yog po rnams kyis gros mol byed mtshams bzhag ste tshab tshub ngang nas me mda'i khog la mda' rdzong bzhin 'phen mgo brtsams/ me mda'i skad 'brug stong ldir ba ltar grags pas/ spyang mang gis rnga ma brla bar la drangs te skyed pos mda' 'phangs pa ltar bros/ shul du spyang ro gcig kyang mi mthong / dus der/ 'jam dbyangs tshe brtan gyis stong dpon yab yum gnyis kur 'jigs snang bskul song snyam ste/ rta kha phyir bskor te skyas phyogs su brgyugs song /spyang tshogs phar sprod byas pa na/ dpon mo bde chen sgrol ma dang g.yog po g.yog mo rnams kyi gdong la rgyal kha'i 'dzum mdangs shig shar 'dug la/ stong dpon nyi ma gcig pu dal cag ger langs te ci zhig la bsam blo gtong bzhin gda'/ khos 'jam dbyangs tshe brtan yong ba shes rjes/ kho khrid de pha gi'i spang ngos de gzas nas song /smyo mdang dgong nga'i mi lam du/ mi nag rta nag can zhig gam la yong ste/ sang nyin khyod kyi bgrod lam na dgra gsum yod/ dgra dang po dang 80

zin po ga rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/gnyis pa las thar thub rung / dgra gsum pa de rgod hrags che bas/ grub thob mthu rtsal can dang dpa' bo srung pa can zhig min na thar dka' zer/nga'i lta tshul ltar na/ dgra sngon ma gnyis ka pho rog dang spyang tshogs yin la/dgra rjes ma de ci yin mi shes/mi tshulags/ mi nag rta nag can de srin po g.yu rngog yin nam/’ 6phal cher yin pa 'dra/ gang ltar kyang khyod dbus la ma 'gro/ nga'i tham ga bzung nas rang yul la song dang / stong dpon gyi go sa khyod la byin pa yin/mi 6 lags/ min/ khyed yul la mi 'gro na nga'ang mi 'gro/mi 6 khyod song / 'di nga'i re ba yin/ ngas dbus kyi lam sne bzung bas/spyang tshogs la skrag nas phyir bros na/ tsho ba'i la rgya dang mkha' lding tshang gi mtshan snyan brlags pa min nam/mi stong dpon nyi mas 'jam dbyangs tshe brtan la kha bsgo ji 'dra btang rung / chod sems la 'gyur ldog spu tsam yang ma byung bas/ khos bla ma mkha' lding tshang la gsol ba 'debs bzhin g.yog po rnams la lam du chas pa'i brda btang / skabs der/ lung ba'i g.yas ngos g.yon ngos nas ki sgra 'brug stong ldir 'dra 'ga' bstud mar grags pa dang mnyam du/ mi nag rta nag can mang po thang smug gzan la bcums pa ltar kho tsho'i phyogs su mchongs yong / 'jam dbyangs tshe brtan gyis myur mor stong dpon yab 8/ma

'tshub ma kher rkyang /dang g.yog mo gnyis ka nye 'gram gyi chu grog der sbas rjes/ me mda' phrag nas blangs te lung ba'i g.yas ngos kyi de'u 'bur klad la 'gos te/ me mda'i rwa sar btsugs pa dang mnyam du mdun phyogs kyi jag pa'i gras la me mda' yos khra rngo ba ltar 'phangs/ dus tshod kyi 'gros dang bstun nas/mdun phyogs kyi jag tshogs kho dang je nye je nye yin la/ rgyab phyogs kyi ki sgra dang mda' skad je che je cher song / de dang mnyam du rta nor lug gsum 'drogs nas yar zhogs mar zhogs byed bzhin 'tsher skad dang 'ba' sgra lhang lhang bsgrags pa na/ gnam sa dus gcig la gas pa dang sa gzhi yom yom 'gul ba'i snang ba ster/ khos dpa' la zhum pa med par tshur rgol ba'i gdong bkag ste me mda' 'phangs pa na/ mi rta mang po bltas bltas rig rig la sa la 'gyel mod/ mi gcig gi steng la srog la phangs sems med pa'i jag pa klad med mang po rub yong na/ gang la mda' kha gtad dgos pa'ang mi shes/ skabs der/ mi nag rta nag ag tshom nag pos brang ngos khebs pa zhig gis ral gri klad la bskor te dom nag khrag gis bzi ba ltar kho'i gam la mchongs yong / 'jam dbyangs tshe brtan myur stabs kyis yar langs te glo gri shubs las bton pa na/ mig lam nag lam mer song ba dang mnyam du ci byung gtan nas mi shes par gyur/'jam dbyangs tshe brtan gyi dran pa sos skabs 'khor yug thams cad dal cag ger 'dug cing mgo bo la zug gzer langs nas bzod thabs bral/82

srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/khos am gcigs bsdams nas yar langs te lung mthil la bltas pa na/dang thog ljang ldem mer/ khra lam mer yod pa'i spang ljongs de rta nor lug gsum gyi bem ros khebs te lta ba mig gis mi bzod pa dang / gshong grog tu khrag dmar yur chu ltar bzhur bzhin gda'/ kho'i sams la skyo gdung gi zug gzer bzod glags med pa zhig langs pa dang mnyam du stong dpon yab yum gnyis ka sems la dran te/ gom pa 'khyar 'khyor spo bzhin chu grog phyogs su song / stong dpon nyi ma'i dpral ngos la me mda' phog ste chu grog klad na 'gyel 'dug kho'i g.yas 'gram la srungs pa'i me mda' dang g.yas g.yon la gtor ba'i zangs sbug mang por gzhigs na/ srog dmar 'ben la bzhag nas 'thab 'dzing byas pa rtogs thub/ dpon mo bde chen mtsho mo dang g.yog mo gnyis ka chu grog las phyi la ma bud rung srog la thar pa ma byung /'jam dbyangs tshe brtan gyis mchi ma 'don bzhin dpon po yab yum gnyis ku'i bem po la bdag dam bzang bo byas te spang ngos gtsang ma zhig la khur rjes/ dal bur rta nor lug gsum gyi bem ro khrod nas g.yog po gzhan rnams btsal/ khos g.yul sa'i lung mthil der skor ba lan gsum brgyab pa na/ g.yog po yod tshad kyi bem ro rnyed byung mod/ mi gnyis ma gtogs gzhan rnams kyi lus steng la rta nor lug gsum gyis brdzis te su yin 'di yin yang mi shes/ skabs der/ kho'i yid la mi nag rta nag can de tsho shar byung bas/ zhe snang chen pos kho tsho'i bem ro re e rig bltas pa na ci yang 83

'tshub ma kher rkyang /mthong rgyu ma byung / par bltas na/ kho tshos stong dpon nyi ma 'khor dang bcas pa rtsa med du btang rjes/ dgra lag la shor pa'i dpung rogs rnams kyi bem po ri nas ma bsgyur pa 'dra/ khos khrag dmar 'dzar bzhin yod pa'i bem po rnams phyogs gcig la khur rjes/ thog ro'i mtha' na langs 'dug pa'i rta rgan der gzas nas song / 'dar sig sig byed pa'i rta gon la mtshon rmas ci yang phog med mod/ srab skyogs g.yag ro zhig gi ske la dkris te rta khyu la 'bro ma thub pa red/ kho myur mor rta thog la bud de la lung bkram pa'i rta nor lug gsum gyi 'phro lus rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa na/ khal ma gzhan rnams mi nag rta nag can gyis ded tshar mod/ stong dpon yab yum gyi mgo sgra bkal yod pa'i mdzo gon de gcig pu nor khyu na lus 'dugamadzo rgan grog shur zhig la bcug nas bzung rjes rgyab kyi mgo sbra phog ste/stong dpon yab yum gnyis ka g.yas do g.yon do byas nas bkal ba na/dpon mos dpon po'i do ya mi yong bas/ g.yog mo chung chung de dpon mo'i phyogs su bkal te/ rta nor lug gsum pha yul gyi phyogs la nyin 'ded mtshan 'ded byas pas/ stong dpon gyi tham ga'ang lam nas bor/sgrol ma pha yul la slebs dus/ stong dpon yab yum gnyis ka spyin sreg byas te rus thal sman lung la gtor ba dang / dbus lam nas tshe srog shor pa'i g.yog po g.yog mo rnams kyi bem po'ang pha yul la drangs te dur du sbas zin la/ mkha' lding dgon pa'i grwa pa rnams dpon tshang la phebs te 84

srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa/bca' ba rim gro sgrub bzhin 'dug mos pha ma gnyis ka dbus lam nas ma 'tshams pa go rjes/ ngu rgyangs shig byas rjes dran med du brgyal song / dran pa sos nas yid sems cung zad bde la babs yod pa'i skabs su/ g.yog mo mtsho bhas mor sems gso yang yang byas te stong dpon yab yum gnyis ka thog mar dbus la chas pa dang / mtha' mar bar chad byung ba'i brgyud rim de gsal bor bshad/phyi lo/ sgrol ma 'jam dbyangs tshe brtan gyi chung mar gyur/zla brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin ni sde ba'i rgan pa chos dad can rnams dbus la 'gro ba'i nyin mo yin la/ gsar brje skyid skya rengs dang po dang mnyam du mal las langs te/ bza' mi rnams la nangs ja zhim po zhig bskol rjes/ gus gus byams byams kyis pha ma gnyis ka mal las bslangs te nangs ja drangs pa dang / de nas pha ma gnyis na'i gyon gos gsar ba rnams mdzod snam las blangs/ nyi ma ri rtse nas thag tshad tsam la 'phags/sde ba'i dbus la 'gro mkhan dang skyel ma byed mkhan rnams kyang snga rjes su a khu klu skyabs tshang gi lhas 'dabs su yong ste/ mjal ba rnams rlangs 'khor la 'gos pa dang skyel ma byed mkhan tshos dngos po ca lag rnams rlangs 'khor klad la brtsigs/rlangs 'khor de ni gsar brje skyid kyi jus bkod ltar tshe brtan 'bum 85

'tshub ma kher rkyang /gyis glas yong ba yin la/ kha sang phyi dro kha lo par kha yag tshig yag bshad de pha ma gnyis ku'i lam gla je dmar btang bar ma zad/ 'dugs stegs kyang bzang bo gnyis bdams/ a khu klu skyabs bza' zla gnyis ka rlangs 'khor du bud rjes/ mos 'o ja tsha dem gang khyer yong nas pha ma gnyis ku'i bar la bzhag pa dang / de nas dkar yol gnyis a ma'i lag la bzhag ste 'di zungs/ lam nas skom na mkho zhes bshad/ mkha' mo tshos tshul de mthong bas ci 'dra'i bud med skyug bro ba zhig red bsams nas 'tshig pa zos mod/mtshang 'byin byed pa'i thabs jus yag po zhig ma rnyed pas/ dge go'i lag nas sgor mo brgya phrag 'ga' blangs te a ma'i lag la bzhag nas 'di lag sne la zungs dang / lam nas mkho ba yin ces bshad/ru mi dgos mi dgos/ a mas sgor mo tshang ma lag sner bzung yod/rang gis gyon gos blor 'bab re nyos/ ’mkha' mo tshos a ma'i gdong la bltas kyin bltas kyin gsar brje skyid kyi spyod stangs bcos ma de brjed de/ sems pa smreng nas bzod bsran byed ma thub pas/ thog mar mig las mchi ma shor pa dang bsdad kyin bsdad kyin cho nge btab pas/ skyel ma byed pa'i bud med mang po ngus pa dang / mjal pa rnams kyi mig las kyang mchi ma rang dbang med par shor song / skabs der/ kha lo pas 'di rnams la ci byung snyam nas yud tsam la bltas rjes/mgo bo 'phred du g.yug bzhin rlangs 'khor gyi glog sgo phye ste 'gro grabs byas 86
nangasari song

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha/nga byis pa'i dus su/ spo bo lags kyis gna' snga mo snga mo zhig la zer nas gtam rgyud ya mtshan gang mang bshad myong la/ bdag gis gtam rgyud de rnams las byung rim phyogs mthun thams cad gzhi gcig tu bsgrigs te spo bo mtho ris po dang klog mkhan rnams la phul pa yin/wa rtsom pa po'i gtam/da skabs/ stong dpon shā zlol kā ḍi/kur gyi mnga' 'bangs khrod du/mgo na sde khrims tsho khrims med pa ni ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis kho na red/le'u gnyis pa/88ra bha 'dre mig mal las langs dus/ nyin gung yol te nyi 'od sbra'i kha

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/tshub brgyud nas pho khyim gyi thab rtsar 'phros 'dug kho dab dub ngang yar snyed kyi slog stan du yid tig ger yud tsam la bsdad pa na/ mgo bo gzer breng nger gyur pa dang mig zung las mchi ma dbang med bzhur pas/ dbyar gzhung gi nyi 'od btsan po de spyi gtsug la phog 'dug pa rtogs te/ nyi ma la dmod mo byed bzhin grib ma'i nang la nur/ g.yon lag gis mig chu phyis pa dang / g.yas lag gis mgo la lan 'gar byugs pa na/ na zug rim gyis 'jags mod/ gnyid yun ha cang ring bas lus kun srid cing dran pa mi gsal ba zhig 'dug ste/ sems pa stong hang nge / mgo bo nag 'thom me/yid la 'char sgo ci yang ma byung bas/ spre'u nag gi kha tshub la mig cer nas bsdad/ skabs der/ a ma skyi mgos thu khud la yong leb 'ga' btus yong ste thab kyi me kha gsos pa dang / de nas khro slang nang la chu 'khyas shag ser blugs pa na/ ra bha 'dre mig la glo bur du sgang bu gcin gyis sbos nas 'gad la khad kyi snang ba zhig skyes te/ had kyis langs te lus po sgong sgong byed bzhin spra sgor brgyugs/ kho sbra'i 'dabs kyi thal phung 'gram la bslebs ma thag 'tshub cha dang bcas dor ma'i kha 'dig grol pa na/ gcin pa rang shugs kyis sa la shag ser bzhur pa dang / gcin pa shag shag bzhur ba dang bstun nas kho la lus zungs rgyas shing rnam rig 'phel ba'i tshor snang bde zhing skyid pa zhig skyes byung / tag tag skabs de la/ kho'i lta phyogs tsam la a ye dkon mchog mtsho mo mthong lam du bud byung / de'i mur mgo rnga med 89

'tshub ma kher rtsang /pa'i khong khro chen po zhig langs te/ rang gi gcin pa gtsang bo rab med cig tu bsgyur te kho tshang gi mi phyugs thams cad bsnubs na ci ma rung snyam mod/gcin pa sa la babs ma thag spang ngos la 'thim ste lha ba rdog po 'ga' las mi mthong bas/ pham sems chen po skyes pa dang bcas shugs ring zhig 'ben rjes/ dal stod lhod kyis dor ma'i kha 'dig bcings te phyir 'khor/glo bur du rin chen rkyal kha la dus btab yod pa yid la shar te/ myur mor mgo bo g.yas phyogs su 'khor nas rgyang lta tsam byas mod/ rin chen rkyal kha'i grib ma tsam yang ma mthong /a ma skyi mgor brel ba ci yang med par dal lhod lhod kyi ngang nangs ja skol bzhin 'dug mo lo lnga bcu lhag la son yod rung / mi tshe 'dir las ka yid mo ma las pa dang sems sdug chen po yod ma myong bas/ lus po rgyags shing rgas nyams kyang chen po med/ de ring 'gro dus gom pa 'khyar 'khyor spo ba dang mig la sngar gyi gzi mdangs med par gzhigs na/ mo goms srol ltar gnyid de snga mor ma langs pa gsal bor rtogs thub/ a ma skyi mgo'i pha mes rnams ni rgyal khams 'grims pa'i 'khyam po 'ba' zhig yin pas/ da skabs rang nyid yul phyogs gang gi yin pa dang rigs rgyud dang tsho khag gang la gtogs pa gtan nas mi shes/ mo'i pha rgan mtho ris po des yab mes kyi goms srol de bsgyur ched/ sdong ru dpon la go btags te ru sde gcig nas gtan 'dug byas mod/ khrim mi rnams la mi tshe 'khyol thabs kyi 90

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha/rtsol ba thabs rdugs re ma gtogs phugs re med pas/ 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen la sngar bzhin 'gyur ldog chen po ma byung / kho tshos sgo na phyugs dang khyim na rgyu med na/ nangs snga langs dang dgong 'phyi nyal byed dngos don ci yang med bsams te/ nam rgyun ga dus ltogs na de dus langs pa dang / ga dus rtsam khug stong bar gyur na de dus sbra sgo khyim sgo nyul nas slong mo byas pa na/khyim tshang 'dir nyin gung ma gtogs mi ldang ba'i goms srol de ngang gis grub/ ra bha 'dre mig phyi la 'khyams te rku byed skabs/ nyin mtshan 'ga' la shi 'thab ro 'thab byas rung gnyid kyis mnar ba par zhog ngal dub kyi tshor snang tsam yang med mod/ rang khyim la log rjes ji ltar nyal na gnyid ni de ltar mang ba dang / nam rgyun a thang chad nas 'gul 'dod 'phag 'dod ci yang med/‘ ra go nangs ja thungs/ ’tsa 'o ya ra bha 'dre mig gis a ma'i lag nas rtsid skud kyis btsems yod pa'i ca ne blangs te zhib lta byas pa na/ ja min chu min du bkang ba'i phor ba'i gting shed na gtul ma mtheb mo tsam la kha zhag skar ma 'dra ba re'ang 'khor gyin med pas/ zas kyi yi ga de ma khad du 'gags par gyur mod/ a mas rang nyid la 'dzum dmul dmul gyis bltas 'dug pa mthong bas/ myur mor ja la nub tsam byas/ 91

'dzub ma kher rkyang /tsa a ma/ khyed kyis ja la kha zhag 'phen rgyu brjed 'dug ’6 kha mar chad nas rab cig yin/ lo lo/mi 6 bden nam/mi ra bha 'dre mig gis a ma'i gdong la zhib lta tsam byas rjes 'dzum mdangs dang bcas skyon med/ a ma ma lo/ thabs bkod rang la yod na kha grog ri na yod ces bshad/a ma skyi mgos ci yang mi bshad par mo khyim gyi mar skyed nas ljid tig ger tsogar bha 'dre mig gis a mas ja skol lugs dang tshig bshad lugs la gzhigs te/ rang khyim gyi gnas tshul dang a ma'i bsam don legs par rtogs song / khos ja 'thung zhor du a ma'i gdong la bltas kyin bltas kyin snying khong rus pa'i gting nas smreng ste ol mdud 'gul tsam 'gul tsam byas pa dang / glo mchin bar nas zug gzer dal gyis langs te mig kong nas gsher gzugs su 'gyur la khad byas/a ma skyi mgo'i chung dus kyi ming la sgrol ma log zer zhing / g.yug dang las ga'i phyogs su gzhan la ngom chog pa dang rang la bshad chog pa'i 'jon thang zhig gtan nas med rung / gzugs bzang zhing gdong mdzes par ma zad/ blo rig rgod cing kha rtse bde bas rtsed mtshar shags 'gyed byas na bshad ya yong mkhan ha cang dkon/ 'on kyang / mos nam rgyun 'dzem do/sdu ci yang med par sbra sgo khyim sgo nyul nas slong mo byas pa na/ bcu drug

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha/lang tsho dar la bab rung kun gyis mthong chung dang dma' 'bebs byed pa las tshe gcig gi 'dun ma 'chol mkhan gcig kyang ma byung / nam zhig gi tshe na slang nang ma zhes par skyi mgo ma zer ba'i khyi mo sdom po zhig yod pa de'i ming mo la btags/ da skabs sdong ru tsho ba'i gzhon pa rnams kyis mo'i dngos ming gtan nas mi shes shing / rgan dar gzhon gsum kun gyis mngon lkog 'dzem med kyis a ma skyi mgo zhes 'bod kyin 'dug ra bha 'dre mig nar son pa nas bzung / sprang zas sprang chu la brten nas 'tsho ba rol stangs de bsgyur te/ thog mar gzhan la g.yog byas te 'tsho ba rol thabs byas mod/ khyim bdag gi mnar gcod ya nga ba de ma bzod par zhe 'khon byung ste/ kho tshor ya lan sprod ched rkun zas rkun chu la brten nas 'tsho ba rol mgo brtsams/ phyi la 'khyams nas za ma dang gyon gos sogs brkus yong tshe/ ngo gnong ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis a mas gang nas brkus pa yin ’ces gtan nas 'dri mi phod cing / nam rgyun gang nas nyos pa dang tsasu yis btsongs pa yin ces 'dri ba yin/ skabs der/ khos kyang a ma'i sems khams dang bstun nas/ de nas nyos pa dang de yis btsongs pa yin ces brkus rdzas rnams rku sa'i sa cha dang rgyu bdag gi ming sba gsang med par bshad nges yin/ mos tshig de dag go na skabs rer zunga'i ra bha bu rgod cig red ces bstod bsngags byed pa dang / mtshams rer phar 'khor nas mchi ma 'don pa red/ rkun zas rnams tshar la nye dus/ mos brjod don gab 93

'tshub ma kher rkyang /nas gab tshig gi tshul du brjod pa las/ mngon lkog gang la khel rung khyim tshang gi gnas tshul drang bshad byed mi phod/ de ring mos ja skol stangs de'ang brda gtong lugs shig yin te/ ja la kha zhag med pa des mkho dngos ci zhig tshar la nye ba'i gsal 'debs byas pa dang / ca de'i mthil la rtsam skya nyung tsam mnan 'dug pa des rtsam pa tshar la nye ba gsal bshad byas pa yin/ ra bhas kyang tshul de mthong bas a ma'i bsam don legs par rtogs/ra bha 'dre mig gis ca de'i zhabs kyi rtsam pa dkrugs te rtsam thang gtsang mar 'thungs rjes/ bka' drin zhu ba'i 'dzum mdangs dang bcas ca ne a ma'i lag la bzhag pa na/ mo la dga' snang glo bur ba zhig byung ste lus kyi stobs shugs kyang ches cher 'phel/ mo myur mor yar langs te ja dem nang la ja btab ste legs par gdus rjes/ ca de'i nang la mar dog chen po zhig 'phangs pa dang / ja blugs pa dang rtsam pa tshad dang ran pa zhig btab rjes bu yi lag la bzhag ra bha 'dre mig gis myur mor rtsam pa brdzis te phyed ka changs bu bcos nas a ma'i lag la bzhag pa dang / de nas 'phro lus rnams changs bu bcos te rang gis bzung rjes ca de'i nang la ja blugs te/ma bu gnyis gas kha res bskor te ja 'thung zhor du dga' dga' spro spro'i ngang nas mar rtsam sdum po de dal gyis zos/ 6ra bha/ ca ne zhig cis kyang nyo dgos 'dug ma bu gnyis mar kha phor gcig las med na/ bza' btung la stabs mi bde/ a ma skyi mgos 94

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/mgo bo sgur nas de ltar bshad/ra bha 'dre mig gis ca ne blangs te lag mthil nas g.yas skor g.yo cha skor byed bzhin zhib lta byas/ ca de de ni mes pos bzhag pa'i shul nor yin pa dang / dus yun ring bor gas ka gsar ba re byung ma thag rtsid skud kyis btsems pa na/ da skabs ca ne hril bo rtsid skud kyis khebs te snyad dra zhig dang mtshungs/ kho chung ba'i dus nas bzung kha phor rdzob po de kha res bskor nas ja 'byungs pa yin pas/ ca ne gzhan zhig rang nyid gcig pu'i kha phor byas na zas kyi yi ga'ang chad 'gro ba 'dra/ a ma bka' drin can gyis ci bshad dang len byed dgos pas/ zu red/ ca ne zhig nyo dgos 'dug ces tshig lan de byin/zu ca ne zhig nyo dgos la/ mna' ma zhig kyang len dgos/ shuwa wakhyod la chung ma len ran 'dug a ma skyi mgos sdug nyams dang bcas de skad bshad/ snang da lta pho lo nyer gsum red/ chung ma zhig len ran pa'i mi tshad 'phyi 'dug yin yang sgo na ra ma zhig kyang med pas/ khyim la mna' ma ji ltar bsu/ bar snang stong ba nyid la lag stob byas te gser 'tshol ba ma yin nam/mi ngas kyang de ltar bsams pa yin/ ldong ru tsho ba'i bu mo rnams 'u tshang la yong mi srid/ yong rung pha mas ster mi srid/ bla ma dkon /rdog

'tshub ma kher rkyang /gis mkhyen/ nga 'chi dus thab ka 'di su la sprod/ gal te rin chen la sring mo zhig yod na ci ma rung / ’6 a la ku re yin/ stobs 'byor ri bong rwa yin rung chung ma mi rnyed pa'i dpe zhig ga la yod/ spyir mgo nag bod la cha mtshon na/ skyes pho re'i gam na mo re yod la/ 'di ni sngon bas gas ḍa sa kyi 'bras bu red/ dus la babs na gzha' thabs gzur thabs kyang yod mi srid ra bha/ sngon bsags las dang bsod nams bshad na/ 'u ma bu gnyis ku'i bsod nams de khyis zos pa dang 'dra bas nga la 'chi dus thab ka sprod sa zhig kyang med pa 'di a ma skyi mgo ngus byung /ra bha 'dre mig 'tshub cha dang bcas myur mor a ma'i gam la song ste/sems gso'i gtam sna tshogs bshad de a ma dga' ru bcug rjes/ sems pa sdug cing a thang chad pa'i ngang nas par dgye ste mgo bor byugs pa lan 'ga' byas pa na/ rin chen rkyal la skya yom mer mar snyed kyi sne na had 'dug pa mthong byung /6 rkyal kha/ khyod ga dus bslebs pa yin/mi ra bha 'dre mig gis dogs mi bde ba'i ngang nas de skad dris/6 nga 'dir bslebs nas yud tsam 'gor song / a ma skyi mgos mgron po khyim la bslebs 'dug pa shes rjes/ myur mor langs nas rin chen rkyal kha'i dpung bar khu tshur gyis lan 'ga' gzhus 96

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha/te glen pa zog 'dra ba 'di/ sgo kha nas 'bod mi shes pa ci yin zer bzhin kho mar snyed nas 'dug tu bcug pa dang / rin chen rkyal khas 'phongs tshos ljid tig ger sa la 'grwa ngas te ci mi snyam pa'i ngang nas a ma skyi mgo nga 'dir bslebs dus khyod ngu bzhin 'dug pa ci yin ces dris 6sems sdug pa red/ ya log gangs dkar sems su sdug med na/mgo skogs skam po'i nang nas chu ga la bzhur/ bzhur mi srid ca sems sdug don 6chog gi chog gi ya rkyal la/ pho rgod po la 'char gzhi legs po ga 'dra yod/ ra bha 'dre mig gis a ma'i ngu kha slar yang 'chor bar dogs nas rin chen rkyal kha'i tshig mtshams bcad cing de ltar dris/6 nga la 'char gzhi ci yang med/ ‘ med na yong don ci yin/ nga la phug 'dri gting 'dri ma byed/ ngas ci yang mi shes pa khyod kyi sems su a sngon a gsal yin/ 'char gzhi zhig yod ga la srid/mi rin chen rkyal khas bshad pa drang gtam yin te/ kho la dngos 'brel 'char gzhi ci yang med/ kho'i gzugs gzhi ha cang che zhing stobs shugs khyad mtshar ldan pas/ ston kha'i g.yag rgod so bzhi zhig mchan la bcir nas song na glag rgod kyis lu gu bzung ba dang mtshungs/ lhag par kho'i mthug cing che la skad cha bshad dus lhab lhab tu 'dar ba'i mchu sgros la 97

'tshub ma kher rkyang /'jigs nyams zhig yod pas/ ra bha 'dre mig ma gtogs kho'i gdong la ce rer lta phod mkhan ha cang nyung / 'on kyang / kho'i blo rig rtul cing 'char sgo ci yang med pas/ gam du bkod 'doms pa zhig med na don dag ci yang mi 'grub/ kho ni spun bdun nang gi gnyis pa yin la phu bo khams kyi a skyo ba 'ga' dang lhan du nyi ma lha sar song ste lo lnga 'gor mod/ da lta'i bar du shi gson gyi skad cha ci yang ma go nu bo lnga bos khyim la 'byor ba zhan pas 'tsho ba rol thabs mi 'dug bsams te snga gzhug tu mkha' lding bkra shis chos sgar du grwa pa byas rung / kho tsho'i gras na bca' ba rim gro sgrub par chas te 'bul ba blo 'bab re lon mkhan gcig kyang med pas/ khyim gyi pha ma gnyis ka dang dgon pa'i nu bo rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i rten gzhi ni rin chen rgyal kha gcig pu yin/ khos thog mar phyug po rnams la g.yog byas te khyim tshang skyong thabs byas pa dang / de nas ra bha 'dre mig gi rjes su 'brangs te rku byas pa na/ yong 'bab g.yog las byed pa las bzang bas/ khyim mi rnams la zas mug chu mug byung ma myong / lhag par rang gi yid tshims pa zhig ni/ ra bha 'dre mig la dpa' dang snying stobs chen po med rung / mtshan mo sa la bsdad nas ci zhig la gsol ba btab rjes/ khyim tshang gang zhig la 'dzul nas gang mkho brkus pa na mi khyi gcig gis kyang mi mthong / kho gnyis dmigs yul ngan pa gcig gi don du yun ring la 'grogs pa na/ khyi rkun 'o zangs kha nas mthun par gyur/ lhag par rin chen rkyal kha ni ra bha 'dre mig gi ci 98

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/'dod gang mkho rku thub pa'i 'jon thang de la mtshar te/ kho la bshad mi shes pa'i dad pa 'dra ba zhig skyes pas/ ra bha 'dre mig gis ci bshad dang len dang lag bstar byed pa yin/ zurin chen/ ja thungs/ ’smyo 'o ya/ / rin chen rkyal khas rum nas ca ne blangs te a ma skyi mgo'i lag la ba6/ga6 a ma bde 'tshams yin nam/ mi sa ma skyi mgos de ltar dris/6 yin/ nyin 'ga'i sngon la mgo khol zhig byung nas zas kyang za mi thub mod/ a lags mkha' lding tshang gis byabs khrus thengs shig byas pas na zug 'jags song / ’tsa shuwa walo 'di dag la mo nas pa ha cang mgyogs/ da ni mna' ma zhig len ran red/’ 6a mas kyang de 'dra bshad kyin 'dug ’6 chog gi chog ga myur mor ja thungs dang tshong la 'gro/mi ra bha 'dre mig a ma ngu bar dogs nas de ltar bshad/le'u gsum pa/ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis lam la chas/ dmigs yul ni yun ring la ma song ba'i gling tsha tsho dgu yin/99

mu sgyu1nga zub khebazab shāmitshopa/ ——— gling tsha tsho dgu ni 'brog sde zhig yin la/ ldong ru tsho ba nas nyin zhag lnga la 'gro dgos/ tsho ba de'i mi rnams kyis rang nyid gling smug po gdong gi mi rgyud yin zer nas tsho bar che rgyud dang chung rgyud/ 'bring rgyud gsum du bgos yod pa dang / ge sar rgyal po dang stag rong khro rgyal las gzhan pa'i gling gi dpal rtul ma sru che 'bring chung gsum thams cad kho tsho'i tsho bar dngos su 'khrungs yod zer/ da lta'i mi rabs 'dir dga' bde chos skyong ber nag smon lam gyi dbang gis tsho ba gzhan nas 'khrungs pas/ sde dpon tsho dpon rnams kyis rtsal rgu bton nas btsal kyang ma rnyed/ ra bha 'dre mig da thengs gling tsha tsho dgu la 'gro bar dmigs yul gnyis yod de/ gcig na tsho ba de ha cang phyug pas/ nor lug 'ga' dang mar chur rtsam pa tsam brkus na/ sprang por sbyin pa btang ba yin zer nas kha ya spu tsam yang mi byed/gnyis na de ru kho'i snying sdug mja' mo'ang yod/ mo ni me bza' 'bum skyid kyi skye ba yin zer pa dang / skyes gzugs mdzes par ma zad gshis ga'ang ha cang 'jam/rin chen rkyal khas lam bro bcug yod pa'i ta len de phrag la 'khur ba dang / ra bha 'dre mig gis gos lwa ljang khu de lus la gyon zhing thag pa dkar nag gnyis phrag la khur nas gom kha nyi ma nub phyogs su gtad nas song ba na/khyim mtshes rnams kyis kho gnyis gar 'gro la lta bzhin de gnyis ldong ru tsho ba'i zhabs 'dren yin tshul gyi kha brda sna tshogs byas/100

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/ldong ru tsho ba de ni yar klung nas mched pa'i ngag rgyun ni rgan pa rnams kyi la rgya dang gzhon pa rnams kyi gzi brjid yin/ mi zhig gis kho tsho'i phugs 'dun dang ldog nas bya ba re bsgrubs pa na/ lo na rgan pa rnams kyis nged yar klung tshang gi mtshan snyan brlags song zer nas smre sngags 'don pa yin/gang ltar ldong ru tsho ba'i stong dpon rim byon ni mig rgyang ring zhing blo gros ldan pa'i dpon po tshad ldan 'ba' zhig yin la/ kho tshos dus yun ring bor nang mi byams kyis skyong zhing phyi dgra thabs kyis 'dul ba na/ pha spun bar la nang 'khrug ma byung ba dang / btsan pos tshur rgol byas pa'i chags 'jig kyang byung ma myong / lhag par stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar ni thob dang tham ga'i bdag po byas pa nas bzung / sngon chad ngag thog na gnas pa'i tsho khrims de je rgyas je zhib la btang ste yi ger bkod nas gtan 'bebs byas pa na/ 'bangs mi rnams sngar las kyang je bzang je mthun la song ba dang /mgo 'dogs zhu mkhan yang je mang nas je mang la phyin/ tsho khrims gsar ba de la ma tshang ba zhig med rung / kun gyis bstod bsngags dang gong bkur byed sa ni tsho ba'i phyi nang kun la rkun jag 'phrog gsum byas mi chog pa'i don tshan de red/ tsho ba'i rkun ma jag pa rnams kyis tsho khrims gsar ba de brtsi srung gang legs byed ched/ mala' lding bkra shis chos sgar la song nas/ sku gsung thugs rten dpang la bzhag ste rkun jag 'phrog gsum mi byed pa'i mna' bskyal/ 'on kyang / ra bha 'dre mig gis rang gi goms srol de sgyur 101

'tshub ma kher rkyang /ba phar zhog da dung rin chen rkyal kha grogs su bkug nas/ ga sa gang la 'khyams nas ci mkho ci dgos brkus te 'tsho ba rol pa na/ stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar lags kyis tsho khrims lag bstar byed pa phar zhog tha na kha ta slob gso'i tshig kyang mi bshad pas/ 'bangs mi rnams kyis 'khang ra byas pa dang / mna' skyel mkhan rnams kyang 'gyod pa skyes/ tsho ba'i 'du ra bsdu skabs brgya dpon dang lo lon spobs pa can la las bsam 'char gang mang bshad mod/ stong dpon chen pos ma 'ongs pa'i dus shig la/ kho gnyis gas 'u cag gi tsho ba chags 'jig las skyob pas da skabs sde khrims tsho khrims la sbyor mi rung / gnas skabs su kho gnyis kyi mgo na sde khrims tsho khrims med/ 'di a lags mkha' lding tshang gi bka' dang lung bstan yin ces bshad nas bsam 'char dang len ma byas pas/ mi re'i sems la dogs gzhi re bzung nas mi 'dug ka med byung / lo 'ga' 'gor pa na/ mi rnams kyis kho gnyis la tsho ba'i zhabs 'dren zhes sdigs dmod byed bzhin yod rung sems kyi 'khang ra yal song ba dang / kho gnyis rku la 'gro ba ni mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i nang gi grub cha gal chen zhig tu gyur te/ ga'on nu de gnyis dus yun ring bor phyi la ma 'khyams na/ mi la la'i sems la 'tshub cha dang za 'phrug langs nas 'dug mi bzod pa 'dra/ de ring rin chen rkyal khas slog hrul de gyon nas ra bha 'dre mig tshang la song ba na/ khyim mtshes rnams kyis kho mthong ma thag sems pa dga' lhang nger song ste/ bya rgod rgyags pa ltar nye 102

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/'gram gyi thod dang de'u 'bur steng la bud de ltad mor bltas/ ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rgyal kha snga gzhug tu spra sgor bud de lam la chas pa na ltad mor lta mkhan sngar las je mang la song ba dang / nyin 'ga'i sngon la shes tshang tsho ba nas bros yong ste sdong ru dpon la mgo btags pa'i khyim tshang de dag gi sgo kha na'ang mi 'ga' re langs 'dug la/ kho tshos lag brda byed pa dang mgo bo g.yas 'khor g.yon 'khor byed bzhin bltas 'dug par gzhigs na/ ya mtshan dang bcas rang rang gi lta stangs brjod bzhin yod pa 'dra/ 'on kyang / ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis la dogs snang ci yang mi 'dug kho gnyis ci mi snyam pa'i ngang nas lam la chas te rdo 'bum nyag ga'i pha rol tu bzhud pa na/ mi rnams kyis ci zhig bor pa ltar mgo bo dud nas rang gi khyim la logardo 'bum nyag ga'i pha rol ni stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar tshang gi dgun sa yin la/ da skabs rtswa khyigs bsdams 'dug pas/ nor lug gcig kyang mi mthong zhing gang sa gang na me tog sna tshogs khra lam mer bzhad 'dug nyag ga'i byang phyogs na ri bo glang chen chu 'thung gi dbyibs 'dra ba zhig yod pa de ni ldong ru dpon tshang gi bla ri glang chen g.yang 'bebs zer ba de yin la/ de ring ri rtse smug pas g.yogs 'dug pas lab tse mi mthong mod/skabs rer bya rgod re smug pa'i khrod nas tshur la 'phur yong ba na/ rgyus yod rnams kyis ri rtse ga tsam na yod pa rtogs thub/ ri 'dabs kyi nags tshal du 103

'tshub ma kher rkyang /khu byug gi gsung skad lhang lhang sgrog pas/ mi sems la bdud rtsi 'jo ba lta bu'i bde ba ster/ kho gnyis mas mdzes ljongs de la sems pa g.yeng khom med pas ri ngos 'phred gtub byas nas yun ring la song ba na/ ra bha 'dre mig je mgyogs je myur yin pa dang / rin chen rkyal kha'i gom stabs la 'gyur ldog ci yang med pas/ ra bha 'dre mig gis rkyal kha/ rem ya zer bzhin 'gro zhor sgug zhor byas nas sngon la 'gro bar byed/ ra bha 'dre mig gis dang thog rin chen rkyal kha grogs la 'gugs dus/ phyi la 'khyam skabs dgra dang jag par 'phrad na/ kho'i khyad mtshar gyi gzugs gzhi dang 'jigs che ba'i mchu sgos sogs mthong na/ ngo ya byed mkhan dang do yar langs mkhan yod mi srid bsams pa yin mod/ dus yun nges can zhig la 'grogs pa na/ kho'i gshis ka bzang bar ma zad/ mdzo khal khur nas nyin mtshan 'ga' la song rung a thang chad pa'i snang ba med pa dang / kho gnyis phyi la song ste ci byas thams cad gsang rgya bsdams te su la'ang bshad mi srid pa'i yon tan ldan pas/ kho ni med du mi rung ba'i dpung rogs gal chen zhig la brtsis yod/ 'on kyang / ra bha 'dre mig lam la 'gro dus myur mor ma song na a thang chad nas 'gro mi thub pa dang / rin chen rgyal kha'i gom stabs dal ba de ni kho gnyis dpung sdeb byed dus kyi 'gal ba chen po zhig yin/ skabs 'dir gal srid ra bha 'dre mig la kha brda ya mtshan re yod na/kho'i yid sems bkug ste gom pa ci 'dra mgyogs kyang de'i rjes chod pa yin/104

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/smyo rgyal kha/ stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar gyis dpon mor g.yag sga stod kyin 'dug zer ba khyod kyis e gi 6 rdzun gtam/ dpon tshang la khal g.yag med pa e red/ dpon mor sga bstan nas ci bya/ 6 stong dpon tshang gi gzugs gzhi che ba dang pho ba g.yag grod 'dra zhig yod pas/ g.yag sga ma bstad na dpon mo gcir ba'i nyen kha yod pa min nam/’ rin chen rkyal khas kha brda'i brjod don gsal bor mi go mod/ gom stabs rang dbang med par je mgyogs la song / kho'i sems la stong dpon tshang gi gzugs gzhi che zhing rgyags pas g.yag so drug cig gi lus bongs yod pa dang / lam la 'gro dus drel chen gnyis la res mos byas nas ma bcibs na bzhon rta'i sgal tshigs chad 'gro zer ba bden na'ang / chung mar g.yag sga bstad nas ci bya snyam nas/ sems la dogs gzhi chen po zhig byung ba dang / gom stabs sngar las je mgyogs su gyur/ca nyin 'ga'i sngon la/ ngas stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar tshang gi bya byed la bsam gzhig byed skabs/ glo bur du yid la dogs gzhi 'di 'dra zhig byung / khong gi gzugs gzhi chen po de dpon mos ji ltar theg pa yin/khong gis chung ma'i rum nas sdom pa srung ba yin zer na/ 'o na bu dang bu mo de gsum gyi a pha su yin/ rang sems kyi dogs pa de sel ched/ phyi nyin 105

'tshub ma kher rkyang /mtshan mo stong dpon gyi gzims gur gyi hrag bar la 'dzul te sgug pa na/'jig rten nas rig dka' ba'i ltad mo zhig dngos su mthong byung / ’ra bha 'dre mig gis de skad bshad kyin bshad kyin gom pa myur len byas/ 6 shod ya/ ci zhig mthong byung /mi rin chen rkyal kha'i spro ba ches cher 'phel te ra bha 'dre mig gi rjes su 'dur rgyug byed/6 nyan na 'dod dam/mi lha los 'dod/ 'on kyang / bden pa yin nam/ mi6 yin/ min na dkon mchog gsum/ ra bha 'dre mig gis lam la chas pa nas mgo bzung ste/ 'jab nas hrag 'og la 'dzul tshul/ dpon tshang gis za ma ci zhig zos pa/ kha brda ga 'dra byas tshul/ g.yog po g.yog mo gnyis kyis kha brda ga 'dra byas tshul/dpon pos dpon mo'i lus kyi tsha ru ji ltar bshus tshul/ de nas dpon mo'i brang ngos la g.yag sga bstan nas yags shing sa la legs par gtad rjes/khong gi pho ba g.yag grod 'dra ba de g.yag sga'i steng la bzhag ste ci zhig byas tshul sogs sha bshad rgyu bshad kyis mtshar nyams dang ldan par bshad pa na/kho gnyis myur du sa ser chu khol gyi 'gram la bslebs pa dang / rin chen rkyal kha yun ring la shugs kyis song bas rngul chus lus kun brdzis shing / ral ba las tshi khu nag po bzhur te mkhur ngos brlan 'dug kho gnyis thang la 106

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/bsdad de ngal gso cung tsam byas rjes/ lhog lhog gdu bzhin yod pa'i chu khol blangs nas rtsam pa za zhor du nad rigs kun la phan pa'i sman chu de ca ne 'ga' re 'thungs pa na/ lus la stobs shugs rgyas pa'i tshor snang zhig ngang gis byung / 'di na khyim tshang 'ga' 'dug rin chen rkyal khas gcin pa gtong zhor du dal lhod lhod kyis de ltar bshad/ra bha 'dre mig myur stabs kyis yar langs te zhib lta byas pa na/ chu khol lung ba'i g.yas ngos su lug khyu gnyis dang nor khyu gsum/ la lo khyu gcig bcas 'dug pa mthong / rta nor lug gsum ri ngos la bkram 'dug rung rtswa za bzhin 'dug pa ha cang nyung bar gzhigs na/ dud 'gro de dag nyin 'ded mtshan 'ded byas te thang chad yod pa'i tshor ba zhig ster/ dus der nor khyu gcig gi gras su g.yag rgan sga bstad 'ga' yod pa mthong bas/ra bha 'dre mig gis yod tshad rtogs song / ma gzhi nor lug de dag ni shis tshang tsho ba'i yin la/ kho tsho lung phu 'di nas sbas te zhag gcig la ngal gso byas rjes/ slang nang mar song ste ldong ru dpon la mgo 'dogs zhu rtsis red/ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis gas ldong ru nye 'gram gyi tsho ba rnams la rku ma byas pa gcig kyang med mod/ rig 'dzin me 'bar gyi mthu la skrag ste/ shis tshang tsho ba nas rtsam rdog gcig kyang brkus ma myong / 'on te/kho gnyis rku la 'gro dus shis tshang mnga' khongs lan mang la brgyud myong bas/107

'tshub ma kher rkyang /tsho ba stod sman bar gsum la cha rgyus zhib mo yod/ kho tsho'i stong dpon gyi ming la rnam rgyal mgo dmar zer zhing / dpon phug gnyis yod pa chung dus nas nang mi mthun la/ pha rgan glo bur du tshe las 'das rjes/ kho gnyis gas stong dpon gyi thob dang tham ga brtsad de nang 'khrug byas pa na/ tsho ba'i khyim tshang mang po bros te tsho ba gzhan la mgo 'dogs zhu bzhin yod/mtshams shig la/ skyes ma rgyags po zhig thod ngos la 'gos te nor lug gar 'gro la lta bzhin pa'i skabs su/ glo bur du gsham na skyes pa gnyis langs 'dug pa mthong bas/ 'phral du lung mthil dmigs nas bros pa na/cang ma 'gor par de'u 'bur de'i pha rol zang zing lang long du gyur pa dang /skyes pa 'ga' yis me mda' bzung ste thod 'bur klad la bud/66lo tshos 'u gnyis rkun mar brtsis 'dug rin chen rkyal khar khong khro langs/6 ma red/ kho tshos 'u gnyis shis tshang tsho ba'i ra mda' red snyam song / mi/rdo'agro/ mikho tshor 'jigs snang bskyed nas ci bya/mi kho gnyis gas sa ser chu khol rgyab la bskyur te/ mu mtha' med pa'i spang thang chen po zhig la bslebs pa na/ mun yongs su rub ste rin chen rkyal khas rdog lam yang gsal bor mi mthong mod/ ra bha 'dre mig gi snang ba sngar las je skyid dang blo rig sngar las je gsal la song / kho la mtshon na mtshan mo'i mig gi mthong tshad nyin mo las bzang bas/ mtshan mo lam la 'gro ba ni 108

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/bde skyid cig yin/ khos len lobs su song ba'i la gzhas snyan mo de len bzhin mdun phyogs dang g.yas g.yon la bltas pa na/ spang thang chen po' yod tshad gsal ler mthong yong / g.yas phyogs kyi de'u 'bur chung chung de'i ngos na dgo khyu zhig dal cag ger nyal 'dug pa dang / dgo khyu'i tshu rol na spyang ki zhig gis glo mchin sa la glan nas phar la 'jab kyin gda'/yud tsam gyi rjes su/ dgo khyu 'drogs te skad cig nyid la de'u 'bur de'i pha rol tu zhigs pa na/ spyang ki'ang dgo khyu'i rjes la mda' 'phangs pa ltar mchongs song / mtshams shig la/ bsil rlung 'jam po zhig dal gyis langs pas/ lho phyogs na mtshan rtswa za bzhin yod pa'i rkyang khyus mi yi lus dri tshor pa dang lhan du par phyogs la mchong rgyug byas pa na/ de dang thag mi ring ba'i rkyang khyu rnams kyang gcig 'phror gcig mthud kyis zhogs song / ra bha 'dre mig gis rang gi 'dre mig khyad mtshar de la brten nas spang thang la lta bzhin dal gyis mdun la song ba na/ rin chen rkyal khas khor yug gi ltad mo mi mthong rung 'gro ya'i rjes chod pas/ lus kun rngul chus brlan ma dgos/kho gnyis kha rog ger mdun la 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs la/ spyang ma zhig gis spyang phrug dgu khrid de kho gnyis ma'i rjes su 'brangs pas/ ra bha 'dre mig gis myur mor thag pa dkar po de'i mdud pa grol te sa la drud nas song /spyang ki ni gcan gzan g.yo sgyu can zhig yin la/ mtshan mo mi rnams kyis sa stong lung stong brgyud dus/ phrag la me mda' khur yod pa mthong na gcig 109

'tshub ma kher rkyang /kyang rig sar yong mi phod mod/ gal srid lam 'gro ba de phrag stong yin na/zla 'od 'og tu thag nag 'drud pa dang zla 'od med dus thag dkar drud nas ma song na/ spyang mang rub yong ste mi la 'jigs snang bskul te ci byed 'di byed med par byas rjes/ gcig ni g.yas nas g.yon la brgyugs te sha kham gang bcad nas par song na/ cig shos g.yon nas g.yas la brgyugs te sha kham gang bcad nas 'gro ba red/ de ltar thengs 'gar par brgyugs tshur brgyugs byas te mi de sa la bskyel nas phyir rgol byed pa'i stobs shugs med par gyur rjes/ spyang mang la stong 'jigs med par rub yong ste skad cig de nyid la mi de lhag lus med par zos 'gro ba yin/smyo rgyal kha/ 'u gnyis rjes kyi spyang ma 'di'i g.yas lag chad 'dug 6 lcags rnyis bzung myong ba zhig yin nam/mi smyo sus shes/ gang ltar ngar shugs la gzhigs na mi la sha 'khon chen po yod pa 'dra/’ 6 khyi mo gcig dang khyi phrug dgu yis 'u gnyis la ci bya nus/ ci yang bya mi nus/mi rin chen rkyal khas tshab tshub med par de ltar bshad/skabs der/ spya nga ma 'jab rgyug byas te thag sne la so 'ga' btab pa na/ ra bha 'dre mig gis ki ring 'ga' btab ste spyang ma dkrogs rjes/ myur mor thag sne rin chen rgyal kha'i lag la bzhag ste g.yas g.yon nas ong leb gnyis btus yong ste gcig la me bgos/ ong leb gcig la me 'gos te du 110

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/ba sngo lhog lhog byed dus/ yong leb gzhan zhig la me bgos te yud tsam la song ba na/ spyang ma lag rdum de slar yang thag sne la bslebs byung bas/'bar la nye ba'i yong leb de rgyab phyogs la shugs kyis g.yugs/ spyang phrug rnams kyis dmar lam lam byed pa'i me phung de skyen po'i mda' ltar rang nyid phyogs su yong bzhin pa mthong ste/ ngu zug byed bzhin phar bros pa dang /spyang ma de phyir cung tsam bros rjes slar yang kho gnyis kyi rjes su 'brangs/ kho gnyis kyis rmang leb la me bgo zhor dang spyang ki'i phyogs la g.yug zhor byas te mtsher shul zhig la bslebs dus/ spyang ma'i ngar shugs sngar las je cher song ste me la'ang de 'dra mi skrag par mu mthud du mdun la song na/ spyang ma des ci byed mi shes pas/ kho gnyis myur du mtsher shul na spyil bu zhig yod pa der 'dzul/spyil bu chung chung de'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi bkod pa la gzhigs na/phal cher sngags pa sgyid lug cig gi mtshams khang yin pa 'dra la/ spo tho'i rtsig pa la 'dam bag kyang byil med pas/ gang sa gang na phyi rol mthong ba'i bar hrag mang po 'dug kho gnyis sar tsog nas kha rog ger bsdad pa na/spyal bu'i rgyab phyogs su sa la sder 'brad byed pa'i sgra zhig dal gyis grags nga / 6 'di ci red/mi rin chen rkyal khas de ltar dris/6 spyang mas rtsig pa 'brad bzhin 'dug 111

'tshub ma kher rkyang /6 khyi rgan ma der ham pa che ba la ang / mgo khung nang la 'dzul nas byung na gson 'dzin byed/mi kho gnyis kha rog ger langs nas bsdad pa na/ rin chen rkyal khas sngar gyi sgra de go ba ma gtogs ci pang mi mthong la/ ra bha 'dre mig gis spo tho gnyis kyi bar stong na sa rdul mched bzhin yod pa mthong nas/ glo gri shubs las bton te sa la tsog yud tsam gyi rjes su/ sa rdul je che nas je cher song ba dang bstun nas spyang ma'i g.yon lag mngon byung bas/ sder mgor dmigs nas gri yis shugs kyis bsnun pa na/ spyang mas phe rgyangs byed bzhin bros song /rin chen rkyal kha gnyid song / kho'i gnam sa g.yo ba lta bu'i sdur sgra'i khrod du/ ra bha 'dre mig gnyid mi khugs par gyur/ khos mig zung deb tsam deb tsam byed bzhin gnyid la bsgugs pa na/ sems pa rta rgod ji bzhin 'das don gyi thang chen la brgyugs te bdag dam byed mi thub par gyur/ rang gi 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim ring mo'i khrod kyi don rkyen brjed dka' ba rnams nyi rdul 'khrigs pa ltar mig lam la mngon byung / khos skad cha ldab ldib bshad shes dus/ a mas slong mo byas te 'tsho ba rol bzhin yod la/ skabs der/khos slong mo byed pa ni don dag yid du 'ong ba zhig la brtsis te a ma'i rjes su 'brangs rtsis byas mod/ mos nam rgyun 'dzum dmul dmul gyis 6de ga la rung / gtan nas mi rung / a ma'i gces phrug nar son na mi gras la 112

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/'tshud dgos/’ zer nas skyur thabs byed nges yin/ de dus mi gras la 'tshud dgos :zhes par go ba ci yang ma lon par a mar 'khang ra byas mod/da skabs yid la dran na ya chung gangs dkar sems la smug long langs yong /skabs shig la/ byis pa gzhan la a ma yod par ma zad da rung a pha zer ba zhig kyang yod pa rtogs pas/ khos rang gi a pha gang na yod pa u tshugs kyis dris pa na/ dang thog a ma'i gdong la sdug nyams shig shar te ci yang mi bshad mod/ yud tsam gyi rjes su gdong la 'dzum mdangs bcos ma zhig bsdus te gces phrug khyod kyi a pha dag pa'i zhing na yod/ 'u gnyis ka zhing der 'gro thabs med mices bshad de/ bu kho pang la bzung ste mgo la byil byil byas/ khos dag pa'i zhing zer ba de 'dra thag ring zhig yin nam mizhes 'dri rtsis byed dus/ a mas glo bur du ngu skad phyung nas ngus pas/ kho rim nas yar langs te a ma'i mchi ma 'byid bzhin a ma/ nga la a pha mi dgos/ khyod ma ngu zhes yang bshad bskyar bshad byas pa dang / rjes su a pa'i thad kyi tshig gcig kyang 'dri ma phod pas/ da skabs rang nyid la bka' drin til 'bru tsam yang med pa'i a pha de su yin pa'ang mi shes/ a ma'i bka' drin la brten nas/ khyim tshang la med mug ci 'dra byung rung rtsam khug bzung nas spra sgo khyim sgo nyul ma dgos/ 'on kyang / skyes pho rab cig yin na tshe gcig gi 'tsho ba a mar brten na ga la 'grig kho pho lo bco lngar son pa nas bzung / rang nyid blo pha la mi 'dri ba dang bro ma la mi slong ba'i dus 113

'tshub ma kher rkyang /la bslebs byung snyam ste/ rang gi thabs dang nus pa la brten nas a ma'i drin lan ji ltar gzo bar bsam gzhig byas pa na/ gzhan gyi g.yog byas nas 'tsho ba rol pa las thabs gzhan ma rnyed/ kho a ye dkon mchog mtsho mo tshang gi lug rdzi byas pa na/ 'jig rten mi yul na gzhan la gla byed pa las 'tsho stangs thabs rdugs shig yod mi srid pa'i tshor snang byung / snga mo phyugs rdzir 'gro dus/ a ye dkon mchog mtsho mos 6khyi dang g.yog po gnyis ma'i pho ba rgyags mi nyan zer nas za ma nyung tsam za ru bcug rjes sbra sgor 'den pa dang / kho pho ba ltogs nas bzod thabs med rung nyin hril bor dogs zon chen po dang bcas phyugs khyu'i rjes su brgyugs pa na/ phyi dro nor lug lhas la 'ded dus a thang chad de gom pa spo ba'i stobs shugs kyang med/'on kyang / a ye dkon mchog mtsho mos snying rje sgom mi srid/ kho khyim la bslebs ma thag 6khyi dang g.yog po gnyis ka khom mi nyan 〉zer nas khyim las sna tshogs bkod sgrig byed nges yin la/ khos khyim las las skabs sha rdog re dang go re za 'phro re mthong na za 'dod kyi 'gram chu langs te 'dug mi bzod mod/ a ye dkon mchog mtsho mos lta rtog byed bzhin yod pas bzod bsran mi byed ka med yin/ mtshan mo'i dus tshod ring mo de bas kyang 'khyol dka' ste/ mos khyi dang g.yog po gnyis nas lhas srung dgos zer nas kho lhas srung la mngags pa na/ mtshan gang bor sgo khyi rnams dang lhan du lhas mtha' bskor nas brgyugs dgos/ gal srid mo lta rtog la yong dus kho 114

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/gnyid 'dug pa mthong na g.yag so bzhi gla la byin pa'i g.yog po de las ka med rung langs nas 'dug dgos zer bzhin gcar rdung byed pa yin/a ye dkon mchog mtsho mo'i bu mo gangs dkar sgrol ma ni ya rabs gshis bzang zhig yin la/ mos a mas g.yog po la zas mnar 'thung mnar byed bzhin yod pa mthong ste/ sems kyis ma bzod par skabs rer stabs 'grig dus rtsam log re dang sha rdog re gsang nas kho la byin pa na/ kho'i bkres ltogs kyi sdug bsngal chen po de cung tsam sel thub pa byung / 'on kyang /skyid de la rnga ma ring bo zhig ga la yod/ zhogs pa zhig la/ gangs dkar sgrol mas sha rdog 'ga' lkog nas kho la ster bzhin yod pa a ye dkon mchog mtsho mos mthong byung bas/ mo ni khro ba'i mchu 'dab lhab lhab dang tshig ngan gyi thal ba gtsub bzhin brgyugs yong nas khyod khu ta shar nas yong ste nga pho rog tshang nas 'ded rtsis yin nam/ nga'i bu mo 'di mar me mgo yi 'od dang rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i tog yin/ mug phrug khyod 'dra zhig gi g.yo 'og la tshud na ga la 'grig ces snying na ba'i gtam sna tshogs phreng bar bsgrigs nas dmod mo byas pa na/ gangs dkar sgrol ma phyir bltas med par lhas 'dabs la bros song mod/ kho ni skrag ste ya yo med par langs nas bsdad/ yud tsam 'gor nas blo rig cung tsam rnal la babs pa dang bstun nas spobs pa'ang phran tsam rgyas pas/ khos 'jigs snang dang bcas yin lugs kyi gtam 'ga' bshad pa na/ a ye dkon mchog mtsho mos ag rgyangs byed bzhin sa 115

'tshub ma khyer rkyang /nas rdo log cig blangs byung bas/ kho myur stabs kyis par 'khor te bros na'ang / gom pa lnga drug tsam ma gtogs spo dbang ma byin par rdo de yo gzur ci yang med par ltag gor la phog pa dang mnyam du kho sa la 'gyel te brgyal song / kho'i dran pa sos dus nyin gung yol 'dug la/ a ye dkon mchog mtsho mo tshang gi bza' mi che chung tshang ma kho'i mtha' 'khor la rub 'dug pa dang / la la'i mchi ma 'don bzhin mchis/ khos mi ngan 'di dag gis rang la ltad mor bltas 'dug snyam ste btsan shugs kyis yar langs pa na/ mgo bo na nas bzod thabs med pa dang gnam sa thams cad dus gcig la g.yos byung bas/ kho slar yang ljid tig ger sa la 'gyel song /ya mtshan zhig la/ de'i rjes nas bzung kho'i mig la khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig byung ste mtshan mo'i mthong tshad nyin mo las bzang bar gyur/ gla ba'i 'tsho ba ni de ltar mjug rdzogs la/ kho rang khyim la log nas bsdad pa na/ khong khro je che nas je cher phyin te a ye dkon mchog mtsho mo gson por bshas rung yid mi tshim par gyur/ lhag par a mas rtsam khug bzung ste spra sgo khyim sgo nyul nasarangasto byed bzhin pa mthong ba na/ na sems sngar las je cher phyin pa dang sdusabasngal zad med skyes pas/ 'dug ma bzod par yar langs nas par 'gro tshur 'gro byas pa dang / skabs der yid 'jog ma byas par lobs phyogs kyis mgo la byil byil re byas pa na/ ltag gor gyi rma kha gzer brang breng byed pas/ a mas rma kha mthong na ci bya snyam bzhin ral ba 116

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/bsed bsed byas nas ltag gor la legs par bkab rjes kha rog ger tsog nas bsdad/ skabs der kho'i yid la dran pa ni rang nyid la 'tsho stangs gsar ba zhig 'tshol rgyu de red/ khos bsam gzhig ci 'dra byas rung gzhan nor brkus nas 'tsho ba rol pa las thabs gzhan ma rnyed/ 'on te gzhan gyi rgyu nor rku ba ni yid la dran sla rung lag len byed dka' ba zhig red/ kho thog mar a ye dkon mchog mtsho mo tshang la rku byed par 'gro dus/ sgo khyi rnams la 'dris 'dug rung spra'i nye sar btud mi phod la/ u tshugs chen pos spra sgor btud rung ci zhig rku rtsis byas pa na skyid pa lhag lhag 'dar te rang lus kyang lcogs dka' bas/ rkang 'jab lag 'jab kyis phyir la mi 'gro thabs med byung / de'i rjes su kho sems ma pham par mtshan mo gang mang la sde ba'i ru 'dabs nyul/ mtshan mo zhig la ra ma zhig lcags rnyis bzung 'dug pa dang 'phrad pas/ skrag nas lus kun lhab lhab 'dar rung /lcags rnyi khur cing ra ma khrid de yul la song / khos sngon chad ra lug bshas ma myong bas/ ra ma'i mchu to bsnams te gsod thabs byas rjes/ khrag rtsa'ang ma bcad par ra lpags bshus shing ra sha ka mgo la dpyangs pa dang /rgyu ma dang grod pu 'phyi khung zhig la bcug pa'i thog la sa bkabs nas gzhan gyis mi mthong bar byas nas sbas/ phyi nyin nam langs dus bltas pa na/ ra sha khrag gis gos te dmar lam lam byed pa dang / sha sne tshil ril mang po lpags ngos la 'byar du bcug pas lta srol med pa zhig byas 'dug sa mas 117

'tshub ma kher rkyang /ka sked kyi ra sha mthong bas ngo mdangs skad cig nyid la 'gyur te shugs ring 'ga' 'then mod/ kha nas ci yang ma bshad par ra sha dum bur bgos te snye stong zhig tu bcug rjes ma ṇi zlo bzhin rang ma bu gnyis la nangs ja bskol/mtshan mo de nas bzung / kho'i snying stobs rim gyis je cher song ste/ mun rub nas mi skad khyi skad 'jags dus/ a ye dkon mchog mtsho mo tshang gtso byas pa'i khyim tshang mang por 'dzul te mar dang rtsam pa/ nas dang chur ba sogs brkus pa na/ nyams myong dang phod pa rim gyis byung ste rku byed par 'jigs snang dang dka' khag chen po med par gyur pas/ sde ba'i khyim tshang dbul po rnams la rku byed mtshams bzhag ste/ khyim tshang phyug po rnams la 'dzul nas nye bar mkho ba'i zas gos rku ci thub byas pa dang / phyug po'i khyim las dngos po re brkus pa na a ye dkon mchog mtsho mo'i snying rtser gri yis bsnun pa lta bu'i dga' snang tsam thob yong / rjes su a myes rgyal mtshan gyi mgul nas srin po g.yu rngog gi bla rdo brkus pa na/ gong ma rgyal po'i phyag tham rku dgos rung las sla bo yin pa zhig tu gyur pas/ spobs pa chen po dang bcas sde ba tsho ba gzhan la song nas phyug po rnams kyi rgyu nor brkus/skabs rer khyim tshang dbul po re dang 'phrad na/ phyug po rnams las mar chur rtsam pa sogs brkus te de dag la bskyal pas/ rim gyis mug skyob byed par dga' ba'i goms srol gsar ba zhig kyang ngang gis grub/ stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar gyis tsho ba'i phyi nang kun la rku byas mi chog pa'i tsho khrims 118

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/gtan 'bebs byas rjes/ kho zla gcig lhag la khrim nas legs por bsdad mod/ mar chur dang rtsam pa rim gyis tshar ba na/ khrims kyi 'jigs snang rgyab la bskyur te phyi la mi 'khyam thabs med byung / bsam yul las 'das pa zhig ni/ sde ba tsho bas tsho khrims gsar ba de dpral ba'i mig ltar rtsi bzhin yod rung / kho phyi la 'khyams te gang mkho ci dgos brkus pa na/ tsho khrims lag bstar byed pa phar zhog las de byed mi rung mi chog zer mkhan zhig kyang ma byung bas/ snying khams dang spobs pa sngar las je cher song ste/ rang gis gzhan nor rku bar ma zad/ da dung rin chen rkyal kha'ang grogs su bkugs nas tsho ba'i khrims dkrugs/ khos rku byas nas lo brgyad 'gor rung /gcig na rgyu la rgyu 'dang chung ba dang / gnyis su stobs 'byor ldan na rang gi mi gshis bzang bo 'gyur bar dogs nas/ nam rgyun khab bsogs nas 'bigs dang 'bigs bsogs nas gri brdung ba'i bsam blo med pas/ khyim tshang gi 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen la 'gyur ldog chen po ma byung /mig zung deb tsam rdob tsam byed bzhin 'das don la bsam gzhig byas pa na/ gnyid pa phar zhog rig pa je gsal nas je gsal yin pas/ ra bha 'dre mig 'u thug pa'i ngang nas yar langs te spyil bu'i sgo la bud/ khor yug gi yod tshad dal cag ger 'dug la/ nam mkha'i dbyings su sprin pa bye'u mgo tsam yang mi mthong / skabs der/ shar phyogs kyi mkha' dbyings su skar mda' zhig dmar 'tshub be mched byung bas/ khos de ma thag rang 119

'tshub ma kher rkyang /khyim na gcig bur gnas pa'i a ma dran byung /smyo skar mda' gcig mched na mi gcig 'chi bar bshad/ a ma bde 'tshams yin nam/ mir bha 'dre mig gi sems la zug gzer zhig langs pa dang mnyam du chig lab de 'dra byas/le'ubazhipa/sdong ru tsho ba ni tsho chung bcu gsum gyis grub pa yin mod/ tsho ba'i byed ka ge sar mar slang du 'tsho bas/ lobs phyogs kyis shog kha gnyis su bgos te/ ge sar rgyal po'i mar slang du yod pa rnams la slang nang ma dang /sla nga'i phyi rol tu gnas pa rnams la slang phyi ma zhes 'bod pa yin/ ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis kyang slang nang ma'i gras su gtogs/ kho tsho yod sa'i gshong chen sgor mo de phyogs bzhi ri yis bskor yod cing / ston dus sa dpyad mkhan ri rtse la 'gos te zhib lta byas na zangs kyi sla ngar mar khus bkang ba dang kun nas mtshungs/ rgan po rnams kyi ngag sgros ltar na gshong sa chen po de ni gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sla nga yin la/ sngon dus seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyis hor gur dkar rgyal por gnya' sga bstad pa dang / hor yul thams cad chos la bsgyur pa na/ the'u rang dkar nag khra gsum gyis srog snying phul te dam pa'i chos la zhabs zhu sgrub pa'i dam bca' bzhag pa dang / mgo 'dogs zhu rten la mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba'i zangs 120
