ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/kyi sla nga blugs ma zhig phul/ seng chen mi rje rin po ches sla nga de mar slang byas te/ rgya dkar nag dang bod mgo nag gi 'gro ba nyam chung rnams la mar sbyin btang ste kun gyi yid tshims par byas pa na/ bdud rje shing khri rgyal por phrag dog bzod glags med pa skyes te/ mon ri gser nag gyen spungs kyi klad la bud nas bdud mda' khrag 'thung me 'bar zer ba de shugs kyis 'phangs pa na/ gling gi dgra lha wer ma rnams skad cig nyid la rub yong ste mda' shing dang mda' sgro la dam por 'jus nas phyir 'then mod/ gcig na bdud lha'i mthu btsan pa dang / gnyis su bdud rje shing khri rgyal po'i rtsal rgod pas/ bdud mda' me stag 'tshub se zangs kyi sla nga la phog pa na/ da skabs shar nub gnyis na kha gtad du yod pa'i nyag ga de gnyis byung ba red/ra bha 'dre mig tshang ni ge sar mar slang byang phyogs kyi ri 'dabs na yod la/gshong sa'i spra nag mang po'i nye 'gram du nag gor rer 'khyil ba'i phyugs lhas yod pa dang / phyugs lhas kyi che chung la gzhigs na khrim tshang so sor stobs 'byor ga tsam ldan pa rtogs thub/ ra bha 'dre mig tshang la nor lug gcig kyang med pas/ phyugs lhas kyi dod ni skya leb ber 'dug pa'i thal phung de red/ kho tshang gi spre'u nag dang mar gsham gyi de'u 'bur bar na rkang lam phra mo zhig drang shar se 'ben 'dug la/ de ni a ma skyi mgo nyi ma lde bar 'gro skabs kyi bgrod lam yin pa dang / spre'u nag nas g.yon phyogs kyi chu mig bar du rkang lam gya ma gyu zhig mchis pa de ni a ma skyi mgo'i chu lam red/121

'tshub ma kher rkyang /de ring a ma skyi mgo mal las langs dus sngar bzhin nyin gung yin la/mos dal bur ja zhig bskol te rtsam pa zos pa na/ nyin gung yol te nyi thig pho khyim gyi thab rtsar 'phros byung / khyim tshang la las ka ci yang med pa dang /ra bha'ang yul la bslebs la nye snyam pa na lobs phyogs ltar rkang lam phra mo de ded nas de'u 'bur klad la bslebs ma thag lag pas nyi 'od bsgribs te nub phyogs su zhib lta yun ring la byas rung / mthong tshad na rkang thang tshur yong gcig kyang ma byung bas/ 'char sgo ci ying med par sar tsog ste nyi mar lde nas bsdad/ re zhig 'gor nas lta phyogs kyis mar sbyin de'u 'bur mthong ba na / chung dus mthong ba'i mar sbyin gtong mkhan la la'i snang brnyan yid la gsal ler shar pas/ sems su skyid la sdug pa'i snang ba zhig shar/ rang khyim dang thag mi ring ba'i sa na yod pa'i de'u 'bur de'i ming la dang thog ci zer ba mi shes mod/ kho tshang gis sdong ru dpon la mgo 'dogs dus de la mar sbyin thod mgo dang mar sbyin de'u 'bur zer ba dang / gling tsha tsho dgu zer ba'i 'brog sde stobs 'byor can des ge sar rgyal po'i phyag srol rgyun 'dzin byed ched/ lo re'i ston dus nam rgyun slang nang mar yong ste/nyi ma bdun gyi ring la sa phyogs kun gyi mi nyam chung dbul po rnams la mar sbyin gtong bzhin yod pa dang / de dus kho tsho 'dug sa ni mar sbyin thod mgo'i zhol red/ a ma skyi mgor mtshon na chung dus mar sbyin gtong mkhan rnams la re ltos ha cang che/ byis pa bsam med yin dus/ mar sbyin gtong 122

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/mkhan rnams yul 'dir 'byor na/ slong mo ma byas rung 'bri mar ser po mang po'i yong 'bab yod pa dang / lhag par dga' bde chos skyong ber nag gi sku skye yin par bshad pa'i bgres po mgo dkar de de'i gras su yod na/ mo gam la bos te byis pa snying sdug cig 'dug zer bzhin mgo la byil byil byed par ma zad/ nyin bdun ring la ga dus song rung 'bri mar yid tshims pa zhig ster nges yin pas/ bgres po mgo dkar la dungs sems zab mo chags te/ mar sbyin gtong mkhan rnams sngar mal du 'byor ma thag dran gdung dang bcas bgres po mgo dkar de 'tshol ba yin/ rjes su na tshod rim gyis smin te pho gzhon na mnyam mthong na sems la tshor snang khyad mtshar skyes pa'i skabs der/ bgres po byams sems can de gtan nas mi mthong bar gyur mod/ mor sdug bsngal dang dran gdung chen po ma byung / mos rang khyim gyi mi grangs bshad de mar skal len zhor du/ pho gzhon lo mnyam zhig gis rang nyid la dungs sems kyi zur mda' 'phen par re ltos byas/ rang nyid mo lo nyi shu la son pa'i ston kha der mar sbyin gtong mkhan rnams dus ltar sngar mal la 'byor ba na/ mos re ltos drag po byed bzhin rang khyim gyi mar skal de blangs mod/ rang la yid 'jog byed pa'i skyes pa gcig kyang ma byung bas/ yid sems 'khyags te khrim la ga ler log 'on te bsam yul las 'das pa zhig ni/ mtshan mo der skyes pa zhig rkang 'jab lag 'jab kyis mo'i mal du glo bur la bslebs byung / khos mo'i gong ba'i 'ben te 123

'tshub ma kher rkyang /gsal la mi gsal ba'i tshig 'ga' bshad pa na/ mo skrag nas lus po 'dar te tshig gcig kyang bshad mi phod mod/ rang sems kyi dran gdung de sel ched/ sems pa rnal la phab nas khos ci bshad dang len byas te/ 'jigs zhed dang zug gzer khrod nas phyugs phyung ma'i 'tsho ba de phar bskyal pa na/ma gzhir 'jig rten 'tsho ba ni 'di 'dra zhig yin nam snyam pa'i tshor snang byung / de nas bstud mar mtshan mo lnga la skyes pa de mo'i gam la yong ba dang /kho'i tshig gi bshad lugs sogs la gzhigs na/ skyes pa de gshis rgyud drang zhing ngang rgyud 'jam pa'i pho gzhon ya rabs shig yin pa 'dra mod/ 'on kyang yid skyo ba zhig ni/ nyin mo nam rgyun mar sbyin thod la song ste mtshan mo yong ba'i skyes pa de btsal ba na/ mor 'dzum mdangs ston mkhan gcig kyang ma byung bas/ mtshan mo'i mgron po de ngos 'dzin byed ma thub/ra bha 'dre mig ni skabs der mo'i lus la 'khor pa yin/ dus de nas bzung / mos mar sbyin gtong mkhan la re stos byed pa'i skyo gdung sngar las je drag la song ste/ mtshan mo gling tsha tsho dgu'i mna' mar gyur pa'i rmi lam khrod nas spro snang btsal pa dang / nyin mo stong 'dang dang 'phrul snang la brten nas dus 'da' bar byas/ rjes su mar sbyin gtong mkhan rnams lo re bzhin yong mod/ mo'i mi lam de mngon 'gyur byed pa'i bskal pa ma byung /a ma skyi mgo kha rog ger nyi mar lde nas bsdad pa na/ dbyar gyi nyi 'od drag po'i 'og tu mgo bo tsha lam lam byed pa dang / gling tsha tsho dgu'i skyes pa khrel 124

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/med de'i spyod pa yid la 'khor na sems pa 'khyag sib sib byed/ru kyiwa wa.a ma skyi mgo rgyang de tsam mi ring ba'i sa nas bud med cig gis bos byung bas/ a ma skyi mgo langs te g.yas lta g.yon lta byas pa na/ a ye dkon mchog mtsho mo rang khyim gyi lhas 'dabs su langs te mor bltas 'dug pa mthong /smyo kyiwa wa.a ma skyi mgo khyod kyis khyi zhig khogs dang /mi 44'o ya ya/ a ma skyi mgos a ye dkon mchog mtsho mor lag g.yug lan 'ga' byas rjes/ dal ba dal bur khyi mo nyal yod sa'i gad skyibs de gzas nas phar song / a ye dkon mchog mtsho mo ni bud med nga rgyal can zhig yin la/ mos rang khyim la stobs 'byor ldan pa dang / pha mes skabs su ldong ru dpon tshang la gnyen 'brel byung ba de la rgyab bcol te/ nam rgyun stobs 'byor dman pa rnams la 'phya dmod dang dma' 'bebs kho na byed par ma zad/ dbul po 'khyam po thams cad mi gras su mi 'jog pas/ gal srid rang khyim gyi tshwa khu tshar te thabs bkod zad pa min na/ ra bha 'dre mig tshang lta bu'i khyim tshang dbul po zhig la gtan nas yong mi srid/ mos dang thog a ma skyi mgo 'bod dus gzhan gyis go bar dogs nas khyim mtshes rnams kyi sgo 'gram na mi gcig kyang med dus bos pa dang / de nas tshur yong dus gzhan gyis mthong na ci bya snyam nas chu mig bzhur sa'i grog shur de brgyud de kun gyis mi mthong bar byas/ mo ra bha 'dre mig tshang gi ze'u nag 125

'tshub ma kher rkyang /nang la 'dzul ma thag ci yang mi bshad par khengs nyams dang bcas lag gi lug sha rkang yas de ras khug dang lhan du a ma skyi mgo'i lag la bzhag pa na/ a ma skyi mgo thog mar had de yud tsam la cer nas bsdad mod/ de nas ci zhig rtogs pa ltar dga' bslug bslug gis lug sha blangs te do thog la bzhag rjes/ myur mor thab la yong ba ded de ja skol grabs byas/a ye dkon mchog mtsho mo'i rum na da dung mar dang chur ba'ang nyung tsam yod la/ gal srid tshwa khu yid tshims pa zhig ma lon na rum gyi mar chur ster rtsis med/ mo 'dzem dogs dang bcas pho khyim gyi slog gdan la bsdad de khyim gyi ca lag dang mgo spra la bltas pa na/ ci 'dra'i khyim tshang dbul po zhig red ang snyam pa'i tshor ba byung ba dang bstun nas/ rang gi tshe sngon gyi tshogs bsags dang da lta'i bsod nams ni gzhan la ngom chog snyam pa'i gdeng tshod de sngar las sra brtan du gyur/skabs shig la/ ste'u nag chung chung de du bas khengs song bas a ma skyi mgos brel 'tshub dang bcas thab khung la shugs kyis phu btab pa na/ thab me dmar hang hang du 'bar byung ba dang / mo'i mig zung gzer brang breng byed pa dang mchi ma rdog phreng 'ga' mig kong las mkhur ngos la gril byung /zu a ye/ khyod la dud bdug byas song /mi a ma skyi mgos gus gus zhum zhum gyis de ltar bshad/sna skyon med/mi a ye dkon mchog mtsho mos khengs nyams dang bcas de 126

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin tshen rtsal kha/ltar bshad rjes glo bur du rang gi 'ong don dran byung bas/ gdong la sngar med pa'i 'dzum mdangs bcos ma zhig bsdus te a la/ ngas brjed 'dugamadang dgong nged tshang gis lug bshas pas/ de ring gzas nas sha skal khyer yong ba yin ces bshad/zu 'o brgyal/ nga'i don la lan chags 'di 'dra myong ga la dgos/mi cadabyar kha drin chen po/ gnam gshis bzang bas skyid mod/ lug gcig bshas rung myur mor ma zos na/ nyin 'ga'i rjes su rul te khyis kyang mi za/mi a ye dkon mchog mtsho mos yid 'jog ma byas par khengs nyams kyis de ltar bshad pa na slar yang yong don dran te 'gyod pa skyes/lug sha ci 'dra rul na'ang khyis kyang mi za zer ba ni gnas lugs dang cung 'byor dka' ba zhig red de/ a ma skyi mgos phyug po yin na kha pho che snyam bzhin bden pa'i brda la mgo bo ldem ldem byas/6 mdang dgong gi lug de ha cang tsho mod/ nged tshang gi tshwa khu tshar 'dug pas/ g.yos rgyu sdug ma thub/mi /a ho/ khyod tshang gis khrag rgyu'ang za ma thub/ tshwa khu med na nged tshang la yong na mi chog gam/ ’66ngas khyod tshang la tshwa khu yod pa ma shes/ mi 'i ye dkon mchog mtsho mos bsam don 'grub la nye snyam ste dga' spro skyes/a ma skyi mgo myur mor yar langs te/ ras khug nang gi sha de sha snye 127

'tshub ma kher rkyang /nang la bcug rjes/ tshwa snye'i kha 'dig grol te tshwa rdog ras khug phyed tsam bcus te mo'i gam la bzhag pa na/ a ye dkon mchog mtsho mor khe spogs byung ba'i dga' spro dpag med skyes pas/ myur mor rum nas mar chur rnams blangs te a la/ ngas 'di brjed 'dug ces bshad bzhin a ma skyi mgo'i lag la bzhagarang khyim la log skabs/ a ye dkon mchog mtsho mos brel 'tshub chen pos g.yas lta g.yon lta byed bzhin chu mig bzhur sa'i grog shur de'i nang la babs nas song / a ma skyi mgos tshul de mthong bas/ thog mar mo'i bsam don rtogs pa dang / de nas bsam gzhig zhib mo byas pa na mo'i yong don yang gsal ler rtogs pas/ thog mar khong khro bzod glags med pa zhig skyes mod/ slar yang zhib 'dang zhig brgyab na/ khong khro skyes don gtan nas med par snyam/ gcig na tshwa rin la mar chur blangs yod pa dang /gnyis su stobs 'byor ldan zhing nga rgyal che ba'i bud med des rang nyid la slong mo byas/ a ma skyi mgos bsam blo btang gin btang gin spro snang je che nas je cher phyin te/ rgyal kha'i 'dzum mdangs dang bcas ste'u nag nang la 'dzul song /le'u lnga pa/128mdang dgong / ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis kus mtsher

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/shul gyi spyil bu chung chung de nas ngal gso byas pa na/ rin chen rkyal kha la gnyid stug po babs te ngal gso legs po byas pa dang / ra bha 'dre mig gis yar dran brgya dang mar dran stong byas te yun ring la gnyid ma thub rung /de ring lam la chas pa na rin chen rkyal khas sngar bzhin ra bha 'dre mig gi rjes mi chod/ kho gnyis nyin hril bor skabs rer brel 'gro dang mtshams rer dal ba'i 'gros kyis mdun la song ba na/ nyi ma nub phyogs kyi ri rtser lhung la nye ba'i skabs su/ btsan rgod nyag chen gsal ler mthong ba'i sa la bslebs byung /mun rub pa dang bstun nas nam mkha' char sprin stug pos bzung ste skar phran zhig kyang mi mthong / ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis ka btsan rgod nyag chen mar gsham la bslebs dus/ nub phyogs kyi char sprin cig po'i klong nas g.yu 'brug gnam sa gas pa ltar grags pa dang /glog dmar g.yung drung ris su bar med 'khyugs pas/ kho gnyis gas gom pa mgyogs len byed bzhin nyag chen pha rol gyi brag skyibs de gzas nas song / kho gnyis de sngon gling tsha tsho dgu la 'gro skabs/ brag skyibs de nas lan mang la bsdad myong ba dang / de yang char ba 'bab bzhin yod pa'i mtshan mo zhig la/ kho gnyis ma'i lus kun grang shur shur byed bzhin brag skyibs mar gsham la bslebs pa na/ rin chen rkyal khas mgo bo bskur nas rdog lam la zhib lta byed bzhin mdun la 'gro bzhin yod pas ci yang ma 129

'tshub ma kher rkyang /mthong mod/ ra bha 'dre mig gis brag skyibs 'gram na rta g.yag sga bstad mang po btags yod pa dang / phying lu gon pa'i skyes pa 'ga' yis rta g.yag rnams srung 'dug pa mthong byung / khos rin chen rkyal kha pha bong chen po zhig gi 'gram du bskyur rjes/ rang nyid dal bur 'jabs nas ri ngos la 'gos pa na/ brag skyibs sgo na skyes pa 'ga' brag la bsnyes nas gnyid 'dug pa mthong / ra bha 'dre mig gis de dag ni tshong pa skor zhig yin pa shes te rkang 'jab lag 'jab kyis brag skyibs nang la 'dzul/ kho dogs zon dang bcas brag skyibs nang la 'dzul ba na/ brag skyibs phugs na dngos rdzas mang po brtsigs 'dug pa dang / de'i mar gsham na skyes pa zhig gis phying lu zhig gdan la btings shing / phying lwa gnyis dang gos lu zhig rgyab la gon nas gnyis 'dug tshul de la ltas na phal cher tshong dpon yin pa shes thub/ ra bha 'dre mig gis tshul de mthong ma thag 'di na'ang a ye dkon mchog mtsho mo dang 'dra bar rang nyid gcig pu la ma gtogs gces mi shes pa'i mi ngan khyi 'dra ba zhig 'dug snyam ste khong khro glo bur ba zhig skyes te 'dug mi bzod par gyur/ khos thog mar mi ngan khyi 'dra ba de la gcar rdung yid tshims pa zhig byed rtsis byas mod/ gcig na rang nyid mi de'i do ya yong min mi shes pa dang / gnyis su phyi rol gyi so pa rnams rub yong na 'bro ba'i go skabs kyang mi 'dug bsams pa na/ bya thabs bral te tshong dpon de'i 'gram nas par 'gro tshur 'gro byas/ skabs shig la thabs jus legs po zhig rnyed byung 130

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/bas/ 'dzum dmul dmul byed bzhin rang gi slog hrul de tshong dpon gyi sngas 'gram la bzhag pa dang / gos lu ljang khu de rang gis gyon rjes/dngos rdzas kyi nang nas thag pa zhig btsal yong ste/ thag pa'i sne gcig tshong dpon gyi rkang mgor mdud pa dang sne kha gzhan zhig brag skyibs kyi nye 'gram na g.yag rgan zhig yod pa de'i ske thug la mdud rjes/ dal ba dal bur rin chen rkyal kha gzas nas ri ngos las babs/ kho gnyis ra bha 'dre mig gi jus bkod ltar brag skyibs steng phyogs kyi ri ngos la 'gos te/ rbab rdo chung chung 'ga' snga gzhug tu bur la bsgril pa na/ thog mar rta g.yag rnams 'drogs te 'ur chil ler zhogs pa dang / de nas skyes pa zhig gis dngangs skrag dang bcas ag rgyangs byas song bas/ ra bha 'dre mig gis gad mo dgod bzhin gi ki swo swo lha rgyal lo zhes ki rgyangs lan 'ga' byas/ rjes su kho btsan rgod nyag chen la bslebs thengs rer don dag de dran na kha 'dzum khong 'dzum langs te kher dgod byed pa yin la/ do dgong yang de las ma 'das/kho gnyis nyag stong la bslebs te yud tsam la song ba na/ mun pa stug po'i khrod du rin chen rkyal khas ci yang mi mthong mod/ ra bha 'dre mig gis nyag ga'i mar gsham na spra gur khra lam mer dang / la lo nag rig ger 'dug pa mthong bas/ kho gnyis dal bur 'jabs te nyag ga'i g.yon phyogs kyi ri ngos la 'gos/131

'tshub ma kher rkyang /dri 6gsham na ci zhig 'dug rin chen rgyal kha ri rtse ru bsdad de de skad sa/ smyo kha rog ra bha 'dre mig gis blo rtse gcig tu bsgrims te zhib lta byas pa na/ mar gsham gyi tshogs gur chen po'i nang du me 'od dmar lam lam byed pa dang / skabs rer mi re gur nang nas par 'gro tshur 'gro byas na/ kho'i grib ma gur la phog ste nag yor yor byed/ tshogs gur chen po de'i mtha' 'khor na g.yas ru dang g.yon ru/ mdun ru dang rgyab ru bcas kyi tshul du sbra gur bzhi phub yod pa dang / gur nang na mi yod med mi shes rung gsal la mi gsal ba'i sgron me re bsgron 'dug mdun ru'i mar gsham du lcags ri'i dod la spra gur bzhi bcu lhag gi chon thag sbrel te sha gzhong dbyibs su phub yod pa dang / gur mang gi nang rol tu rta rdang 'ben 'dug ra bha 'dre mig gis tshul de mthong rjes/ thog mar nye bar gcar 'dod kyi kun slong byung ste 'tshub cha langs pa dang / de nas gsham du tshom bu tshom bu byas nas yod pa'i gur rnams ni dmag sgar chen po zhig red bsams pa na/ 'jigs snang byung ste sngar gyi spobs pa de gar song rjes med du gyur/66gsham na sgra gur 'ga' las ci yod/mi 6 dmag sgar chen po zhig brgyab 'dug ra bha 'dre mig gis de ltar bshad rjes shugs ring zhig 'then/6 ri ling kru'u zhi'i jag sgar yin nam/ 132

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha///ma red/mi spra gur la brtags na bod kyi dmag sgar zhig red/’ dmag sgar la blta bar 'gro rtsis byas rjes/ ra bha 'dre mig skyil krung du bsdad de/ thog mar mgul gyi bla rdo la g.yas lag gis 'phur 'phur lan 'ga' byas pa dang / de nas lag zung thal mo sbyar te a lags mkha' lding tshang la gsol ba 'debs bzhin srin po g.yu rngog la kha 'dzin sdongs grogs mdzad dgos pa'i skul ba byas mod/ dmag sgar chen po de'i gzhi khyon yid la shar na sems pa rnal la dbab thabs med pas/ slar yang bsang gsur khri 'bum khas len byed bzhin srin po g.yu rngog la skul ba thengs shig byas/gal srid kho'i mgul na bla rdo mthu nus can de med na/ gsham gyi dmag sgar de 'dra'i khrod la 'gro ba'i spobs pa ga la yod/srin po g.yu rngog gi bla rdo de ni mkha' lding sku phreng gnyis pa 'phrin las 'jigs med chos kyi rdo rje tshang gis srin po g.yu rngog zhi ba'i thabs kyis chos 'og la 'gugs skabs/ gzhi bdag nag phyogs pa des srog snying phul pa'i dan rtags brjed par byas pa yin la/ bla rdo de bkol spyod byed par man ngag sna tshogs yod pa dang / gal srid man ngag thams cad chad lus med par yid la nges na/ 'dzam gling hril bo mgo mjug brje dgos rung rang lag yin par bshad/ bla rdo de mkha' lding sku phreng rim byon gyis rten 'gangs chen zhig la brtsis te mgul bar btags yod mod/ mkha' lding dge legs rnam rgyal 'jigs med rang byung rdo rje tshang ldong ru rgyal mtshan 133

'tshub ma kher rtsang /tshang la phebs nas mtshan mo zhag bzhugs gnangs pa na/ nam gung stag gi dus su khong nyid mal khri'i steng du rdo rje skyil krung la bzhugs te re zhig gzugs sku'i bkod pa rdzogs pa'i tshul bstan/ skabs der khong nyid dgung lo nga gsum la son ma thag yin pas/ sdong ru tsho ba'i ser skya pho mo rnams la bla ma'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang lhag par sku snga por 'phur pa'i gdung bas mnar te/ mig nas mchi ma tha ra ra dang kha nas smre sngags di ri ri byas/ kho tshos stobs shugs gcig tu bsdus te gdung mchod kyi cho ga legs par bsgrubs pa dang / gser dang zangs las grub pa'i mchod rten bzhengs te sku gdung mchod rten du bzhugs par gsol skabs/ khong gi mgul na srin po g.yu rngog gi bla rdo 'gangs chen de med pa shes song / dgon pa'i grwa pa rgan pa rnams kyis sdong ru rgyal mtshan gyis brkus song snyam ste/ bo tshogs chen 'du khang la bos te yin lugs kyi lo rgyus bshad pa na/ ldong ru rgyal mtshan gyis chos skyong srung ma dpang la bzhag ste sku gzhogs tshang la de lta bu'i rin po che zhig yod pa gtan nas mi shes zhes bshad de/ khyod tshos mi skyon med mgo la skyon bzhag pa dang rta mthur med rgyab la sga bstan pa red ces gtan nas khas ma blangs pas/ dgon pas kho stong dpon tshang la mi sprod thabs med byung la/ stong dpon tshang gis gtam ngan de go ma thag tu khong khro'i me rtse rab tu 'phyur nas/ khrims lcag gshed ma'i srog len gyis lan lnga brgya brabs te lus kun khrag gis brdzis rung / sdong ru rgyal mtshan gyis ngos 134

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/len ma byas pas/ stong dpon gyi khong khro sngar las je cher phyin te/ kho ril ril gru gu 'dra zhig bkyigs rjes g.yag ko sgron pas btums te nyi mar lde rung sngar bzhin ngos len ma byas pas/ stong dpon 'u thug ste kho la dkar 'don mi byed ka med byung / dgun dkyil gyi mtshan mo zhig la/ ra bha 'dre mig gis sha rtsam dang mar chur re rku ched/ sde ba'i ru 'dabs nyul nas song ba na/ chu grog chung chung zhig gi 'gram na skyes pa zhig 'gyel 'dug pa mthong bas/ 'di la ci byung snyam bzhin gam la song ste zhib lta byas pa na/ ma gzhir skyes pa de ni ldong ru rgyal mtshan yin la/ kha nas chang dri thu li li byed pa dang chang gis bzi 'dug pa shes nas/ 'di ltar bzhag na rgan po'i rkang lag phyid 'gro snyam ste/ kho'i ming nas yun ring la bos rung 'gul tsam yang mi byed/ de nas phu rung nas bzung ste thog mar dal bur 'ben pa dang de'i rjes shugs kyis 'then rung / kho'i kha nas chang dri thu li li byed pa las tshor snang tsam yang med pas/ ra bha 'dre mig gi rgan po 'di shi 'dug snyam ste/snying lding gin yod med la brtag ched brel 'tshub dang bcas g.yas lag kho'i rum la bsrings pa na/ sko la rde'u zhig btags yod pa de la reg byung bas/skad cig nyid la srin po g.yu rngog gi bla rdo kho tshang nas bor ba yid la 'khor te/ myur mor brgyus thig bcad de de'u lag la bzung nas phyir bltas med par bros/ khos bla rdo'i man ngag gcig kyang mi shes rung mgul la sung ba'i tshab tu btags/ nyin zhig la/ kho spang ngos su skyil krung du bsdad de/135

'tshub ma kher rkyang /g.yas lag gis mgul gyi bla rdo la 'phur 'phur lan 'ga' byas rjes/ sku gzhogs mkha' lding tshang la gsol ba 'debs zhor du/ srin po g.yu rngog la kha 'dzin sdongs grogs mdzad par rting skul byas rjes/ dmigs yul ci yang med par nye 'gram gyi dud khrim de la 'khrums/ bsam yul las 'das pa zhig ni/ kho lhas 'dabs la bslebs dus khyi yis ma mthong zhing / spra nang la 'dzul ba na bza' mi che chung gcig gis kyang kha ya mi byed pas/ bla rdo'i mthu la brten nas chos skyong srung ma dang yul lha gzhi bdag gis rang gi lus kun bsgribs 'dug snyam ste/ dga' spro chen po dang bcas mo khyim gyi mar grod de 'ubs btab nas spra sgor bud/ dus de nas bzung / kho'i spobs pa sngar las je cher phyin te/ nyin mo'ang gzhan khyim la 'dzul te rku byed pa'i snying stobs yod par gyur/nub phyogs char sprin stug po'i klong gi 'brug sgra sngar las je drag tu song ba dang bstun nas/ btsan rgod nyag chen la'ang char ba drag tu babs pa na/ nye 'gram gyi ri lung thang gsum mun pas gtibs te ci yang mi mthong ba dang / tshogs gur chen po'i nang rol gyi me 'od de mun pa stug po'i khrod du je gsal nas the gsal la 'gro bzhin yod pa'i tshor ba ster/ rkang 'jab lag 'jab kyis spra gur gyi nye sar bcar pa na/ so pa gcig gis kyang kho ma mthong bas/ sems kyi 'jigs snang cung tsam yal te/ gur stong zhig gi 'gram nas rta sga rnying ba zhig khur nas dogs zon dang bcas mdun la song /136

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha/kho tshogs gur sgo 'gram la bslebs dus skrag ste snying chung lu gu lding lding byas mod/ ci mi snyam pa'i ngang tshul bzung nas sa la bsdad rjes/ sga hrul la ci zhig las khul byed zhor du gur nang la zhib lta byas/ tshogs gur gyi gdong gral gyi gral mgo na shing khri mthon po zhig brgyab 'dug pa dang / khri steng na shis tshang dpon phrug tshe ring bsdad 'dug shing khri mar gsham gyi g.yas gral dang g.yon gral na brgya dpon dang lo lon mang po phreng bar bsgrigs te kha gtad du bsdad 'dug phyi gral na'ang mi ha cang mang la/ kho tshor gral sgrig lugs ci yang med par gdong gral la rub ste mgo krog krog dang rna cor cor byed bzhin bsdad 'dug ra bha 'dre mig gis tshe ring zer ba'i mi ngan 'dis thob dang tham ga len ched/ ldong ru dang shis tshang gnyis ku'i sa mtshams nas dmag sgar brgyab 'dug snyam bzhin kho tshos ci bshad la nyan nas bsdad/ kho tsho'i tshig rkang la gzhigs na/ shis tshang tsho ba'i tham ga da skabs dpon mo'i lag na yod la/ gal srid dpon phrug gnyis la nang mthun ma byung na/ mo thob dang tham ga'i bdag po byas te stong dpon byed rtsis red/ dpon phrug tshe ring la mtshon na/ gcig na gcung bo bsod nams dang nang mthun byed thabs med pa dang / gnyis su btsan po'i dpung gis 'thab na gcung bo'i do ya mi yong bas/ thabs zad de rang shog dpon 'bangs rnams dang lhan du mi med yul stong 'di la bros yong ste/ rjes phyogs jus kyi 'du 'god la gros mol byed bzhin mchis/ skabs shig la/137

'tshub ma khyer rkyang /gdong gral gyi rgan po zhig gis tshulags/ gal srid dpon phrug bsod nams lkog gsod byed thub na/ kho'i rjes kyi dpon 'bangs rnams ni sdong bo bcad pa'i rjes kyi sprel tshogs dang 'dra bas ci yang byed mi nus la/ skabs de dang bstun nas dpon mo'i lag gi tham ga 'phrog na/ khyed nyid stong dpon du gyur pa ma yin nam mi zhes bshad pa na/ dpon phrug tshe ring la dga' spro dpag med skyes te 'dzum dmul dmul gyis thabs jus de ha cang legs/ 'o na bsod nams ji ltar gsod dgos zhes dris byung bas/ ra bha 'dre mig gis 'di na'ang a ye dkon mchog mtsho mo 'dra ba'i mi ngan skyug bro ba zhig 'dug snyam pa dang mnyam du/ kho tsho'i kha brda la nyan pa'i 'dun pa de skad cig nyid la yal song / kho ni ci byed 'di byed med par yar langs te/ dal ba dal bur tshogs gur mdun gyi spra nang la 'dzul ba na/nang na mi gcig kyang med pa dang ka ngos la me mda' dang rked 'ching mdel shubs mang po dpyangs 'dug khos dmigs yul ci yang med par rgya gar pu ra gnyis dang de mthun gyi mdel shubs gnyis blangs te sbra sgor bud rjes/g.yas g.yon la lta bzhin dal ba dal bur tshogs gur g.yas phyogs kyi gur de la gzas nas song / gur chung chung de'i nang na gsar bu skor zhig gis rang nyid bud med gang dang lus 'brel yod pa sba gsang med par bshad pa'i zhor du/ bud med re re'i khyad chos zhib brjod byed kyin gda'/ kho tsho'i lus kyi gyon gos/ lag gi mtshon cha/ kha brda'i brjod don bcas la 138

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/gzhigs na g.yog po dbul po 'ga' zhig yin pa rtogs thub/ gur de dang thag mi ring ba'i sa na/ gsar bu lo nyung zhig gis ba rdo 'gram du dal lhod kyis sbud pa rgyag bzhin mchis la/ zangs dmar gyi ba ma nas chu lhog lhog gdus pa dang bstun nas/ sha dri zhim po zhig sna lam la 'then yong bas/tsā ri 'ange mis ri za langong ci yi spu ce ste pho ba nonas pa'i tshor ring gyung nide'i mtshams shig la/ gsar bu lo nyung de langs te gnam ngo la bltas ma bltas shig byas rjes/ ske la 'phrug bzhin g.yog po'i gur de la 'dzul ba na/kho myur stabs kyis par song ste ba ma sa la 'bogs zhor du sha khu phyed ka sa la pho ba dang / de nas myur stabs kyis mda' ra gcig long bu byas rjes/ ba ma khyer te phyir bltas med par bros song /ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis gas dal lhod lhod kyis lug sha za zhor du ca de gcig pur kha res byas nas sha khu 'thung bzhin ngal gsos pa na/ 'brug sgra je nye nas je nyer phyin pa dang char ba je che nas je cher song / skabs shig la/ tshogs gur g.yas phyogs kyi spra gur las thog mar mi gnyis 'khon pa dang / de nas mi 'ga' rub ste mi gcig la gcar rdung byas pa na/ rim bzhin dmag sgar hril bo zang zing lang long du gyur/ra bha 'dre mig gis rang nyid kyis gsar bu lo nyung de sdug la gtad song snyam nas/ snying khong rus pa'i gting nas 'gyod pa bzod glags med pa zhig skyes te zas kyi yi ga'ang chad song mod/ dpon phrug tshe ring gi skyug bro ba'i 139

'tshub ma kher rkyang /bsam don de yid la 'khor pa na/ sngar gyi 'gyod pa rim bzhin 'khon sems su gyur te/ tshe ring la 'khon lan bslog pa dang shis tshang gi rtsod gzhi med par byed ched/ da reb gling tsha tsho dgur mi 'gro bar shis tshang stong dpon gyi tham ga de rku thabs byed dgos snyam byung /dris/ smyo don dag ci byung /mi rin chen rgyal khas ci yang ma mthong bas de ltar //ja mas di ma bor song bas/ tshang mas ja mar gcar gyin gda'/’ zu par bltas na ba ma 'di'i rin thang ja ma las che bas/ cis kyang kho tshor 'phrod thabs byed dgos/mi ra bha 'dre mig gis khong khro chen po dang bcas de ltar bshad/ ‘khyod ba ma ster bar 'gro'am/mi zu mi 'gro nga bdud phrug tshe ring gi g.yog po min/mi ra bha 'dre mig gis lug sha 'phro lus rnams rdo thog cig la blangs rjes sha khu lhag lus med par sa la pho ba dang / de nas rdo a dkar lu gu'i grod pu 'dra zhig btsal yong ste ba ma'i nang la bzhag rjes/ ba ma'i kha leb bkab cing thag pas legs par bsdams nas rbab tu bsgril/ ba ma de char ba chen po'i khrod du khrog sgra chom sgra dang bcas mar 'gril ba na/ mar gsham gyi rta rnams dus gcig la 'drogs te rta rdang dang mthur mda' bcad de zhogs so/ sdus/ dus shig la rta po'i mig sgra/ ba ma'i chom sgra/ nam mkha'i

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha/'brug sgra thams cad gzhi gcig tu 'dres te/ gnam sa thams cad dus gcig la g.yos pa'i snang ba zhig ster/ skabs shig la mar gsham gyi mi rnams kyis ci zhig rtogs pa ltar ri rtse la me mda' yos khra brngos pa ltar 'phangs mod/ ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis gas rgya gar pu ra re khur te snga mo nas ri bo'i pha rol la bzhud song /nam kha'i dbyings su sprin pa bye'u mgo tsam yang med na'ang / mdang dgong char ba chen po babs te sa gzhi thams cad rlan shur shur byed pas/dbyar gyi nyi 'od btsan rung tsha rmugs de 'dra che rgyu med/ ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis gas gom kha nub phyogs su gtad de song ba na/spang ri dang nags ri 'dzoms pa'i lung ba chen po zhig tu bslebs pa dang /kho gnyis gas lung chen de 'phred kyis gtubs te nyag chen zhig gi stong la bslebs pa na/ lung chen de'i pha rol ni lung phran chung chung zhig yin pa dang /lung mthil gyi chu mig 'gram na skyes pa zhig gis bzhin pa gam la btags te 'brong ko zhig bshu bzhin gda'/ ra bha 'dre mig gis mar gsham gyi skyes pa 'di ya rabs gshis bzang zhig yin na sha rdog 'ga' bslang la/ gal srid ma rabs tha shal ba zhig yin na gcar rdung yid tshims pa zhig byas rjes 'brong sha phrogs nas rgod la sha sbyin gtong bsams te ya yo med par skyes pa de gzas nas ri ngos las babs/kho gnyis lung mthil la bslebs dus/ skyes pa des 'brong ko bshus 141

'tshub ma kher rkyang /tshar te/ byang cha ldan pa'i sgo nas 'brong sha lhu gsil rgyag mgo brtsams/skyes pa de'i lus po cung rin na'ang / gzugs gzhi che zhing gdong mdog nag la/ mgo la ral ba chen po zhig bzhag 'dug pas/ bltas pa tsam gyis 'jigs snang skyes pa zhig red/ kho gnyis gam la bslebs pa na/ skyes pa des dogs snang ci yang med par sngar bzhin 'brong sha gtub pa las kho gnyis la kha ya tsam yang mi byed/ ra bha 'dre mig gis tshul de mthong bas/sems la skyes pa 'di'i gzugs gzhi dpa' snying sogs gang la bltas kyang rngon pa phal ba zhig ma red snyam ste/ gcar rdung 'phrog gsum byed pa'i bsam pa de 'phral du gar song cha med du gyur/6 a rog sha rdog 'ga' byin na ci 'dra red/’ ra bha 'dre mig gis khengs nyams dang bcas de ltar bshad/skyes pa des kho gnyis la bltas tsam byas rjes/ mgo bo sgur te 'dzum dmul dmul byed bzhin sngar ltar 'brong sha gtub pa na/ rin chen rkyal kha la khong khro bzod glags med pa zhig skyes te kha lce'ang sbrid mod/ ra bha 'dre mig gis ci byed 'di byed kyi brda tsam yang ma bstan pas/ bzod bsran byed bzhin kha rog ger mi 'dug thabs med byung /6 sha rdog 'ga' byin na chog gam/mi smyo bu stag 'dra gnyis kyis bo'u thog 'dra re khur te/ mi la sha rdog slong ba mtshar gtam zhig min nam/’ 142

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/smyo nged gnyis la sha za 'dod las 'brong gsod 'dod med/mi skyes pa des ra bha 'dre mig gi snang 'jigs med pa'i gtam lan de go ma thag ha las pa'i rnam 'gyur cung tsam bstan med/ yud tsam gyi rjes su sngar ltar 'dzum dmul dmul gyis 'brong sha gtub bzhin bsdad/ skabs der ra bha 'dre mig gis dpung rogs la mig brda zhig btang ba na/ rin chen rkyal khas 'brong sha rkang yas shig byis pas dbyug pa bzung ba ltar yar bkyags te mdun phyogs la gtad nas 'brong gsod na pha gi na yod dam zhes dris rjes/ ya yo med par 'brong sha ko khud la g.yugs pa na/ skyes pa de myur stabs kyis yar langs zhor du 'brong sha rkang yas de bzung ste nub phyogs bstan nas 6'brong gsod na pha gi na ha cang mang zhes bshad rjes/'brong sha ko khud la g.yugs te dogs pa ci yang med par sa la bsdad/ ra bha 'dre mig gis tshul de mthong bas/ skyes pa 'di'i dpa' dang stobs shugs rin chen rkyal kha dang a mnyam cha mnyam yin par ma zad/ blo rig rin chen rkyal kha las bzang bas/ btsan po dpung ba gtugs na su pham su rgyal mi shes snyam bzhin kha rog ger bsdad/6 sha za 'dod na rta rgyab na ba ma yod/ khyod rang gis tshos/3 yud tsam 'gor rjes skyes pa des de ltar bshad/lha btso mi dgos/ nged gnyis gas sha rlon zos chog ra bha 'dre mig gis kho la tshig lan de 'dra byin rjes/ rin chen rgyal kha la ya grogs po/143

'tshub ma kher rkyang /'brong sha yid tshims pa zhig zo zhes bshad pa na/ rin chen rkyal khar 'jigs snang ci yang med par lhu gcig blangs te za mgo brtsams mod/ ra bha 'dre mig gis rgyal kha ji ltar len par bsam gzhig byed bzhin yod pas 'brong sha za ba'i yi ga gzhan zhig na 'gags 'dug skyes pa des rin chen rkyal kha'i za stangs thun mong ma yin pa de la bltas kyin bltas kyin ya mtshan te khyod gnyis ga'i ming la ci zer/ sa cha gang gi yin ces dris pa na/rin chen rkyal khas sha rdog cig sdod zhor du nged gnyis sdong ru tsho ba'i ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha yin ces bshad/6 bden nam/mi 6 bden/mi ra bha 'dre mig gis dal lhod lhod kyis de ltar bshad/6 ya 'grig song / ldong ru tsho ba na rin chen rkyal kha dang ra bha 'dre mig zer ba'i pho rgod rgya stag 'dra ba gnyis yod pa snga mo nas go mod/ de ring ma gtogs rig ma thub/ ngo ma 'grig song / 'u cag tshang ma dga' phyogs dang 'tsho stangs gcig pa'i mi red/ rjes su gcig rgyab gcig gis mnan te rting ma len ya/mi skyes pa de dga' lhang lhang gis yar langs te kho gnyis la 'phyis drags pa'i 'tshams 'dri zhig zhus/66khyod kyi ming la ci zer/mi ra bha 'dre mig gis de ltar dris/6 nga'i ming la btsan mgon lag ring zer mismyo a gi khyod ngo ma khyi skor gyi btsan mgon lag ring yin nam/mi ra bha 144

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha/'dre mig dngos gnas mtshar song /ze yin/mi skyes pa de'i gdong la 'dzum zhig langs nas slar yang de ltar ra/ ma gzhi khyi skor sde ba'i btsan mgon lag ring zer ba ni 'thab na stag mo'i ngar shugs yod pa dang / brgyugs na rkyang gi bang myur ldan pa/ dus kun jag la 'gro zhing ra mda' rjes gcod byung na gson por bshas te sha chen khrag chen lha la mchod pa'i bu rgod dpa' ya med pa zhig yin pas sa nye ring kun gyi mi che chung gnyis ga'i khrod du kho'i ming mi shes pa zhig med/pho rog dang khā ta mang pos sha dri tshor te nye 'gram la babs nas ag 'gyur byas pas/ bya rgod mang po'ang phyogs so so nas 'phur yong ste mgo klad nas lding skor brgyab/ kho gsum pos ba rdo btsugs te 'byong sha btso zhor du/ gcig gi tshig lder gcig gis mthun de kha brda byas/skabs der ra bha 'dre mig gi yid la dpon phrug tshe ring dran byung bas/btsan mgon lag ring zer ba'i pho rgod 'di shis tshang la khrid thabs byed dgos snyam byung /zu ya ra bha 'dre mig khyod rdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med zer ba bden nam/ mir bha 'dre mig gis bden pa'i tshul ston ched/ 'dzum dmul dmul byed bzhin yud tsam la bsdad rjes/ ci mi snyam pa'i ngang nas da reb khyod 145

'tshub ma kher rkyang /gang la 'gro rtsis yod ces dris/6 shis tshang tsho bar nang 'khrug byung yod pa go bas/ gcig na ltad mor lta ba dang / gnyis su rta khyu 'ded rtsis yin/ rab yin na khyod gnyis kyang 'gro/mi ra bha 'dre mig gis tshig de go ma thag bsam thog la song snyam ste dga' spro chen po skyes mod/ gdong la de 'dra'i spro ba med na yang grogs gsar ba'i sbya ma chod pa'i nyams snang bcos ma zhig bsdus te chog pa'i brda la mgo ldem tsam rdi/rtsa/ gnyis gling tsha tsho dgu la 'gro dgos pa min nam/mi rin chen rgyal khas bden cog cog gis de ltar bshad/zu da skabs shis tshang tsho ba'i dud khyim mang pos ldong ru dpon la mgo 'dogs zhu bzhin yod zer pa bden nam/ 6 bden/mi ra bha 'dre mig gis de ltar bshad/ 6stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar de rig 'dzin me 'bar gyi mthu la mi skrag gam/mi 6 sus shes/mi le'u drug pa/6 gsol ja bzhes rogs/ ’146

wa ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha/6 ya ya ’stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar gyis 'dzum mdangs dang bcas gsol thab pa la tshig lan de 'dra byin mod/ ca de la reg tsam yang mi byed par pus mor 'phur 'phur byed bzhin mgo bo g.yas skyog g.yon skyog byed par gzhigs na/ khong khro dang 'tshub cha bzod glags med pa zhig langs yod rung bya thabs zad de 'u thug 'dug pa rtogs thub/ kho da nangs nyi 'od sa la phog pa dang mnyam du mkha' lding bkra shes chos sgar la bslebs pa dang /sprul sku rin po che mal las bzhengs yod med la sems khur byed bzhin bla brang du 'dzul ba na/ mkha' lding 'jigs med bdud 'joms rdo rje tshang mal khri'i steng nas rdo rje skyis krung du bzhugs te/ rtse gcig gis ci zhig bsgoms 'dug la/ khos dal lhod lhod kyis mjal dar dang mtshams rtags rnams khong gi sku mdun la bzhag ste yong don zhu rtsis byas pa na/ sprul sku tshang la sngar ltar nyams snang ci ying med par sgom la bzhugs te kho la kha ya tsam yang mi byed pas/ stong dpon ngo mtshar ba dang dogs mi bde ba'i ngang nas a khu bstan 'dzin/ khong la ci byung zhes dris pa na/ gsol thab pas kho'i gdong la'ang lta mi phod par mgo la byil byil byed bzhin mi shes lags/khong sgom la bzhugs te gsol ja'ang mi bzhes zhes bshad rjes/ bka' bkyon gnang bar 'jigs nas phyir nur byed bzhin gzims chung gi sgo la bud song / stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar gyis sprul sku nged gnyis bar la 147

'tshub ma kher rkyang /sel zhugs med dam/’ snyam bzhin sar tsog nas bsdad/ gzim shag gi mal khri dang rtsig pa'i bar na stong cha dog mo tsam las med pa dang / stong dpon gyi gzugs gzhi che zhing lus po ha cang rgyags pas/ kho bar stong chung chung de ru btsangs nas bsdad pa na/ mdun nas mal khri dang rgyab nas rtsig pas bcums te lus kun srid par gyur pa dang / 'gul thabs 'phag thabs med pa'i rkang ba gnyis la zug gzer langs te bzod glags med mod/am gcigs bsdams te bus mo gnyis la 'phur 'phur byed bzhin rang gi yong don la bsam gzhig byas pa na brel 'tshub skyes te 'dug mi bzod pa dang / sprul sku'i bzhugs stangs de mthong na khong khro langs yong / mkha' lding sku phreng thog ma ni ri khrod 'grims pa'i rnal 'byor ba zhig yin la/ khong nyid g.ya' ma rdzong nas mi mngon dbyings la 'phur rjes/ ldong ru stong dpon gyis gdung mchod legs par bsgrubs par ma zad/ rnal 'byor pa'i sgrub gnas nas mkha' lding bkra shis chos sgar btab rjes/ skyes chen dam pa'i zhabs la gtugs te khong gi yang srid blus nas gser khri'i bdag por mnga' gsol/ dus de nas bzung / mkha' lding sku phreng rim byon gyi yon bdag gi yang gtso ni ldong ru dpon tshang byas pa dang / mkha' lding sku phreng gong ma rnams kyis kyang dpon tshang sangs rgyas bstan par bka' drin che gsungs te thugs rtsis ha cang che bar ma zad/ rang nyid kyang dpon tshang gi khongs mi zhig la brtsis te/ sde don tsho don la 'bad pa lhod med byed bzhin 148

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/yod/ mkha' lding dge legs rnam rgyal dpal ldan rang byung rdo rje tshang mi mngon zhi ba'i dbyings la gshegs rjes/ sdong ru dpon tshang gis cho ga sna tshogs sngar ltar bsgrubs par ma zad/ rgyal sras mchog gi zhabs la gtugs te/ yang srid dus ltar thugs brtag chod pa zhus te gser gyi khri la mnga' gsol/ 'on kyang / yang srid rin po che ldong ru tsho bar thugs rtsis chung bar ma zad/ dgos gal che dus lung bstan 'dra zhus na'ang gab tshig lta bu'i gsung re las mi 'byon/ tsho khrims gsar ba de gtan 'bebs byed skabs/ khong gis ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis nas sku byas rung tsho khrims gsar ba de kho gnyis ke'i mgo la 'bab mi chog ces gsungs mod/ stong dpon gyis gus phyag dang bcas rtsa ba rgyu mtshan dris pa na/ khong gis khong khro chen pos 6rjes su sdong ru tsho ba chag che nyam nga las skyob pa yin ces gsungs rjes/ zhu 'dri ga 'dra byas rung tshig lan gcig kyang mi gsung /dus de nas bzung stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar gyis chags 'jig la sems khur byed bzhin ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis ka khrims 'og la ma bcun par sde mgo tsho mgo skyong thabs byas/ shis tshang tsho bar nang 'khrug byung rjes/ dud khyim re gnyis bros yong ste sdong ru la mgo 'dogs zhus pa na/khos dus phyi'i mjug 'bras la bsam gzhig byed pa phar zhog sa lags mkha' lding tshang la lung bstan yang ma zhus par kho tsho sde gras la blangs/ rjes su mgo 'dogs zhu mkhan rim bzhin je mang la song bas/ kho tsho ni tsho ba'i 149

'tshub ma kher rkyang /chags 'jig la 'brel ba yod pa dang byur gyi sna 'dren yin nam snyam nas ci byed 'di byed med par gyur/ skabs rer sprul sku mchog la lung bstan re zhu bsam mod/ khong gis mgo rnga yod pa'i gsung zhig 'byon mi srid pas/lung bstan zhus rung grub 'bras chung ba yin bsams te mgo 'dogs zhu mkhan rnams rim gyis sde gras la blangs/ kha sang phyi dro khyim tshang nyi shu lhag mgo 'dogs zhu bar yong bzhin mchis pa go rjes/ 'jigs snang dang ci byed 'di byed med pa'i brel 'tshub chen po skyes te/ de ring sprul sku mchog gi sku mdun la mi yong ka med byung / shis tshang gi sngags pa rig 'dzin me 'bar zer ba de phrag dog che zhing mthu yang che bas/ rang shog gi dud khyim rnams kyis tsho ba gzhan la mgo btags na/ gtor zor 'phangs te tsho ba de la gnod 'tshe chen po gtong ba dang / gal srid dpon phrug gnyis la nang mthun byung na/ dmag dpung drangs te rang shog gi dud khyim rnams len thabs byed nges yin/ gal srid rkyen ngan de 'dra byung na/ sdong ru tsho ba chag che nyam nga la gzha' thabs med pa dang / ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha lta bu'i rkun ma gnyis ka dpung rogs su re yang chag sgo la gzur thabs ga la yod/ stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar gyis ya nga ba'i mjug 'bras de dran pa na 'tshub cha bzod glags med pa zhig langs mod/ mkha' sding tshang la nyams snang ci yang med par sgom la bzhugs 'dug pas/ stong dpon gyis rkang ba'i zug gzer de bsal ched/ yar langs te bla brang phyi la 150

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/mi 'gro thabs med byung /stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar bla brang la slar bslebs dus nyin gung yol 'dug la/ khos mkha' lding tshang gis gung tshigs bzhes bzhin pa mthong bas dga' spro dpag med skyes/8 mchog sprul rin po che sku bde'am/’ che bde mo yin/’ stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar gyis 'dzum dmul dmul byed bzhin sngar mal la 'khums nas tsog mkha' sding tshang gis tshul de mthong bas thog mar khog 'dzum zhig langs pa dang / glen pa zog 'dra ba 'dis rang gi sems don rtogs mi 'dug snyam pa na/ thugs pham ste khong khro cung tsam langs/ ldong ru dpon tshang mkha' lding sku phreng rim byon la drin che ba bden mod kyang / ldong ru dpon tshang gis rang nyid skyabs dang skyob pa khyad par can zhig gi gras la bzhag ste mthong chen ma byas pa dang / sku phreng gong ma rnams la srid phyogs na thugs 'dun chen po med pas/ ho thog thu sogs kyi go ming yod pa par zhog lha sde'ang sdong ru tsho ba gcig pu las med pa'i gnas su lhung / khong gis rang nyid kyi gnas bab mi bzang ba de rtsa ba nas bsgyur ched/ bla ma gang bzang gi zhabs la gtugs te thos bsam sgom gsum la 'bad pa'i zhor du/ sa cha gzhan dang tsho ba gzhan la phebs nas 'gro don bskyangs pa na/ chos 'brel yod pa'i lha sde gang mang byung ba dang 151

'tshub ma kher rkyang /mtshan snyan yang je che nas je cher phyin/ 'on kyang / rang shog lha sde'i rgya bskyed rgyu de'ang las sla mo zhig ga la yin/ khong shes tshang tsho bar phebs te 'gro don skyong skabs/ rig 'dzin me 'bar khong gi sku mdun la ma yong bas/dud khyim gang mang zhig gis bla ma rang khyim la gdan 'dren zhu ma phod/ dus de nas bzung sngags pa gtum po de tshar du ma bcad na/ shis tshang tsho ba rang shog tu tshud dka' snyam/ 'on te/ rang nyid lo bco brgyad la son ma thag gi na gzhon zhig yin pas/ tshe gcig lus gcig nyid la dmigs 'ben gcig gnad la bzung ste/ rang shog lha sde'i rgya bskyed pa dang mtshan snyan je cher btang na/ gong mas gnang ba'i cho lo dang tham ga gser yig ma zhig gi thob skal yod pa yin dgongs yod/ gal srid tsho ba gcig gi skyabs mgon byas na gzim shag legs po zhig kyang slong thabs med la/ ltos dang /rang nyid kyi bla brang 'di brag skyibs gcig dang khyad ci yod/ de ring stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar de bar 'phrang dog mo de ru tsog tu bcug ste/ rang nyid la gzim shag chen po zhig las dgos pa'i dran skul byas mod/ glen pa zlog 'dra ba des rang gi tsho don gcig pu bsams te dran skul byas pa'i rnam 'gyur tsam yang go ba ma lon/zu lags/ nga 'khobs dog sa 'dis bcir te 'dug thabs med/’ stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar gyis zug gzer langs pa'i pus mor 'phur 'phur byed bzhin de ltar bshad/152

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/zu thabs bkod ci yod/ mkha' lding bla brang gi cha rkyen de 'dra red/mi stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar gyis sprul sku sdong ru tsho bar thugs rtsis chen po med pa gzim shag zhan pa'i rkyen red snyam pa na/ gdong la bsam don 'grub pa'i 'dzum mdangs shig rgyas pa dang lhan du gzim shag gsar bzheng byed pa'i 'char 'god kyang yid la gsal ler 'khor byung /6 lags/ shes tshang tsho ba'i mgo 'dogs zhu mkhan nyin bzhin je mang yin pas/ ji ltar byas na legs/mi zu yong mkhan thams cad sde gras la longs/’ mkha' lding tshang gis the tshom med par de ltar gsungs/6 lags/ rig 'dzin me 'bar gyis mthu gtong ba dang / dpon phrug gnyis nang mthun byung rjes dmag drangs na ci bya/mi 8kho'i rtsam rdog 'ga' la skrag don ci yod/ dpon phrug gnyis la nang mthun byung dus/ tsho ba'i phyed ka tshar 'dug pas/ tshur rgol byed pa'i dpung shugs med/’ mkha' lding tshang gis lung bstan gsal bo de 'dra gnangs pas/ stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar la dga' spro chen po byung ste rkang ba'i na zug kyang brjed 'dug skabs shig la ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis kus ga dus sdong ru tsho ba gnod 'tshe las bskyab dgos zhes 'dri bsams mod/ mchog sprul rin po che thugs rgyal bzheng bar zhed nas 'o ja 'thung 153

le'u bdun pa/ra bha 'dre mig gi jus bkod ltar btsan mgon lag ring gi bzhon rta lung phran rtswa chu 'dzoms sa zhig nas bstad pa dang / gcan gzan gyi 'jigs pa bsal ched phyogs bzhi nas tho yor mi dang 'dra ba du ma brtsigs te lam la chas/ kho tsho me 'khor gshong chen gyi yang phu la bslebs pa na/gshong chen gyi gong zhol bar gsum gsal bor mi mthong rung / rin chen rkyal kha dang btsan mgon lag ring gnyis ka a thang chad de 'gro thabs med pas/ spang ngos shig nas lus ljid tig ger sa la bsdad nas mthong lam la ltad mo lta bzhin grag 'gul med par ngal gso byas/shis tshang tsho ba ni zhing phyugs gnyis ka 'dzoms pa'i rong ma 'brog gi sa cha zhig yin la/ stong dpon gyi tsho khrims btsan pa dang rtswa khyigs zhing khyigs sdom lugs rab dang rim pa yod pas/ mi ser rnams nam rgyun 'gro na lug khyu ded 'dra dang 'dug na mtsho mo 'khyil 'dra byed dgos/ kho tsho'i dgun sa ni btsan rgod nyag chen nas klu tshang gad pa bar gyi yul gru chen po yin la/ gnam lo gsar ba'i rjes su/ stong dpon dang khyigs bdag gi jus bkod ltar dgun sa bskyur nas dpyid sar spor dgos/ dpyid sa nas zhing 'debs pa dang bal 'breg pa/ yur ma yur ba sogs zhing phyugs thad 154

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/kyi las ka gal chen rnams mjug 'grub rjes/ slar yang stong dpon dang khyigs bdag gi jus bkod ltar dbyar sar spor dgos/ skabs rer/ khyim tshang la la dus ltar spor ma thub na/ gnas lugs gnam 'dra yod rung rtswa khyigs zhing khyigs sdom lugs ltar chad pa nan mo gcod nges yin pas/ mi ser rnams la mtshon na stong dpon dang khyigs bdag rnams la zhe 'khon ha cang che mod/ byis pa skyes lam nas rgas pa dang mgo spra g.yag rgyab nas ral zhes 'khang gtam bshad bzhin bka' dang gtan 'bebs byung na ya ya legs so 〉zer bzhin ci bshad dang len mi byed ka med yin/ kho tsho'i dbyar sa ni brag dkar phu dgu zer ba'i lung chen gcig la lung phran dgu yod pa'i ri lung yid du 'ong ba zhig yod pa de yin/ lung phran mang po'i shar phyogs kyi ri rab hor rgyal po'i zhwa dang gnyis su med pa de ni shis tshang tsho ba'i gnas ri nor bu gyen srungs yin la/ gnas ri'i klad kyi lab tse de rgyang ring nas bltas na dbu zhwa'i steng gi tog dang gnyis su ma mchis/ gnas ri rngam brjid can de'i gsham na/ rtsa ba spang dang rtse mo brag sked pa nags bcas kyis grub pa'i ri bo phying zhwa sne ring 'dra ba zhig mchis pa de la a ma me 'bar zer zhing / mo ni nor bu gyen spungs kyi gnas bdag me 'khor stobs ldan rngam chen gyi btsun mo yin/ gnas ri de gnyis kyi nub phyogs su de'u 'bur mang po can gyi spang gshong chen po zhig yod pa de ni me 'khor sde ba'i dbyar sa yin la/ shis tshang stong dpon rim byon sde ba de nas byung bas/155

'tshub ma kher rkyang /sde ba tsho ba gzhan gyis dpon skor gshong chen zhes kyang 'bod/ sngar yin na khyim tshang so so khyigs bdag gis gtan 'bebs byas pa'i mtsher sar 'bab dgos mod/ da lo stong dpon rnam rgyal glo bur tshe las 'das rjes/ dpon phrug che ba tshe ring gis rang nyid bu spun nang gi che ba yin pas/ thob dang tham ga'i bdag po rtsod med yin snyam ste tsho mgo skyong rtsis byas pa na/ dpon phrug chung ba bsod nams kyis phu bo ni a pha dang 'dra bar gdug rtsub dang phrag dog che bas/ gal srid sde mgo tsho mgo bskyangs na 'bangs mi'i 'khang ra dang sdang sems je cher song ste pha gzhis 'chor ba'i nyen kha yod snyam ste/rang nyid thob dang tham ga'i bdag po byed rtsis byas pas/ phu nu bar gyi 'gal ba je che nas je cher phyin te mjug mthar dmag dpung bsdus nas g.yul bshams pa na/ dmag 'khrug gi gnod 'tshe la 'jigs pa'i dud khyim mang po lkog 'bro byas te tsho ba gzhan la mgo btags pa dang / 'khrug long la 'jigs rung pha yul rgyab tu bskyur 'dod med pa rnams kyis skyes pa rta gong thub pa rnams dmag la chas pa dang / bud med byis pa rnams kyis ru rdang sprel te mgo spra a long skor ba ltar phub cing / mtshan mo nor lug rnams a long nang rol la bskyis nas bsdad yod la/ me 'khor gshong chen na de lta'i ru tshogs mang po mchis/ de min 'byor ba zhan zhing rtul phod che ba'i dud khyim la las 'dod mos ltar de'u 'bur re re'i 'gram la gnas bcas yod pas/ sde ba'i ru 'bab stangs la nges gtan med par gyur/ da 156

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha/skabs me 'khor sde ba'i skyes pa rnams dpon phrug tshe ring gi rjes su 'brangs te btsan rgod nyag chen tshu rol na dmag sgar btab yod pa dang / de min sde ba brgyad kyi skyes pa rnams dpon phrug bsod nams kyi rjes su 'brangs te glang chen rab brtan mdun rol na dmag sgar babs yod pas/ byis pa bud med rnams kyis nyin mo dpon phrug gnyis la nang mthun yong ba'i smon lam 'debs pa dang / mtshan mo rkun ma jag pas rang rgyu 'phrog par zhed de dogs zon byed bzhin gnas thabs tsam byed cing yod/spang gshong chen po de'i pha rol ni nags ri yid du 'ong ba zhig yin la/ri rgyud chen po g.yu 'brug chu 'thung zhig gi dbyibs su grub 'dug pas/ yul mi rnams kyis de la 'brug rgan nags ri zhes 'bod/ g.yu 'brug mchan 'og na yod pa'i sgrub sde chung chung de ni hūṃ nag chos sgar yin la/ chos sgar mtha' 'khor na bzhin rta mang po 'dug pa dang / rgyab phyogs kyi bsang khri'i steng na du ba sngo lhog lhog 'phyur gyin yod/ rig 'dzin me 'bar chung dus khams kyi sngags sde mang por nyug ste bla ma grub thob gang mang bsten pas/ gzhung chen po rnams la go ba chen po med rung mthu dang rlung la ha cang mkhas/ skabs rer rlung bzung ste bar snang nas dus yun ring bor rdo rje rma krung la 'dug thub zer/ khos tshe gcig la chos kho na sgrub bzhin yod na'ang / blo kha chos la bsgyur ma thub par nam rgyun phreng bar sen 'brad byed pa'i zhor la rang don gtso byas pa'i sde don tsho don kho na bsam bzhin yod par ma zad/ kho 157

'tshub ma kher rkyang /mi dga' sa rnams la mthu gtong bar dogs snang tsam yang med/ gal srid dud khyim zhig gis tsho ba gzhan la mgo btags na/ de ma thag tsho ba de la mthu btang ste gnod 'tshe skyel nges yin/ sngon dus dud khyim 'ga' shis tshang tsho khrims la 'gal te/ lkog tu bros nas khyi skor stong dpon la mgo btags pa na/ dbyar dus stong dpon gyi mgo sbra thog gis bsregs par ma zad/ dud khyim bco brgyad kyi mi phyugs thams cad chu log gis khur/ de ni rig 'dzin me 'bar gyis mthu btang ba'i ngan 'bras yin par bshad/ rjes su dud khyim 'ga' yis dgun dus rang khyim dus ltar spar ma thub pas/khyigs bdag gi chad pa la skrag nas tsho ba gzhan la mgo btags pa na/dpyid dus tsho ba de'i byis pa mang por cham nad ya mtshan zhig gis srog phrogs par bshad/ de'ang rig 'dzin me 'bar gyis mthu btang bas yin zer/ khos rang gi mthu dang rlung la brten nas gzhan yin 'khums par byas rjes/ stong dpon min rung stong dpon gyi srid don de sgrub bzhin yod mod/ gnam lo gsar ba tshes pa nas bzung / rang nyid la da lo bar chad chen po zhig yod par bshad de mun mtshams la bsdad pas/ tsho bar nang 'khrug byung rjes bar 'dum byed pa'i go skabs kyang ma byung /mthong lam gyi ri lung thang gsum la zhib lta byed bzhin yun ring la ngal gso byas pa na/ ngal dub rim gyis yal cing lus stobs slar yang sos byung bas/ ra bha 'dre mig rang rlom dang bcas yar langs te lam la chas pa 158

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/na/ btsan mgon lag ring gis lam bro bcug yod pa'i ta len de khur pa dang / rin chen rkyal khas ba ma dang thag pa bcug yod pa'i bal snye de khur nas kho yi rjes su 'brangs/ sngar srol ltar na btsan mgon lag ring jag la 'gro dus rkang thang la 'gro mi srid mod/ ra bha 'dre mig gis shis tshang tsho bar nang 'khrug byung 'dug pas skya mi cha med rig na dogs zon byed pa dang /sbas skung byed dus rta la bdag dam byed dka' ba'i gnas lugs de yang bshad bskyar bshad byas pa na/ khos kyang bden par snyam ste rkang thang la 'gro bar yid 'thad byung /kho tshos ri ngos kyi ri dwags gshar lam ded nas nor bu gyen spungs phyogs su gom kha bsgyur/66gsar bu gnyis ga shis tshang la bu mo me tog 'dra ba ha cang mang /da reb 'u cag gis mi re la chung ma re phrogs na ci 'dra red/mi btsan mgon lag ring 'gro zhor du 'dzum dmul dmul gyis de skad bshad/6 de ha cang bzang /’ rin chen rkyal khas bden cog cog gis de ltar bshad/ 6nga ra bha 'dre mig 'dre red/ bu mo lha mo 'dra ba zhig nga'i gam la bslebs rung / tshang mas de la 'dre mo zhes 'bod pa yin pas/ ngas bu mo de tsho la 'o brgyal byed 'dod med/’ tsang ni 'dre lag khyod ni 'dre mig kho ni 'dre kha/ 'u cag 'dre rgan 159

'tshub ma kher rkyang /gsum gyis lha mo gsum 'dre mor bsgyur nas chung mar blangs na/ rjes su 'dre sde chen po gsum 'grub srid pas/ skyes pho lus thob pa don ldan ma yin nam/mi nga la rgyal kha ma gtogs 'dre kha mi zer/mi 6 red/ 'o na 'u cag rang gi mtshang ming dang lo rgyus mi shes pa'i sa cha rgyus med cig la song ste mag pa byas na ga 'dra red/ 6min/ nga mi 'gro/ ngas pha ma gnyis mar zhabs zhu sgrub dgos/mi rin chen rkyal khas kha khog med par de ltar bshad rjes/ gdong la sdug nyams chen po zhig bsdus te kha rog ger hrig nas bsdad pa na/ ra bha 'dre mig dang btsan mgon lag ring gnyis ka sa la tsog nas pho bar 'phur 'phur byed bzhin dgod kha shor/kho tshos ri dwags gshar lam ded nas spen ma can gyi lung phran zhig la bslebs pa na/ sngar gyi lam phran de lung phu'i chu mig phyogs su 'then yod pas/ slar yang glang ma can gyi ri ngos nas lam phran gya gyu zhig den de ri gdong lham mgo 'dra ba de la bslebs/ gdong ga'i pha rol ni shug sdong thar thor can gyi brag 'phrang zhig yin la/ brag 'phrang gi mkha' ru pho rog dang khā ta mang pos ag 'gyur byed bzhin 'dug pas/ mi sems 'tshab 'tshub dang zang zing du bsgyur yong / kho tsho snga gzhug tu sa la bsdad de gsham gyi spang gshong chen por zhib lta byas pa na/ ru rdang sbrel ba'i dud khyim dang rta nor 160

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/lug gsum mang po mthong byung / ra bha 'dre mig dang btsan mgon lag ring gnyis gas de tshos nor lug thag ring la 'ded ma phod par ru 'dabs na 'tshos yod pa dang / rdzi bo thams cad byis pa dang bud med yin pa rtogs rjes/ rang sems la ci byed gang byed kyi 'char bkod re 'then bzhin bsdad mod/ rin chen rkyal khar bsam rgyu dran rgyu ci yang med par ngal gso byas/ 6 a la/ pha gi na rta khyu bdag med cig skabs shig la ra bha 'dre mig gis 'brug rgan nags ri'i lung phran zhig la bkram 'dug pa'i la lo'i khyu de mthong byung bas/ btsan mgon lag ring la rta khyu de 'ded pa'i dran skul byed ched ngo mtshar ba'i nyams kyis de ltar bshad/zu rta khyu der rdzi bo med par ri rgyag thang rgyag byas par bltas na phal cher rig 'dzin me 'bar tshang gi yin pa 'dra/mi btsan mgon lag ring gis zhib lta byas rjes de ltar bshad/smyo rig 'dzin me 'bar ni mtshon ral gri'i kha nas me 'bar zhing /gnyan phur bu'i mgo nas du ba langs pa zhig yin skad/ khos gnyan shed tshad de rkun jag dmag 'khrug sogs gang la'ang ma skrag par la lo ri rgyag byas 'dug pa red/ ’6 'o na do nub 'u cag gis pha gi'i rta khyu gan 'ded ya/mi ra bha 'dre mig gis tshig de go ma thag rang gi bsam don 'grub rgyu red 161

'tshub ma kher rkyang /snyam ste khong 'dzum langs mod/ gdong la mi 'thad mi rung ba'i nyams shig bstan te 6btsan po thog 'drar 'phrad na 'u cag thar thabs yod rung /gnyan po dug 'drar 'gras na thar lam gtan nas medami ces bshad/smyo deng gi sngags pa rnams kyis ral ba khyi ro 'dra re drud de 'jigs 'jigs byed mod/ don dam du mthu nus ga 'dra yod pa sus shes/mi skabs shig la/ pho rog 'ga' kho tsho'i mgo klad nas brag 'phrang gi phyogs la 'phur pa na/ btsan mgon lag ring gi gdong la 'dzum zhig langs te gsham na ri dwags rmas ma zhig 'dug ces bshad bzhin yar langs te myur ba myur bar brag ngos kyi 'bab lam btsal pa dang / ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis gas bden nam snyam bzhin kho'i rjes su 'brangs/btsan mgon lag ring gis brag 'phrang mthil gyi chu grog 'gram la gtor 'dug pa'i gla spu de mthong ma thag the tshom ci yang med par chu grog brgyud nas mar brgyugs pa na/ lcags rnyis thebs pa'i gla ba de mthong byung bas/ca rten 'brel yag po 'dug rten 'brel yag po 'dug zer bzhin thog mar gla rtsi blangs pa dang / de nas gla ba gson por bshas te snying khrag yul lha gzhi bdag dang lha srin sde brgyad rnams la mchod pa na/ ra bha 'dre mig gi ya chung nang nas zug gzer langs te 'dug mi bzod par gyur pa dang mnyam du/ kho ni ci 'dra'i mi gdug rtsub can zhig red ang snyam byung /khos thog mar shes tshang stong dpon gyi gser tham rku rtsis byas rjes/ rig 162

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/'dzin me 'bar gyi mthu la skrag ste 'os mthun gyi thabs bkod cig la bsam blo bskor mod/ re zhig mthu yi mjug 'bras gdong gis bsu ba las thabs gzhan ma rnyed kyang / rjes su btsan mgon lag ring la mnyam 'brel byung rjes bdag gzhan gnyis la phan pa'i thabs bkod gsar ba zhig rnyed byung /g.yo dang thabs la brten nas btsan mgon lag ring la rig 'dzin me 'bar tshang gi la lo 'ded du 'jug pa dang / rang nyid kyis stong dpon gyi gser tham brkus na/ gcig na sngags pas rang rgyu bsams te rta 'ded mkhan la mthu btang na/ rang nyid la gnod pa chen po mi 'byung zhing / gnyis su btsan mgon lag ring ni mi gdug rtsub can zhig yin pas/ dgra lag la 'jog thabs ma byas na rjes su don ci 'byung mi shes snyam/ 'on kyang /btsan mgon lag ring la bkod 'doms byed pa las sla mo zhig ga la yin/khos don dag cig sgrub pa'i tshe na de mi bzang mi legs pa go rjes bsam bzhin du sgrub par byed pa dang / de bzang tshul legs tshul bshad na lag bstar gtan nas mi byed/ ra bha 'dre mig gis rig 'dzin me 'bar tshang gi rta khyu de mthong rjes/ sngags pa'i la lo ded na mjug 'bras mi legs pa'i gnas lugs de zhib bshad ma byas na/ kho la rig 'dzin me 'bar gyi la lo 'ded pa'i chod sems brtan po de yod mi srid/btsan mgon lag ring gis spro snang dang bcas gla lpags bshus rjes/rin chen rkyal kha mngags te bud shing btus pa dang / rang nyid kyis ba rdo 163

'tshub ma kher rtsang /btsugs shing / de nas ba mar chu blangs te gla sha 'tshod mgo brtsams/ ra bha 'dre mig gis kho'i gdug rtsub dang spro snang / las chod bcas la bltas kyin bltas kyin yid mug pa dang skyug mer ba'i tshor snang ya mtshan pa zhig 'gran pa bzhin byung mod/ kho la nyin 'ga'i tshe thag las med shas che snyam pa na/ rang nyid kyang kho lta bu zhig ma yin nam bsams te yig drug sems nas zlo bzhin kha rog ger bsdad/gla sha tshos rjes/ btsan mgon lag ring gis ci mi snyam pa'i ngang nas rtsi gu dang tshang ra rnams ba ma'i kha leb steng la blangs te kho gnyis kyi mdun la bzhag pa dang / rang nyid kyis ba ma las sog pa ya gcig blangs te za mgo brtsams/ khos sog rus steng gi sha rnams zos rjes/ thog mar sog pa la shug dud bdugs te gtsang dag byas pa dang / de nas sog rus dpral bar glan nas ci zhig la gsol ba btab rjes sog rus me thog la bzhag ste/slar yang sog pa gzhan pa de ba ma las blangs te zos/ khos sog pa gnyis pa de zos tshar dus/ me phung khrod kyi sog pa de tshig nas skya bor gyur 'dug pas/ khos sog rus tshig ro de shing thur gnyis kyi bar la bcir nas tshur blangs te/ sog rus kyi gas ga so so'i gas stangs la zhib tu bltas te spro snang zad mtha' med pa zhig skyes byung /6 ci 'dra'i sog mo ya mtshan zhig ngas dang thog gla pho rnyed dus kyang rten 'brel ha cang bzang ba rtogs mod/ 'u cag la 'di 'dra'i las skal 164

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/mchog gyur 'byung ba ma shes/ ngo ma yag po 'dug mismyo sog mo yag na zhib bshad byos dang /mi ra bha 'dre mig gis spro snang dang bcas de ltar bshad/ca grogs po gnyis nas nyon dang / sog pa la dpyad na da reb 'u cag gis don dag ngo mtshar zhig 'grub rgyu red/ don dag de 'grub rjes rang phyogs la skrag 'jigs dang dgra phyogs la god kha chen po 'byung srid pa dang /rjes su nga'i 'tsho stangs la 'gyur ldog chen po med mod/ khyod gnyis la gser gyi lung ba dang dngul gyi gshong ba re'i yong 'bab 'dug lhag par ra bha 'dre mig la mi brgya'i gong nas gtam bshad pa dang rta brgya'i gong nas lcag g.yug pa'i skal ba ldan/ ci 'dra red/ sog mo yag gam/ ’ra bha 'dre mig gis thog mar yid ches pa'i ngang nas mgo bo ldem ldem byas pa dang / yud tsam gyi rjes su rang nyid la de lta bu'i bsod nams dang dbang skal yod mi srid snyam ste/ sog rus gzhan pa de me la bsregs nas dpyad pa gtong ba'i re ba bton/ btsan mgon lag ring gdug rtsub che zhing gshis ka gyong rung rdzun gtam 'ud gtam mi bshad pas/ rang nyid jag la 'gro dus sog rus bsregs te sa phyogs yul khams gang la song na bzang ba dang / yong 'bab dka' sdug ga 'dra yod par brtags rjes lam la chas pa na/ da lta'i bar du chags 'jig bar chad gcig kyang byung ma myong zer ba bden shas che/ ra bha 'dre mig gis kho'i sog rus la dpyad pa'i 'jon thang 165

'tshub ma kher rkyang /la yid ches byed bzhin yod/mun nub pa dang bstun nas/ kho tshos nor lug mang zhing mgo spra che ba'i ru tshogs de dmigs nas ri ngos las mar babs/ gsum ga lhan du ru 'dabs kyi grog shur de la bslebs rjes/ ra bha 'dre mig gis btsan mgon lag ring la khyod jag la song / nged gnyis rku la 'gro/ nam gung yol rjes 'di nas 'dzom par bya/ khyod kyis rig 'dzin me 'bar gyi rta khyu 'ded mi rung / nga kho'i dpa' la mi skrag gnyan la skrag pa yin ces bshad de rin chen rkyal kha rjes su khrid nas lam la chas/kho gnyis shis tshang stong dpon gyi sgar kha yod sa'i spra tshogs de'i nye 'gram la bslebs dus/ ra bha 'dre mig gis rin chen rgyal kha gad skyibs shig la skung du bcug rjes/ the tshom ci yang med par dud khyim zhig la 'dzul te khyim hril bor zhib lta byas/ dud khyim de ga'i mo khyim na byis pa lnga bstar nas nyal 'dug pa dang / pho khyim gyi mchod khri'i mdun du bud med dar ma zhig gis pus mo gnyis ka sa la btsugs te sdug bsngal gyi mchi ma 'don bzhin mchis/ mo'i gam gyi bu mo chung chung des 6a ma/ ma ngu zhes yang yang bshad bzhin yod mod/ mo rang yang ngus te mkhur ngos mchi mas brlan 'dug ra bha 'dre mig gis tshul de mthong ma thag khyim 'di'i bdag po tsho ba'i nang 'khrug khrod du 'das song snyam ste/ snying rje skyes pa dang lhan du kho tshang nas khab skud tsam yang rku 'dod med par gyur pas/ sems pa 166

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha/gzer brang breng byed bzhin spra sgor bud de dud khyim gzhan zhig gi spra nang la 'dzul/ dud khyim de ga ni khyim tshang phyug po zhig red/ pho khyim hril bor sgam brtsigs yod pa dang / mo khyim hril bor sgro ba bsgrigs 'dug par ma zad/ mchod khri'i steng la dngul gyi mchod skong chen po ri mo can zhig bzhag 'dug khyim mi che chung rnams gang 'dod ltar nyal 'dug la/ mo khyim gyi thab rtsa na nyal 'dug pa'i mo gsar des skyes pa zhig rum 'dug skabs shig la/ pho mo de gnyis gas skad cha shab shub 'ga' bshad rjes/ rim bzhin brel 'tshub che ba'i 'khun sgra sgrog pas/ ra bha 'dre mig la thog mar lus kun sgrid pa'i tshor snang ya mtshan zhig skyes mod/ bltas kyin bltas kyin rang dbang med par khong khro zhig langs nas/ skyes pa de'i gyon chas khyer te 'phyi khung zhig tu bcug rjes/ slar yang khyim la 'dzul yong ste khyod tshang gi ya phug nas mchod pa bshams/ mar snyed nas 'khrig spyod byas snyam bzhin dngul rkong de rum la bcug rjes/ 'gro zhor du rtsam pa sgro ba gang dang glang sga zhig khur te rin chen rkyal kha yod sar bskyal/ des thob dngos khur nas 'gro rtsis byas pa na/ 'dre mig gis dud khyim 'di la chag sgo de tsam gyis chog pa ma red snyam ste rin chen rkyal kha/ sdod dang da rung yodami ces bshad rjes/ slar yang dud khyim de la 'dzul nas snga rjes su rtsam pa sgro ba gsum dang mar grod gcig glang sga gcig bcas brkus yong / de rjes kyi khyim tshang de ni stobs 'byor dbang thang can zhig red/ sbra'i gru bzhi bo na 167

'tshub ma kher rkyang /skyes pa re so par langs 'dug pa dang / ya phug na kun dga' ra ba chung chung zhig gi nang du li sku mang por mchod me'i ldog 'od lam lam 'phro bzhin yod/ lha sku'i mdun na gos chen ser po'i phyi thum can gyi dngos po zhig bzhag 'dug pas/ ra bha 'dre mig gis pha gi ni dngos po rtsa chen zhig yin pa thag gis chod snyam bzhin mchod khri'i gam la dal gyis bcar/ khos dogs zon dang bcas gos thum gyi mdud pa grol ba na/ shis tshang stong dpon gyi gser gyi tham ga mig lam la gsal ler mngon byung bas/ phu nu gnyis ga'i rtsod gzhi dang tsho ba 'khrug pa'i 'byung gzhi ni 'di red/ da reb brkus song na rjes su ci zhig rtsod snyam bzhin dga' lhang lhang gis tham ga rum la bcugar bha 'dre mig sngar gyi chu grog 'gram la bslebs dus/ g.yas g.yon thams cad la lo yin pa dang / rin chen rkyal kha dang btsan mgon lag ring gnyis gas mar rtsam thams cad mdzo gnyis kyi rgyab la bkal cing / mi re la bzhon rta re bzung ste kho la sgug 'dugasmyo 'di rnams rig 'dzin me 'bar tshang gi la lo min nam/mi ra bha 'dre mis gis bsam bzhin du de ltar dris/6tsam red/ shis tshang stong dpon tshang gi red/mi btsan mgon lag ring gis 'tshab 'tshub med par de skad bshad/ ‘khyod kyis stong dpon tshang gi la lo yin pa ji ltar shes/’ 168

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha/6 ngas bzung 'dug pa 'di stong dpon gyi chibs rta red/mi ra bha 'dre mig gis btsan mgon lag ring gi gtam la yid ches byed dka' mod/ khos sgrub 'dod pa'i bya bar sngon 'gog byed dka' ba'i nyams ston ched/ mgo bo 'phred du g.yug zhor du shugs ring zhig 'then rjes gang ltar kyang rta ni ded zin mizar bzhin myur stabs kyis rta la zhon te la lo gyen la bskor te den/ skabs shig la/ la lo'i khyu na rta pho nag khra dar tshon sna lnga'i srung ba can zhig yod pa des 'tsher skad lhang lhang sgrog bzhin rta khyu'i mdun nas bkag ste/ la lo sngon ma rnams la 'phra shag dang so shad byas pas/kho tsho g.yas rgyug g.yon rgyug byas te la lo rnams sdun la ded rung / la lo a long 'khor ba bzhin skor rgyug byas te mdun la 'ded ma thub/ skabs der btsan mgon lag ring glog dmar 'khyug pa ltar brgyugs te rta pho gos srung can de'i rnga mar 'jus te kha gyen la bskor nas g.yas gcu g.yon gcu byed bzhin pa'i skabs su ra bha 'dre mig gis thag pa ske la bskon rjes/ myur stabs kyis rta'i gong la bud pa na/ rta pho mchong lding 'ga' byas rung kho sa la g.yug ma thub/ skabs der ra bha 'dre mig gis myur stabs kyis rked kyi glo gri phyung nas rta'i rngog mar btags pa'i srung mdud bcad nas phar g.yugs/rta pho nag khras mu mthud du gnam lding sa lding 'ga' byas mthar rim bzhin lhod la babs/ btsan mgon lag ring gis tshul de mthong bas re zhig ha las par gyur par ma zad/ ra bha 'dre mig la dad pa sngar med cig skyes pa 169

'tshub ma kher rkyang /dang / rig 'dzin me 'bar zer ba de sngags pa phal ba zhig ma red snyam byung /kho tshos rta rnams bde blag ngang ded de me 'khor nyag chen pha rol la bslebs rjes/ btsan mgon lag ring rta khyu dang bcas pa kho rang gi yul phyogs su mngags pa dang / ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis nas mar rtsam bkal yod pa'i mdzo gnyis ded de rang yul phyogs la chas song /kho gnyis gas btsan mgon lag ring dang dpung ba bsdebs nas la lo 'ded dus/ gcig na stong dpon gyi gser tham rku thub song bas/ dpon phrug tshe ring cham la dbab par mthun rkyen legs po bskrun pa dang / btsan mgon lag ring g.yo 'og la tshud de rig 'dzin me 'bar gyi rta khyu ded pa de yang yang yin la 'khor pas/ kho dang gyes pa'i bar du/ ra bha 'dre mig gi gdong la rgyal kha'i 'dzum mdangs kyis khengs te 'tshub cha dang skrag 'jigs ci yang med/ 'on te kho dang gyes nas rang yul gyi lam sne bzung ba dang bstun nas/ rin chen rkyal kha la dga' sdug gi nyams snang ci yang med mod/ra bha 'dre mig gis rig 'dzin me 'bar mthu dang gtor zor la rang dbang thob yod pa'i zer sgros de dran pa dang / btsan mgon lag ring gis rta khyu de rang nyid kyi lkog jus ltar ded pa yin snyam pa na/ ‘ bsam pa mi la gnag na sbyor ba rang la 'khor zer ba bden pa yin shas che snyam byung bas/sems la 'jigs snang skyes te lus kun srid tsam sbrid tsam byas/ kho gnyis 170

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/gas mdzo rgan gnyis ka ded de brel 'gros kyis mdun la song ba na/ ra bha 'dre mig la mi min zog min 'jigs su rung ba zhig rjes su ded 'dug pa'i 'phrul snang byung ste/ mdun la brel 'gro byed zhor du rgyab phyogs la yang yang lta dgos byung mod/ lta thengs rer rgyab phyogs su ci yang mi mthong / skabs skabs su/ ra bha 'dre mig gis rta khyu 'ded mkhan ni lag ring yin la/ kho gnyis gas mi re la rta re las ma brkus pa dran na/ yid sems bde la babs te chag sgo ci yang 'byung mi srid snyam ste 'gro ba dang / rgyab phyogs su ci zhig ded yod pa'i 'phrul snang de'ang yal 'gro/ skabs shig la/ gnyid du yur 'dug pa'i ri bong zhig kho gnyis ga'i nye 'gram nas glo bur du 'drogs te phar bros pa na/ ra bha 'dre mig gis rnam rig bsgrims 'dug pas/ sga 'gyur byas pa tsam las sar ma lhung mod/ rin chen rkyal khas lus sems thams cad lhod 'dug pa dang gnyid kyang cung zad babs 'dug pas/rta 'drogs ma thag ljid tig ger sa la lhung / ra bha 'dre mig gis than rtags bstan song snyam ste sngangs 'tshab dang bcas rta kha bsgags te zhib lta byas pa na/ rna ba ske khud la bsnyal nas 'bro bzhin pa'i ri bong de mthong bas/ yid sems skad cig la bde la babs te dbugs ring 'byin bzhin rta thog nas zur 'dug byas te/ 'dzum mdangs dang bcas srab mdar 'jus te sa nas 'phag ra byas te par langs grabs byed pa'i rin chen rkyal kha la bltas nas bsdad/171

'tshub ma kher rkyang /kho gnyis gas khal mdzo ded de brel 'gros kyis mdun la song ba na/nam mkha' rim gyis gsal te nyi ma stong ba'i dbyings la 'phags byung / nam langs pa dang bstun nas/ ra bha 'dre mig la rjes su ci zhig ded 'dug pa'i tshor snang med par gyur te/ yid sems bde la babs pa dang lus yongs lhod la babs pa'i tshor snang byung mod/ skabs shig la snying nas gus pa'i a ma dran byung bas/ skad cig la sngags rgan des rang khyim phyogs la gtor zor 'phangs yod las che snyam ste/ sems la 'tshub cha bzod glags med pa zhig langs pa dang / rang nyid kyi 'char 'god mang ba'i sems pa la 'alang ra yang yang byed dgos byung /ra bha 'dre mig gis rin chen rkyal kha khrid de rang yul nas lam la chas skabs/ gling tsha tsho dgu la song ste zas gos la sogs mabo dngos gang mang rku ba'i zhor du/ sems gting nas 'dris pa'i mdza' mo la lta skor thengs shig byed rtsis yin/ 'on kyang / lam skad nas dpon phrug tshe ring gi jus bkod skyug bro ba de rtogs pas/ rang sems kyi 'char gzhi de mi bsgyur ka med byung /khos thog mar rang gi jus bkod de sgyur skabs/ shis tshang dpon po'i gser tham de brkus rjes/ tham ga de tshe ring gi bka' ltar tsho mi zhig gis brkus te kha che'i tshong dpon zhig la btsongs zin zhes rdzun gtam 'ur sgrog byas na/ shis tshang mi ser kun gyis tshe ring gis pha jus brlags song zer nas rtsad gcod zhib 'jug med par kho'i mi lpags gson bshu byed nges snyam 172

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/ste/ gser tham dang mar rtsam nyung ngu las mkho dngos ci yang sku rtsis med mod/ lam bar nas btsan mgon lag ring la 'phrad pa na/ rim gyis mi pho gdug rtsub can de med brlags ma byas na rjes su nag nyes gang mang bzo nges bsams te/ g.yo jus bkod nas rig 'dzin me 'bar gyi rta khyu 'ded du bcug mod/ skabs der/ rang nyid la ngan sngags/ kyis gtse ba'i nyen kha yod pa gtan nas ma rtogs/ da lta nor 'chugs yongs su rtogs pa na/shis tshang gi gser tham dpon phrug su la thob rung rang nyid la thob shor ci yang med cing / btsan mgon lag ring gis nag nyes ga 'dra bzos rung byeng nyid dang 'brel ba ci yang med snyam ste/ sngar byas la 'gyod pa drag po sa/ ra bha 'dre mig gis 'tshub cha dang bcas rta la lcag gis bskul nas mdun la song ba na/ bzhon pa gnyis ka rngul chus brlan te chu nang la lhung ba dang mtshungs la/ mdzo rgan gnyis ka a thang chad de la nas dbu ba 'phyur gyin gda'/ra bha 'dre mig gis mi zog gi ngal dub la 'dzem dogs med par sngar bzhin brel 'gros kyis mdun du song ba na/ rin chen rkyal khas ci zhig bshad 'dod yod mod/ ra bha 'dre mig gi gdong la sdug nyams dang brel nyams sngar rnyed cig shar 'dug pas/ kharoganyer khal mañdza 'dedasnagasabyas nas mdun la song / 173

'tshub ma kher rkyang /kho gnyis bstud mar brel 'tshub kyis mdun la song ba na/ slang nang mar bslebs dus phyi nyin gyi nam gung yol te yun ring 'gor 'dug skabs shig la ra bha 'dre mig gis rang khyim na me lce dmar lam lam byed pa dang /spra rgyab kyi bsang khri na du ba sngo lhog lhog byed pa mthong bas/ btsan mgon lag ring gis bshad pa'i dgra phyogs nas 'ong rgyu'i chags 'jig de rang phyogs la 'khor ba yin nam snyam bzhin 'tshub cha dang bcas yul phyogs la brgyugs/ kho chu mig grog mo'i g.yas 'gram la bslebs dus/ grwa pa zhig sgor bud de gtor ma'am ci zhig nub phyogs su 'phangs pa mthong bas a ma ma 'tshams snyam ste ngu sngangs byed bzhin rta la lcag gis bskul nas mdun du brgyugs/ kho spra sgo la bslebs ma thag rta pho sgo chon la btags te ngu rgyangs byed bzhin khyim la 'dzul pa na/ a mas mchi ma 'don bzhin mar snyed na langs 'dug pa mthong bas/ sems pa cung tsam bde bar gyur te ngu mtshams bzhag mod/ a lags mkha' lding tshang khong khro dang bcas pho khyim shā yar snyed na bzhugs 'dug pa mthong bas sngar las kyang 'tshub cha chen po ga ༷༷rdo nga/na khyi 'dra ba khyod kyis ci byas e shes/mi tsu lagasawa ngas lags/ mi ra bha 'dre mig gis bla rdo brkus pa de bla mas mkhyen 'dug snyam ste 'tshub cha sngar las je cher gyur/6 ra bha 'dre mig khyod gnyan po zhig la 'gal song zer ba bden 174

ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/nam/mi a mas mchi ma 'byid bzhin de skad dris/zu bden/mi 6 ra bha 'dre mig 6 lags/ yod lags/’ lha shis tshang tsho bar nang 'khrug byung rjes/ dud khyim mang po bros te ldong ru dpon la mgo 'dogs byas pa na/ rig 'dzin me 'bar khong khro langs kyang / rang don yid la bcangs nas bzod bsran byas/ da reb rin chen rkyal kha khyod gnyis gas kho'i mgon rta brkus par ma zad/ shis tshang stong dpon gyi tham ga'ang brkus pas/ khos bzod bsran ma thub par me 'khor stobs ldan rngam chen dang a ma me 'bar gnyis ka ra mdar mngags mod/ nga'i chos skyong srung ma dang lha srin sde brgyad rnams kyis khyod gnyis la mgon skyob sdongs grogs mdzad pas gnod pa ma byung / sngags rgan gyis khyod gnyis thar pa rtogs te sang nyin rtswa gzugs mngag rtsis yod/des kyang sdong ru tsho ba tshar gcod byed ma thub na gtor zor 'phen rgyu red/da ci bya/mi tshulags/ sku nyid kyis thugs bkod 'then rogs/mi a lags mkha' lding tshang gis ra bha 'dre mig gi ci byed 'di byed med pa'i ngang tshul de mthong bas/ glen pa 'dis yod tshad bden par rlom 'dug snyam ste khong 'dzum zhig langs mod/ gdong la khro nyams shig ༵༵sa

'tshub ma khyer rkyang /te nga la thabs bkod ci yod ces gsungs/tsa lags/ khyed kyis thugs rje skyabs 'og nas mi 'dor bar zhu/mi 6 myur mor rin chen rkyal kha 'bod du song /mi 6 lags so/mi ra bha 'dre mig gis g.yas lta g.yon lta gsal bo byas rjes/ da gzod rin chen rkyal khas mar rtsam bkal yod pa'i mdzo rgan gnyis ka khrid de rang khyim la song ba rtogs/6 rem mizu shāspyogs cas/ /mi le'u brgyad pa/ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis ka bsdad yod pa'i brag khung de ge sar mar slang chen po'i nub ngos na yod pa dang / brag khung nas bltas na shing khri rgyal po'i lcags mdas gtor ba'i nyag chen de gsal ler mthong yong / a lags mkha' lding tshang gi lung bstan ltar na/ rig 'dzin me 'bar gyis mngags pa'i rtswa gzugs des nyag ga chen po de brgyud nas slang nang mar yong nges yin/ kho gnyis brag khung du 'dzul nas rtswa gzugs la sgug bzhin bsdad pa na/ rin chen rkyal kha la 'dang rgyag ci yang med mod/ra bha 'dre mig gis tsugal srid rtswa gzugs phyir bzlog ma thub na/ ldong ru tsho ba/ sdugs 'jig byung rung mi skyon mod/ rang a ma gcig pur bar chad

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rgyal kha/'dra byung na ci bya snyam pa na/ skabs rer 'jigs snang skyes te snying chung lu gu lding lding byas pa dang / mtshams rer 'tshub cha chen po langs te brag khung du phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed par ma zad/ 'dug mi bzod par lag pa 'phur 'phur dang mgo la reg reg byed kyin 'dug skabs 'dir kho'i sems nas yal thabs med pa ni rang gi a ma yin la/ gal srid a ma la bar chad re byung na lag dmar ni rang nyid yin bsam bzhin yod/mdang dgong / ra bha 'dre mig gis rin chen rkyal kha khrid de skrag skrag 'jigs 'jigs ngang nas khyim la log dus/ a lags mkha' lding tshang gi khong khro chen po de cung tsam zhi 'dug la/ khong gis ci zhig la dmigs pa gtad de kho gnyis la mjal kha gnang bar ma zad/ mnol bsang bdugs pa dang khrus dbang bskur rjes/ rin chen rgyal kha mdun la bos te 6rin chen rkyal kha/ khyod ni mthu dang skyogs la rang dbang thob pa dang / brag ri rngam chen dpung gis 'degs pa'i dga' bde chos skyong ber nag gi sku skyes yin pas/ sang nyin ldong ru tsho ba mthu 'og nas skyob pa'i dus la babs pa yin/'di ni khyod kyi tshe sngon gyi smon lam dang da lta'i las skal yin/ 'jigs 'jigs ma byed pha yi bu/ gcig na tshe sngon smon lam gyi mthu btsan pa dang /gnyis su bdag gi chos skyong srung ma dang gling gi yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyis kha 'dzin sdongs grogs byed pas/ ci bsam thams cad lhun gyis 'grub nges yin ces gsungs te/ mdung mo yid du 'ong ba zhig shubs nas bton 177

'tshub ma kher rkyang /te rin chen rkyal kha'i lag la bzhag mdung mo de ni stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar tshang gi rten 'gangs chen zhig yin la/ de la lo rgyus dang gtam rgyud kyang yid smon 'chor ba zhig mchis/mdung mo de dang thog mgar khri 'bring gi phyag mdung yin par bshad/bod chen po sil bur thor rjes tsong kha rgyal po'i phyag tu son/ de nas tsong kha rgyal rabs 'jig rjes/ mdung mo de tshong dpon zhig gi lag la tshud de mi rabs du ma 'gor pa na/ stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar gyi mes po zhig gis gser dngul gang mang byin te blus pa yin zer/ mdung mo de'i mdung shing tsan dan sbrul gyi snying bo yin la/ mdung mgo rno nag rdo rje srog gcod yin par ma zad/ yu ba la gser dngul gyi shan dang g.yu byur gyis phra btab yod pas/ nyi 'od 'og tu khra lam lam dang 'od kyug kyug byed/ mdung mo de'i mdung shing sbom zhing mdung mgo ha cang ring bas/ gsar bu phal ba zhig gis lag la 'dzin pa ma gtogs/ lag gis g.yug skor byed mi thub/ ra bha 'dre mig gis a lags kyis rin chen rkyal kha'i skye ba gong ma ngos 'dzin byas par ma zad/ rten mdung ngo mtshar can de lag la bzhag pa mthong ste/ rang nyid kyang skyes chen dam pa zhig gi sku skye la ngos 'dzin byas te mtshon cha gang bzang zhig gnang rgyu red snyam bzhin re sgug byas pa na/ mkha' lding tshang gis mdung mo'i lo rgyus gsungs rjes ci zhig la dmigs pa gtad nas bzhugs pa las kho la kha ya tsam yang mi byed pas/ sprul sku mchog gis rang 178

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/nyid brjed 'dug snyam nas spobs pa chen pos rin po che lags/ 'o na nga zhes mi zhu thabs med byung /66khyod kyang sang nyin 'gro dgos/mi smyo lags/ nga'i mi tshe gong ma mi66khyod ni nga'i sku phreng gong ma'i gsol thab pa bde mchog la khyi mo rkun ma zhig yod pa de red/mi rjo lags/ bden nam/ ra bha 'dre mig gis a lags kyi gsung de ku re yin na ci ma rung snyam byung /a lags mkha' lding tshang 'dzum dmul dmul byed bzhin bzhugs pa las ci yang ma gsungs/shing khri rgyal pos gtor ba'i nyag chen de sngar bzhin stong hang nge ci yang mi mthong la/ ra bha 'dre mig gis sgug gin sgug gin 'tshub cha langs te/rtswa gzugs zer ba'i ltas ngan de myur mor mthong lam la 'byor na sdug bsngal 'di 'dra myong mi dgos snyam pa dang / slar yang rtswa gzugs kyi nus mthu khyad mtshar de yid la shar pa na/ de ma thag a ye dkon mchog mtsho mos kho la mnar gcod byas pa'i brgyud rim ring mo de sems la 'khor pas/rtswa gzugs de kho tshang phyogs la mngags te/ mi phyugs thams cad rtsa med byas na bsams mod/ bu mo gangs dkar sgrol ma yid la dran na de ltar bya mi rung snyam/ a lags mkha' lding tshang gi lung bstan ltar na/ rig 'dzin 79

'tshub ma kher rkyang /me 'bar gyis mngags pa'i rtswa gzugs de nyin gung sngon la sa 'dir bslebs thub pa dang / than ltas de nyid brag khung tshur rol la son ma thag bo gnyis gzhug phyogs nas 'jab rgyug byas te/ rin chen rkyal khas than ltas de mdung mo'i rtse la bskyon te sngar yong sa'i phyogs la kha gtad nas bzhag rjes/ra bha 'dre mig gis sdigs mdzub bstan te rig 'dzin me 'bar sgar la ho ma ya zhes brjod na/ rtswa gzugs kyis yong lam ded nas rig 'dzin me 'bar gyi sgar thog la log ste sngags pa de nyid rtsa med du bzo ba yin/ skabs shig la/ra bha 'dre mig gis rin chen rkyal kha'i lus po kun la zhib lta thengs shig byas pa na/ de'i gdong na gzhan dang mi mtshungs pa'i khyad chos shig yod pa'i tshor snang byung /6 rin chen rkyal kha/ khyod dga' bde chos skyong ber nag gi sprul ba yin pa bden nam/ ’66ngas mi shes/ mdang dgong a lags mkha' lding tshang gis mnol bsang bdugs shing khrus dbang bskur rjes/ rig pa dwangs shing sems khams skyid pa'i tshor snang tsam byung mod/ tshe sngon gyi bya ba gcig kyang mi dran/mi bden nam/mi tsa bden/mi zu 'o na khyod kyi skye phreng gong ma de chang gis bzi ste ra ror gyur rjes shi 180
