ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/song ba 'dra/mi 6 ci redami rin chen rkyal khas bden cog cog gis de ltar dris/ ‘khyod nam rgyun chang gis bzi ba ltar sad ma sangs la 'dug pa zhig ma yin nam/ ’rin chen rkyal khas nyag ga'i phyogs la lta ba las ci yang mi bshad/ ra bha 'dre mig gis slar yang kho'i gdong la zhib lta thengs shig byas pa na/ sngar gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos de gar song mi shes/nyin gung la bsleb par nye dus/ thog mar nyag ga'i pha rol nas pho rog gsum bstud mar 'phur yong ba dang / de'i rjes su rlung nag 'tshub ma zhig dang bcas rtswa gzugs de skya yom yom byed bzhin nyag ga'i tshu rol la bslebs/tsa rtsa gzugs bslebs byung / a lags kyis ci gsung yid la zungs/ ’ra bha 'dre mig gis de ltar bshad/sna ya/ brjed med/ ’rtswa gzugs de'i bongs ni mi dar ma zhig gi tshod dang mnyam la/ rkang lag mgo rked thams cad mi yi dbyibs su 'dug tshur yong dus gom pa 'khyar 'khyor spo bzhin yod na'ang / gshong 'bur kun la thogs pa med pa dang / 'khyar re 'khyor re ngang nas gom pa mgyogs len byas te tshur yong ba na/ rta pho brel 'gro byas pa'i bang myur lta bu ldan/ tshul de mthong rjes1/81ra

'tshub ma kher rkyang /bha 'dre mig gis sku gzhogs mkha' lding tshang dang khong gi chos skyong srung ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs bzhin rin chen rkyal kha la a pa'i bu/ a lags tshang gis ci gsung yid la zungs /zhes dran skul byas/ skabs shig la/rtswa gzugs de pho rog gsum dang 'tshub ma che chung gnyis kyis mdun bsus pa la brten nas/ skya yom yom gyi ngang brag khung tshu rol du bslebs pas/rin chen rkyal khas mdung yu dam por bzung ste ltas ngan skya bo de yi rjes la stong 'jigs dang 'tshab 'tshub med par 'jab rgyug byas pa na/ ra bha 'dre mig gis kyang bla rdo la 'phur 'phur byed bzhin grogs po'i rjes su 'brangs/rin chen rgyal khas mgar khri 'bring gi phyag mdung de rtswa gzugs kyi sog rgyab la shugs kyis bsnun pa na/ sngar gyi 'tshub ma glo bur du je cher gyur pa dang / pho rog gsum po 'tshub ma'i khrod zhugs te lding 'khor byed bzhin ag 'gyur byas pas/ mi sems zang zing lang long du gyur te ci byed 'di byed med pa'i gnas la lhung / rin chen rkyal khas rlung 'tshub khrod du ci yang mi mthong rung / rtswa gzugs mdung mo'i rtse la bskyon cing yong phyogs su ldog ste kha gtad nas bzhag pa na/ ltas ngan skya bo de rlung 'tshub khrod nas yom yom 'gul bzhin langs nas bsdad/ skabs der/ ra bha 'dre mig gis sdigs mdzub bstan nas skad gsang mthon pos rig 'dzin me 'bar sgar la ho ma ya zhes brjod pa na/ rlung 'tshub chen po de rim bzhin gnyis su gyes la/ rlung 'tshub chen pos mdun bsus pa dang / rlung 'tshub chung ngu de'ang 182

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/dal gyis nub phyogs la 'khor nas g.yugs pas/ rlung 'tshub dkyil gyi rtswa gzugs des kyang phyir lam ded nas song / pho rog rnams ma rangs pa dang 'dra bar 'tshub ma'i klad nas lding 'khor byed bzhin ag 'gyur byas/rtswa gzugs phyir bzlogs rjes byung ba'i gnas tshul ni ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha la mtshon na dngos gnas bsam yul las 'das pa zhig red/ ma gzhi rtswa gzugs ni mngags pa'i yul la ma bslebs na 'dug mi srid pa dang / lam bar nas ci la 'phrad na de rtsa med du 'gro srid/ rig 'dzin me 'bar gyis mngags pa'i rtswa gzugs de btsan rgod nyag chen brgyud nas phyir 'gro skabs dpon phrug tshe ring gi dmag sgar rtsa med du bzos pa dang / mthar rig 'dzin me 'bar dang kho'i sgar kha'ang rmeg med du btang /rjes su/ a lags mkha' lding tshang 'khor dang bcas pa me 'khor gshong chen la phebs te/ ra bha 'dre mig gis brkus yong ba'i tham ga dpon phrug bsod nams la sprad pa dang / brgya dpon dang lo lon 'phro lus rnams lhan du bsdus te bka' chos gsung ba'i zhor du tsho bar nang mthun yong dgos pa'i gnas lugs zhib tu gsungs pa na/ la lar yid 'gul thebs shing la lar 'gyod sems skyes te/ gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis dpon phrug bsod nams thob dang tham ga'i bdag por bkur ba'i dam bca' byas pa dang / dpon phrug bsod nams kyis bla ma'i sku drin gzo ched/ me 'bar chos sgar de g.yu 'brug mchan bar nas g.yu 'brug rwa bar la spar te a 183

'tshub ma kher rkyang /lags mkha' lding la dbul ba'i khas len byas/'di ni rjes su byung ba'i gtam rgyud cig red/ston zla brgyad pa tshes pa na/ gnam gshes kyi 'gyur ldog dang bstun nas/ slang nang ma'i rtswa dang rtsi shing gi lo 'dab rim gyis ser por gyur pas/ri rtse gang rung zhig nas rgyang lta byas na/ gshong sa chen po de zangs kyi sla ngar mar khu blugs pa dang gnyis su ma mchis/ra bha 'dre mig tshang gi mgo sbra gsar ba de sngar gyi sbre'u nag las ldab 'gyur gyis che bas/ mar gsham na skya tho se byed pa'i thal phung de sngar las je chung la song ba'i snang ba zhig ster/ lhag par du brgya nor stong lug shong ba'i nor lhas dang lug lhas chen po de gnyis ka la brten nas/ mgo sbra chen po de la de bas gson shugs dang gzi brjid cig bsnan 'dug sa ma skyi mgo nyi mar lde ru 'gro sa'i rkang lam phra mo de la yun ring zhugs mkhan ma byung bas/ rgyang ring nas bltas na gsal la mi gsal ba zhig tu gyur 'dug pa dang / spra nag dang chu mig bar gyi rkang lam gya gyu de sngar bzhin gsal ler mthong /ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis gas ldong ru tsho ba sngags pa'i mthu 'og nas bskyabs rjes/ kho gnyis ga'i mdzad pa 'phrin las gcig gis gcig la brgyud nas kun tu khyab pas/ mi rnams kyis mkha' lding tshang giX 'ongs pa'i dus shig la/ kho gnyis gas 'u cag gi sde ba tsho ba chags

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/'jig las skyob pa mkha' lding tshang la sngar las kyang dang pa'i spu long g.yo ba zhig byung bar ma zad/ ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis la snying khong rus pa'i gting nas bka' drin zhu dgos byung / ’lhag par sngon chad gzhon nu de gnyis mi tha shal ba zhig la brtsis te/sde khrims tsho khrims ltar chad pa nan mo gcad dgos pa'i bsam 'char bshad myong ba'i brgya dpon dang lo lon rnams kyang 'gyod pa chen po skyes pa dang /mi la las kho gnyis btsal te dgongs dag gu yangs byed dgos pa'i re ba'ang yang yang zhus myong zer/ sde ba tsho bas kho gnyis la gong bkur dang bstod bsngags byed bzhin yod pa'i skabs dang bstun nas/ stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar gyis a lags mkha' lding tshang gi bka' gsung ltar brgya dpon dang lo lon rnams lhan du bsdus te/ thog mar a lags mkha' lding gis lung bstan rim pa gnyis la gnang ba'i brgyud rim de rgyas bshad thengs shig byas pa dang / de nas dal lhod lhod kyi ngang drin chen la drin gzo byed dgos pa'i gnas lugs zhib bshad byas te/ nor chig brgya lhag yod pa'i khyim tshang gis kho gnyis la 'bri g.yag gsum re dang / lug lnga brgya lhag yod pa'i khyim tshang gis mtsher mo bcu re/ la lo khyur longs pa'i khyim tshang gis rta dang rgod ma gcig re ster dgos pa dang / de min slang nang ma'i sde ba yongs kyis ra bha 'dre mig tshang la mgo sbra dang ca lag bsgrig dgos pa dang /slang phyi ma yongs kyis rin chen rkyal kha tshang la mgo spra dang ca lag bsgrig 185

'tshub ma kher rtsang /dgos pa'i bka' gsung mi 'gyur brag ri 'dra ba de kun khyab tu bsgrags pa na/ brgya dpon mang shas de la yid 'thad byung ste ngo so bstod pa dang /lhag par sngon chad kha nas tshig ngan shor myong ba'i brgya dpon rnams kyis jus bkod de ni rang nyid bde sa dang yangs sar 'bud pa'i go skabs gal chen zhig la brtsis te rtsal rgu gdon pa'i dam bca' yid la bcangs/zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin/ sdong ru shog ka gnyis ma'i brgya dpon rnams kyis mgo spra bkal cing rta nor lug gsum ded de snga rjes su dpon tshang gi lhas 'dabs la bslebs pa na/ stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar gyis mgo spra dang ca lag gi spus ka la zhib lta dang / rta nor lug gsum gyi grangs ka blangs rjes khag gnyis su bgos te/ ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha gnyis la sprad pa dang / de nas lhan 'dzoms byung ba'i brgya dpon dang lo lon rnams la gsol ston rgya chen bshams te bza' ba sha mar thud gsum dang btung ba ja chang gis mgron kun tshims par byas rjes/ tshe rnam zer ba'i brgya dpon bgres po rabs chad cig yod pa de'i thob dang tham ga ra bha 'dre mig la sprod dgos pa'i re ba bton/rin chen rkyal kha dga' bde chos skyong ber nag gi sprul sku yin par thugs thag bcad rung / bkur ste byed mkhan re gnyis las ma byung / de 'dra yin na'ang kho tshang la lug sum brgya dang rta nor chig brgya lhag thob par ma zad/ mgo sbra dang ca lag gsar ba cha tshang byung bas/ bza' mi kun 186

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/gyis stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar la bka' drin zhu bzhin bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba rol mgo brtsams/ ra bha 'dre mig tshang la mtshon na/ a ma skyi mgo la dga' snang chen po byung ba ma gtogs/ ra bha 'dre mig la de las ldog ste skyid snang spu tsam yang ma byung / khos nyin mo nor lug rnams 'tsho skabs/ rta nor thag ring la song na bor 'gro ba dang / lug khyu gzhan la 'dres na rang zog ngos mi zin bsams nas/ zog khyu lung shur gcig la bkag nas 'tshos pa na/ rta nor lug gsum gyis gang 'dod ltar rtswa za ma thub pas/ sha shed rim gyis je zhan la song ba dang / mtshan mo rkun ma yong bar dogs nas/nam rgyun cung tsam gnyid rjes yar langs te lug lhas dang nor lhas la skor ba re brgyab rjes/ mgo spra'i phog dang nye 'khor la zhib lta byas te/ mi khyi gcig kyang ma mthong na sems pa cung tsam bde la babs te nyal mod/ yud tsam gnyid pa'i rjes su slar yang yar lang dgos pas/ nyin mo 'dug khom med pa dang mtshan mo gnyid khom yang ma byung bas/ lus po nyin bzhin je rid nas je rid du gyur/ a ma skyi mgos tshul de mthong rjes skyo nyams dang bcas g.yog po g.yog mo 'ga' btsal te rta rdzi lug rdzir mngags pa'i re ba bton mod/ khos 'jig rten srid pa'i khams na gzhan la g.yog byed pa lta bu'i las ka thabs rdugs shig med la/ gzhan pa g.yog la bkol pa'i nyes pa las lci ba zhig med ces bshad de/ a ma'i bsam 'char la bden kha ma byin/ khos dang thog gzhan nor brkus nas 'tsho ba rol skabs/ rku byed 187

'tshub ma kher rkyang /pa ni bya ba tha shal ba zhig yin pa'i tshor snang gtan nas byung ma myong mod/nye sngon stobs 'byor dang go gnas la gnam sa bla 'og brjes 'dra'i 'pho 'gyur byung ba na/ thog mar rang nyid mi gas su tshud song snyam ste dga' snang chen po byung ba dang / rjes su 'tsho gnas lta bar 'gyur ldog byung ba dang bstun nas/ gzhan nor rku ba ni bya ba tha shal ba zhig yin pa'i bsam tshul byung ste/ sngar byas la 'gyod pa byed mgo brtsams/ kho rang nyid brgya dpon gyi thob dang tham ga'i bdag po byas pa nas bzung / rang shog gi don dag che chung thams cad phrag la babs pas/ sde don zhu mkhan ha cang mang /mgron po de rigs bslebs te rang nyid kyi yong don bshad pa na/ gcig na srid don gyi nyams myong med pas/ bya ba rnams ji ltar thag gcod dgos mi shes la/ gnyis su mgron po la tshig lan ster skabs rang nyid kyis sngar byas thams cad yid la shar pa na/ 'tshub cha langs te ngo mdog dmar por 'gyur nas yin lugs kyi skad cha mgo rnga can zhig kyang bshad mi thub/ dang thog ra bha 'dre mig la brgya dpon gyi go sa gnangs rjes/ a ye dkon mchog mtsho mo de phrag dog skyes te sems nad dwangs rgyu med pa zhig byung mod/bsam gyin bsam gyin rang khyim yang ra bha 'dre mig gi sde shog la gtogs pas/ mthun thabs 'grig thabs shig btsal nas kho'i 'khon sems bsal thabs ma byas na/ rjes su rang khyim la bde 'jags yod mi srid snyam ste/sngar byas la 'gyod bshags byed bzhin jus bkod la bsam gzhig byas pa na/188

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/ra bha 'dre mig la chung ma med pa dang / rang gi bu mo gangs dkar sgrol ma rang khyim na lus yod pa dran pas/ brgya dpon gyi 'khon sems gnyen gyis bsal dgos bsams byung / bu mo gangs dkar sgrol ma da skabs mo lo nyer bzhi yin la/ mo lo bcu drug la son pa nas bzung gnas bdag gang mang byung mod/ a ye dkon mchog mtsho mos brgya dpon gang rung zhig sa gnyen slong bar re sgug byas te/ bu mo mo lo nyer bzhir lon pa'i bar du rang khyim nas go rgas su btang / mos ra bha 'dre mig tshang dang gnyen gyi 'brel ba byung na/ gcig na ra bha 'dre mig gi 'khon sems bsal te rjes su khang ba'i yang thog brdib la khad pa lta bu'i skrag 'jigs ngang nas 'tsho ba rol mi dgos pa dang / gnyis su rang gi mi rabs la dpon tshang dang gnyen 'brel byung na phyi rabs pa rnams la byas rjes ngom chog pa zhig bzhag pa yin snyam te/rang gi bsam tshul bu mo dang khyo ga gnyis la bshad pa na/ bu mo gangs dkar sgrol ma ni ngang rgyud 'jam zhing pha mas ci bshad dang len byed pa zhig yin pas/ 'thad dang mi 'thad kyi skad cha ci yang ma bshad mod/ khyo gas rkun ma ni brgya dpon byas pa phar zhog gong ma rgyal po'i go sa thob rung sngar bzhin rkun ma zhig yin pas/ mi ngan de lta bur gnyen 'brel byung na khyim tshang gi mtshang dang bu mo'i sdug yin ces bshad de/ ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas med/ khyim tshang gi dbang cha che chung thams cad a ye dkon mchog mtsho mo'i lag na yod pas/ khyo ga'i ngo rgol la grub 'bras ci yang ma byung / mos 189

'tshub ma kher rkyang /rang gi bsam tshul de a ma skyi mgo la bshad pa na/ a ma skyi mgor dga' spro dpag med skyes te/ mchi ma 'don bzhin mo la bka' drin yang yang zhus par ma zad/ bu mo myur ba myur bar rang khyim la bag mar brdzang dgos pa'i re ba bton/mo gnyis gar gros mthun legs po byung rjes/ a ma skyi mgos bkra shis g.yang gi ra ba 'di skabs su bab nas lha yis skyil bzhin 'dug snyam ste 'phrin bzang de bu la bshad/ ma bsams sa nas ra bha 'dre mig la khong khro glo bur ba zhig langs te dkon mchog mtsho mo zer ba'i bud med khyi mo 'dra ba de g.yo jus che ang : zer nas mi 'thad pa'i gnas lugs brgya bshad stong bshad byas/ a ma skyi mgo yang thabs zad de gnyen don de mi 'jog thabs med byung /ston ka gser gyi dus tshigs shar ba na/ ri dang lung ba thams cad ser lam lam byed pa dang / dbyar gyi nyi 'od btsan po de'ang dus tshigs dang bstun nas bsil zhing 'jam pa zhig tu gyur 'dugad lo'i mar sbyin gtong ba'i dus yang bslebs byung bas/ gling tsha tsho dgu'i mi rnams sngar ltar sa der yong / kho tshos dga' bde chos skyong ber nag ldong ru tsho ba na 'khrungs yod pa'i gtam bzang de go rjes/ pho mo rgan gzhon kun la dga' spro dpag med skyes/ mar sbyin gtong ba'i go skabs dang bstun nas/ tsho ba'i stong dpon brgya dpon dang gling gi dpa' rtul che 190

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/'bring chung gsum thams cad slang nang mar phebs te/ rin chen rkyal kha la 'bri g.yag brgya dang rta bzang brgya rtsa brgyad 'tshams zhur phul pa na/ rin chen rkyal khas a lags mkha' lding tshang gi jus bkod ltar sne len gang legs byas te nyin mtshan kun tu gsol ston rgya chen bshams/ dpa' rtul dpon po tshang ma de la 'dzoms nas glu dang gar la rol te/ mar sbyin gtong rgyu'i las ka ni go gnas med pa'i g.yog po rnams la sprad/ra bha 'dre mig stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar gyi sku mdun la song ste/da lo'i tsho khral bsdu lugs bka' 'dri zhib mo byas rjes/ skyid kyi nyi 'od ngo nas 'dzum bzhin rang yul du bslebs skabs/ ya phug na rgan po cha med cig bsdad 'dug la/ zhib lta byas rjes gling tsha tsho dgu'i gu ru nag gyong zer ba de yin pa shes pas kho re zhig ha las par gyur/ ma gzhir khos bgres po de tshang la rku byas myong bar ma zad/ kho'i bu mo me bza' 'bum skyid dang sha mthun rus mthun du gyur yod/ra bha 'dre mig gis gu ru nag gyong mthong ma thag cung dogs mi bde bar gyur na'ang rgad pos kho'i ngo mi shes pa tshor rjes sems rim bzhin bde la ba dri/ khu a/ glo bde mo/ ’tsa bde mo bde mo/ 6 yar langs mi dgos/ sngar mal nas bzhugs/mi 191

'tshub ma kher rkyang /66ya ya migu ru nag gyong sngar mal nas ma 'gul par ra bha 'dre mig la zhib lta byas pa na/ kho ni ha las te hrig nas 'dug dgos byung /snga dror gu ru nag gyong rang nyid gsar bu yin pa'i skabs kyi mna' grogs te ldong ru tsho ba'i rgad po rdo bha zer bar thug nas gnyis ka chang gis cung bzi nas gzhon dus kyi don rnams glings pa na/ gu ru nag gyong gis da lta'i bar su la'ang bshad ma myong ba'i rang nyid gzhon dus mar sbyin gtong ba'i skabs su sdong ru tsho ba'i bu mo zhig dang dus thung thung gi nang thun mong min pa'i 'dod brtse zhig chags pa'i gtam rgyud de bshad pa dang / skabs de'i bu mo'i gnas tshul zhib tu brjod pa na/ rgad po rdo bhas bu mo de ni a ma skyi mgo yin pa 'phral du ngos rin te ma bu gnyis ga'i da lta'i gnas tshul cung lud brjod nas mtshams sbyor byas pas/ gu ru nag gyong dga' skyo zung 'brel gyi ngang 'tshams rtags dang kha btags bzung ste kho tshang la bslebs pa na/ ra bha 'dre mig khyim na mi 'dug mod/ a ma skyi mgo la dga' snang tshad med pa zhig skyes te/ thog mar kho la mgron bsu legs po byas pa dang / de nas kho slang nang mar ga dus yong ba sogs phug 'dri gting 'dri byas pas/gu ru nag gyong 'u thug ste sngar byas thams cad sba gsang med par bshad pa na/mo dga' ste lag pa 'phur 'phur byed bzhin ‘khyod kyi kha mig thams cad ra bha 'dre mig dang gnyis su med pas/ khyod mthong ma thag ra bha 'dre mig sa a 192

ra lha 'dre mig dang rin chen rtsal kha/pha bslebs byung snyam ste dga' snang chen po byed nges/ dus tshod la gzhigs na nga la nor 'phyugs med/ khyod ra bha'i a pha red ces bshad de/mdzod sgam las nas chang blangs te mgron bsu sngar las lhag pa byed mgo brtsams/ gu ru nag gyong gis ra bha 'dre mig dngos su mthong ba na/ kho'i yid kyi dogs gzhi de skad cig nyid la chag med du gyur te ci byed 'di byed med par gyur/ ra bha 'dre mig gi lus ni cung tsam ring rung / mig dang kha sna thams cad dang / de min skad cha 'chad lugs tshang ma rang gi bu mgon skyabs dang gnyis su med/66ra ga kho ni khyod kyi a pha red/’ a ma skyi mgos spro snang dang bcas de lta 6bshad/mi 6 we/ had nas ci bya/ kho ni khyod kyi a pha red/mi ra bha 'dre mig gis a mas ci bshad gsal bor go ba na/ thog mar da 'grig song snyam nas dga' snang chen po byung ba dang / de nas gu ru nag gyong gi bu mo me bza' 'bum skyid la lus 'brel yod pa de yid la shar pas/skad cig nyid la lus kun zin cing dran pa 'thor song / de nas yud tsam gyi rjes su dran pa sos mod/ 'jigs snang dang bcas had nas re zhig 'gor pa na/ slar yang lus kun srid de sngangs 'tshab dang bcas ag rgyangs byed bzhin spra sgor bros/6 ra bha/mi 193

'tshub ma kher sgrung /zu ra bha/ nga khyod kyi a pha yin/mi le'u bcu pa/da skabs/ stong dpon khro rgyal ber dkar gyi mnga' 'og gi brgya /sbya/ /kā // smyos te rang mgo rang gis mi 'khyongs pa ni ra bha 'dre mig 194

'tshub ma kher rkyang /dngapo/nam rgyun dang 'dra bar/ dgun gyi gnam gshis de ha cang 'khyagaskabs shig la/ 'tshub ma kher rkyang zhig skya yom yom/ zed slog slog byed bzhin nub nas shar la ldang mgo brtsams/'tshub ma kher rkyang de kho gnyis yod sa'i grog shur chung chung de yi 'gram la bslebs pa na/ nye 'gram gyi rtsi to dang 'jag mas mgo lcog ldem bzhin shugs glu dbyangs su gyer ba dang / bar snang nas sa rdul sib sib tu babs byung bas/ re zhig la/ kho gnyis ka mig zung btsums te kha rog ger ma 'gul ma 'phag par bsdad/ yud tsam gyi rjes su/ 'tshub ma kher rkyang de rim gyis shar la ldang ba dang bstun nas/ khor lug thams cad dal cag ger song mod/ gar yong 'di yong med pa'i pho rog cig kho gnyis kyi mgo 195

'tshub ma kher rtsang /klad la yong ste lding skor byed bzhin byang la 'phur ba na/ bsod nams dbang mor nyams snang ci yang med rung / mgon po bkra shis kyis de ni chag sgo zhig gis snga ltas yin par snyam pas sems pa gzer breng nger song /mgon po bkra shis kyis sun snang dang bcas mgo bo yar bkyags nas pho rog gi rjes la bltas pa na/ grang ngar khrod na gshog 'gyur byed bzhin yod pa'i 'dab chags nag po de ni stong ba'i dbyings na rang dbang med par g.yo ba'i bal rdog cig dang mtshungs/ khos nag thig srog ldan de la bltas kyin bltas kyin yid kyi 'tshub cha ngang gis zhi ba dang / lus kun la ngal zhing dub pa'i tshor snang byung bas/ re zhig la rang gi brang 'og la mi zhig mnan 'dug pa'ang brjed song /pho rog de dal ba dal bur 'phur bzhin pa'i skabs/ glo bur du ci zhig mthong ba ltar myur stabs kyis mar bcums pa na/ skad cig nyid la mi snang bar gyur/ mgon po bkra shes kyis tshul de mthong bas/ ci zhig bor pa lta bu'i tshor snang glo bur ba zhig byung ste/ mgo rnga med pa'i dngan pa ring bo zhig 'then bzhin ci dran 'di dran med par mar bltas pa na/ bsod nams dbang mos sdug snang dang bcas mgo bo g.yas la dkyogs shing mig za~X deb tsam byed pa mthong bas/ sngangs 'tshub dang bcas mgo g.yon la da gaXbo/ bas bsod nams dbang mos bzod sron dang bcas de ltar 196

bshad/66 6bobs ya 6 ci red/mi mgon po bkra shis kyis rang nongs de sba ched/ gdong la ci mi /nyam pa'i nyams 'gyur bcos ma zhig bsdus te btsan shugs kyis de skad 61ci/ red zer ram/ khyod khyi red/ bobs ya/ zhon shes pa las 'bab mi shes pa yin nam/mi bsod nams dbang mos khro nyams dang bcas de ltar bshad/mgon po bkra shis ni mi pho khog dpung can zhig yin pas/ rang nyid khyi gras la bzhag pa'i gtam de go ba na khong khro glo bur ba zhig langs pa dang /khong khro de dang bstun nas spobs pa chen po zhig kyang skyes byung bas/ 'dzem bag dang nongs sems ci yang med par mo'i gdong la cer nas bsdad pa na/bsod nams dbang mo'ang re zhig la had song ba ltar 'dugamagon po bkra shes kyis mi lo bco lnga tsam la bsod nams dbang mo'i gdong la lta ma myong bas/ de ring glo bur du gdong la cer nas zhib lta byas pa na/ dang thog mi cha med cig mthong lam la mngon pa'i tshor snang byung /bsod nams dbang mo chung dus su ha cang mdzes pas/ sde ba chung chung 'di la grags skad ha cang che/ 'on kyang / shu wa ltos dang / chung dus skad cha bshad shes pa'i khra chung mig gnyis ka ni rgas te sa rkong re la ril ma 197

'tshub ma kher rkyang /'phangs pa dang mtshungs shing / dkar la dmar mdangs chags pa'i mkhur bar tshi dreg tsam las ngang mdangs spu tsam yang mi mthong / smin ma g.yon pa'i gong rol na blo la 'bab pa'i sme ba nag po zhig mchis pa de je cher phyin nas ril ma phyed ka lta bu zhig tu gyur 'dug pa dang / steng na spu nyag nag po zhig yengs yengs su g.yo bzhin gda'/ mgon po bkra shis kyis tshul de mthong bas sngar byas la 'gyod pa drag po skyes/6 bobs ya smyo kha rog a thang chad de 'gul 'dod 'phag 'dod ci yang med/mi 6 khyi rgan/ mar bobs/mi bsod nams dbang mor khong khro langs te ngo mdangs dmar por gyur/6 kha rog khyi zer ram/ dang thog khyod rgya sgo 'dra zhig dgrad dus/ nga ni mdzes sdug lha yi gzhon nu zhig la 'phyugs pa yin nam/mi mgon po bkra shis kyis khengs nyams dang bcas de ltar bshad/bsod nams dbang mo'i yid sems rab tu pham song /mos ngu rgyangs byed bzhin stobs bshugs yod rgu bton nas 'phag mod/ mgon po bkra shis ni skyes pa stobs ldan zhig yin pas thar thabs ma byung ba na sems pa sngar las pham pa dang / pham sems dang bcas don gyi mgo mjug kun la bsam gzhig yud tsam byas pa na/ khong khro snga na med pa zhig glo bur du langs byung bas/ bzod glags med par ag rgyangs byed 198

'tshub ma kher chung /zhor du/ g.yon lag mgon po bkra shis kyi thong rtser 'jus pa dang / g.yas lag kho'i skra lor 'thams te stobs shugs yod rgu bton nas sprug sprug yang yang byas pa na/ mgon po bkra shis sngangs 'tshab dang bcas mar babs te/sngar byas la 'gyod gdung dang bcas sa la tsog nas bsdad/bsod nams dbang mo myur mor yar langs rjes/ thog mar byang cha yod pa'i sgo nas tshar lu ljang khu de la ska rags bcings pa dang / de nas brel 'tshub dang bcas gom pa spo zhor du lan bu nang gi rtswa chag rnams gtsang len byas rjes/ mgo gcud glo dmar de mgo la dkri bzhin lam la chas pa na/mgon po bkra shis kyis kha rog ger mo'i gom sgra la nyan nas bsdad/ grog shur klad la 'gos ma thag mos glo bur du 'gro mtshams bzhag ste lus stod g.yas la dkyogs nas 'phongs tshos ngos la lta tsam byas rjes/ brel 'tshub dang bcas sog rgyab dang 'phongs tshos ngos kyi sa rdul sprug mgo brtsams/skabs shig la/ mos lta phyogs tsam gyis sngar mal na ci byed 'di byed med par sgongs ser tsog 'dug pa'i mgon po bkra shis mthong ba na/ khong khro dang bcas mchil ma 'byar bag can zhig kho yi phyogs la 'phangs te/ lus kyi rdul yang mi sprug par gom pa shugs kyis spo bzhin mdun la song /nam mkha' sngo thing nger/ sa gzhi skya yom mer/ yod tshad la gson shugs bral cing rgyad ltas mngon pa'i snang ba ster/ ltos dang / nyi ma ni khrag tshan byugs pa rnga bo che zhig dang 'dra bar dmar lam mer nub rir snyeg 199

'tshub ma kher rkyang /zhor du/ zhen kha phyogs ris med pa'i 'od snang de ri lung kun la gtor bzhin mchis mod/ dgun gsum grang lhags la gdug rtsub che bas/ sgo me dgo thang la lam lam 'phros pa'i nyi 'od de la mun pa bsal ba'i nus mthu las drod khol gnang ba'i mthu stobs med par gyur/sgo me dgo thang ni rdo dkar sde ba'i dgun sa yin la/ thang chen g.yer mo 'di'i thang stod ni stong gi 'brong la ring mo dang 'brel zhing thang rgyab rdo dkar gtsang bor gtad yod pa dang / thang gi mgo mjug bar gsum du rtsi to ni gro zhing btab pa ltar skyes yod/ than skyon med cing char ba 'bab zhod che ba'i lo la/ dgun stod kyi skabs su/ char chu 'khyil sa'i gshong rkong mang bo'i rtsi to'i khrod la rta nor song na lus kun nub 'gro/ da lo dbyar dus char chu dkon pas/ rtswa yi skyes tshad bzang gras su gtogs dka' mod/ ru rnams dgun sar mnyam spor byas nas zla gcig lhag 'gor rung / rtswa mgo rnog pa tsam las rtswa rdzong ni sngar bzhin rdzubs pas/ snga mor rtswa yis 'grangs pa'i nor lug rnams lhas la 'ded pa'i dus la ma son rung / rang 'gul sgos rang lhas phyogs la log 'gro/ lhag par de ring grang ngar che bas/ nor lug slar log pa'i dus tshod nam rgyun las snga/ ltos dang / de ring snga dro nas bzung / bsod nams dbang mo grog shur chung chung de las thar ma thub rung / mo'i nor lug rnams ci zhig gis ded pa ltar rang gi lhas 'dabs la son 'dug pa dang / mgon po bkra shis kyi lug khyu ni kho tshang gi rgyab phyogs 200

'tshub ma kher rkyang /kyi grog mo de la rub 'dug lo tshang gi ba lang rnams gang la song 'o/pha gir 'dug ba lang rnams ni a khu mchog ldan tshang gi thal phung g.yas g.yon la rub 'dug pa dang / glang rgan ske dkar gcig pu ba lang rnams kyi mtha' ru langs te mgo bo g.yas skyog g.yon skyog byed bzhin mchis la par brdos na kha nang la rus pa chen po zhig bzung ste 'cha' bzhin yod pa'i snang ba ram/gon po bkra shis kyi bsam don yongs su grub ste ci bsam 'di bsam med par dbo lug tu bsdad 'dug skabs/ lhags rlung 'khyag po zhig dal ba dal bur langs pa dang bstun nas/ g.yogs ma'i phu thung gnyis ka lhab lhab tu g.yos pa dang / kho la lus kun grang ba'i tshor snang byung bas/ da gzod 'dug ran ma yin 'gro ran yin pa yid la shar/ khos g.yas lag sa la khen nas langs grabs byed skabs/ sa na che chung mi 'dra ba'i rjes shul dar kor kha shas 'dug pa mthong bas/ thog mar sa la gog nas rjes shul re rer zhib lta byas pa dang / de nas rjes shul rnams la g.yas skor gcig dang g.yon skor gnyis byas/ skor ba de gsum brgyud nas khos thog mar bsod nams dbang mo'i 'phongs tshos dang mgo bo'i rjes shul ngos zin pa dang /de nas rang gi pus mo dang rdog sne/ gru mo bcas kyi rjes shul yang rnyed byung /khos rang gi ngos zin de yang dag yin pa ra sprod byed ched/ rang gi rdog sne'i rjes shul la rdog sne dang / pus mo'i rjes shul la pus mo sprad de gog pa 201

'tshub ma kher rkyang /na/ bsod nams dbang mo'i mgo bo'i rjes shul de mig lam la gsal ler mngon byung / khos rjes shul de la bltas kyin bltas kyin na chung bu mo lta na sdug pa zhig gi zhal ras mig lam la glog brnyan bzhin du 'phos pa dang /tshor snang de dang bstun nas lus stobs kyang glo bur du rgyas byung bas/ myur stabs kyis yar langs zhor du ska rags mchan la bcir nas rgyug thengs gcig gis grog shur klad la bud/bsod nams dbang mo brel 'tshub dang bcas mdun la 'gro bzhin mchis/ mgon po bkra shis kyis mo'i rgyab gzugs la lta bzhin krong nger langs pa na/ thog mar yid sems stong hang nger song ba dang / yud tsam gyi rjes su de ring gi lag rjes dmigs bsal can de dran pa na/ yid sems rim gyis spro bas khyab mod/ kho gnyis ga'i byis pa'i dus kyi 'tsho ba de dran skabs sems pa skad cig nyid la pham ste dngan pa ring bo zhig 'ben dgos byung /mgon po bkra shes dang bsod nams dbang mo gnyis ka byis pa yin dus/ lo mang ring la khyim tshang gnyis ka ru skor khyim mtshes byas nas nor lug 'tsho skyong byas pa na/ kho gnyis la chung chung lu gu mnyam 'tsho dang yang chung me tog mnyam 'thu byed pa'i skal ba byung bas/ rim gyis phan tshun bar la brtse dungs rma med pa zhig chags te 'bral thabs med par gyur/ khyim bdag rnams kyis tshul de mthong bas nam rgyun ku re'i skad cha sna tshogs 202

'tshub ma kher rkyang /bshad pa na/ dang thog kho gnyis kha skyengs te ngo mdangs dmar por 'gyur 'gro mod/ dus tshod kyi 'gyangs 'gor dang bstun nas ku re'i skad cha 'dra bshad rung / kho gnyis dgod pa tsam las snang dogs spu tsam yang med par ma zad/ lhan du be'u rdzi sogs la 'gro skabs/ ri nas rdo yi khyim gzhi bsgrigs te 'jom bag ci yang med par khyo shug gi rtsed mor rol nges yin/rjes su sde ba'i mtsher sa bkod sgrig byed lugs la 'gyur ldog byung ste/ khyim tshang gnyis ka so sor gyes pa na/ bsod nams dbang mor rtsed grogs gzhan byung ba dang bstun nas mgon po bkra shes rim gyis brjed de/ gang sa gang nas phrad rung nyams snang ci yang med par gyur/ 'on kyang / mgon po bkra shis de 'dra gtan nas min/ kho gnyis kha gyes pa nas bzung / khos mo la bcangs pa'i brtse sems de nyin bzhin je zab nas je zab tu gyur par ma zad/ lang tsho'i me tog rim gyis bzhad pa dang bstun nas/ khos bsod nams dbang mo la bcangs pa'i brtse sems de yi rang bzhin la 'gyur ldog chen po byung ste/ chung dus pha mas ku re'i tshul du bshad pa'i skad cha de rnams bden pa yin na ci ma rung / kho gnyis rtse ra chung chung re la lhan du 'dzoms te rtsed mo sna tshogs la rol ba de don dam yin na ci ma rung snyam song / skabs der/ gang sa gang nas bsod nams dbang mo dang phrad skabs/ kho la dogs mi bde ba'i tshor snang thun mong ma yin pa zhig 'byung ste/mo'i gdong la lta mi phod par ma zad/ stobs shugs zad de skad cha shab shub 203

'tshub ma kher rkyang /tsam las bshad mi phod/ 'on kyang / kho gnyis gyes rjes/ kho'i spobs pa myur mor slar rgyas par 'gyur bar ma zad/ ‘ nga la ci byung / de ring yang sems gtam 'o ma 'dra ba de bshad ma phod/mi snyam pa na/ 'gyod pa dang bcas rang gi brla thog la thal lcag gis gzhus te 'khang ra byas pa dang /'gyod pa chen po skyes pa'i skabs su rang dbang med par ki rgyangs re'ang byed dgos pa byung mod/ rjes su slar yang phrad dus/ 'bad pa ga 'dra byas rung sngar bzhin sems gtam tshig gcig bshad pa'i spobs pa bral/ lhag par mo a khu dpal 'byor tshang gi mna' mar gyur pa na/ mo gang nas mthong na gzha' thabs gzur thabs byed dgos pas/ sems gtam dang dran gdung de dus kun sems kyi btson la 'gugs dgos byung /de ring mgon po bkra shes grog shur 'di la 'dzul nas nyi mar lde 'dug skabs/ bsod nams dbang mo gar yong 'dir yong med par glo bur du bslebs pa na/ kho la sngangs 'tshub glo bur ba zhig skyes byung bas/ myur stabs kyis yar langs te 'gro rtsis byas mod/ mos dgod pa'i gdangs kyisar khyod kyang lug rdzi yin nam zhes dris rjes/ 'dzem bag dang the tshom ci yang med par kho yi gam la yong nas sa la bsdad pa na/ kho'i lus kun sbrid de re zhig la blong blong bor gyur pa las 'gro sems 'dug sems ci yang med par gyur/ skabs shig la/ mgon po bkra shis blong blong bor sa la bsdad mod/204

'tshub ma kher rtsang /kho la mtshon na ga dus bsdad pa dang ji ltar bsdad pa gtan nas mi shes/gang ltar kho'i dran pa sos skabs/ bsod nams dbang mos yid la gang shar dang sems la gang dran 'dzem bag med par brjod de kha brda byed bzhin yod pa dang / khos mgo bo sgur sgur dang lus po sgong sgong byas te ci bshad kun la nyan gyin 'dug rung / skabs bab dang bstun nas skad cha tshig gsum bshad pa par zhog tha na kha brda'i tshig 'gros dang bstun nasaphared/mi dang yin/mi la sogs lta bu'i tshig lan stabs bde tsam yang ster mi phod par zhum nyams dang bcas bsdad 'dug khos bsam gzhig tsam byas pa na/ kho'i tshugs ka de ni byis pa nongs can zhig a ma'i gam la bslebs pa dang gnyis su mi 'dug snyam ste ngo nongs mod/ rang sems rang gis gsos te u tshugs dang brtson pa ga 'dra byas rung / mgo bo yar bkyags nas mo'i gdong la lta ba dang / mo'i tshig 'gros dang bstun nas 'dzem bag med par kha brda byed pa'i dpa' sems dang spobs pa gtan nas med pas/gdung sems dang bcas sngar bzhin mgo bo sgur sgur dang lus po sgong sgong byas nas mi 'dug ka med byung /bsod nams dbang mo ni bshad la dga' ba'i bud med kha bde rtse bde zhig yin la/ gal srid rang la bshad khom dang gzhan la nyan khom yod na/nyin hril bor rang gcig pus bshad dgos rung / kha tshig kha brdar rdzogs mtha' yod mi srid/ de ring grog shur 'di la yong ste sar bsdad rjes/ thog 205

'tshub ma kheng rkyang /mar rang nyid sku 'bum dang bya khyung sogs la gnas skor du phyin pa'i brgyud rim zhib bshad byas pa dang / de nas sde ba'i khral rigs sdud lugs de khrims mthun lugs mthun min pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad/ skabs shig la/ mos ci zhig dran pa ltar dngan pa ring bo zhig 'ben rjes/ rang khyim la dpe blangs te deng skabs kyi byis pa rnams ma rabs pra tshag yin lugs/ kha len tshig brtsi med tshul sogs dpe don gnyis kyi sgo nas zhib bshad byas pa na/mgon po bkra shis kyis nyan gyin nyan gyin mo'i gtam gyis yid sems phrogs te lus sems cung tsam bde la babs pa dang / bde snang de dang bstun nas ngag las bden pa la ang zhes pa'i bden kha ster ba'i tshig de shor pas/thog mar nongs sems glo bur ba zhig byung ba dang bstun nas sngangs 'dar glo bur ba zhig byas pa dang / de nas ci bshad kun la zhib nyan byed bzhin bsam gzhig yud tsam byas pa na/ rang gi spobs par yar rgyas cung zad byung song snyam nas dga' spro skyes/ bsod nams dbang mos mgon po bkra shis kyi nyams 'gyur thun min de ma rtogs mod/ mo la bden kha byin pa'i tshig lan stabs bde de go ma thag dga' spro snga na med pa byung ste/ kha brda byed pa'i spro snang sngar las je cher 'phel/ skabs shig la/ mos glo lu tsam byas rjes 'dang re brgyab na/ deng skabs kyi byis pa tsho la'ang khag mi 'dug mices bshad rjes/ spro sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas kho gnyis ma'i byis pa'i dus kyi 'tsho ba de glengs byung / mgon po bkra shes la cha mtshon na/ tshe 206

'tshub ma kher rtsang /gcig lus gcig nyid la gtan nas brjed thabs med pa ni byis pa'i dus kyi 'tsho ba de yin pas/ bsod nams dbang mos gtam gyi sgo mo phye ste 'das don gang zhig glengs na/ de ma thag 'das don glog brnyan ji bzhin 'bur gzugs dang tshon mdog gis 'char yang / khos spro sems dang bcas mos ci bshad kun la zhib tu nyan pa na/ skabs shig la ya chung las drod jig cig 'phos te sems khong drod lam mer byas pa dang / rim gyis rkang mthil lam gang zhig nas ngar lam lam byed pa'i rlung bu zhig langs te rtsa lam kun la dal gyis khyab pa'i tshor snang byung / skabs der/ khos bzod bsran byed bzhin mgo bo skur sgur dang lus po sgong sgong byas nas mos ci bshad la nyan pa na/ rlung bu de nyid sngar ltar sgab rtsa dang 'phar rtsa kun la snyom par ldang ba dang bstun nas/ lus kun sbos nas tsha lam lam byed pa dang / 'phar rtsa lhog lhog 'phar ba dang mnyam du mgo bo lhem lhem 'dar bar ma zad/mo'i skad gdangs kyang skabs rer mtho zhing skabs rer dma' ba'i tshor snang byung / skabs shig la/ kho'i g.yas lag de su zhig gis btsan gyis 'ben pa ltar rang dbang med par par bsrings te mo'i lag pa la 'jus pas/bsod nams dbang mo re zhig la had nas hrig ger 'dug dgos byung ba dang / khos nongs sems chen po dang bcas lag pa glod rtsis byas mod/rang gi lag pa rang la mi dbang ba dang mtshungs/dal cag ger/207

'tshub ma kher rkyang /mgon po bkra shes kyi kha brda'i klong de glo bur du brdol byung / 'di ni bsod nams dbang mo la mtshon na dngos 'brel bsam yul las 'das pa zhig red/ khos sngar bzhin mo'i gdong la lta mi phod pas/ mgo bo smin legs snye ma'i mgo lcog ltar dud 'dug rung / mor dungs tshul dang mo dran tshul sogs gleng skabs the tshom dogs gzhi spu tsam mchis pa par zhog dpa' nyams dang skyo nyams chen pos tshig mgo shwa 'od brdol brdol dang tshig rnga lug khyu zhogs zhogs byas nas yin lugs zhib bshad byas pa na/ mos kyang rgol lan med par mig skong mchi mas brlan nas nyan dgos byung / skabs zhig la/ khos the tshom ci yang med par lu gnyis la tshe gcig gi bsod nams med rung / thengs gcig gi las dbang yod dgos zer nas rang gi tshe stod kyi re ba de bshad pa na/ bsod nams dbang mor 'jigs snang glo bur ba zhig byung ste/ myur stabs kyis yar langs rtsis byus mod/ mgon po bkra shis kyis bde myur dang bcas mo tshur 'then te mchan la bcir byung bas/ bsod nams dbang mo ni rgya khras bzung ba'i bye'u chung ltar shor thabs thar thabs gtan nas med par gyur/bsod nams dbang mos zhu ba byas na'ang 'dra/ khong khro langs na'ang chog ste/ mgon po bkra shis kyis rang gi re ba de zhib bshad byed pa las/mos ci bshad la kha ya dang do snang spu tsam yang mi byed pas/ 'u thug ste kha rog ger 'dug dgos byung /208

'tshub ma kher rkyang /bsod nams dbang mo grog shur 'di la bslebs rjes/ rang gi nor lug gar 'gro gang 'dug la lan gcig kyang ma bltas pas/ dus tshod kyi 'gyangs 'gor dang bstun nas sems la 'tshub cha chen po langs mod/thabs bkod ci yod/ bsam don ma 'grub na mgon po bkra shis kyis mo gtong rtsis gtan nas med/ skabs shig la/ mo 'u thug pa'i khar sems kyi 'tshub cha bzod glags med pa de ma non te/ khong khro dang bcas 'phag ra pa/ sduga' byas rjes/ rang lus bem po zhig dang 'dra bar kho'i mdun du gnyis pa/dgun gyi kha ba thog ma de ni glo bur du babs byung /kha ba babs pa'i snga nyin/ nam rgyun nub nas shar la ldang bzhin yod pa'i lhags rlung gdug rtsub can de glo bur du kha phyogs 'gyur te/ ci zhig la rngam pa ltar shar nas nub la ldang ba na/ sgo me dgo thang gi rtsi tos shugs glu len bzhin mgo lcog nub la ldem pa dang / rdzi bo rnams kyis lhags rlung la rgyab gtad de ngo gdong nub la phyogs nas bsdad rung / grang ngar gdug rtsub can des gong ba la sogs brgyud nas lus la dpung 'jug byed pas/kho tshos ske sgong sgong dang lus kum kum byed bzhin nor lug gar 'gro la lta zhor du nyi ma tshang la bzhud par re sgug byas/ 'on kyang / lhags rlung chen 209

'tshub ma kher rkyang /po 'di ni kha ba chen po zhig gi sna 'dren yin pa sus kyang ma rtogs la/ zhing chen rlung 'phrin khang gi gnam gshis sngon brda las kyang ma bshad/mtshan mo der/ byis pa gnyis ka gnyid du yur rjes/ mgon po bkra shis khyo shug gnyis ku'i las ka de goms srol dang dgos mkho ltar mgo brtsams byung / skabs shig la/ chung ma 'phags 'tsho ni tsha rlangs sam yang na 'dun pa zhig gis gyen la spur te/ dbyar dgun gyi dbye ba med pa'i spang ljongs g.yer mo zhig gi mkha' dbyings la bslebs pa na/ mthong lam gyi ri rab rta phur 'dra ba de mo'i re smon dang bstun nas yar 'phags mod/ rtse mos char sprin rngams ka can de brtol la nye dus/ ri rab lhun po de je dma' nas je dmar song bas/ mos brel 'tshub dang bcas rtsal dgu bton nas mchong lding byed zhor du/ ham rngam dang bcas ri rab de nyid slar yang gyen la 'phags pa'i gsol ba btab pa na/ ri rab ni je mtho nas je mtho/je mtho nas je mthor song / skabs shig la/ nyi ma che chung med pa dgu mthongs la 'phags te spang ljongs g.yer mo de nyid skad cig nyid la sbar ba dang / gzhob dri'i khrod du char sprin rngams ka can de las char ba shag shag tu babs pa na/ spang ljongs g.yer mo de la slar yang me tog sna tshogs khra lam mer bzhad mod/ nyi ma re re nub la bzhud pa dang bstun nas/ sa gzhi thams cad mun pas bzung ba dang / mo'ang a thang chad de ri rab de la re ltos dang char sprin de la snang sems ci yang med par gyur/210

'tshub ma kher rkyang /lus shugs rtsed 'jo drag po de la rol rjes/ chung ma 'phags 'tsho ni a thang chad de/ ci dran 'di dran med par gnyid du yur/ mos dal lhod lhod kyis me la phu 'debs pa ltar phu btab pa dang / de nas ci zhig ldan bzhin 'khun sgra gsal la mi gsal ba zhig bton rjes/ sngar srol ltar phu 'debs bzhin sdur ba than thun de 'ben mgo brtsams/ mgon po bkra shis kyis chung ma'i mid par ci zhig khegs pa lta bu'i sdur sgra rdzob po de la nyan gyin nyan gyin sun snang glo bur ba zhig skyes pas/ myur stabs dang bcas phar 'khor pa na/ g.yon lag gi gru mo 'phags 'tsho'i myos bum chen po la thogs pa dang bstun nas/ 'dre mo 'chi med ma 'di'i brang gi sha lha de gnyis rlan shur shur byed pa'i a krad cha gcig dang mtshungs/ gal srid gam na gnyid 'dug pa ni bsod nams dbang mo yin na/ sdur sgra rdzob po 'di ༷drar nyan mi dgos la/ yid sems kyang bde ldan zhing na yod nges snyam nga /mgon po bkra shis kyi mig lam la bsod nams dbang mo'i snang brnyan sna tshogs gcig 'phror gcig brgyud mar mthun nas 'phos pa na/ gnyid ni gtan nas mi khugs pas/ rang sems kyi gtam rgyud de la byung rim bkod sgrig byed bzhin kha rog ger bsdad/nyin mtshan gang yin rung / mgon po bkra shis kyi lus sems gnyis ka khom pa na/ de ma thag bsod nams dbang mo dran yong ba dang / bsod 211

'tshub ma kher rkyang /nams dbang mo dran pa dang bstun nas/ kho gnyis chung dus byis blo 'dris lugs/ gzhon dus zhe sems mthun lugs/ de'i rjes gzhis khyim 'dzin lugs rang gi phugs bsam dang 'dod mos ltar rtog bzo byed pa ni kho'i goms srol thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin/ goms srol de yun ring la rgyun 'dzin dam po byas pa na/ dus skabs re re'i sems khams dang mos pa mi 'dra bas/ byung rim kha shas la snon 'phri dang 'gyur ldog byung rung / dus kyi 'gyangs 'gor/ spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur sogs dang bstun nas byung rim zhib phra ldan pa'i gtam rgyud legs po zhig ngang gis grub byung / 'on kyang /da lo mo'i lus po thob rjes/ kho sngar gyi gtam rgyud rnying ba de la sun snang skyes te/ bsod nams dbang mo'i gdong gi gos nyams chen po de mig 'phrul yin par sgom pa'i zhoradu/ mo sgrol ma 'bum dang gyes te rang gi gam la bslebs pa de nas mgo brtsams te gzhis khyim 'dzin lugs rtog bzo byas pa yin mod/ 'byung 'gyur gyi 'tsho ba'i 'gyur ldog la yid tshod med pas/gtam rgyud rnying ba de la sun snang ga 'dra skyes rung / de yi byung rim legs po rnams skabs bab dgos mkho dang bstun nas tshur len mi byed ka med byung / do dgong khos sngar bzhin gtam rgyud gsar ba de blo bzo byas pa na/kho ho thog thu'i('phags pa'i)cho lo yod pa'i bla ma chen po zhig gi yab tu gyur pas/ spro snang chen po dang bcas de mthun gyi byung rim phra zhing phra ba rnams rtog bzo byed mgo brtsams/212

'tshub ma kher rkyang /skabs shig la/ bu chung rgya mtshos rto hrug hrug tu 'chos pa dang / de nas ha cang bzod dka' ba'i nyams kyis lus po kum kum byed bzhin yud tsam la bsdad rjes/ glo bur du sad de myur stabs kyis tsog byung / 6ci red/ 〉 bu chung gis kho'i gtam rgyud kyi rtog bzo la bar chad byas pas/ khong khro dang bcas mgo bo yar brkyags nas de skad dris/smyo gcin pa gtong bar 'gro dgos/’ 6 song / 'chi khar gtam ma mang / nyal khar chu ma mang zer na mi nyan/ rem ya/ ’6 ya ya rgya mtsho sgren por tsha thab las mar babs/ kho nyig sgra dang bcas khang sgor bud de gom pa 'ga' spos ma thag ag rgyangs byed bzhin myur stabs kyis phyir nur byas te khang sgo dkar nag mtshams la bslebs rjes/ ci yin 'di yin med par gcin pa shag ser btang byung /smyo khyod la ci byung / mgon po bkra shis la 'tshub cha langs zu a chu chu/ kha ba babs 'dug 64'o/ kha ba babs pa yin nam/mi rgya mtsho myur stabs kyis khyim la brgyugs yong ste nu bo'i rum la 'dzul pa na/ rkang mthil nu bo'i gang zhig la thogs ma thag nu bos kyang sngangs 'tshub dang bcas ag rgyangs lan zhig byas rjes/ a chu steng la a chu 213

'tshub ma kher rkyang /brtsegs mod/ 'phags 'tsho ni sad pa par zhog tha na 'gul tsam yang mi byed/ tshul de mthong bas/ mgon po bkra shis khong khro langs te/ myur mor yar langs nas mo'i mgo bor rdog rdzi lan 'ga' byas na ang snyam/dgun gyi kha ba thog ma de ni ha cang mthug mdo dbus mtho sgang gi yul gru mang shos la kha ba 'di 'dra babs na/ khangs skyon byung ste nor lug mang po ltogs grir 'chi nges yin mod/ dgo thang la kha ba ga 'dra babs rung rtsi to ni snub thabs med pas mi rnams kyis kha ba babs 'dug pa mthong ba na/6 a la la/ kha ba mthug pa la ang zhes brjod pa las khangs gnod la sems khur gtan nas mi byed par ma zad/ nor lug rnams chu khar 'ded ༵ dgos pa de dran na/ kha ba babs pa ni bde skyid cig la'ang rtsi bzhin da/ kha ba babs rjes/ rdzi bo rnams kyis nor lug lam gcig la ded nas sa gcig la gtor ba dang / rjes su nor lug ma song sa'i kha ba mthug po de lhags pas sra mkhregs can du bsgyur nas phyugs kyi bgrod lam bkag pa na/dus tshod nges can zhig gi rjes su/ khyim tshang so so'i lhas rgyab la che chung mi 'dra ba'i rjes shul phyags ma chen po 'dra ba re re babs/mtho sa nas bltas na/ dud khyim phyug po rnams kyi lhas 'dabs nas phyugs kyi kha ba'i nang gi rjes shul phyags ma'i dbyibs can de'i yu ba khyim dang mgo bo thang la gtad de phyags ma chen po re bsnyel 'dug pa dang /214

'tshub ma kher rtsang /dbul bo rnams kyi lhas rgyab na phyags ma chung chung re las med/ de min/ rdzi bo brtson ldan rnams kyis kha ba babs ma thag nor lug rgyang la ded pa na/lhas rgyab kyi phyags ma'i yu ba de phyags ma gzhan las ring / mgon po bkra shis ni rdzi bo brtson ldan zhig min mod/ bsod nams dbang mo'i 'phongs tshos kyi rjes shul la lta chen nor lug rgyang la den pa na/ kho tshang gi lhas rgyab kyi phyags ma de la'ang yu ba ring bo zhig byung bar ma zad/ kha ba babs pa'i phyi nyin/ khos nor lug rnams grog shur mar gsham nas phyir bskor te/rang nyid kyis brjed mi thub pa'i g.yang sa de la song ba na/ phyags ma'i sne la skud pa dkar khra zhig btags song /yul gru thams cad dkar bong nger/ nyi zer gyi ldog 'od lam lam 'phro/gnam gshes sngar las bzang bas/ mgon po bkra shes kyi sems khams kyang ha cang bzang /khos sngar srol ltar nor lug rnams phyags ma'i mgo la ded rjes/dal ba dal bur rang gi rjes shul re re la rkang ba bzhag ste mdun la song /kho grog shur 'gram la bslebs rjes/ thog mar krong nger langs te grog mthil la zhib lta lan zhig byas pa dang de nas slar yang rang gi rjes shul la rkang ba bzhag ste/ sems kyi gnas mchog de la g.yas skor gnyis dang g.yon skor gcig byas rjes/ rang rlom chen po dang bcas krong nger langs nas zhib lta yud tsam byas pa na/ kha ba'i ngos su bya bye'u babs pa'i rjes 215

'tshub ma kher rkyang /shul tsam yang mi mthong bas/ yid sems bde la babs te dal lhod lhod kyis rang gi rjes shul re la rkang ba bzhag nas grog shur 'gram la bud de/sngar mal nas ljid tig ger sa la bsdad/nyin der/ grog shur 'di gar bsod nams dbang mo'i lus po thob rjes/ nam rgyun de la song nas mo'i 'phongs tshos dang mgo bo'i rjes shul la bltas pa yin/ rjes su rjes shul de dag rlung gis bsubs na'ang / 'phongs tshos dang mgo bo'i rjes shul gang na yod pa sems su khrigs khrigs yin pas/spro snang dang bcas sems kyis ma gtogs mi mthong ba'i ri mo de dag la bltas te/ gtam rgyud gsar ba der byung rim sna tshogs rtog bzo byas/ kha ba babs rjes/ grog shur chung chung de kha bas g.yogs rung / kha ba'i 'og gi rjes shul de gsal ler mthong /mgon po bkra shis kyis yid sems rnal la phab nas kha ba'i 'og gi rjes shul la bltas pa na/ rjes shul de rim bzhin mi ru gyur te/ bzhin ras lha mo las mdzes pa/ mchor sgeg klu mo las lhag pa'i bu mo lta na sdug pa zhig gis gar gyi stangs stabs sgyur bzhin yar langs byung / mo ni mgon po bkra shis kyi gangs dkar dran pa'i bcud la 'gyur med rtag brtan du zhugs pa'i bsod nams dbang mo red/ ltos dang / zhal ras rje btsun sgrol ma/mig zung skar chen cha ma/ dung so mu tig bstar ma/ skyes lus tshigs drug sgyug ma/ skra lo rgya lcang lo ma/ 'dzum mdangs gser gyi nyi ma/ da dung / da 216

'tshub ma kher rkyang /dung zhe 'dang drin chen pha ma/ kha tshig rje btsun mgur ma/ gshis ka 'bri mo'i 'o ma/ ltos dang / lha yi bu mo la mi tshang ba de mo la tshang yod/klu yi bu mo la mi 'dzoms pa de mor 'dzoms yod/bsod nams dbang mo'i bsam don ri mo grub cing 'dzum dkar me tog bzhad de sgeg pa'i stangs stabs sgyur bzhin kho'i gam la bslebs pa na/kho gnyis gas skabs rer phan tshun la dam por 'khyud de 'o byed pa dang /mtshams rer lag rdang sbrel te mchong lding byed bzhin mdun la brgyugs pa na/rim gyis ga sa gang du dmar po byi ru'i me tog ser po gser gyi me togasngon po g.yu yi me tog dkar po dung gi me tog rnam par bzhad pa'i gnas mchog yid du 'ong ba zhig la son/ kho gnyis gas dngul gyi rkang lam zhig ded nas mdun la song ba na/ lung ba g.yu 'brug tshang na nyal 'dug pa dang gnyis su med pa zhig gi mdo la bslebs byung / lung ba chen po de'i lung phu na nor khyu rdza ri nyil 'dra/ g.yas ngos na rta khyu mtshams sprin brdol 'dra/g.yon ngos na lug khyu sprin dkar mched 'dra/ lung mthil na rtsig pa gser dang rgya thabs g.yu las grub pa'i gzhal med kyi khang bzang zhig rngam brjid dang bcas 'gying 'dug la/ nyi 'od 'og tu ldog 'od lam lam 'phros pa na lta ba mig gis mi bzod/ kho lung ba'i ltad mos rab tu bzi ste ci bsam gang bsam med par hrig 'dug skabs/ bsod nams dbang mos dga' spro dang bcas pha gi ni 'u gnyis na'i khyim gzhis red ces bshad de mdun la 217

'tshub ma kher rkyang /brgyugs pa na/ kho la'ang 'char sgo glo bur ba zhig byung ste gom pa myur stabs kyis mdun la spos/gzhal med khang bzang de la son rjes su/ mgon po bkra shis kyis rtsal rgya bton nas rjes kyi 'tsho ba rol stangs la bsam gzhig byas pa na/'char bkod legs po sna tshogs gcig 'phror gcig mthud nas sems la shar byung bas/ khos spro sems dang bcas 'tsho ba'i brgyud rim rnams gung sgrig bzhin 'dug skabs/ bser bu 'khyag po zhig gdong la phog pa dang mnyam du/ rang nyid lha sgrung gi zhing khams shig la 'khyams 'dug pa glo bur du rtogs te/ gzhal med khang bzang dang de ga'i 'tsho bar yid sems ga 'dra 'khreng rung / dngos yod 'tsho ba gnad du bzung nas gtam rgyud gsar ba de'i byung rim blos slong mi byed ka med byung /nyin gung gi skabs su/ mdo mdo tshong kha mgon po bkra shis tshang gi lhas rgyab kyi phyags ma'i yul ba de la zhugs te phyags mgor bslebs rjes/mgon po bkra shis kyi rjes shul re re la rkang ba bzhag ste tshur yong /mdo mdo tshong kha'i dngos ming la mdo sde rgya mtsho zer zhing / pha ma gnyis nas rang gi brtse sems dungs sems de mtshon ched/ bu la mdo mdo zer ba'i gces ming zhig btags pa dang / kho ni tshong la ha cang dga' bas/mi rgyus yod rgyus med gang la 'phrad dus tshong gtam kho na bshad pa na/ rim gyis sde mi rnams kyis gces ming gi rjes la mtshang ming zhig sbyar te mdo mdo 218

'tshub ma kher rtsang /tshong kha zhes 'bod mgo brtsams/mdo mdo tshong kha 'dzum mdangs dang bcas mgon po bkra shis kyi gam nas bsdad rjes/ thog mar mgon po bkra shis rdzi bo brtson ldan rnams kyi gras su bkod de bstod bsngags byas/ de nas kho tshang sde mi phyug po rnams kyi gras la bzhag ste yid smon dang bcas bstod ra byas pa na/ mgon po bkra shis kyis mi pho 'dis sems la g.yo jus shig bcangs 'dug snyam nas/ dogs zon chen pos khos ci bshad la nyan pa las yin min gyi skad cha ci yang ma bshad/zu phu bo mgon po bkra shis/ a tshang gi glang rgan ske dkar nga la tshongs shig a/’ mgon po bkra shis kha rog ger bsdad/mgon po bkra shis la sgor mo'i mkho gal che mod/ glang rgan ske dkar btsongs na ga la 'grig glang rgan de dang bu chung rgya mtsho gnyis ka na zla yin la/ chung mas bu chung btsa' skabs/ nyin mtshan lnga la gzer nas shi gson gnyis na'i dbye mtshams na gnas skabs/ a ma 'u thug ste be'u ske dkar mgo la chu khrus byas nas tshe thar la btang zhing / bshas te sha mi za la btsongs te rin mi len pa'i dam bca' byas pa na/ rgya mtsho ni ci zhig gis mar ded pa ltar sa la lhung ste ag rgyangs byas pas/ be'u de sgo zog dmigs bsal can zhig la brtsis te 'tsho skyong byas/ sgo kha'i tshe thar gcig pu 219

'tshub ma kher rkyang /btsongs na/ pha ma gnyis gas gshe gshe gtong bar ma zad/ sde mi rnams kyis kyang mi bshad rgu bshad byed nges/ lhag par rang khyim gang la spor na khal ma ni glang rgan ske dkar gcig pu las med pas/ sgor mo ci 'dra mkho rung btsong thabs gtan nas med/smyo sna/ kha rog ger bsdad nas ci byed/ tshongs ya/mi //bye/sa/ dang / sgor mo chig stong nyis brgya byin chog 6 yin khyod kyis nga'i glang rgan nag tho nyo'am/mi 6 ci zer/ khyod la glang rgan de 'dra zhig gang na yod/mi mdo mdo tshong kha the tshom dang bcas yud tsam la cer rjes/ spro snang chen pos de ltar dris/sna 'di na yod/mi mgon po bkra shis kyis rang gi 'doms la mdzub mo btsugs nas de ltar bshad/tshul de mthong bas mdo mdo tshong kha'i ngo mdangs skad cig nyid la 'gyur song /skabs shig la/ mdo mdo tshong kha la kha sha srad cing sgang ba sbos pa'i tshor snang byung bas/ mgon po bkra shis kyi rjes shul la rkang ba spo bzhin grog shur mthil la babs rjes/ rjes shul gyi gom pa spo phyogs ltar bsod nams dbang mo'i mirdog sde nas lang te/ gcin pa shag shag tu btang ba na/rlangs pa thu lu lu byed pa'i gsher khu de'i sne gcig 6mo'i migasang gnas bde 220

'tshub ma khyer rkyang /skyong gling la phog pas/ mgon po bkra shis la sngangs 'tshub dang khong khro glo bur ba zhig byung ste/ ci dran gang dran dang ci byed 'di byed med par myur stabs kyis yar langs rjes/ ngar shugs dang bcas a rog khyi rgan/ khyod kyis ci byed kyin gda'/’ zhes bshad pa na/ mdo mdo tshong khas gdong la ha mi go ba'i nyams shig bsdus te kho'i gdong la cer/64ci red/ ngas ci zhig byas song / ’6 ci red zer ram/ khyod kyis mgon po bkra shis glo bur du sad byung / kho rang gi dran pa sad pa dang bstun nas nongs 'gyod glo bur ba zhig kyang skyes pas/ 'u thug pa'i ngang nas gdong la 'dzum mdangs bcos ma zhig bsdus te tshungs khyod kyi gcin pa bsgag rtsis yin mod/ khyod kyi glang rgan nag tho skyug pa'i las la rang dbang thob 'dug ces 'chad bzhin sa la bsdad mod/ gcin pa sngar bzhin gsang gnas su bzhur bzhin pa mthong na/ sems par ral gris bsnun pa ltar zug gzer bzod glags med pa zhig bar mtshams med par langs mod/ mgo bo g.yas la dkyogs te shag sgra ya nga ba de la nyan bzhin mi 'dug ka med byung /mdo mdo slar grog shur 'gram la yong nas sa la bsdad rjes/ kho gnyis nas gang dran dran glengs nas kha brda yun ring la byas mod/ tshur la ci bshad pa dang phar la gang bshad pa gtan nas mi shes/221

'tshub ma kher rkyang /yod tshad kyi yod tshad mdo mdo tshong kha lan pa yin/ khos bsam yul las 'das pa'i khong khro de 'dra bslangs pa na/ mgon po bkra shis phyi dro khyim la log dus/ sems kyi zug gzer dang khong khro de sngar bzhin zhi med pas/'phags 'tsho ni sa 'dam mer mer ba'i phung bo zhig dang 'dra bar go khar 'byar te brnyan 'phrin la bltas 'dug pa mthong ba na/ zhe snang sngar las che ba zhig langs te/ ngar shugs dang bcas par mchong ste thog mar mo yar drud de lag pa'i phyi nang gis 'gram lcag lan 'gar gzhus pa dang / de nas sa la bsnyel te rkang bcags byas pa na/ tsha thab steng gi byis pa gnyis ka sngangs 'jigs dang bcas mchongs yong ste a pa'i sbyin pa g.yas g.yon la 'thams byung / byis pa'i 'jigs yer gyi phe rgyangs re re kho'i sems la tsha tsag dang bcas par zug pa dang bstun nas/ kho'i sems kyi zhe snang drag po de rim gyis yal pa dang / sa na ha las te mchi ma'ang re zhig bzhur rgyu med 'dug pa'i chung ma la snying rje glo bur ba zhig skyes te sems pa grang shu rer song mod/ rkang bcags lan 'ga' byas rjes de ma thag mo yar bslangs te 'gyod bshags byas na/ byis pa gnyis kur ngo tsha bar ma zad/ chung mas kyang mthong chung byed nges yin snyam ste/ zhe snang med rung ngar shugs dang bcas tsha thab klad la bud de dpon 'dug cig byas nas bsdad/'phags 'tsho lang thub la mi thub cig gis par langs rjes/ smin dbrag bsdus te lus kyi gzer mig re re la 'phur 'phur lan 'ga' byas pa 222

'tshub ma kher skung /dang / de nas am gcigs bsdams te khyo gar ja gang blugs te dal ba dal bur go khar song nas sa la bsdad/ skabs der byis pa gnyis ka 'tsher snang dang bcas a phar cer 'dug mod/ yud tsam gyi rjes su a mas skad phyung nas ngus pa na/ kho gnyis a ma'i g.yas g.yon la 'thams te skyo gdung dang bcas phe rgyangs byas/ma bu gsum ga'i ngu skad de bar mtshams med par mgon po bkra shis kyi rna bar lhung ste ya chung du 'khyug 'khyug byas pa na/ kho'i sems rab tu sdug ste mig skong mchi mas brlan song /'phags 'tsho la nyes pa ci yod/ ci yang med/ ngo ma ci yang med/mgon po bkra shis kyis bsams kyin bsams kyin 'gyod gdung snga na med pa zhig skyes byung /mgon po bkra shis pho lo bco brgyad la son pa na/ rang gi tshe gcig gi 'tsho ba'i rkya ya ni bsod nams dbang mo yin par snyam ste gnyen gyi pho nya mngags/ 'on kyang / bsam yul las 'das pa zhig ni/ pho nya khyim la son te yong lugs dang yin lugs bshad rjes bsod nams dbang mo'i pha ma gnyis gas bu mo 'thad min 'dri dgos zer te yin min gyi skad cha ci yang ma bshad mod/ mo ni gnyen don de la gtan nas ma 'thad pas/ mgon po bkra shis la khog dpung chen po langs te 'gran sems dang bcas rang las lo gsum gyis che ba'i 'phags 'tsho myur ba myur bar chung mar blangs rdo 2 3

'tshub ma kher rkyang /gnyen ston rgya chen po bshams/ 'phags 'tsho dang mgon po bkra shis gnyis ka sde ba gcig nas nar son pa yin rung / gal srid pham kha chen po de 'dra trī byung na/ kho la mo chung mar len rgyu'i 'char sgo ni gtan nas 'byung mi da/ 'phags 'tshos las ka ci zhig las rung las phyod chen po med na'ang /las ka gang zhig mgo brtsams na de la brtson pa yod rgu bton nas mjug sdud pa dang / bde sdug ci la phrad kyang nyams snang chen po med par ma zad/skad cha yag btsog ci 'dra thos rung skyid snang sdug snang ci yang med pa zhig yin pas/ rim bzhin sgyug po sgyug mo gnyis ga'i sems khong nas rtsa ba tshugs te mna' ma ni gtan nas ma 'chugs snyam mgo brtsams mod/ mgon po bkra shis kyis rang gi chung mar bzang cha dang yon tan ci yod gtan nas ma rtogs/ nam rgyun stong 'dang la rnam par rol te mos ci byas ci dran la yid 'jog dang do snang ma byas pa na/ mo'i gshes ka dang yon tan ni ga la rtogs srid/ gtan nas rtogs mi srid/ 'phags 'tshos rang gi khyo gas rang la snang chung byed tshul sna tshogs mthong ba na/ sdug snang byung ste sems pa grang shur shur byed mod/ mo la mtshon na/ sems gtam brjod par mi dga'/ mchor gos la mi dga'/ ltad mo la mi dga'/ lhag par bu chung dpal mgon btsas rjes gla rtsi mang po 'thungs pa nas/ lus sha shin tu rgyas par gyur mod/ mos de la'ang do snang spu tsam yang mi byed pas/ mo la 224

'tshub ma kher chung /'char sgo dang dga' phyogs ga 'dra yod pa mi zhig gis gtan nas mi rtogs/'on kyang rjes su brnyan 'phrin de nyos pa nas bzung mo la dga' phyogs glo bur ba zhig byung ste/ rgya skad tshig gcig mi go rung sgam chung khyad mtshar ngos kyi brnyan ris la cer 'gro ba dang / khyad par du brnyan 'phrin zlos gar legs po re byung na khyim las kyang brjed 'gro/ dus tshod nges can zhig 'gor pa na/ mos brnyan 'phrin le tshan gyi gtong lugs la cha rgyus nges can byung bas/ brnyan 'phrin zlos gar med dus khyim las thams cad rdzogs par las pa yin/ khyim gyi rnam pa la gzhigs na/ de ring gi khyim las kyang sngar srol ltar 'char gzhi ldan par las pa rtogs thub/ ltos dang / khang mig chung chung de'i gzhi khyon chung zhing bzo bkod zhan na'ang / khyim hril bor gad snyigs phran tsam med par gtsang phyags byas 'dug par ma zad/ snod dang ca lag thams cad gtsang mar bkrus te rang rang gi mal na legs par bsgrigs 'dug pa dang / thab kyi sla ngar rlangs pa thu lu lu byed la/ phar bltas na nus pa yod rgya bton nas nub 'tshal zhig g.yo sbyor byed pa'i sta gon bya ba yongs su rdzogs 'dugamagon po bkra shis kyis 'phags 'tsho ma bu gsum ga'i ngu skad nyam nga ba/ yid skyo ba de 7 nyan gyin nyan gyin sems pa rim bzhin blong blong bor gyur pa na/ sngar gyi ltogs snang dang skom snang de'ang gar song cha med du gyur pas/ ngu skad la gzha' ba dang sems pa gnang ched khang mig phyi la bud/225

'tshub ma kher rtsang /sde ba'i nor lug kun rang rang gi lhas zhol la 'khor 'dug pa dang /khyim tshang so so'i khang klad na du ba sngo lhog lhog tu 'phyur gyin gda'/a nyag sde ba 'di ni rong ma 'brog gi sde ba chung chung zhig yin la/bcings 'grol byas rjes zhing phyugs gnyis su bgos te khyim tshang la las phyugs 'tshos pa dang khyim tshang la las zhing btab pa yin/ 'gan gtsang len byed skabs zhing sa dang nor lug thams cad sger la bgos pa na/ sde ba'i lo lon dang byis pa rnams zhing las nas brtan 'dug byas pa dang / na gzhon rnams kyis dgun sa dang dpyid sa nas khang mig re brtsigs te phyugs las gnyer bzhin yod/ mgon po bkra shis tshang gi dgun sa'i khang mig chung chung de'i gzhi khyon ni chung gras su gtogs rung / pha ma gnyis ka sku 'bum byams pa gling la mjal skor du 'gro skabs/ zi ling nas nyi glog cig nyos pa dang / dgo thang mdun rol gyi dmag sgar chen po'i tshoms khang klad la sder ma chen po zhig bzhag pa na/ nye 'khor nas brnyan 'phrin le tshan la bltas chog pa go rjes/ mgon po bkra shis kyis tshon med brnyan 'phrin chung chung zhig nyos pas/ gzhis khyim chung chung de ni spro skyid ldan pa zhig du gyur/'on kyang / las ka med pa'i khyim mtshes la la nam rgyun kho tshang la yong nas brel ba med par brnyan 'phrin la bltas pa na/ kho tshang gi nyin mo'i las ka dang mtshan mo'i gnyid la bar chad rab dang rim pa byung /mgon po bkra shis kyis dgo thang gi stod smad bar gsum la zhib lta 226

'tshub ma kher rtsang /lan zhig byas rjes/ ci bsam gang bsam dang gang dran 'di dran med par yid tig ger sa la 'dug dgos byung / khos g.yas lag gis dpral ngos la 'phur 'phur lan 'ga' byas pa na/ rang nyid kyi las dbang de khyi'i ske la btags 'dug pa dang mtshungs snyam pa dang / las dbang la bsam gzhig byed kyin byed kyin bsod nams dbang mo'i snang brnyan de slar yang gangs dkar dran pa'i klong la gsal ler 'phos byung bas/ rang dbang med par mgo bo g.yas su bskyogs te sgrol ma 'bum tshang gi phyogs la ham sems dang bcas lta dgos byung / skabs shig la/ grang rlung gdug rtsub can zhig 'ur sgra dang bcas tshur langs nas 'ongs pa na/ mgon po bkra shis kyis da ni khyim la mi log thabs med red snyam ste/ dngan pa ring bo zhig dang mnyam du yar langs te dogs mi bde ba'i ngang nas khyim la log pa na/ 'phags 'tshos ci yang ma byung ba'i nyams kyis nub 'tshal skol bzhin 'dug pa dang /byis pa gnyis ka go khar bsdad de brnyan 'phrin la lta bzhin gda'/ khos nongs sems dang bcas khyekhya/ la zhib lta lan zhig byas rjes kha rog ger tsha thab steng la bud/gsum pa/nyis stong lo'i gnam lo gsar ba de tshes byung / byis pa gnyis nas lu ba gsar ba re gyon te khyim tshang so sor lo sar gyi rten 'brel zhu bar song ba 227

'tshub ma kher rkyang /dang / khyim bdag gzhan dang byis pa gzhan dag gis kyang rum la kha btags re dang dam be re bzung ste kho tshang la yong gin gda' mod/ 'phags 'tsho la sbra sgo khyim sgo nyul ba'i goms srol med pa dang / gnam gang dgong mo'i don rkyen de dran na/ mgon po bkra shis la khyim tshang gzhan par 'gro ba'i spobs pa gtan nas med pas/ kho tshang ni gtan nas khom song ba dang / khom nas ci byed 'di byed kyang med par gyur/mgon po bkra shis la bsod nams dbang mo'i lus po thob rjes/ kho'i sems la nam rgyun ha cang yid tshim pa'i snang ba zhig 'char/ sngar gyi 'char gzhi ltar na/ lo sar skabs su mgron po tshur yong la dgyes ston phun sum tshogs pa bshams pa dang / khyim tshang gzhan pa nye ring kun la song ste glu len gar rtse la rol rtsis yin mod/ 'char gzhis 'gyur ldog la bstun pa las 'gyur ldog gis 'char gzhi la mi bstun pas/ 'char gzhi zhib rgyas de lag bstar byed pa la 'gyur ldog gis bar chad byas/lo sar gyi snga rol tu/ kho khom skabs dang bstun nas dmag sgar la song ste/ byis pa dang chung mar lu ba cha tshang re dang sngo tshod sna tshogs/ bro sman sna tshogs/ de min ka ra a rag sogs nyos nang glang rgan ske dkar la bkal yong /gnam gang gi nyi ma nub pa na/ mgon po bkra shis kyis tsha thab gtsang ma/ sdugs rjes/ thog mar dga' spro dang bcas sha dang ko re/ sil tog

'tshub ma kher chung /gsum ga'i sder ga bsgrigs pa dang / de nas rang la byang cha yod pa'i tshul 'chos dang bcas 'phags 'tsho la bkod 'doms byas te sngo tshod sna tshogs las nas mdun cog steng la bsgrigs pa na/ byis pa gnyis nas thur ma cha re bzung ste 'dzem dogs ci yang med par tsha thab steng la bud/ mgon po bkra shes kyis tshul de mthong ba na 'char sgo glo bur ba zhig byung ste/ myur stabs dang bcas mdzod sgam las rgyan chang dang chang dkar dam be 'ga' blangs te cog tse steng la bzhaga'aphags 'tsho dal ba dal bur tsha thab steng la bud de pha bu gsum gar 'o ja dkar yol gang re blugs rjes/ go khar song ste kha rog ger bsdad/sna 'phags 'tsho/ khyod kyang tsha thab steng la shog ’6 min/ nga 'di gar bsdad chog zu shog shog khyod gcig pu de gar 'dre 'dug byas nas ci bya/ tsha thab steng la bud/ do dgong gnam gang red/ shog ya/ shog shog 'phags 'tsho re zhig la had rjes go kha nas myur stabs kyis langs pa dang / de nas dga' snang dang bcas tsha dem bzung ste tsha thab steng la bud/mos byis pa gnyis ga'i mgo bor dungs sems dang bcas byil byil 'ga' byas nas rang gi smon 'dun dang spro snang grag med tshor med du brjod skabs/mgon po bkra shis kyis thog mar rang la chang dkar phor ba gang blugs pa dang / de nas ma bu gsum gar rgyan chang dmar po de dkar yol gang re 229

'tshub ma kher rtsang /blugs te kho cho'i mdun la bzhag rjes/ spro sems chen pos rang mdun gyi dkar yol yar bkyags te ya/ do dgong ni gnam gang red/ 'u cag zhim mngar zas dang bdud rtsi chang la rol ya/mi zhes brjod pa na/ byis pa gnyis nas brnyan 'phrin las ltad mo de 'dra lan mang mthong myong bas/byang cha dang bcas rang mdun gyi dkar yol de yar brkyags mod/ 'phags 'tshos ci byed 'di byed med par lag pa 'phur 'phur byed zhor du 'tsher snang dang bcas khyo ga'i gdong la cer nas bsdud/zu a ma/ dkar yol zungs ya/ brnyan 'phrin du nam rgyun 'di ltar 'thung gin yod pa khyod kyis ma mthong ngam/ shog rgya mtshos dga' spro dang bcas de ltar bshad/bza' mi bzhi bos zas za zhor du chang la rol ba na/ mgon po bkra shis la nyams snang ci yang med mod/ byis pa gnyis ka bzi nas ra ror gyur te/ rgya mtshos ri lhun po'i dbu rtse je mtho red〉zer ba'i glu de yang yang blangs pa dang / dpal mgon gyis rta zhig yod pa rte'u yin〉zer ba'i glu gzhas de yang len bskyar len byas/ 'phags 'tshos dar chang 'thung gin 'thung gin snang ba je skyid dang lus po je yang la song ba na/ rig rtsal dgong tshogs yid du 'ong ba de la'ang lta 'dod gtan nas med par gyur/skabs shig la/ mos skad phyung nas glu zhig len 'dod byung mod/ g.yas lag gis 'gram pa bskyor te len rtsis byas pa na/ mgrin par ci zhig khegs 230

'tshub ma kher rtsang /pa ltar skad ni 'byin ma thub/byis pa gnyis nas kur chang bag med du 'thungs pa na/ re zhig gi rjes su rim bzhin ra ro gsum pa'i dus la son te/ g.yas log g.yon log byas te gnyid du yur/ skabs der/ 'phags 'tsho'i ngo mdangs dmar por gyur 'dug cing / mig zhibs lci mo de btsan shugs kyis yar 'ben te zhib lta byas pa na/ skabs rer khyo ga ni mi gnyis yin la/ mtshams rer mi gcig tu 'dug mos kho la bltas kyin bltas kyin sha dang rus pa'i gting nas tsha rlabs dang za 'phrug mi chung ba zhig langs yong /6 rgya mtsho'i a pha/ da ngal gso byas na chog gam/mi 'phags 'tshos bzi nyams dang bcas de ltar bshad/6 ngas kyang de ltar bsams pa yin/mi mgon po bkra shis kyis mgo sdid tig ger sngas thog la bzhag pa na/da gzod 'phags 'tsho sgren mor nyal 'dug pa rtogs/ kho rang gi lus po bde la babs ma thag mo ni sbrul chen shing la 'thams pa ltar kho la 'thams pa dang / kha nas chung dus khos ga 'dra 'dod pa dang rjes su chung mar bsus rjes dga' spro ga 'dra skyes pa sogs zhib bshad byas/ skabs shig la/kho gnyis tsha rlangs chen po zhig gis btums te yod tshad rang dbang na med par gyu/ /gnyis 'ja' tshon gyi them skas shig la zhugs te ham sems dang 231

'tshub ma kher rkyang /bcas gyen nas gyen la 'gro skabs/ sgo 'gram du shog sbag skag skag tu bkad pa dang / skag sgra chen po de dang bstun nas/ mi zhig gis khang sgo khrog ger phye ba dang mnyam dulowa wasarawa wabazangawa wazhes khagayang sgrog zhor du tsha thab steng la lag sgron bkar/ de nas ci byung khos gtan nas mi shes la/ gang ltar kho'i dran pa sos dus/ byis pa gnyis ka go khar bsnyal 'dug pa dang / tsha thab steng la sder ga sna tshogs legs par bsgrigs te khos mgron po rnams la lo chang 'dren bzhin gda'/sang nyin ni gnam lo gsar ba'i tshes pa bzhi yin mod/ mgon po bkra shis khyim tshang gcig la'ang 'gro mi phod/ bza' mi rnams khang mig chung bur 'dzoms te dal cag ger nub 'tshal 'thung bzhin pa'i skabs su/mdo mdo tshong kha dang klu lha/ bkra shis mgon gsum gsalowa wasarawa wabazangawa wangamazhes skad la bkyags te 'chad bzhin khyim la 'dzul yong ste/'di ni khyod kyi lo sar yin/ ces 'chad bzhin mi re'i rum nas ske la kha btags mdud 'dug pa'i a rag dam be re blangs te mgon po bkra shis kyi lag la bzhagaphu bo mgon bkra/ da lo lo sar la mi 'gro ba ci yin/ mdo mdo tshong kha tsha thab tu bde bar bsdad rjes de skad dris/ma khom pas red/ ma khom zer ram/ gnam gang gi dgong mo rgod ma rkyang nyig mar 232

'tshub ma kher rkyang /bcibs te lo lha rgan por gnam lo gsar tshes kyi bkra shis rten 'brel zhu bar 'gro rtsis byas pa min nam/’ klu sgye dang bkra shis mgon gnyis ka hab dgod byas pa dang / 'phags 'tsho kha skyengs te phyi la bros/smyo go thos la/ phu bo mgon bkras lha yul dmigs te gyen la 'phur skabs/ rgod ma rkyang nyig ma glo bur du 'drogs te kho thang la g.yug mod/kho'i rkang ba yob la thogs te thog mar lha yul la drud/ de nas klu yul la drud/ rjes su slar yang mi yul la log ste kho cal sgra dang bcas tsha thab steng la g.yug de dus/ rgod ma'i rgyab na sga med/ mgo na srab med/ phu bo'i rkang na lham med par bshad/’ klu sge dang bkra shis mgon gnyis gas mchi ma 'byin bzhin bgad/smyo mdo mdo/ ma bshad/ ngas phyag gsum 'tshal kyang chog mgon po bkra shis 'u thug nas de skad bshad/66khyod nga tsho dang lhan du lo sar la 'gro na/ ngas tshig gcig kyang mi bshad/6/ming la khom pa med/’ 6bden nam/ ’ (bden/mi sna des na khyod sdod dang / ngas sde ba'i gsar bu kha bde lce bde sdu/sa

'tshub ma kher rtsang /cad 'di ru bsdus chog de dus ci bshad ngas kyang mi shes/mi 6 chog gi chog gi nga 'gro ya/mi 6bden nam/ ’6 bden/ dkon mchog gsum/mi ja chang gnyis ga'i longs spyod la re zhig rol rjes/ kho tsho lhan du lam la chasakhyi/ma tshang so so'i sgo 'gram la bslebs pa na/ mgon po bkra shis kyi lus kun khrid nas rengs por gyur te gom pa'ang mdun la spo dkar mod/khyim bdag mang che bas kho dmigs te ku re mtshar gtam ci yang ma brjod pa dang / khyim bdag la las mtshar gtam sna tshogs bshad rung / mdo mdo tshong khas rtsal rgya bton nas shags 'gyed byas pa na/ mgon po bkra shis kyis ngo tsha chen po nyo ma dgos/ 'on kyang / mi rnams la brjod bya de 'dra byung na/ kho tsho la bgrod lam bde mo zhig yod mi srid/ kho tsho rig yag tshang la bslebs skabs/ khyim bdag mas mgon po bkra shis la ja 'dren zhor du kho'i gdong la lta tsam byas pa na/ skad cig nyid la gnam gang gi don rkyen de dran pas/ bzod thabs bral te hab dgod thengs gcig byas pa dang mnyam du lag gi dkar yol de mgon po bkra shis kyi pang la lhung song /skabs der rig yag gis chung mar sdigs mo nag po zhig byas rjes/ 'dzum dmul dmul gyis ya ma 'grig do dgong nged tshang gi nag mos lo lha rgan 234

'tshub ma kher rkyang /po'i tsha bo bsregs song / da ni chags 'jig dang god kha rgyun ma chad pa red/mi ces ku re'i mgo brtsams te mtshar gtam brjod pa na/ mdo mdo tshong khas phar rgol ga 'dra byas na'ang / 'thab ya ma yong bas/ rig yag gis tshig gcig bshad na/ der yod tshang ma 'ur chil ler dgod dgos byung ba dang / dgod sgra re re dang bstun nas mgon po bkra shis kyi dpral bar rngul chu'i dog pa re re sran ril ltar mar 'gril byung / skabs shig la/rig yag gis ci zhig dran pa ltar gang ltar bshad rung / gnam gang dgong mo rgod ma 'drogs te yob thag bcad/ do dgong sgrol ma bgad nas yob thag bcad/ da lo mgon po bkra shis lo lha rgan po'i mdun la ma son pa red/mi ces bshad rjes/ mtshar gtam bshad mtshams bzhag ste mgron po rnams la chang drangs pa dang / der yod rnams kyis gang dran ci dran brjod de kha brda byed zhor du/ ja chang gi longs spyod la mngon par rol ba na/ mgon po bkra shis kyi dpral ba'i rngul chu de'ang ngang gis srad mod/ kho la a rag ham 'thung byed pa'i lto ba las kha brda byed pa'i spobs pa gtan nas med par gyur/kho tsho sgrol ma 'bum tshang gi lhas 'dabs la son skabs/ mgon po bkra shis kyis gcig na bsod nams dbang mo dang mdo mdo tshong kha gnyis ka ma spun yin pas/ kho tshang nas 'chal gtam de 'dra bshad mi srid/gnyis na bsod nams dbang mor lus 'brel yod pas gcig rgyus gcig la 235

'tshub ma kher rkyang /mnga' ba yin snyam pa na/ spobs pa glo bur ba zhig thol thol du rgyas byung bas/ chang gis bzi nas ra ror gyur med na yang / bsam bzhin du gom pa 'khyar 'khyor spos nas mdun la song ba na/ sngon gyi lus po sbrid de rengs por gyur pa'i tshor snang de gar song rjes med du gyur/sgo khyi shugs kyis 'ab pa dang bstun nas/ sgrol ma 'bum bza' zla gnyis ka snga gzhug tu khang sgor bud de mgron por bsu ba byas/ kho tshos khyim bdag mthong ma thag lowa sarawa bzangawa ngam zhes g.yang 'bod 'tshams 'dri re byas rjes/ rum gyi a rag dam be de blangs nas 'di ni khyod kyi lo sar yin zer bzhin khyim bdag gi lag la bzhag skabs der/ sgrol ma 'bum dga' ste 'dzum dmul dmul byed pa las nyams 'gyur dmigs bsal ba zhig ma byung mod/ bsod nams dbang mos kho mthong ma thag gdong la ci mi snyam pa'i nyams 'gyur bcos ma zhig bsdus/mgron po bzhi ga'i gras su/ lo na ches che ba ni mgon po bkra shis yin pas/ kho ni gral mgo 'dzin mkhan rtsod med yin/ kho tsha thab gong rol tu ljid tig ger bsdud rjes/ g.yon lag pus mo la khen pa dang / g.yas lag gis ma ne bskyor te skom tshugs su rang rlom dang bcas mthong lam kun la zhib lta byas/dang thog bsod nams dbang mo rang nyid kyis slong skabs/ mos kho tshang la 'char gzhi med/ cha rkyen zhan/ khyim tshang de 'dra zhig nas ji ltar 236

'tshub ma khyer rkyang /'tsho/mi zhes brjod de gnyen lam med par byas mod/ sgrol ma 'bum tshang gi cha rkyen rang khyim las bzang rung / 'char gzhi rang las lhag pa gtan nas mi rtogs/ ltos dang / kho tshang gi khang ba'i gzhi khyon ni rang khyim las che rung / gyang ngos thams cad 'bar 'bur dang kong kong gis khebs 'dug pa dang / de yi ngos kyi glog brnyan 'khrab ston pa mang po'i 'dra par gsar rnying mi 'dra zhing / la la'i steng la dud dreg chags te thog ma'i kha dog kyang ci yin mi shes/ khang ba'i klad ngos la nyi glog gi glog sgron zhig btags 'dug mod/ phyi shun ngos la dud dreg dang sa rdul chags te 'od snang yang mag mog tu bsgyur 'dug khang ba'i bzo bkod dang / khyim gyi gtsang spra/ca lag sogs kyi sgrig lugs 'jog stangs la gzhigs na/ sgrol ma 'bum ni 'char gzhi dang blo jus ci yang med pa'i skyes pa rig rtul zhig dang / bsod nams dbang mo ni sgyid lug rul ma zhig yin pa'i tshor snang ster/ mo pha gzhis su yod dus de 'dra zhig gtan nas min/ gnas yul 'grims rjes ci byung / 'gyur ldog che ba la ang / mgon po bkra shis kyis khyim hril bor bltas kyin bltas kyin rang dbang med par dngan pa zhig 'then dgos byung /6 mgon bkra/ do dgong ma gtogs khyod kyis khyim tshang 'di la gom pa spos ma myong ste/ lo sar la 'di ltar yong ba dngos gnas bka' drin che/ ngas dkon mchog gsum gyi skal la chang skal gsum 'dren ya/'di gsum cis kyang gtsang bzhes byed dgos/mi sgrol ma 'bum gyis sder ma 237

'tshub ma kher rkyang /chung chung zhig gi nang la chang phor gsum bzhag ste kho'i mdun la bsrings/6 min min/ ngas dkon mchog gi skal ni 'thung mi phod/ gal srid bsod nams dbang mos glu zhig blangs na/ ngas glu chang 'thung chog mi6 de 'dra ma bshad/ 'di ni lo sar gyi lo chang yin/ glu chang rjes na yod/mi 4 min/ mi 6 bsod nams dbang mo/ shog glu zhig longs dang / mgon po bkra shis kyis lo chang mi 'thung gi smyo nga mi khom/ 'thung 'dod med na btsan sdud ma byed/’ bdod nams dbang mos me khang nas khyo ga la de ltar bshad/mgon po bkra shis kyis ci mi snyam pa'i ngang nas me khang phyogs la lta tsam byas pa na/ mdo mdo tshong khas 'dzum mdangs dang bcas kho la bltas 'dug pa mthong bas/ mi ngan 'di yi ngag nas gtam ngan ci 'dra 'byung ba mi shes snyam ste/ 'jigs snang dang bcas chang phor gsum ga gcig 'phror gcig len byas te gtsang 'thung byas/sgrol ma 'bum gyis mgron po 'phro ma rnams la chang skal drangs pa na/mgon po bkra shis kyis ci mi snyam pa'i ngang nas me khang phyogs la bltas nas bsdad/ skabs shig la/ bsod nams dbang mos sha gzhong zhig la tshod ma brtsigs te rlangs pa thu lu lu byed bzhin me khang phyi la bslebs byung / mos 238

'tshub ma kher rkyang /lobs phyogs kyis tshur la lta tsam byas pa na/ kho gnyis ke'i mig 'od de bar snang chung chung de nas phan tshun bsnol pas/ bsod nams dbang mos kho la sdang mig bgrad de khro lta lan zhig byas te gom pa shugs len byas mod/mgon po bkra shis kyi gdong la rgyal kha'i 'dzum mdangs snga na med pa zhig rgyas/ nyin/ da dung nga rgyal che ba la ang / nyin der/ sa dog mo gdan la btings/ dgung nyi ma ltad mor bkugs nas gcin pa gtong mkhan ni nga rang yin/ ci 'dra red/ ngas do nub khyim 'di'i gral mgo bzung nas yin lugs ltar bsdad na/ khyod bza' zla gnyis gas da dung ja 'dren chang 'dren byed dgos/ rgyal kha zer ba ni de red/ ngas nyin der khyod kyi 'phongs tshos rjes shul rlung gis bsubs pa de sgrol ma 'bum la bstan te 'di na bud med mdzes ma zhig gan rgyal du nyal ba'i rjes shul yod/mi ces bshad pa na/ khos zhib lta ga 'dra byas rung ci yang ma mthong / de ni kho la brnyas bcos tshad med dang rang gis rgyal kha sngar med blangs pa ma yin nam/zas dang chang la rol nas re zhig 'gor pa na/ mgron po rnams kyis bsod nams dbang mo la glu zhig len pa'i re ba yang yang bton rung / mos mi len zer nas re ba gtan nas dang len mi byed/ mgon po bkra shis kyis mos /mi len zer ba'i mthil don rtogs yod snyam nas dga' spro skyes mod/don dam du bsod nams dbang mo la dmigs yul gzhan zhig yod pa yin/kha ba babs rjes kyi nyin mo zhig la/ mdo mdo tshong kha kho tshang la yong ste rang 239

'tshub ma kher rkyang /gis mgon po bkra shis tshang gi glang rgan ske dkar nyo rtsis yod mod/ khos tshe thar yin par bshad de gtan nas mi btsong ba'i brgyud rim de bshad pa na/bsod nams dbang mo la jus bkod glo bur ba zhig byung bas/ gang dran thams cad ji bzhin bshad rjes/ ming sring gnyis ga'i blo gros gcig tu bsdus te jus bkod de lag bstar byed thabs la gros mol byas/ 'on kyang /jus bkod bzang bo de dus ltar lag bstar byed ma thub pa na/ mdo mdo tshong kha la 'tshub cha langs pa dang / bsod nams dbang mo'i yid sems kyang mi bde bar gyur/ do dgong ni 'char gzhi de dngos 'bebs byed pa'i go skabs yin pas/ gzhis mgron gnyis gas glu len gar rtse byas te nyi ma 'khyol thabs byas na ga la 'grig skabs shig la/ bsod nams dbang mos mig brda lan zhig bstan pa dang bstun nas/ mdo mdo tshong khas gyig sho brgyab na bzang tshul bshad pa na/ gzhis mgron gnyis mar chang 'thung 'dod chen po med pas/ tshang ma de la yid 'thad byung /bsod nams dbang mos sder ga rnams me khang la bzhag rjes/ cog tse gtsang mar phyis pa na/ mgon po bkra shis dang mdo mdo tshong kha/ sgrol ma 'bum/ bkra shis mgon bzhi ga cog tse mtha' la rub ste gyig sho la rol ba dang / klu lha dang bsod nams dbang mo gnyis ka kho tsho'i mtha' ru bsdad de ltad mor bltas/shar phyogs kyi mkha' mtha' mag mog tu gyur 'dug par gzhigs na/240

'tshub ma kher rkyang /nyi ma ni gnam sa'i mtha' na 'dzum gyi ler yar 'phags bzhin yod pa rtogs/ mgon po bkra shes kyis phyugs rdzir 'gro dgos par kha g.yar nas phangs sems chen po dang bcas khang sgor bud pa na/ mtshan mo gcig la ma gnyid pa'i khar nam smad la blo rig lcags skud bzhin du bsgrims nas gyig sho brgyab pas/ rkang lag sbrid cing a thang chad de gom pa'ang mdun la spo dka' bar gyur 'dug kho krong nger langs nas yud tsam la ngal gso byas rjes/ 'khreng sems dang bcas khang mig phyogs la phyir bltas lan zhig byas pa na/ gzhis mgron 'phro ma rnams kyis da dung gyig sho rgyag bzhin yod pas/kho la skyes ma byed mkhan zhig kyang med pa gzhi nas rtogs/mdang dgong / thog mar gyig sho rgyag dus/ mgon po bkra shis kyi lag pa ni gser lag dang g.yang lag yin pas/ rtsed ya rnams kyi sgor mo ni ci zhig gis bkugs pa ltar rang gi mdun la spungs byung / khos do dgong gi gyig shos rang la khog dpung dang la rgya brtson len byas song snyam nas bsod nams dbang mo/ ltos dang / pho rab zer ba nga 'dra yin ces khong bshad byed zhor du/ rang rlom chen po dang bcas sho lha dkar mo gshog drug ma/ /gshog pa dkar po'i ldem rtsal gyis/ /gshog rlabs 'phrul gyis bsgyur byos la/ /sho g.yang stsol la ho ma ya mizhes dpa' skad 'dra sgrog bzhin gyig sho re re tshur blangs pa na/ rang la gang mkho na lag la de son pas/ rang gis rang la 'ud bstod byed bzhin sho yi rtse dga' la rol/ skabs der/ bsod 241

'tshub ma kher rkyang /nams dbang mos sgrol ma 'bum la ‘khyod kyis ci yang mi nus/ mar song zhes bshad rjes/ khyo ga phar ded de rang nyid shul nas bsdad pa na/ mgon po bkra shis kyis mo ni bud med 'di lta bu zhig yin nam snyam pa na/ thog mar skyug bro ba'i tshor snang byung ba dang / yud tsam gyi rjes su phangs sems chen po skyes/ khos skyo snang dang bcas gyig sho tshur blangs pa na/ lag pa ni rim bzhin skyag lag dang 'gong lag tu gyur te/ rang la gang mi mkho na de len pa dang / gzhan la gang mkho na de 'phen pas/ mdun gyi sgor mo rnams rim bzhin gzhan lag la shor pa na/ rang rlom chen po de gar song rjes med du gyur par ma zad/ ngag nas a hu hu bar mtshams med par brjod pa ma gtogs/ sho lha ngar skad kyis 'bod rgyu'ang brjed 'dugaskabs shig la/ mdun gyi sgor mo phar zhog tha na rum gyi de'ang gzhan la shor pas/ khos rang gi gyong gud ni gnas skabs tsam yin snyam ste/ glang rgan ske dkar gta' mar bzhag nas mdo mdo tshong kha'i lag nas sgor mo stong gcig bskyis pa dang / ma rtsa gsar ba de'ang shor song na/ rjes su sgor mo lnga brgya byin na glang rgan 'khrid chog par byas/ 'on kyang / kho'i gser lag de 'gong lag tu gyur pa nas bzung slar yang gser lag tu 'gyur ba'i rtags mtshan ni gtan nas ma byung bas/ nam langs la nye dus/ lag gi sgor mo yod tshad gzhan la shor pa na/ mdun cog mtha' la bud de rang yul la chas grabs mi byed thabs med byung / shuwa waglang rgan gcig pu sgor mo lnga 242
