'tshub ma kher rkyang /brgyar btsongs na/ pha ma gnyis kur ji ltar bshad/ sde mis go na ji ltar byed/ rjes su khal 'gel dus snod dang ca lag gang la 'gel/ da dung de ni tshe thar yin/ mgon po bkra shis kyi lus po'i mgo mjug bar gsum gyi stobs yal te/ 'char sgo'ang chen po med med/ yid sems rnal la phab nas bsam blo tsam btang ba na/ rang nyid mdo mdo tshong kha'i g.yo 'og tu tshud pa'i tshor snang byung mod/ de la thabs bkod ci yod/ sgor mo skyi mkhan ni rang nyid yin/ glang rgan gta' mar 'jog mkhan ni rang nyid yin pas/g.yo 'og tu tshud rung byung lugs ltar 'gro dgos/mgon po bkra shis kyis rang yul dmigs te dran med tshor med du mdun la 'gro skabs g.yas rkang sa 'bur zhig la thogs te sa la 'gyel/ khos 'phag ra yud tsam byas te thang la bsdad rjes/ rang sems rang gis gso bzhin ngal gso cung zad byas pa dang / de nas yar lang zhor du khong khro dang bcas sa la mchil ma 'byar bag can zhig btab ste gom pa shugs len byed bzhin mdun la song /skabs shig la/ kho la sgang ba sbos pa'i tshor snang glo bur ba zhig byung bas/ mdo mdo tshong kha tshang gi khang ba dmigs te dor ma'i kha 'dig grol mod/ gcin lam la ci zhig khegs pa ltar chu thigs gcig kyang sa la ma lhung /rgyab phyogs su 'tshub ma chen po zhig 'ur shugs dang bcas tshur langs rung /khos lus sems yongs su lhod de dal gyis bcir pa na/ gcin pa shag se sa 243

'tshub ma kher rkyang /la babs mod/ shag sgra de dang bstun nas rlung 'tshub kyang gam la son pas/'ur sgra zhig dang mnyam du mgo bo'i zhwa mo 'tshub ma'i klong la drangs song /khos dor ma'i kha 'khor lag pas bzung ste myur stabs kyis mdun la brgyugs mod/ gcig na 'tshub ma mi las mgyogs pas rjes mi chod/ gnyis na zhwa mo 'asdeb maḥ spyang rol la son te kyi li 'khor bzhin yod pas rjes ni chod rung ma bzlo sa pashes/ sems dang bcas 'tshub ma chen po de la mig gis skyel ma byas te mthong lam du yal rjes/ mgo bo bsgur te dor ma'i kha 'dig mdud pa na/ dor ma'i rkang shag steng la gcin thigs mang po babs pa dang / de'i steng la sa rdul chags te skya thig mar kor mang po grub 'dug pa mthong /rang khyim gyi khang mig klad na du ba sngo lhog lhog tu 'phyur bzhin gda'/kho mu mthud du mdun la 'gro bzhin pa'i skabs su/ rang nyid bsod nams dbang mo la 'phrad pa nas bzung gcin pa rin thang can mang po bstud mar btang yod snyam pa na/ thog mar mgo bo nag 'thom mer song ba dang / de /spri bye/sa la 'gyod gdung drag po skyes te gom pa'ang gar spo 'dir spo med 244

lam/de ring ni a khu rgya mtsho tshang gis nags lam srung ba'i nyi ma yin stabs/kho skya rengs dang po'i skabs su gnyid las sad pa dang / gnyid las sad ma thag de ring gi las don gal chen de yid la dran byung / rlangs 'khor snga mo nas yul 'dir slebs mi srid pa kho'i sems na khrigs khrigs yin pa dang /mdang dgong nam stod la dga' spro skyes nas gnyid ma khug nam smad la lam rin len pa'i mi lam sna tshogs rmis te a thang chad 'dug rung / 'gro 'dod kyi brel 'tshub chen pos sems pa zang zing lang long du bsgyur te 'dug mi bzod pas/ myur mor mal las langs te lam la chas/ skabs der/ tsha bo tshe ring la'ang mgo rnga med pa'i brel 'tshub cig byung ste/ gnyid ma sad kyis bag leb cig la so 'debs zhor du/ g.yas lag spo bo'i phu thung la 'jus te rnga ma ci bzhin rjes su 'brangs byung /kho gnyis thog mar grong gseb kyi rkang lam gya gyu de la zhugs pa dang /245

'tshub ma kher rkyang /de nas shar chu'i zam pa zhol ma brgyud de ma ṇi khang gi sgo 'gram la slebs dus/ nyi ma btsan rgod nyag chen nas yar 'phags bzhin yod pa dang /shar khog gi dbyar gyi gnam gshis yul gru gzhan las 'khyag pas/ tsha bo tshe ring grang nas lhab lhab tu 'dar zhing lag gi bag leb de'ang za ma thub par drag char khrod kyi bong bu ltar langs 'dug a khu rgya mtshos lta phyogs shig gis tshul de mthong bas deng sang gi byis pa 'di tshor gna' mi'i khog dpung dang la rgya par zhog tha na lus drod tsam yang mi 'dug ces phangs sems dang bcas sdug smre thung thung de bton rjes/ mgo bo 'phred du g.yug bzhin rang gi g.yogs ma'i ske rags grol ba dang / de nas sa la ljid tig ger tsog ste tshe ring pang la bzung/ yud tsam 'gor rjes tsha bo'i lus drod rgyas byung bas/slar yang bag leb la so 'debs zhor du mar gsham gyi nags lam la cer nas bsdad/ skabs der/ gad pa skya ring phyogs kyi gzhung lam steng du skabs rer rlangs 'khor chung chung re shar rgyug byed pa dang / mtshams rer rnam rdzas drud yod pa'i rlangs 'khor chen po re gnyis stobs shugs bskyed de shar gtong byed pa'i sgra de thos yong mod/ ma ṇi khang mar gsham gyi nags lam ngos su rlangs 'khor gcig kyang yar 'gro mar 'gro ma byas/zhe spo bo/ rlangs 'khor ma yong na nga la brel 'tshub skyes te 'dug mi bzod/mi 24bye brel don ci yod/ a ma'i bu dal dgos/ rgod ma'i bu brel dgos

lam/zer ba ma go'am/mi a khu rgya mtsho ni bdag gzhan kun la rang gi bsam tshul ngo ma mi bshad pa'i rgan po khog gyong zhig yin pas/ nags lam du rlangs 'khor che chung shar gtong byed pa'i dus la ma son na/ sems dang bsam pa'i gting nas 'tshub cha zhig langs mod/ rang tshugs bzung ste sos dal bag phebs kyi tshul 'chos shig ston bzhin de skad bshad/kho gnyis kha rog ger dus tshod nges can zhig la bsdad rung / yid sems kyi re sgug la sngar bzhin 'bras bu ci yang ma byung bas/ tsha bo tshe ring gis bag leb za 'phro de la sen btog byas te gor rdog re re kha nang la g.yugs nas rtsed mo la rol ba dang / spo bos mthong lam gyi ri lung dang rang gi grong sde la lta zhor du yig drug bton te dus tshod 'khyol thabs byas/a khu rgya mtsho la mtshon na yul 'di nas mi lo bdun cu lhag la 'tsho ba rol myong bas/ yig drug zlo bzhin ri lung la lta ba ni goms srol tsam dang sems pa g.yeng thabs tsam las dgos mkho ci yang med/ khos mig zung btsums shing mchu sgros mur mur byed bzhin phreng ba gtong skabs kyang yul gru chung chung 'di'i ri sul dang nyag ga re re/ grog rong dang chu mig re re/ tha na sde 'dabs kyi pha bong che chung dang bya tshang bye'u tshang rnams kyang yid la dran thub la/ cha rgyus yod pa'i snang brnyan de dag dang lhan du 'das don sna tshogs kyang gcig 'phror gcig byas te mig lam du shar na/ khos lob 247

'tshub ma kher rkyang /phyogs kyis phreng ba bstud mar gtong ba dang mchu sgros myur mur byed bzhin yod na'ang / ci zhig 'don bzhin yod pa rang nyid kyis kyang mi shes/kho'i mig mdun gyi ri sde phra mo 'di la shar ba zer zhing / sde ba chags yod pa'i lung ba 'di la shar khog tu 'bod/ gna' snga mo nas bzung gzhan la rkun jag 'phrog gsum byas te/ mi sems la zhe 'khon dang sdug bsngal gyi rma kha zab mo bzos yod/ a khu rgya mtshos tshig par bshad kyi smra dag pa dang gtam tshur bshad kyi don go ba'i skabs su/ shar ba la dud khyim bcu tsam las med mod/ rgan po rnams kyis ri sde phra mo 'di stobs 'byor mnga' thang ldan pa'i rgyal khab chung chung zhig tu brtsis yod/ bgres po la las sde ba 'di myang yul nas mched par bshad la/ rgan po la las rang gi mes po gtsang yar klung nas phebs par brjod/ sde ba 'di'i rigs rus 'byung khungs thad la rtsod gzhi ji 'dra che rung / rang gi mes po rnams ni chos rgyal slong btsan sgam pos bod la mnga' dbang bsgyur skabs rgyal mtshams srung ba'i so dmag la mngags pa kha gcig lce gcig yin/ 'on kyang / gcig na sde ba 'di rgya bod gnyis ga'i sa mtshams na med pa dang / gnyis su dmag dpung zhig gi mi grangs kyang med la/ par bltas na nyes can skor zhig bros yong ste lung kyog 'di nas sba skung byas 'dug pa dang gnyis su med pas/ kho tshos kha nas de ltar bshad rung khog nas yid ches chen po mi byed/ gang ltar dus yun ring bo zhig la kho tsho rus rgyud dang tsho khag gcig la'ang mi gtogs pas/248

lam/'ching grol yar sngon la mgon skyabs byed mkhan med par ma zad/ tsho ba gzhan dang 'dra bar khral dang 'u lag sna tshogs kyang sprod sa med/ skabs der sde ba deng skabs las kyang dbul bas/ dud khyim rnams kyis lung mdo'i nags gseb tu sdong skam dang g.ya' ma'i spyil bu sna tshogs brtsigs te dbyar gsum gyi char ba dang dgun gsum gyi grang ngar 'gog thabs byas/khyim tshang mang che bar rta re dang bo'u re las med la/ sgo na rta nor bcu tsam yod pa ni phyug po gter bdag cig la brtsis yod/ skyes ma byis pa rnams kyis sa zhing lag mthil tsam re mchis pa de 'debs pa dang / skyes pa dpa' bo rnams kyis rkun jag 'phrog gsum byed pa/ dpa' med snar ma rnams kyis ri dwags rngon pa ni ri sde 'di'i 'tsho stangs shig yin la/ kho tshos rang nyid kyi 'tsho stangs de 'os mthun gyi las bgos shig la brtsis nas mi rabs nas mi rabs la mkhregs 'dzin byas pa na/ thams cad de la goms te 'tsho stangs gzhan zhig yid la 'char mi srid/ sngon chad mnyam las khang btsugs rjes/ skyes pa rnams kyi phrag gi me mda' gzhung bzhes byas te zhing las gnyer du bcug pa na/ sde ba'i pho mo rgan gzhon thams cad kha skyengs te skyes pa zhig gis zhing 'debs srid dam zhes 'khang ra byas pa dang / skyes pa la la zhing las gnyer bar ngo gnong ste rang srog bcad byung la/ a khu rgya mtsho'i pha rgan yang de'i nang gi gcig yin/a khu rgya mtsho'i pha rgan gyi ming la klu skyabs gla kha zer zhing / mi pho de 249

'tshub ma kher rkyang /ni glang chen snyon pa'i shugs yar mnyam pa'i dpa' bo do med cig yin la/kho rang rkun jag 'phrog gsum dang khyad par du jag la ha cang dga' bas/rang nyid kyi tshe stod rta rgyab nas phar bskyal mod/ rjes su jag la mngags pa'i bu che 'bring gnyis ka dgra lag la shor ba na/ ci zhig la 'gyod bshags byed bzhin tshong lam pha rol gyi nyin ngos nas thar mdo'i ma ṇi zhig bskor te dge rtsa la 'bad pa'i zhor du/ phangs sems chen po dang bcas tshong lam phra mo brgyud pa'i tshong ba rnams las lam rin tsam blangs te 'tsho ba rol ba na/sde ba'i rkun ma jag pa rnams kyang kho'i pha rgan gyi 'tsho stangs de la yid smon skyes te snga gzhug tu tshong lam phra mo de nas rtswa rin chu rin dang lam rin sogs len pa'i khral sgar du ma btab mod/ klu skyabs gla khas lam rin gzhan la sprad pa'i tshong dpon rnams kyi lag nas lam rin sngar las mang po blangs te rjes su lam rin gzhan la sprad na/ de'i mgo skogs blangs te chab to byed nges yin/mi ces 'jigs snang skul ba na/ tshong ba rgyus yod rnams kyis gzhan la dngul rdog gcig kyang mi sprod la/ khral len pa rnams kyis kyang rtswa rin lam rin btsan 'phrog byas na/ klu skyabs gla kha la zhe 'khon byung ste rgol lan sprod pa yin snyam ste/ phangs sems dang bcas jag dang rngon pa'i las la mi rol ka med byung /pho lo bco lngar son pa nas bzung / a khu rgya mtsho pha rgan gyi rjes su 'brangs te tshong lam srung mgo brtsams/ kho la a pa'i dpa' dang dpung 250

—lam/shugs de 'dra gtan nas med rung / kha lce bde ba dang blo rig ha cang rgod pas/ lam rin len skabs gang la gang mthun gyi gnas lugs dang rgyu mtshan re bshad pa na/ yong 'bab pha rgan las bzang zhing / tshong dpon rnams kyis kyang ji 'dra'i byis pa rig bzang zhig zer nas bstod bsngags yang yang byed pa dang / kho rang la gtam gleng dang 'brel 'dris byed pa ni spro snang ldan pa'i bya bzhag cig la brtsis yod/ kho dang thog lam rin len par 'gro skabs pha rgan gyis btsan khrid byas pa yin mod/ rjes su bya ba la byang cha byung ba dang gzhan gyis bstod rar yid smon byas pa dang bstun nas/thog mar spro snang ci yang med pa'i las ka de nyin mo'i dran gzhi dang mtshan mo'i mi lam gyi grub cha gal chen zhig tu gyur/ shar ba 'ching grol byas rjes/srid gzhung gis lam rin len pa'i goms srol de gtan 'gog byas pa dang /sngar gyi tshong lam phra mo de je drang je yangs su btang ste nags lam du bsgyur ba na/ a khu rgya mcho'i sems la sdug bsngal gyi zug gzer chen po zhig byung ste/ nam rgyun ci zhig bor ba ltar 'dug mi bzod par gyur/ lhag par nags lam nas rlangs 'khor sna tshogs the tshom bkag 'gog med par shar gtong byas pa na/ sems gting nas za 'phrug cig langs te nags 'gram la rgyug 'dod skyes mod/ srid jus dang sgrig lam btsan pas/ lag pa 'phur 'phur byed bzhin 'u thug pa'i dngan pa ring bo re 'ben pa las thabs bkod ci yang med/ 'gan gtsang len gyi lam lugs lag bstar byas 251

'tshub ma kher rkyang /rjes/ nags lam bkag ste lam rin len pa'i srol de btsugs pa na/ kho'i sems gting gi sdug bsngal de gar song cha med du gyur te/ nam rgyun ma ṇi khang gi sgo 'gram la yong ste spro snang chen po dang bcas ltad mor lta ba yin/skabs rer gsar bu rnams kyis nags lam gyi rlangs 'khor bkag ste lam rin yid tshims pa zhig lon na/ dga' spro dpag med skyes te myur stabs kyis mchong lding byed 'dod skyes pa dang / mtshams rer tshig gi bshad stangs dang thabs jus bkol lugs 'phyugs te sgor mo nyung ngu tsam las ma lon na/ kho gsar bu rnams kyi gras su zhugs te yin lugs kyi skad cha mgo rnga tshang ba zhig bshad nas/ lam rin yid tshims pa zhig len 'dod skyes mod/ rgan pa nga 'dra zhig gi sbyor ba de 'dra spel na gzhan gyis mi 'phya'am snyam ste rang tshugs bzung nas mi 'dug ka med byung zhes bshad/ spyir shar ba ri sde la mtshon na/ a khu rgya mtsho ni don gyi snga phyi kun la bsam gzhig byed shes pa'i rgan po rig bzang zhig yin pa dang / lhag par khos rang sems gzhan la mi ston par ma zad/ dga' spro chags sdang ga 'dra byung rung btsan shugs kyis gzhan gyis mi rtogs par byed pas/ nags lam du don dag ga 'dra byung rung ci mi snyam pa'i tshul 'chos dang bcas phreng ba gtong bzhin kha brda byed pa las/ lam rin la yid 'jog byas yod pa'i nyams snang spu tsam yang mi ston/mi nyi ma dus ltar btsan rgod nyag chen gyi la rtser 'gos te dal bur 252

lam/mkha' la 'phags pa na/ 'khyag sib sib byed pa'i mkha' dbugs de je dror gyur pa dang / shar khog lung ba'i drod grangs rim gyis 'phel te/ mi la yid sems skyid cing lus khams dwangs pa'i snang ba ster/ skabs 'dir/tshe ring gis dros 'khyag gi skyid sdug spo bo'i g.yogs ma la re mi dgos/ ci zhig glo bur du dran pa ltar myur stabs kyis yar langs te/ bag leb za 'phro cung tsam lus 'dug pa de ma ṇi khang gi dra mig khar bzhag rjes/ thog mar mchong ma lding gis g.yon 'gram gyi gdong gar 'gos te/ gad pa skya ring gting phyogs kyi rgya lam la lta tsam byas rjes ci yang mi mthong zhes bshad pa dang / de nas mchong lding byed bzhin g.yas 'gram gyi gdong gar 'gos te shar khog lung phu la lta tsam byas te spo bo/ ci yang mi mthong zhes ki rgyangs tsam byas rjes/ rdung len snyan mo zhig dbyangs rta la bkug ste sus kyang mi go ba'i glu dbyangs shig len bzhin spo bo'i phyogs la gom kha bsgyur/ kho ma ṇi khang gi nye 'gram du slebs la nye dus/ glo bur du sa nas rdo log cig blangs te khong khro chen po dang bcas mi ngan khyi 'dra 'di/ ngas khyod kyi gson snying bton te khyi la ster/ gson khrag bton te bdud la sdud/mi ces sdigs dmed byed bzhin rdo de shugs kyis g.yugs rjes/ mi mang gis khor bkag 'dug pa'i tshul gyis snang ma 'dzin/ ngas mi ngan 'di'i gson snying 'don ’zer bzhin g.yas lding g.yon lding yud tsam byas pa dang / de nas su zhig gi lag nas sgor mo blangs te lan 'gar rtsis pa'i nyams shig bstan rjes song /253

'tshub ma kher rkyang /de ring tshe thar la btang ba yin ces bshad pa'i tshul de mthong bas a khu rgya mtsho la spro snang zad mi shes pa zhig byung ste/ tsha bos mu mthud du gsar bu rnams kyis lam rin len par lad mo byas nas/ rtsed mo sna tshogs 'khrab ston byas na ci ma rung snyam mod/ tshe ring gis sgor mo legs par brtsis te am phrag tu bcug rjes/ slar yang sus kyang mi go ba'i glu dbyangs shig len bzhin zhabs bro 'khrab pa na/ a khu rgya mtsho'i sems pa stong sang nger song ba dang bstun nas slar yang brel ba langs mgo brtsams/ khos dus tshod dang rlangs 'khor kha lo pa rnams la le bda' byed bzhin yar langs te ska rags legs par bcings rjes/ ma ṇi khang gi g.yon 'gram gyi gdong la bud/gad pa skya ring mar gsham gyi rgya lam steng du rlangs 'khor che chung mang po shar gtong byed bzhin mchis mod/ nags lam la rlangs 'khor che chung gcig kyang ma zhugs pas/ khos nyi ma la lta tsam byas rjes phangs sems dang bcas dngan pa ring bo zhig 'ben pa dang / de nas lob phyogs kyis sa la tsog ste dmigs yul ci yang med par shar khog lung ba'i phu mda' bar gsum la lta dgos byung /shar khog ni mdo dbus mtho sgang gi lung ba dkyus ma zhig yin mod/shar ba'i mi rnams de la dung sems ha cang che/ lung ba 'di'i lung phu lho dang lung mdo byang la gtad yod cing lung 'phrang ni ha cang dog sngon chad luX sdu'i phu mda' bar gsum thams cad nags tshal yin med/ da skabs

lam/lung mdo nas bltas na sdong bo gcig kyang mi mthong bas/ mi rgyus med cig la mi lo lnga bcu'i snga rol tu lung ba 'di nags kyis khebs 'dug pa dang /shar ba ri sde nags gseb tu chags yod ces na yid ches byed mkhan ha cang nyung / lung phu nas bur la gya gyur 'bab bzhin yod pa'i gzhung chu de la shar chu zer zhing / shar chu dal gyis bzhur te lung mdor slebs pa na/ sa dbyibs dang bstun nas drag 'bab byas te 'bri chu'i klong la zhugs pa na/bzhur lam du grog rong gting zab pa zhig btod de shar khog lung mdo ru ma bu gnyis su bgos/ chu grog pha rol gyi ri sde de shar ba yin pa dang / tshur rol na sgur khang 'ga' phreng bar bsgrigs 'dug pa de ni shar ba yul tsho srid gzhung red/ da skabs shar chu la zam pa gsum yod mod/ zam pa zhol ma de gad pa gting phyogs kyi rgya lam log na yod pas/ sde mi rnams kyis de rang nyid dang 'brel ba ci yang med par snyam ste zam pa de zam pa zhig la'ang mi brtsi/ ri sde dang yul tsho srid gzhung bar gyi zam pa de spyir na shar chu'i zam pa bar ma yin mod/ mi rnams kyis de la zam pa zhol ma zhes 'bod kyin yod/ sngon chad shar khog na tshong lam de las gzhung lam gcig kyang med la/ 'ching grol byas rjes/ srid gzhung gis rang skyong khul nas zhing chen bar la gzhung lam zhig las pa dang / sde mi rnams kyis de la rgya lam zer/ de'i rjes su shar khog lung phu nas gzhung lam zhig las te rgya lam la mthud pa dang / lam de ni shing sdong 'drud lam byas pas mi rnams kyis 255

'tshub ma kher rkyang kyinags lam zhes 'bod/ yang de'i rjes su shar khog lung phu nas nags las khang zhig btsug te shing sdong bcad pa na/ nags lam gyi rlangs 'khor je mang nas je mang yin pa dang / nags tshal gyi gzhi khyon je chung nas je chung la song / yul tsho srid gzhung gong rol na zam pa chung chung zhig yod la/dbyar dus shar chu brug ste zam pa khur na/ rlangs 'khor mang po gnas der khegs te nyin mtshan 'ga' la 'gro mi thub/ sngon chad zam pa khur te shing sdong skyel 'dren la bar chad byung na/ shar ba mang tshogs kyis bzo zhing khyim gcig yin zer nas zam pa ga dus khur na de'i dus bskyar las byed pa yin/'gan gtsang len gyi lam lugs lag bstar byas te sa zhing sger la bgos rjes/ mi rnams kyi bsam blo gtong stangs dang 'tsho ba rol stangs la 'gyur ldog byung ste/ zam pa khur na yul tsho srid gzhung gis mang tshogs rtsa 'dzug byed mi thub cing / mang tshogs kyis kyang bzo zhing khyim gcig yin pa gtan nas brjed 'dug skabs der/ shar khog nags las khang 'u thug ste zam pa bskyar rtsig byas pa'i mang tshogs la gla yon nyung tsam byin pa na/ kho tsho dga' ste dbyar zla gsum la shar chu brug par re sgug byas nas bsdad yod/rgyu mtshan ni/ shar ba sde mis bzo zhing khyim gcig yin pa brjed pa dang bstun nas/ skyes pa rnams kyis slar yang zhing las gnyer ba de ngo tsha chen po zhig la brtsis byung / 'on kyang / da skabs gcig na sngar ltar jag la 'gro mi chog pa dang / gnyis su nye 'khor gyi ri dwags rnams zas mug byung ba'i 256

lam/lo de dag la bsad tshar te ri bong zhig kyang mi lus pas/ skyes pa rnams khom ste ci zhig las dgos pa'ang mi shes par gyur pa dang / bud med dang byis pa rnams kyis thon skyed byas pa'i 'bru rigs nyung ngu des zas gos kyi gnad don thag gcod byed mi thub/ der brten/ shar chu'i zam pa gong ma de kho tsho'i 'tsho rten gal chen zhig tu gyur/ rjes su zam pa bskyar rtsig byas par kha g.yar nas/ kha lo pa rnams kyi lag nas las gla blangs pa na/ sde mi rnams kyi yong 'bab nyin bzhin je mang la song / shar khog nags las khang gis kho tsho'i las phyogs de khrims mthun lugs mthun zhig min pa shes mod/gcig na rang nyid kyis ma dngul gtong mi dgos pa dang / gnyis su shing sdong skyel 'dren la'ang bar chad med pas/ kha lo pa rnams 'u thug ste zhu gtug ga 'dra byas rung do snang spu tsam yang mi byed/ mi'i bsam pa rgya yan du btang na/ las mi spobs pa gcig kyang med zer ba ha cang bden la/de'i rjes su sde mi zhig gis a khu rgya mtsho'i pha rgan la lad mo byas te/ ma ṇi khang gi mar gsham du khral sngar zhig btab ste nags lam la zhugs pa'i kha lo pa rnams las 6lam rin migayo len byas pa na/ sde mi thams cad nags lam la rub yong ste lam rin blangs pas/ kha lo pa dang mang tshogs bar la 'gal ba byung ba dang / sde mi dang sde mi bar la rtsod gzhi byung ste/ ma ṇi khang gi mar gsham ni phyi 'khrug dang nang 'khrug gi dbye ba med pa'i g.yul sa chung chung zhig tu gyur/ sde ba'i mgo khrid dang lo lon rgan pa rnams kyis ngang 257

'tshub ma kher rkyang /tshul de mthong rjes 'jigs snang chen po zhig skyes byung la/ gal srid las phyogs 'di la bkag 'gog ma byas na rjes su shi rkyen god chag 'byung ba'i nyen kha yod pa dang / lhag par gong rim gyis bka' bkyon gnang na shar chu zam pa gong ma'i lam rin de'ang shor 'gro/ 'on kyang / deng skabs kyi mang tshogs gras na mgo khrid la khas len tshig brtsi byed mkhan ha cang nyung bas/thams cad ma ṇi khang gi mar gsham la 'dzoms te rgyu nor g.yo 'phrog ma byed ces brjod na sus kyang dang len mi byed/ kho tshos bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis dang blo rtse nyi shu rtsa lnga bkol rjes/ shar chu zam pa dang ma ṇi khang mar gsham gyi nags lam gnyis so so khyim tshang gcig gis nyin re la srung ba dang /ma ṇi khang mar gsham gyi nags lam srung skabs/ blo gros kyi rtsal la brten nas lam rin len pa ma gtogs sgor mo btsan 'phrog dang mi la gcar rdung byas mi chog ces khyab sgrog byas pa na/ sde mi thams cad de la yid 'thad byung ste ya ya legs so zer bzhin ngo so bstad/nags lam la rlangs 'khor gcig kyang ma zhugs rung / nyi ma'i 'phags tshad la gzhigs na rlangs 'khor slebs pa'i dus la son pas/ a khu rgya mtsho dal bur yar langs te ma ṇi khang gi phyogs la gom kha bsgyur/ tsha bo tshe ring gis a bra zhig bzung ste spen ma'i sna gcu dang skud pa'i sna thug sprad nas ma ṇi khang gi g.yon 'gram na yar 'drud mar 'drud byed bzhin mchis la/ khos spo bo slebs byung ba rtogs rjes 'dzum dmul dmul gyis 258

lam/ngas a bra 'di bzung bas/ de ring nas bzung nga ge sar du gyur pa yin nam zhes dris/ a khu rgya mtshos kho la tshig lan yid tshims pa zhig ster bsam mod/ zhib tu bsam na jo rus a bra bsad pa dang tsha bos a bra bzung ba'i dbye ba ji 'dra'i zhib cing rgyas pa zhig bshad rung / kho lo bdun la ma gtogs son med pas gtan nas go ba mi lon snyam ste/ ci yang mi bshad par brtse ba'i 'dzum mdangs shig bstan pa na/ tshe ring gis rang nyid la bden kha byin song bsams te nga ge sar du gyur/ nga ge sar du gyur zer bzhin dga' spro chen pos mchong lding byas pas/ yid 'jog ma byas par a bra'i sna gcu bcag byung ba dang / khos rang gi lag na ras skud nyag ma gcig las med pa rtogs dus/ a bra snga mo nas bros te ab khung zhig la 'dzul song /6 spo bo/ nga'i a bra/’ ra ma shes/ ma rig ca nga ge sar du 'gyur ma thub pa red/mi tsha bo tshe ring gis de ltar bshad rjes sems sdug nas ngu rgyangs byas/a khu rgya mtshos rtsal dgu bton te dgod bro ba'i kha mtshar sna tshogs bshad pa na/ tsha bo tshe ring gis da gzod ngu mtshams bzhag mod/ rang nyid a thang chad de dpral ngos rgyal chus brlan 'dugasna spo bo spo bo/ slebs byung /mi 259

'tshub ma kher rkyang / 6ci zhig slebs byung / ’ca/a pha ༷ ma dang a khu rnams mi.a khu rgya mtsho'i bu dang mag pa rnams kyis sgye mo 'khur te shar chu zam pa brgyud nas tshur yong bzhin mchis/ kho tshos gom pa re re ljid tig tig tu spo bzhin yod par gzhigs na/ mi re'i rgyab na nas snye re khur yod pa rtogs thub/ tshul de mthong bas/ a khu rgya mtshos gsang bdag gis thabs jus ga 'dra bkod de lam rin len rgyu yin pa rtogs song / tshe ring gis a ma'ang slebs byung zer ba min nam/ ngas mi rig pa ci yin/ 'owa wamo bu dang mag pa rnams kyi rgyab phyogs na yod pas/ mgo dkri tsam las mi mthong /a khu rgya mtsho la bu lnga dang bu mo gnyis yod la/ khos snga gzhug tu bu mo gnyis ka gnas la byin pa dang / bu rnams la dus ltar chung ma bsus te khyim gzhi gsar ba re bsgrigs rjes/ rang nyid bu tha chung gsang bdag gi khyim mi byas yod/ da skabs gsang bdag gi byis pa gnyis ka da dung chung rung / gzhan pa rnams kyi byis pa mang shas nar son 'dug pas/ bu spun rnams dpung sdong byas na nags lam srung thub mod/ ma ṇi khang mar gsham gyi nags lam 'gog pa de da skabs srid jus gi las la gtogs pas/ a khu rgya mtshos bsam gzhig yang yang byas rjes/ shar chu zam pa srung dus byis pa rnams mngags na rung mod/ ma ṇi khang gi nags lam de la bu dang mag pa rnams las byis pa bsam shes gcig kyang btud mi chog pa'i bka' mchid 260

bsgragasayod lam/kho tsho nags lam 'gram la slebs ma thag mna' ma g.yang mtshos myur mor lag gi tsha dem dang rgyab kyi sbya chang sar bzhag ste/ myur stabs kyis phu bo rnams dang khyo ga'i rgyab kyi nas sgye gcig 'phror gcig mthud kyis blangs te sa la bzhag pa na/ gsang bdag gis am phrag las tha mag blangs te mi re la dud rkang gcig re byin te gus gus byams byams kyis me bgos/a khu rgya mtsho'i bu bu mo dang mag pa rnams ni gnyen la then pa dang che bkur chung byams kyi goms srol can skor zhig yin la/ khyim tshang gcig la las ka yod na thams cad 'dzoms te mnyam las byed pa dang / khyim tshang gcig la dka' ngal byung na/ che chung kun gyis rang don zhig la brtsis te dka' ngal sel thabs byed pa yin/ lhag par ma ṇi khang gi mar gsham du lam rin len pa de ni dpung shugs mkho ba'i las ka zhig yin pas/ kho tsho las khyim tshang gang zhig lam srung la babs kyang / tshang ma dus ltar grogs su yong nges yin/ ltos dang / de ring a khu rgya mtsho'i bu tha chung gsang bdag gis lam srung ba'i nyi ma yin mod/ bu dang mag pa rnams gcig kyang ma lus par slebs 'dug6 a pha/ rlangs 'khor e yong ngam/’ gsang bdag gis ma ṇi khang sgo 'gram na tsog 'dug pa'i a pha la de ltar dris/6 a pha/ gcig kyang ma yong /mi tshe ring gis spo bo'i kha phrogs te de 261

'tshub ma kher rkyang /skad bshad/6 'o na 'grig 'dug mna' ma g.yang mtsho 'dzum dmul dmul byed bzhin ma ṇi khang gi sgo 'gram la yong ste tsha dem sa la bzhag rjes/ thog mar mgo dkri blangs te sa la btings pa dang / de nas rum gyi dkar yol dang mar rtsam blangs te steng du bzhag rjes/ byang cha yod pa'i sgo nas a pha dang tshe ring gnyis la nangs ja drangs/ skabs der rlangs 'khor gyi sgra zhig 'ur 'ur du grags pas/ mar gsham gyi lam srung ba rnams kyis lha chang 'thung mtshams bzhag ste yar langs pa dang / a khu rgya mtshos kyang dkar yol thang la bzhag nas spro sems dang bcas sgug nas bsdad/ ma gzhir nags lam la zhugs pa ni pe cin 06bzhig yin la/ phyi shun gyi kha dog dang klad kyi glog sgron dmar po la gzhigs na sbyangs 'khor de nags las mngag gtong khang gi yin pa rtogs pas 'gog ma dan/ngas 'khor slebs pa'i dus la son pa dang bstun nas/ sde ba'i skyes pa rnams skor dang skor byas te ma ṇi khang gi g.yon 'gram nas ri ngos la 'gos pa dang / yul tsho srid gzhung gi las byed pa rnams ma ṇi khang gi g.yas 'gram nas ri ngos la 'gos byung la/ sde ba'i gsar bu re gnyis la ri mgor 'go ba'i cha rkyen med pas nags lam du yong nas bsdad pa dang / a khu lha mchog dang skyabs lo/ jo mo kha sho ma gsum ga'ang ri ngos la 'gos 262

lam/rung las ka ci yang med pas sngar bzhin ma ṇi khang gi sgo 'gram la yong nas sa la tsog sngar yin na a khu bdud 'dul yang kho tsho'i gras na yod mod/ de ring kho tshang zam srung yin pas de la bud song /ma ṇi khang gong rol gyi gdong kha na 'du ra gong 'og gnyis yod la/'du ra zhol ma la dmangs kyi 'du ra zer zhing / sngon dus de ni shar ba sde mis dbyar dus skyid skyid gtong sa yin mod/ nags lam srung ste yong 'bab cung zad byung ba nas bzung / skyes pa rnams nam rgyun de la 'dzoms te/ rgyan 'dzugs zhor du chang 'thung ste nyi ma lde sa zhig tu gyur/ 'du ra bong ma ni yul tsho srid gzhung gi las byed pa 'du sa yin pas/ mi rnams kyis de la dpon gyi 'du ra zhes 'bod kyin gda'/ sngon chad las byed pa rnams ri mgor 'go ba'i srol de med mod/ shar ba sde mis nags lam srung ba'i srol de btsugs pa nas bzung / gzhung las khang nas gzhung don sgrub thabs med pas/ ri la mi 'gro thabs med byung / kha lo pa rnams kyis mang kha nyung ngus ma lon par lam rin sprad rjes/ khong khro dang bcas yul tsho srid gzhung la song ste zhu gtug byed pa yin/ skabs der/ mgo khrid pas kho tshor snyan zhing 'jibs pa'i rdzun gtam re bshad de kha lo pa rnams mngags thabs byed pa las thabs bkod ci yang med/ 'gan gtsang len byas rjes/ mang tshogs khrod du gong rim gyi kha len tshig brtsi byed mkhan nyung bas/ zhi ba'i thabs kyis bkag 'grog byas na grub 'bras ci yang med/ gal srid btsan 263

'tshub ma kher rkyang /shugs kyis bkag 'gog byas na kho tshos srid gzhung la drag shugs kyis ngo rgol byed mi srid mod/ rjes su mgo khrid 'dems skabs dpon po 'di tsho dmangs la rtsub zer nas 'dem shog gcig kyang mi 'phen/ de 'dra'i don rkyen yul tsho gang mang nas byung myong / kho tshos rang nyid kyi go sa sra brtan du gtong ched mang tshogs rgya yan du gtong ba dang kha lo pa rnams la gzha' thabs gzur thabs byed dgos byung / lhag par ma ṇi khang gi mar gsham du lam rin len mgo brtsams rjes/ yul tsho srid gzhung ni nam rgyun kha lo pas rngam ston byed sa zhig tu gyur pas/ las byed pa rnams gzhung las khang nas 'dug thabs bral te/ dgun dus rang rang gi mal khang du 'dzul te kha rog ger sbas 'dug pa dang / dbyar dus ri ngos la bros te gzhung don ri nas bsgrubs pa na 'du ra gong ma de byung song /shar khog lung mdo nas shar rlung rtags can gyi rlangs 'khor zhig lam la zhugs te sa rdul skya 'tshub 'tshub byed bzhin ma ṇi khang gi mar gsham du slebs pa na/ gsang bdag lam dkyil du langs te rlangs 'khor bkag6 a khu kha lo pa/ ngas me ru dgon la za ma nyung tsam 'drud dgos mod/yul 'dir rlangs 'khor dkon pas 'drud thabs ma byung / nyid kyis 'o brgyal myong rogs/mi gsang bdag mgo sgam gyi them skas steng la bud de de ltar bshad/264kha lo pa ni gsar bu lo nyung zhig yin la/ khos rang rlom dang bcas

lam/mi khom mi 'drud zer lugs la gzhigs na/ shar khog gi yul srol la cha rgyus ci yang med pa 'dra/ gsang bdag gis tshul de rtogs pas/ mi pho 'di nyid la khong khro bslangs na kha g.yar sa dang khag 'jog sa legs po zhig rnyed nges red snyam ste/ skabs rer 'u thug pa'i tshul 'chos kyis zhu ba byed pa dang /mtshams rer gnas lugs med pa'i 'chal gtam kho na brjod pa na/ kha lo pa la zhe snang chen po langs te/ mgo sgam gyi sgo mo shugs kyis phyes ste gsang bdag sa la g.yugs rjes glog sgo phyes nas 'gro grabs byas/ gsang bdag sa la 'gyel ma thag 'phongs tshos dang g.yas lag gru mgo la thug gzer zhig langs mod/ kho myur stabs kyis yar langs zhor du rdo log cig blangs te shugs kyis brgyab pa na/ rdo de yo gzur ci yang med par mgo sgam gyi sgo la phog pas khrog sgra chom sgra chen po grags/ khrog sgra chom sgra de dang lhan du kha lo pa hrig ste ci dran 'di dran med par gyur la/ kho rang gi dran pa sos dus/gsang bdag skyes pa gnyis kyis bkag 'dug na'ang khong khro chen pos g.yas lding g.yon lding byed bzhin tsangs mi ngan 'di'i gson snying bton te khyi la ster zhes ag rgyangs byed bzhin yod la/ mi mang rlangs 'khor 'gram la rub ste bros rung thar lam med par byas 'dug kho la ci byed 'di byed kyi 'char sgo med pa'i skabs der skyes pa stobs chen zhig gis dal lhod kyis mgo sgam gyi g.yon sgo phyes te kho sa la drud/4 khyod la gdug rtsub 'di 'dra gang nas byung /’ 265

'tshub ma kher rkyang /6 nga 'phyugs song / nga 'phyugs song / kha lo pa skrag nas lus kun lhab lhab 'dar gyin gda'/dri 'phyugs 'dug pa shes sam/ mi skyes pa des gzab nan gyis de ltar sa/ rgyu los shes/ nga smyos song ba red/ mi kha lo pas de ltar bshad rjes g.yas g.yon la lta tsam byas pa na/ mi rnams khros te la las khu tshur la 'phur 'phur byed bzhin am gcigs bsdams 'dug pa dang / la las gzhung lam g.yas g.yon na rdo btu bzhin 'dug pas/ de ring shi lam las gson lam zhig mi 'dug snyam byung /kha lo pa sar drud pa'i skyes pa de ni gsang bdag gi phu bo che ba yin la/sngon chad nags las khang nas yun ring la bsdad pas/ rgya skad yag po zhig bshad shes par ma zad/ bzo ba rkyal stong rnams dang 'grogs te g.yo sgyu khram gsum spel lugs la'ang sbyong ba cung zad byas yod/ khos gsar bu lo nyung de skrag nas ci byed 'di byed med pa mthong bas/ sems dang bsam pa'i gting nas rgyal kha thob pa'i spro snang zhig byung mod/ gdong la 'u thug pa'i nyams snang bcos ma zhig bsdus te kha lo pa mi mang gi mtha' la khrid rjes/ 6bod rigs la mtshon na rta thog nas mar drud pa de las brnyas bcos chen po zhig med la/ da skabs rlangs 'khor steng nas sar g.yug pa de'ang rta thog nas drud pa dang 'dra bas/ khyod de ring 'di nas thar thabs byed pa ni 266

wa lam/las sla mo zhig gtan nas ma yin zer nas 'jigs pa bslangs rje(mi /6 gal srid chag sgo bar chad med par 'gro 'dod yod na/ sgor mo sum brgya bsgyur nas song dang / ngas kho tshor gsol ston bshams te mthol gsol zhu zhes brjod pa na/ kha lo pa la thar lam 'tshol ba las 'char sgo ci yang med pas/ kho'i skad cha de go ma thag mig lam gsal lam mer song ste/ 'dar sig sig byed bzhin am phrag las sgor brgya shog can gsum blangs te kho la byin pa dang / de nas slar yang ci zhig dran pa ltar tha mag rkang gcig blangs te phul rjes myur mor me bgos/ skabs der gsang bdag gi phu bos kha nas du ba sngo lhog lhog byed bzhin sgor mo bstan te ya/ chog gi chog gilam rin lon thal/ khor lam la mngags rogs zhes bshad pa na/ gsang bdag gis sngar bzhin mi ngan 'di'i gson snying 'don dgos zhes g.yas lding g.yon lding byas mod/ mi gzhan rnams yid 'thad min mod bya thabs bral ba'i tshul 'chos ston bzhin gzhung lam g.yas g.yon la bkyed pas/ kha lo pas lag rdo la yid 'jog byed bzhin mgo sgam nang la 'dzul te myur mor rlangs 'khor la kha lo sgyur bzhin bros song la/ gsang bdag dang bar bshol mkhan gnyis ga'ang a thang chad de snga gzhug tu sa la tsog mi rnams rlangs 'khor rjes kyi sa rdul la cer nas yud tsam la bsdad rjes/ gsang bdag gi mtha' bskor te rmas skyon byung min sogs dris/ skabs shig la su zhig gis gsang bdag gi 'phongs tshos kyi rin gong mtho ba la ang thang 267

'tshub ma kher rkyang /la lan gcig brgyab na sgor mo sum brgya zhes brjod pa na/ mi rnams 'ur chil ler bgad byung /bu dang mag pa rnams kyis rgyal kha chen po de 'dra blangs pa na/ a khu rgya mtsho la dga' spro 'dug mi bzod pa zhig skyes mod/ gdong la nyams snang ci yang med pa'i mdangs shig shar 'dug skabs shig la a khu lha mchog gis ci zhig dran pa ltar kha sang bdud 'dul tshang gis nyin hril bor sgor mo nyis brgya las ma lon mod/ khyo da tshang gis rlangs 'khor gcig las sgor mo sum brgya blangs zhes bshad pa na/ a khu rgya mtsho la thog mar dga' spro zhig skyes pa dang / denas bsam blo yud tsam la btang rjes khos rang nyid bdul 'dul la sdur bzhin yod pa rtogs pas/ brnyas bcos thebs pa'i dran tshul zhig byung ba dang bstun nas khong khro langs mod/ kha nas ci yang mi bshad par mgo bo g.yas la bskyos nas kha rog ger bsdad/de'i rjes rlangs 'khor gcig yong la/ kha lo pa ni shar khog la cha rgyus can zhig yin pas/ rlangs 'khor bkag ma thag myur mor sgor mo lnga bcu blangs te grogs po rnam pa/ bde mo/ 'di khyed cag gi legs skyes tsam yin mices bshad rjes/ sgor mo bzung yod pa'i g.yon lag dra mig phyi la bsrings pa na/ gsang bdag gis dogs mi bde ba'i ngang nas sgor mo de blangs rjes/ gus gus byams byams kyis khor lam la mngags/yang de'i rjes su rlangs 'khor gcig yong ba'i kha lo pa ni mi po gtum 268

lam/po zhig yin la/ kho'i lag nas sgor mo chig brgya btsan 'phrog byas pa na/kho yul tsho srid gzhung la song ste mgo khrid yun ring la btsal rung mi gcig kyang ma rnyed pas/ khong khro chen pos rlangs 'khor la kha lo bsgyur te lam la chas/ kho shar chu zam khar slebs dus slar yang lam rin rim pa gcig blangs pa na/ zhe sdang langs te glo mchin yang gas 'gro ba 'dra/skabs der/ mna' ma g.yang mtshos ma ṇi khang gi grib gzugs la gzhigs te nyin gung la son pa rtogs pas/ tsha dem bzung ste za ma g.yo skol byed par song /nyin gung yol ba dang bstun nas/ shar gyi char sprin rim gyis nub la ldang bas/ nyi ma'i 'od zer char sprin smug pos btums te/ ljang ldem ldem byed pa'i ri lung 'khyag sib be btang ba na/ tsha smug chen pos dab dib tu bsgyur 'dug pa'i mi rnams la yid sems skyid cing lus khams dwangs pa'i snang ba byung mod/ a khu rgya mtsho'i bu dang mag pa rnams la mtshon na/sems dang bsam pa'i gting nas 'char bkod ma 'grub pa'i tsha smug cig langs te/ nyi 'od sprin gyis btums pa de las skyid snang ci yang ma byung /nam rgyun yin na/ phyi dro nags lam du shar gtong byed pa'i rlangs 'khor ha cang mang mod/ de ring yar 'gro gsum dang mar yong bzhi las ma byung /kho tshos skabs rer nas snye de rnams stod la 'drud dgos pa dang / mtshams rer smad la skyel nas rlangs 'khor bkag ste glags btsal ba na/ sgor mo 269

'tshub ma kher rkyang /bdun brgya lhag las ma rnyed/ 'di sde ba'i khyim tshang la lar mtshon na yong 'bab 'bor chen zhig yin rung / kho tshang gi sngar gyi yong sgo dang sdur na rgyu g.yang ma 'khor/ gnas tshul de 'dra byung bas/ a khu rgya mtshos kyang yid 'jog byed ma thub par gdong la skyo nyams shig bsdus 'duganags lam la zhugs pa'i rlangs 'khor ji 'dra nyung rung / nyi ma la spro nyams sdug nyams ci yang med par sprin rum brgyud nas nub phyogs kyi mkha' mtha' la son pas/ ri ngos kyi sde mi rnams skor dang rim pa byas te ma ṇi khang gi g.yon 'gram nas mar babs byung / kho tsho lasagazhon nu la la bzi nas ra ror gyur te/ gzhan gyis skyor yod rung gom pa gar spo 'di spo med par thur la 'gro bzhin yod pa dang / la la dga' ste 'dzum dmul dmul byed/ la la sdug ste mgo bo'ang dud 'dug la/ mi mang po la spro sdug gi nyams snang ci yang med rung / a thang chad de mgo bo dab dib tu gyur 'dugam ṇi khang gi sgo 'gram na tsog yod pa'i rgan po rnams kyis kho tsho'i ngo mdangs la brtags te de ring rgyan 'dzugs byas te su zhig gis rgyal kha blangs pa dang /su zhig gis phan kha nyos pa gsal bor rtogs song /slob grwa grol ba na/ tshe ring gi phu bo mgon po slob grogs 'ga' dang mnyam du ma ṇi khang la slebs byung /mgon po ni shar khog slob chung lo rim gsum pa'i slob ma yin la/ kho byis pa rig bzang zhig yin pas/ a khu rgya mtshos nam rgyun gces gces 270

dungs dungs byed bzhin yod/ 'on kyang nyelamakhosartagatu nagasaX// srung ba de bya spyod tha shal ba zhig yin tshul bshad pas/ spo bos kho sems khong nas dor te/ tshe ring la dungs sems chen pos gces skyong byed mgo brtsams/4 mgon po/ lam rin len par song / gsar bu zhig rgan po rnams dang lhan 'dug byas nas ci bya/mi a khu lha mchog gis ku re'i tshul du de ltar bshad/6 min/ nga mi 'gro/ dge rgan gyis bshad na lam rin len pa de ni bya ba tha shal ba zhig yin la/ nga tsho mi rabs rjes ma rnams kyis rig pa legs par sbyangs te/ pha yul la dpal yon gnyis ldan gyi mdun lam yid du 'ong ba zhig gsar gtod byed dgos/mi der yod lo lon rgan pa rnams kyis skad cha de go ma thag sems gting nas khong khro skyes byung / kho tshos lam rin len pa de deng skabs khrims mthun zhig min pa shes rung / bya ba de sbyor ba tha shal ba zhig la gtan nas brtsis med/ 'on kyang dpal yon zung dang mdun lam gsar gtod sogs la go ba ci yang ma lon pas/ sus kyang bden cog cog gi dgag lan ni sprod ma thub/ smyo skad cha de dge gon su sa bshad pa yin/ mi skabs shig la a khu rgya mtshos ci zhig dran pa ltar de skad dris/271

'tshub ma kher rkyang / 6dge rgan bsam 'phel gyis bshad pa red/ kho 'dir yong nas zla gcig lhag las ma 'gor bas/ khyim bdag mang che bas ngo mi shes/mi slob ma zhig gis de ltar bshad/a khu lha mchog gis tshig de go ba na/ khong khro dang bcas yar langs te phreng ba gtong bzhin g.yas 'gro g.yon 'gro byas/ skabs shig la/ khos ci zhig dran pa ltar phreng ba rum la 'jug zhor du sar tsog ste/ nan nan tig tig gis dge rgan de mi tha shal ba zhig red/ khor sgyug thabs ma byas na byis pa rnams brlag rgyu red ces bshad pa na/ a khu skyabs lo dang jo mo kha sho ma gnyis nas bden pa'i brda la mgo bo ldem ldem byas/ a khu rgya mtshos rang gi tsha bo lam log la khrid bzhin yod par sems te/ dge rgan bsam 'phel sa cha gzhan la snag par yid 'thad byung mod/ rang gi bsam tshul de gzhan gyis mi rtogs par byed ched yin min gyi skad cha tshig gcig kyang mi bshad par dal cag ger 'dugaskabs shig la/ nub phyogs mkha' mtha' nas 'brug sgra gnam sa gas 'dra zhig grags byung bas/ a khu rgya mtsho gog ma nur gyis yar langs te nam mkha' la rgyang lta byas pa na/ dang thog shar nas nub la ldang ba'i char sprin de nub phyogs mkha' mtha' la spungs rjes/ ci zhig gis ded pa ltar nub nas shar la ldang mgo brtsams pa dang / sprin gyi rngams ka la gzhigs na char ba chen po 'bab rgyu yin pa thag gis chod/ khos rang tshang gis sang nyin shar 272

lam/chu zam pa srung dgos pa dang / char ba babs na rlangs 'khor mang po mi yong ba'i don dngos de dran pas/ khyim 'di'i rgyu g.yang shor 'dug snyam bzhin nags lam ngos la lta tsam byas pa na/ gsang bdag gis sdug nyams dang bcas char sprin la bltas 'dug pa mthong la/ ngo mdangs la gzhigs na khos kyang sang nyin gyi yong 'bab la sems khur byed bzhin yod pa rtogs thub/

mjug byang /〈'tshub ma kher rkyang〉nang gi sgrung gtam rnams ni bdag gi ches phul du byung ba'i sgrung gtam yin ces bshad mi phod mod/ gang ltar de dag ni nga ches dga' ba'i sgrung gtam skor zhig yin/ ci yin zhe na/ sgrung gtam de dag las bdag gis rang gi pha yul gyi kha sang dang de ring la yang yang brtags shing dpyad pa'i mtha' 'bras de sgyu rtsal gyi thabs lam brgyud nas bstan yod pas na/ sgrung gtam gyi brjod bya dang brjod snying nam yang rang gi snying khong rus pa'i gting na ri mo'i rnam par gnas yod pa dang / sgrung gtam de dag ni bdag gi mi tshe'i brgyud rim khrod kyi dga' ba dang skyo ba/ re ba dang smon 'dun ri mor bris nas byung ba yin pas/ bdag gi sems khams kyi 'gyur ldog dang bstun nas mi rigs shig gi 'das pa dang da lta'i bde sdug la gzugs ris skor zhig yod par gyur/der brten/ sgrung gtam de dag ni bdag gi sems khong gi gces nor du gyur pa yin/274

macag byang /nga srin po g.yu rngog dang nyi ma lha sa〉la dga'/ nga ra bha 'dre mig dang rin chen rkyal kha〉la dga'/ nga 'tshub ma kher rkyang//la dga'/ nga lam〉la dga'/ klog mkhan grogs po lags/ khyed cag la tshor ba ci zhig byung /〈'tshub ma kher rkyang〉nang gi sgrung gtam rnams la khyed cag ma dga' na/bdag ni ji ltar dga' rung dge mtshan chen po med/rtsom pa pos/2009 3275

deb phreng cas 'god pa/ bsod lo/rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pa/ tshe ring mkhar//shā dzo spya/ ṭā/ /sna ༵/ kāḥngachi rnyingahwa hwa/dus rabs21pa'i bod kyi rtsom pa po'i deb phreng /'anāshā /sa trīḥmajung /hāḥ// spe/ la/ mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang / zi 'grongakhog 0)ba da 'tshong / sna t+ta dpa lja 1/ kha par61426par 'debs/ mtsho sngon zi ling par khang //byi shā/ga/ stushāskumo17lo 1732/pa ཿtrīḥ/ //shālo'i zla par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/dpar mangs/ 2010lo'i zaḥpar dpar thengs gnyis pa dpar/dpar grangs/ 1501— sa hā nāgs/ 1sdu ga978—7—420—1 22—1na /kā /ra dbang 'a/ /dri pad pas par bshus brgyab na khrims chad pog(shog ngos chad nor slog skyon gang rung yod tshe par khang la dri gtug phyog
